Senior Technical Executive
description:
**Technical Executive**
**Account Management – Work Dynamics (region/country)**
**What this job involves:**
 Executing flawless technical activities
   

  

 As the go\-to person in all things technical, you’ll keep the Company up to speed on operating and utilities costs. Together with the building manager, you will monitor the invoices for technical services rendered. Aside from these, you’ll keep an eye out on the maintenance practices of our contractors to ensure that their scope of work is aligned with manufacturer recommendations and our own preventive maintenance standards.
   

  

 You’ll also oversee the repair and maintenance of cooling and heating systems, plumbing and water supply, electricity and lighting fixtures, and other equipment and supplies. Moreover, you’ll be in charge of performing routine inspection, inventory and documentation of these systems.
   

  

 Providing sound leadership to boost results
   

  

 Ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operation is a responsibility that requires impeccable leadership skills. You’ll demonstrate this by overseeing our electricians and their scope of work. You’ll also work closely with pretty much everyone across the board\-\-from superiors to peers and subordinates.
   

  

 Aside from our internal teams, you’ll also be the main point of contact for our vendors for all maintenance services. Churning out reports will also be part of your mandate. In this role, you’ll monitor our maintenance activities, and produce daily and weekly summary reports on these activities.
   

  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to have:**
 Technical competence like no other
   

  

 Working for a global real estate leader like JLL, you must demonstrate technical expertise that will help you go head\-to\-head with some of the industry’s most brilliant minds.
   

  

 Having said so, the ideal candidate must be a degree holder with at least three years’ experience in the field. Likewise, you must possess a strong working knowledge of policies, building maintenance and people management. Proven expertise in the principles and techniques of carpentry, electrical, plumbing, and general property management may also give you an edge in getting the job.
   

  

**What we can do for you:**
 At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
   

  

 Apply today!

description:
Gurgaon or Bangalore, India
   

  

 The Senior HR PMO \& AI Enablement Manager is accountable for translating the enterprise AI HR transformation strategy into remit\-specific workforce approaches and for shaping, deploying, and enabling their adoption across Claims, Legal \& Compliance, and Global Operations. As Senior Manager, you will be a driver of AI\-enabled initiatives, not just a project manager. You will draft playbooks, define KPIs, manage stakeholder alignment, and coordinate with the DPO, IT, and business units. You will serve as a strategic PMO and enablement hub, supporting HR’s response to transformation by structuring thinking, connecting initiatives, and translating complexity into clear workforce narratives, decision frameworks, and coordinated HR actions. You will integrate inputs across AI use cases, workforce impact, Orion skills, organizational design, HR capability uplift, change enablement.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

 What will your essential responsibilities include?
   

  

**HR AI Enablement**
* Structure and orchestrate people impact responses to AI transformation initiatives across Claims, Global Operations, and Legal \& Compliance.
* Partner with business, AI, and transformation leaders to translate AI use cases into workforce implications (roles, skills, organization).
* Work closely with the AI HR Taskforce (including HR Workforce Planning \& Transformation) to connect AI initiatives with workforce implications and HR activity into a coherent picture.
* Shape and apply HR approaches based on taskforce outputs within the remit, ensuring consistency, scalability, and practical application.
+ Design and maintain practical HR frameworks to assess AI impact on work, roles, capacity, and skills; contribute to playbooks, templates, and governance materials.
+ KPI framework: develop concrete KPIs per use case and for the overall program (adoption rates, time\-to\-value, learning time, productivity impact, cross\-functional collaboration).


**Workforce Impact, Skills \& Organization Design**
* Contribute to the evolution of organizational design and job architecture
* Structure options and scenarios to support informed decision\-making as roles, skills, and work evolve.
* Build capability through exposure to live cases and co\-design of targeted evolutions; avoid end\-to\-end ownership to enable rapid learning and iteration.


**Facilitation \& Capability Enablement**
* Design and facilitate HRBP and crossR sessions; lead business workshops on AI impact, human–AI collaboration, and role evolution.
* Act as a connector across HRBPs, COEs, HR Transformation, and enterprise initiatives.
* Equip HRBPs with practical playbooks, tools, and frameworks to support assured and composed engagement with leaders on AI use cases.


**Change Management \& Adoption**
* Roll out a people\-centric change approach for AI\-driven transformation; embed change management early and align with ESS and global functions for sustained adoption.


**Strategic PMO \& HR Orchestration Support**
* Provide strategic PMO and orchestration support to the Global HRBP across Legal, Claims, and Global Operations.
* Orchestrate HR priorities, initiatives, and dependencies; maintain operating rhythms, governance forums, and milestones.
* Support coordination of core HR processes, ensuring clear ownership, sequencing, and outcomes.


**Stakeholder Management \& Governance**
* Act as an integrator across HRBPs, COEs, enterprise programs, and AI initiatives.
* Anticipate risks and dependencies; surface them to senior HR leadership and ensure alignment of interconnected initiatives.


 You will report to the Global Head of HR.
   

  

 What you’ll bring
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
   

  

**Experience \& Profile**
* Extensive, progressive experience in HR consulting, transformation, organizational change enablement roles in complex, matrixed environments.
* Relevant advanced degree or certifications in change management, or AI\-enabled transformations preferred.
* Demonstrated experience structuring and orchestrating cross\-functional initiatives (transformation programs, HR operating rhythms, governance, workshops, adoption).
* Experience translating complex topics into practical frameworks, decision narratives, and executive\-ready materials for senior stakeholders.
* Curiosity and working knowledge of AI capabilities, limitations, and organizational implications.


**Skills**
* Preferred: AI and process/flow thinking experience, ideally from a consulting or tech\-forward background. Ability to design frameworks, drive adoption, measure impact, and upskill HR colleagues.
* Cross\-functional collaboration and facilitation to connect HRBPs, COEs, task forces, and business stakeholders into a coherent approach.
* Authentic and impactful communication to craft clear workforce narratives, influence alignment, and communicate with credibility.
* Agility, curiosity, innovation, and growth mindset to operate effectively in evolving AI and transformation contexts.
* Performance excellence and resilience to deliver against deadlines and maintain quality under pressure.
* Project Management to structure workplans, dependencies, milestones, and governance.
* Change Management to support adoption and sustained behavior change across the remit.
* Data\-driven decision making and digital literacy to use insights, tools, and evidence in decisions.
* Risk management and ethical judgment to navigate people risk, sensitive topics, and governance in a regulated environment.
* Relationship management to build trusted collaboration and influence without formal authority.
* Ability to operate autonomously in a highly matrixed environment, navigating complexity and ambiguity.


 What we offer
   

  

**Inclusion**
 AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
 *It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*
* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ\+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family\-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter


 Learn more at axaxl.com/about\-us/inclusion\-and\-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

**Total Rewards**
 AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
   

  

 We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
   

  

**Sustainability**
 At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever\-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023\-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
   

  

**Our Pillars**
* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems \- the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.

Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal\-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. * AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs.  AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
   

  

 How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data\-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
   

  

 With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.

**About the role**  


Ensure efficient HR and payroll operations for UK and ROI colleagues by meeting SLAs and KPIs, maintaining compliance, and delivering a great colleague experience.
**You will be responsible for**  


Identifying operational improvements and finding solutions by applying CI tools and techniques* Responsible for completing tasks and transactions within agreed KPI's
* Knows and applies fundamental work theories/concepts/processes in own areas of work
* Completing, supporting, and coordinating HR Admin \& Payroll Admin transactions.


 o Creating and updating colleague records from hire to retire, including personal, position, and job details.
 o End\-to\-end payroll processing, including collecting, calculating, and inputting payroll data for all employees.* Maintaining good working relationships with teams within and outside People Services, as well as colleagues in the UK.
* Answering all HR and payroll queries promptly and accurately, delivering a great colleague experience.
* Ensuring all transactions are processed with an accuracy score of above 99\.50%.
* Liaising with People \& Safety Managers for queries and issues relating to colleagues' pay.
* Understanding and applying UK legislation, Tesco policies, DC\-specific terms \& conditions, and payroll systems and procedures appropriately to ensure compliance with HR and payroll policies, procedures, and regulations.
* Specializing in activities/tasks like new starters, ROTA changes, retrospective corrections, leavers, transfers, etc.

  


**You will need**  


 Background / work experience in HR Admin and/or Payroll Admin transactional based environment.* Exposure of working in UK Payroll environment is desirable.


Good communication skills* MS Office – Excel, Word \& Powerpoint
* Eye\-to\-Detail
* Speed and Accuracy
* Planning and Organising
* Good Numeracy skills
* Analytical mindset


**Whats in it for you?**  


At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market\- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars \- Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles \- simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** \- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Performance Bonus** \- Opportunity to earn additional compensation bonus based on performance, paid annually

**Leave \& Time\-off** \- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension\-FreeSalary** \- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** \- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in\-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** \- We offer mental health support through self\-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face\-to\-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** \- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one\-to\-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** \- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3\-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.
**About Us**  


At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. The candidate will collaborate with key stakeholders to plan and implement talent development strategy for the technology practice. Additionally, the candidate will be given the opportunities to build, create, and develop various facets of the training processes, collaborate with high\-caliber colleagues in a collegial environment, and lead projects independently.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 As an individual contributor, you will be responsible for providing guidance, advisory support, and implementation to technology business groups for learning and development initiatives and practices. You will partner with various technology business groups to develop talent development strategy and capability\-building plans. In addition, the role requires the development and generation of strategies to address learning needs for the technology practice, including the introduction of structured programs to onboard new hires and upskill experienced employees. You will also collaborate with technical experts within the organization to ensure learning content is up\-to\-date, relevant, and accurate. The aim is to streamline learning processes, platforms, and practices to enhance learner experience and productivity. The role involves deploying programs and initiatives to address domain, technical and behavioral learning needs. Additionally, you will execute end\-to\-end program management and coordinate vendor management, data analysis, and reporting efforts.

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* An MBA in human resources with over 8 \- 10 years of work experience in talent development
* Proficiency in designing instructor\-led and online learning programs, including facilitator, participant guides, and learning job aids

* A passion for the talent development and technology domain as well as robust stakeholder management skills

description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

It’s an exciting time to be part of the Digital and Technology Human Capital Management and Services team with global initiatives focused on process
  

transformation, employee experience and data \& insights. This position reports to the D\&T Manager \- HR and is responsible for configuring and supporting Workday HCM and other HR systems and processes that enhance user experience, support HR process and technology efforts and deliver value to our global workforce. This role is expected to demonstrate high proficiency in system knowledge/configuration, problem solving, process/data analysis, and communication skills. You’ll work collaboratively across teams to provide recommendations on aligning technical solutions to business opportunities.


**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Analyst resource for global HR system process, data and technology projects.
* Provide day\-to\-day operational support of HR systems and ensure system health and sustainability.
* Utilize Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation functional expertise to troubleshoot issues and identify solutions, including business process
* configuration, complex calculated fields, integrations, and EIBs.
* Serve as a consultant for global HR systems, data, and processes by identifying and articulating process impacts on technology/data and potential constraints.
* Partner with business to define functional requirements, including data, configuration and integration needs, and translate them into recommendations and
* technical specifications.
* Partner with business to understand pain points, prioritize requirements, and identify opportunities to improve processes and gain efficiency by leveraging existing and new functionality.
* Successfully deliver prioritized initiatives through discovery, planning, implementation, testing and stabilization.
* Own quality assurance, creation of test scripts, testing execution, and ensuring user acceptance for system solutions.
* Develop technical documentation supporting system or process changes.
* Communicate system or process changes to users with varying technical knowledge.
* Advocate for and influence HR solutions and inform stakeholders on new trends and technologies.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in CIS (Computer Information Systems) or MIS (Management Information Systems) preferred.
* Minimum years of related experience required: 3\+ supporting/delivering complex IT solutions.
* Preferred years of related experience: 5\+ supporting/delivering complex IT solutions
* Experience configuring, solutioning and supporting Workday Compensation required.
* Workday HCM Core experience desired.
* HRSoft experience desired.
* Ability to work with contractors and third\-party vendors to ensure a quality result on projects and enhancements.
* Ability to gather and translate business requirements into specifications.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, configure and support data, processes and technology.
* Experience supporting stabilization and ongoing production support of technical solutions.
* Proven ability to manage multiple tasks/activities and prioritize appropriately.
* Well\-developed interpersonal and communication skills with technical and business partners at all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative team environment.
* Experience working in a global company.
* Should be comfortable to work in shift of 1:30pm to 10:30pm

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATION**

* Excellent interpersonal skills with a high degree of tact and diplomacy.
* Be able to effectively work with ambiguity.
* High learning agility.
* Be able to define business requirements and collaborate across global teams.
* Problem solver and work with minimal guidance.
* Highly organized individual with a process improvement and client service mindset.
* Proven ability to work successfully with global, cross\-functional project teams and translate complex business analysis into actionable recommendations through to implementation.
* Ability to train, guide and mentor others.
* Results oriented with a track record of accomplishments and ability to problem solve and overcome challenges.
* High integrity, sound judgment and discretion regarding confidential information.
* Ability to think critically, proactively, and manage multiple priorities.
* High initiative and passion for improving business systems and processes.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

**“Your insights can redefine how we manage talent—be our next HR Associate!”** 




  





**About the Role:** 




 We are seeking an experienced HR professional to manage the complete employee lifecycle for our India operations. This role involves delivering end\-to\-end HR support, acting as the primary point of contact for employees and managers, and ensuring compliance with policies on employee relations. You will collaborate with business leaders and regional HR partners to provide strategic and operational guidance, maintain accurate HRMS and payroll records, and oversee onboarding and background checks. Additionally, you will prepare productivity reports, drive process improvements, and align local practices with global HR standards.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 




 ▪ End\-to\-End HR Support: Manage the entire employee lifecycle for India, from onboarding to exit including generating offer letters, updating HRMS tool, and preparing exit letters.
 



  





 ▪ HR Support: Serve as the primary contact for employees and managers, addressing HR queries and requests promptly while maintaining strict confidentiality
 



  





 ▪ Employee Relations: Handle disciplinaries, grievances, performance issues, and terminations in line with policy.
 



  





 ▪ Partner with Leaders: Provide operational and strategic HR advice to business leaders and collaborate with the Regional HR Business Partner.
 



  





 ▪ HRMS \& Payroll: Maintain accurate employee records and ensure timely payroll input submission.
 



  





 ▪ Onboarding Coordination: Liaise with admin and other teams to ensure smooth and timely onboarding of new hires.
 



  





 ▪ Background Check: Will be responsible for initiating and monitoring background checks for candidates in the vendor portal and timely reporting of any challenges and observations to HRBP.
 



  





 ▪ Reporting: Prepare and publish monthly productivity and KPI reports.
 



  





 ▪ Process Improvement: Identify and implement opportunities to streamline HR processes for efficiency.
 



  





 ▪ Global Collaboration: Align HR practices with global standards and support cross location initiatives.
 



  





 Any other duties as directed by the HR Business partner.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 




  





**Qualification:** 
 Minimum graduate with specialization in HR (MBA preferred)
 



  





**Work Experience:** 




  





 ▪ Minimum 2\-3 years’ experience in India HR Operations
 



  





 ▪ A good understanding of the principles of good HR practice
 



  





 ▪ A good knowledge of employment law and practices
 



  





**Person Specification** 




  





 ▪ Highly organised with ability to plan, delegate prioritise and multitask.
 



  





 ▪ Ability to communicate clearly, persuasively and with confidence at all levels.
 



  





 ▪ Listening and counselling skills with an ability to handle difficult and confrontational situations.
 



  





 ▪ Self\-motivated, with an ability to manage own workload with minimum supervision.
 



  





 ▪ Highly confidential and ability to maintain honesty, integrity, and empathy in handling personal and company matters.
 



  





**Essential Criteria** 




  





 ▪ Previous experience in a similar India HR Operations role.
 



  





 ▪ Good time management and ability to prioritize work with a sense of urgency, meets deadlines, exceed expectations, and deliver on commitments.
 



  





 ▪ Handling confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion, maturity, and professionalism.
 



  





 ▪ Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to establish effective working relationships with peers and Managers alike.
 



  





 ▪ Excellent attention to detail, including coordinating, gathering, and distributing key information.
 



  





 ▪ Commitment to high quality service and continuous improvement
 



  





 ▪ Proven experience in MS Office products, specifically with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel \& PowerPoint
 



  





**Why NES Fircroft?**

 Time Off: 18 days of paid leave plus birthday leave, 12 days of casual/sick leave, and 12 bank holidays. Paid leave increases to 20 days after 2 years

 Team Environment: Fun, lively atmosphere with plenty of staff events.

 NES Fircroft is a dynamic global leader connecting top talent with major projects in the engineering and technical sectors. We foster growth through innovation and value a work culture that is both enriching and challenging. Since 1978, NES Fircroft has been a leading staffing specialist, providing top\-tier technical and engineering talent across various sectors like Oil and Gas, Power, Construction, Life Sciences, Manufacturing, Chemical, Mining, Automotive, IT, and more. With over 2,000 professionals in 58 global offices, we deliver exceptional staffing solutions and support to our clients.

description:
Our solutions are a key part of most industries \- electronics, medical research, renewable energy, food production, infrastructure and many more. Working with us means working with the latest technologies and groundbreaking, sustainable innovations.
   

  

**Join us on our journey for a better tomorrow.**
 Your role
   

  

 The Senior Officer HR / Assistant Manager HR will support the Human Resources Manager in enhancing organizational capability, employee engagement, wellbeing, talent development, and performance excellence across Atlas Copco Compressor Technique Customer Center India. The role will implement and continuously improve people processes and employee experience initiatives aligned with Atlas Copco values, People Management Guidelines, and "The Way We Do Things."Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Learning \& Capability Development
   

  

 Support training needs analysis through competency mapping, talent reviews, and business inputs.
   

  

 Coordinate technical, functional, behavioral, and leadership development programs.
   

  

 Drive utilization of Learning:Link, LinkedIn Learning, Atlas Copco Academy, and other learning platforms.
   

  

 Monitor learning effectiveness, participation, completion, and training records.
   

  

**Employee Wellbeing**
 Plan and coordinate physical, mental, social, and financial wellbeing initiatives.
   

  

 Promote awareness and participation in wellbeing programs and resources.
   

  

 Coordinate wellbeing campaigns and monitor participation, feedback, and program effectiveness
   

  

**Employee Engagement \& Culture**
 Execute the annual employee engagement calendar, including engagement surveys, pulse surveys, recognition, inclusion, culture\-building, sports, recreation, and CSR activities.
   

  

 Coordinate communication, participation tracking, action planning, and governance of engagement initiatives.
   

  

 Develop engagement communications and monitor participation, feedback, budgets, and outcomes.
   

  

 Collaborate with managers, employee committees, and volunteers to foster a positive employee experience and culture.
   

  

**Performance \& Talent Management**
 Support goal setting, performance reviews, appraisal cycles, and related governance processes.
   

  

 Coordinate talent reviews, succession planning, and development planning activities.
   

  

 Promote the Atlas Copco Talent Framework and Internal Job Market opportunities.
   

  

 Monitor development actions for identified talent and support career development initiatives.
   

  

**HR Projects \& Organizational Development**
 Support strategic HR, organizational development, and change management initiatives.
   

  

 Prepare HR dashboards, reports, presentations, and management review materials.
   

  

 Facilitate employee and manager awareness sessions on people processes and programs.
   

  

 Coordinate with Talent Acquisition and HR Operations teams to ensure a seamless employee lifecycle experience.
   

  

**HR Governance \& Continuous Improvement**
 Maintain accurate records related to learning, engagement, performance, and talent processes.
   

  

 Promote effective use of HR systems including HR:Link, Career Link, and Learning:Link.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with HR policies, governance requirements, and audit standards.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, digitalize, and continuously improve HR processes.
   

  

**Key Focus Areas**
 Learning \& Development
   

  

* Employee Engagement
* Employee Wellbeing
* Talent Management
* Performance Management
* Organizational Development
* HR Analytics \& Governance
* Culture \& Employee Experience


 To succeed, you will need
   

  

**Experience.**
* 4 to 8 years of relevant HR experience.
* Exposure to learning and development, employee engagement, performance management or talent management.
* Experience in a manufacturing, engineering, industrial, service or sales organization is preferred.
* Knowledge / Educational Requirements
* Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
* MBA or Master's degree in Human Resources Management, Personnel Management or an equivalent qualification is preferred.
* Working knowledge of learning and development, employee engagement, performance management, talent management, succession planning and HR analytics.
* Comfort with HR systems and digital learning platforms; proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.


**Core Competencies**
* Stakeholder management
* Learning and capability development
* Communication and facilitation
* Talent and performance management
* Project coordination
* Change orientation
* Data analysis and reporting
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Employee engagement
* Employee wellbeing
* Customer focus


 In return, we offer
   

  

* Culture of trust and accountability
* Lifelong learning and career growth
* Innovation powered by people
* Comprehensive compensation and benefits
* Health and well\-being


 Job location
   

  

 Onsite
   

  

 This role offers an onsite working arrangement in Pune, India.
   

  

**Diverse by nature and inclusive by choice**
 Bright ideas come from all of us. The more unique perspectives we embrace, the more innovative we are. Together we build a culture where difference is valued and we share a deep sense of purpose and belonging.

description:
**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Location:** 
 Cocoma Digital HQ – Andheri West, Mumbai
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time (On\-site)
 



**Overall Experience** 
 : 5\+ years in Human Resources.
 



**HR Manager Experience:** 
 Minimum 2\+ years working in an HR Manager/Asst. Hr Manager role.
 



**Industry Background** 

 : Entertainment, Social Media, Digital Marketing, Advertising, Creative, Media, or Agency experience is mandatory.
 




**Reporting To:** 
 COO / Leadership Team
 



  





**ABOUT COCOMA DIGITAL \& STUDIOS** 




 Cocoma Digital \& Studios is a fast\-growing creative and marketing powerhouse managing multiple brands and sister companies. Our Digital division specializes in YouTube growth strategy, social media marketing, creator collaborations, content development, and digital brand building. Our Studios division delivers end\-to\-end post\-production, localization, and creative production services across Films, OTT, Television, and Digital Platforms.
 



 As we continue to scale rapidly, we're building a structured, technology\-first, and performance\-driven organization. We're looking for an HR professional who can help us hire better, build stronger processes, improve employee experience, and implement AI\-driven HR operations.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We're looking for a proactive and execution\-focused
 **Human Resources Manager** 
 who can build strong HR systems while supporting the company's rapid growth.
 



 This role goes beyond traditional HR.
 



 You'll be responsible for attracting top talent, improving hiring quality, reducing hiring turnaround time, implementing HR processes, strengthening company culture, improving employee retention, driving performance management, and leveraging AI and automation to build a modern HR function.
 



 You'll work closely with leadership and department heads to ensure Cocoma hires the right people, builds scalable processes, and creates a high\-performance culture.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Own end\-to\-end recruitment across Creative Depts, YouTube, Social Media, Production, Technology, Business Development, and Corporate functions.
* Partner with department heads to understand hiring priorities and workforce planning.
* Build strong talent pipelines through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, networking, social media, and proactive talent sourcing.
* Improve hiring quality while reducing hiring turnaround time.
* Screen candidates beyond resumes by evaluating attitude, communication, culture fit, ownership, and long\-term potential.
* Coordinate interviews, assessments, offer rollouts, salary negotiations, documentation, and onboarding.
* Maintain a structured ATS and recruitment database for future hiring needs.



**HR Operations \& Process Excellence** 



* Manage the complete employee lifecycle—from onboarding to exit.
* Maintain employee records, HR documentation, attendance, leave management, and HRMS.
* Coordinate payroll inputs with the Finance team.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements including PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishment Act, and applicable labour laws.
* Prepare HR dashboards, MIS reports, hiring analytics, attrition reports, and workforce insights for leadership.



**Performance Management \& Employee Development** 



* Drive probation reviews, confirmations, KRAs, KPIs, and performance evaluation cycles.
* Partner with managers to identify skill gaps and training requirements.
* Support career development, internal mobility, and succession planning.
* Help managers build high\-performing teams through structured feedback and performance tracking.



**Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Conduct induction and onboarding programs for new employees.
* Foster a collaborative, performance\-oriented, and accountable work culture.
* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, celebrations, learning sessions, and team\-building activities.
* Address employee concerns professionally while maintaining confidentiality and fairness.
* Drive initiatives that improve employee satisfaction and retention.



**HR Systems, SOPs \& Organizational Development** 



* Build, document, and continuously review and improve HR policies, SOPs, onboarding processes, and employee handbooks.
* Standardize HR workflows across departments to ensure consistency and operational efficiency.
* Recommend process improvements that increase transparency, accountability, and productivity.
* Ensure all HR documentation and organizational records are accurate and up to date.



**AI, Automation \& HR Technology** 



* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR tasks using AI and digital tools.
* Utilize ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, AI screening tools, and workflow automation to improve recruitment efficiency.
* Leverage AI for job descriptions, candidate sourcing, interview coordination, HR documentation, reporting, and internal communication.
* Continuously evaluate emerging HR technologies that improve hiring speed, candidate experience, and operational excellence.



**Leadership Partnership** 



* Act as a trusted HR partner for department heads.
* Support leadership in manpower planning, organizational restructuring, and resource allocation.
* Present hiring insights, workforce analytics, and HR recommendations to management.
* Contribute towards building a scalable HR function aligned with Cocoma's long\-term growth plans.



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in HR, Talent Acquisition, or HR Operations.
* Experience hiring for Social Media, Creative Agencies, Media, Technology, Production, or Startup environments is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of recruitment strategies, HR operations, employee engagement, and performance management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational abilities with the capability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* High ownership, execution capability, and problem\-solving mindset.



  





**LANGUAGE \& COMMUNICATION PROFICIENCY** 



* **English** 
 – Professional Proficiency
* **Hindi** 
 – Professional Proficiency



  





**TOOLS \& TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY** 




**HR \& Recruitment** 



* ATS Platforms (Zoho Recruit, Recruit CRM, Workable, or similar)
* LinkedIn Recruiter
* Naukri Recruiter
* HRMS Platforms



**Productivity** 



* Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive)
* Microsoft Office Suite



**AI \& Automation** 



* ChatGPT
* Google Gemini
* Claude
* Perplexity
* AI sourcing and recruitment tools
* Workflow automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)



  





**SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)** 



* Time\-to\-Hire
* Quality of Hire
* Offer Acceptance Rate
* Hiring Target Achievement
* Employee Retention
* Probation Success Rate
* Recruitment Funnel Conversion
* Employee Engagement Score
* HR Process Compliance
* Hiring Manager Satisfaction
* AI \& Process Automation Adoption
* HR Documentation \& SOP Completion



  





**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 We're looking for someone who:
 


* Thinks like a business partner rather than just an HR executive.
* Enjoys building teams and hiring exceptional talent.
* Can identify high\-potential candidates beyond what's written on a resume.
* Is process\-oriented and believes in documentation, SOPs, and continuous improvement.
* Has experience working in high\-growth, fast\-paced organizations.
* Embraces AI and technology to improve HR efficiency.
* Is proactive, accountable, and execution\-focused.
* Can confidently work with founders, department heads, and leadership teams.
* Thrives in a performance\-driven environment and enjoys solving organizational challenges.



  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Competitive Compensation
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Opportunity to Build \& Scale HR for a Rapidly Growing Organization
* Exposure to Creative, Digital, Media \& Technology Businesses
* AI\-Driven HR \& Recruitment Environment
* Collaborative \& Entrepreneurial Work Culture
* Opportunity to Drive Organizational Growth \& Transformation



  





**A DAY AT COCOMA DIGITAL – Human Resources Manager** 




 Your day begins by reviewing hiring priorities, recruitment pipelines, and workforce updates. You'll coordinate with department heads to close critical positions, conduct interviews, and ensure candidates move efficiently through the hiring process.
 



 Throughout the day, you'll optimize recruitment workflows, manage employee relations, support onboarding, review HR metrics, implement AI\-driven hiring processes, and collaborate with leadership on organizational planning.
 



 At Cocoma, HR is more than managing people; it's about building high\-performing teams, creating scalable systems, leveraging technology, and enabling the organization to grow with the right talent, processes, and culture.

**HR Vendor Assessment Analyst (Fixed Term – 6 Months)**
 The second title clearly signals that the primary purpose is evaluating the HR vendor landscape and making recommendations.
   

  

 Add This to the "About the Role" Section
   

  

 In addition to supporting vendor operations and performance management, this role will lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's HR vendor ecosystem. The analyst will evaluate vendor capabilities, service delivery, contractual value, utilization, costs, risks, and business outcomes across multiple HR service areas. The individual will develop recommendations regarding vendor optimization, consolidation, expansion, or elimination to improve operational effectiveness, employee experience, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 Add a New Responsibility Section
   

  

 HR Vendor Assessment \& Optimization
   

  

* Conduct a comprehensive review of all HR and People Services vendors across the employee lifecycle.
* Assess vendor performance, service quality, utilization, cost effectiveness, scalability, and strategic value.

description:
***GLOBAL HEALTH STARTS WITH YOU!***




**Title:** 
 People and Talent (P\&T) Director
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai or Bangaluru, with strong preference given to candidates in Mumbai. 30\-40% travel expected between these two locations and other states.
 



**Reports to:** 
 dual reporting line to the HQ Chief People and Systems Officer and Americares India Foundation (AIF) Country Director
 



**Direct reports:** 
 4
 



**Schedule:** 
 This role will be required to occasionally work during hours that may be outside of traditional office hours as we are an organization that responds to humanitarian emergencies that may occur during evenings and on weekends.
 



  





**Americares Organizational Values:** 




 We create global community, treating people as they want to be treated.
 



 We respond effectively and responsibly, putting plans into practice.
 



 We embed ethics and equity in our work and workplace.
 



 We are better together; partnership is at our core.
 



 We ask and listen, to create sustainable solutions for a healthier tomorrow.
 



 We commit to quality, growing and improving to ensure individuals and communities thrive.
 



  





**Duties and Responsibilities:** 




*People and Talent strategy:*




 \-Develop and implement Americares India Foundation’s comprehensive people and talent strategy aligned with the organization’s mission, values and global P\&T practices.
 



 \-Lead strategy and enhancements in end\-to\-end recruitment and talent retention initiatives for programmatic operations, and leadership roles across states, ensuring fair, compliant, and transparent hiring and internal growth practices.
 



 \-In alignment with global employer brand, strengthen country employer branding to attract values\-aligned, mission\-driven and highly competent talent.
 



 \-Evaluate, strengthen and implement performance management systems linked to organizational goals, mission, strategy, and values.
 



 \-Partner with HQ P\&T to align country learning and development initiatives (including onboarding, technical skills, leadership development, and career progression frameworks) to global L\&D strategy.
 



 \-Support proposal development by contributing to workforce planning, staffing structures, and P\&T\-related budget inputs for new funding opportunities.
 



 \-Oversee P\&T budget and ensure that financial stewardship and adequate resourcing support current and future talent strategy and plans.
 



 \-Oversee and manage external P\&T vendors and consultants, ensuring quality, compliance, cost\-effectiveness, and results.
 



 \-Use data and P\&T analytics to inform decision\-making and improve people outcomes, creating transparent dashboards and report outs to key leadership in AIF and HQ.
 



 \-Enhance workforce surge capacity for emergency response.
 



  





*Culture, communication and engagement:*




 \-Lead people\-related change initiatives, strengthening intentional culture and work community, integrating transparent and effective internal communications and values driven campaigns.
 



 \-Support cross\-functional collaboration and strengthen communication between and among teams, ensuring that all employee languages are actively included in systems, meetings, documents, and day\-to\-day operations.
 



 \-Partner with HQ P\&T to ensure active employee participation in global feedback, well\-being, fairness for all, and organization engagement activities.
 



 \-In alignment with P\&T HQ, lead fairness for all initiatives across all parts of the employee life cycle, embedding equity and inclusion in P\&T policies, procedures, and activities; design and implement fair systems that mitigate and prevent discrimination while enhancing access and inclusion of employees of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences.
 



 \-Embed duty of care standards and practices into all parts of the employee lifecycle.
 



  





*Governance, compliance and risk:*




 \-Build and effectively communicate scalable P\&T systems and governance for a multi\-state, multi\-language, geographically dispersed workforce.
 



 \-Partner with HQ P\&T to design and implement fair, transparent, and competitive compensation packages and structures, aligning with our global compensation philosophy and best practices.
 



 \-Evaluate, strengthen and oversee effective employee relations processes, addressing situations proactively and with impeccable judgment, connecting employees to both local and global reporting systems and collaborate with HQ P\&T as needed.
 



 \-Ensure effective people operations, including but not limited to benefits, contracts, policies, HRIS, PTO, leaves, offboarding, and personnel files in multi\-state contexts, automating whenever possible to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
 



 \-Proactively identify and mitigate people\-related risks.
 



 \-Ensure compliance with all applicable labor laws and statutory requirements within and across states.
 



 \-Lead implementation and monitoring of POSH policies and internal committees.
 



 \-Lead organizational P\&T compliance related to donors, auditors, and government regulatory frameworks (including FCRA implications as they relate to staffing).
 



  





*Organizational leadership:*




 \-Serve as a thought partner to the Country Director and leadership team on organizational design, workforce planning, intentional culture, succession planning, and the full employee experience.
 



 \-Partner with leadership to build people management and leadership capabilities at all levels.
 



 \-People manage P\&T team members, ensuring their success in meeting objectives, modelling organizational values, and embedding ethics and equity in their systems, processes, and interactions.
 



 \-Actively model and contribute to Americares values, work culture, and mission.
 



 \-Engage in and lead team spaces with openness, global competencies, and a growth mindset.
 



 \-Additional responsibilities and duties as needed.
 



  





*Key role outcomes:*




*In the first 90 days, the People and Talent Director will:* 




 Learn and live the Americares values.
 



 Complete all required new hire onboarding trainings.
 



 Create an initial diagnostic of current P\&T processes, structures, compensation packages, culture, and systems, aligning with the Chief People and Systems Officer on priorities for the first 6 months of a P\&T strategic plan.
 



 Determine key P\&T metrics that will be evaluated in the first 6 months and ongoing.
 



 Partner with HQ P\&T engagement team to create an employee feedback plan, assessing baseline and key milestone markers for culture.
 



 Begin building relationships with employees and begin to understand the employee experience.
 



 Audit labor law compliance (multi\-state), POSH implementation, contracts, policies, and employee files, including compliance with laws about protected identities.
 



 Create a risk and compliance heatmap with a plan of improvement, as needed, for the first 6 months and longer\-term.
 



 Define a plan for inclusive language and communication access with employees from various backgrounds, locations, languages, and working conditions (e.g. office vs field).
 



  





*In the first year, the People and Talent Director will:*




 Lead a high functioning intentional culture.
 



 Establish and operationalize a data\-driven P\&T function with clear metrics tied to organizational outcomes.
 



 Be viewed by employees, AIF leadership, and HQ P\&T as an ethical, fair, and strategic driver of values\-aligned and mission\-driven P\&T strategy.
 



 Sustain effective and impactful workplace committees (POSH, fairness for all, etc.).
 



 Implement key people manager and leadership initiatives that enhance employee metrics, satisfaction, and align with organizational culture.
 



 Fully embed P\&T strategy and organizational values into ongoing systems, processes, and experiences for employees.
 



 Create an organizational design and development plan that addresses current and future operational plans, strategy, and sustainable team growth.
 



 Implement a talent attraction and retention plan that generates key results in mission impact.
 



 Successfully embed duty of care and staff well\-being into services, benefits, perks, policies, and initiatives.
 



  





**Competencies required for the role include:**




 Proven ability to design and execute a comprehensive people and talent strategy in a non\-profit organization.
 



 Significant results in translating organizational strategy and values into people systems, processes, and intentional culture best practices.
 



 Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale organizational change and transformation initiatives.
 



 Creative problem solving and strategies for uniting diverse locations, roles, identities, functions, and workplace conditions (e.g. field and office) into a values\-aligned and mission\-driven workplace community.
 



 Prior experience with creating accurate assessment frameworks and metrics that inform meaningful P\&T initiatives, leading to timely and continuous progress.
 



 Senior P\&T leadership experience across multiple states within India.
 



 Demonstrated commitment to leading an intentional culture and initiatives that sustain fairness for all, duty of care, and embed equity.
 



 Subject matter expertise in multi\-state employment laws, compliance, regulations, and compensation packages.
 



 Impeccable integrity, ethics, and judgment.
 



 Ability to navigate global, multi\-state, and local employment contexts, ensuring process and systems alignment.
 



 Effective implementation of P\&T systems that provide accurate records and automate efficiencies.
 



 Successful vendor vetting and negotiation competencies that enhance benefits, perks, and services for employees.
 



 Alignment with our organizational values – in growth mindset, behaviors, and demonstrated results.
 



 Fluent in English, proficient in Hindi, AND able to effectively communicate in at least one of the following languages: Kannada, Tamil, and/or Marathi.
 



  





 This role is open to candidates who have unrestricted work authorization in India and extensive experience leading P\&T in Indian organizations.
 








**These competencies are preferred but not required for the role:** 




 P\&T leadership in a global humanitarian and /or health organization.

description:
**About Entrupy**
 Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods.
   

  

 Entrupy's solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e\-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy's solutions in market:
   

  

* Entrupy Apparel Authentication
* Entrupy Bags \& Leather Goods Authentication
* Entrupy Sneaker Authentication
* Entrupy Fingerprinting


**As we continue to build...**
 We're seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key\-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you're invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we'd love to have you apply.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We're looking for an experienced
 **Manager, People Operations \& HRBP – India \& APAC** 
 to lead and scale People Operations across the region while partnering closely with managers and business leaders as an HR Business Partner.
   

  

 This role will own the employee lifecycle and operational foundation across India and APAC, including onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, HR policies, compliance, and People programs. In addition, the role will provide hands\-on HRBP support to leaders on employee relations, performance, organizational changes, and people\-related decisions.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hybrid – Bangalore, India
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Chief People Officer
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle across India and APAC, from offer acceptance through offboarding.
* Lead onboarding and offboarding programs, ensuring a seamless and consistent employee experience.
* Manage employment offers, contracts, compensation changes, promotions, transfers, and other employee documentation.
* Own HR policies, handbooks, and operational processes while ensuring compliance with local employment laws.
* Partner with business leaders and managers as an HRBP, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, organizational changes, and people decisions.
* Support performance reviews, promotions, compensation cycles, employee engagement initiatives, and other People programs.
* Coach managers on effective people management, feedback, performance conversations, and policy application.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, IT, and Talent Acquisition to ensure effective and scalable People processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve and automate HR processes, systems, and workflows.
* Develop and track People Operations metrics and provide insights to inform business and people decisions.
* Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers on HR policies, processes, and employee lifecycle matters.
* Help build scalable People programs and processes as the organization grows across India and APAC.


**What We're Looking For:**
* **7–10 years of experience** 
 in People Operations, HRBP, or HR Operations roles, ideally in a high\-growth or global organization.
* Strong experience managing employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, and HR compliance.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with managers and business leaders as an HRBP.
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law; experience supporting APAC markets is a plus.
* Experience with performance management, employee relations, organizational changes, and HR programs.
* Strong project management, organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, HiBob, Rippling, Workday, or similar.
* A hands\-on, proactive, and solutions\-oriented approach with a strong focus on employee experience and operational excellence.


**What we offer**
* A hands\-on, mission\-critical role with direct impact on how Entrupy operates and grows in India
* Build and scale People Operations for a fast\-growing global technology company.
* Partner directly with executive leadership and shape the employee experience across India and APAC.
* Be part of a collaborative team that's redefining trust in the global resale economy.
* The opportunity to be part of building something from the ground up — with the backing of a global team and leadership that is invested in getting it right
* The chance to be part of a category\-defining company at an inflection point in its growth


 At Entrupy, we talk straight, think big, bring a growth mindset to everything we do, and make sure to embrace the fun along the way. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 We have had an incredible run so far and laying the foundation for a culture that is fast\-paced, entrepreneurial, and rooted in passion, kindness, and positivity. We live by these values – we hire by them, promote them, and celebrate them every day.
   

  

 Please apply if you want to be a part of a collaborative and dynamic team with a passion for working with high\-end luxury brands and cutting\-edge technology and want to be at the forefront of AI innovation.
   

  

 Entrupy embraces a diversity of backgrounds and experiences and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. We are dedicated to building a company that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.

**Job Description**
**Payroll Specialist (GSC India)**
**Reporting to:** 
 Payroll Lead / Global Payroll Operations
   

  

**Location:** 
 India (GSC)
   

  

 The Senior Payroll Specialist owns payroll delivery for assigned countries, acting as the primary interface between Vertiv and external payroll vendors. This role carries
 **payroll sign‑off responsibility** 
 , ensures statutory compliance, manages escalations, and supports audit and SOX requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end‑to‑end payroll delivery for assigned EMEA and AsiaPac countries
* Act as the primary governance contact for payroll vendors, ensuring SLA adherence and issue resolution
* Perform detailed review and final validation of payroll outputs, including:
+ Gross‑to‑net calculations
+ Statutory taxes, social security, and benefits
+ Country‑specific compliance items

* Provide payroll sign‑off approval prior to payment and posting
* Manage complex payroll changes and escalations beyond analyst level
* Serve as RSC lead for Asia countries, coordinating execution, issue resolution, and country‑specific requirements
* Lead payroll reconciliations with Finance and support GL posting reviews
* Support SOX controls, internal audits, and external audits, ensuring complete documentation and evidence
* Coach and review work performed by Payroll Analysts
* Drive process improvements, vendor performance reviews, and standardisation initiatives
* Support payroll transitions, vendor changes, and system implementations


**Key Requirements**
* 5–8 years of experience in multi‑country payroll (EMEA and/or AsiaPac)
* Strong working knowledge of labour law, statutory compliance, and payroll controls
* Experience working with outsourced payroll vendors (ADP, SD Worx, or equivalent)
* Proven ability to manage vendor performance and country responsibilities independently
* Strong stakeholder management and escalation handling skills


**Skills \& Tools**
* Advanced payroll systems and vendor platforms
* HRIS / HCM systems (Oracle HCM preferred)
* Advanced MS Excel (reconciliations, variance analysis)
* Strong understanding of payroll controls, SOX, and audit requirements


**Languages**
* English – Mandatory
* One or more regional languages – Strongly preferred (depending on country portfolio)

description:

* Group Human Resources has the important role of attracting, retaining, and nurturing talent to ensure that DBS continues to be a competitive employer in Asia. With a well\-established team of HR partners, we support and deliver effective people\-based solutions and services across businesses. Our goal is to build a high\-performance organisation by empowering and engaging our employees. Because we believe that banking is about people. We are hiring for a role in the total rewards function


**Total Rewards Role Key Accountabilities**
* Specialist supports end to end planning and execution of rewards programs for DTI.
* The position is also responsible for overseeing the implementation of specific components of compensation programs and initiatives ensuring appropriate local implementation in the context of global guidelines.


**Responsibilities**
* Oversees the implementation of group compensation initiatives ensuring appropriate local implementation in the context of global guidelines
* Design pieces of compensation programs, resulting in significant and long\-term changes to the company’s compensation offerings and policies ensuring optimal budget utilization
* Own and partner the key reward processes like – annual compensation review, variable pay incl sign\-on and retention cases, reward grievances handling etc.
* Monitor the internal pay ranges, undertake competitive analysis and market trends to provide expert guidance on salary movements, appropriate compensation and grade fitment of new hires and internal movements across all business units/functions of the organization
* Partner in designing and developing training education and communication materials for the implementation of global or local compensation programs
* Design and administer employee recognition and reward programs to foster a culture of appreciation and engagement
* Work closely with DBIL CBG and external vendors to develop engagement initiatives that promote financial awareness and expand employee choice
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to analyze and optimize the organization's total rewards offerings
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends, regulations, and best practices in compensation, benefits, and recognition management
* Provide guidance and support to managers on compensation planning, performance\-based rewards, and employee benefits

description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As Sr. HR Business Partner (People Business Partner) at RZR, you will serve as the primary strategic People partner for our teams in India, working directly with regional leadership to align people strategy with business goals. This role is critical to enabling planned growth by building strong people practices, driving performance, ensuring compliance, and improving day\-to\-day organizational effectiveness in\-region.
   

  

 This is a highly embedded, hands\-on role. You will work alongside GMs and functional leaders to manage employee relations, run performance cycles, build retention programs, and shape how the organization scales — with a clear mandate to make people decisions that move the business forward.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep HRBP experience, strong commercial instincts, and the confidence to influence and challenge senior leaders. This role offers high visibility and direct impact on how a key international market grows and performs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 People Partnership
   

  

* Serve as the primary People Partner for the India region, partnering closely with regional leadership to align people strategy with business goals and planned growth
* Drive retention and reduce attrition by proactively identifying talent risks and implementing data\-informed interventions
* Own and execute the end\-to\-end performance management lifecycle, including goal setting, 90\-day reviews, performance cycles, and talent planning
* Establish and reinforce a high\-performance culture with clear expectations, accountability, and differentiation across teams
* Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers and senior leaders, providing candid guidance on performance, organizational design, and employee engagement
* Lead and manage complex employee relations matters, ensuring timely resolution, risk mitigation, and compliance with local labor laws and regulations
* Operate as a hands\-on partner across the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and day\-to\-day employee support
* Maintain HRIS data integrity, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely updates to support reporting, compliance, and decision\-making
* Identify opportunities to improve and scale People Operations processes, driving efficiency, consistency, and impact
* Leverage HR systems and data to generate insights, inform decision\-making, and enhance overall people practices
* Partner cross\-functionally to ensure alignment and execution of people initiatives across regions


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in a People Partner or Senior People Partner role, preferably in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments (ad tech, gaming, tech, or similar)
* Strong experience supporting international teams, with direct experience in India strongly preferred
* Proven track record managing core HRBP responsibilities including performance management, talent planning, and complex employee relations within local regulatory frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands\-on individual contributor, balancing strategic partnership with day\-to\-day execution
* Experience coaching and influencing senior leaders, with the ability to provide direct, candid feedback and drive decision\-making
* Strong knowledge of local labor laws and employment practices, with the ability to navigate compliance and mitigate risk effectively
* Experience driving process improvements and scaling people programs in growing organizations
* Proficiency with HR systems and tools such as BambooHR, Lattice, or CultureAmp, and comfort using data to inform people decisions
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Experience in ad tech, programmatic advertising, gaming, or platform technology environments
* Exposure to scaling a People function from early\-stage to structured operations
* Experience supporting teams across multiple Indian cities or geographies


 Why Join RZR?
   

  

* High\-impact, embedded ownership — not a shared services role — you will be the sole Sr. HR Business Partner for the India region, with a direct line to regional leadership and a real mandate to shape how the business runs from a people perspective.
* Own the full HRBP scope — performance management, employee relations, retention, organizational design, talent planning, and manager capability are all yours to own and build, not manage from a distance.
* Autonomy to build from scratch — you will have the freedom to design programs, improve processes, and create structure where none exists today, with the visibility to influence decisions at leadership level.
* True strategic partnership in a performance\-driven environment — without the politics of a large HR function. Your work has direct bearing on how the India region grows and performs.
* A function that keeps growing — as the region scales, this role becomes the foundation for a broader People team, with a clear path toward leading it.


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

This role will serve as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers, ensuring operational excellence, compliance, and effective execution of people processes.

The role requires strong collaboration with managers, employees, Talent Acquisition, and other People teams to ensure consistent and high\-quality HR service delivery across India.

* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, organizational changes, leave management, and offboarding.
* Ensure a seamless employee experience throughout the employee journey.
* Maintain accurate employee records, documentation, and data within HR systems.

**HR Operations \& Service Excellence**
* Partner closely with the India HR Leader to execute people processes and HR initiatives across the India organization.
* Serve as the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR policies, processes, and employee lifecycle matters.

* Ensure HR processes are compliant, efficient, and delivered within defined timelines and service standards.

**Employee Relations \& Manager Support**

* Support employee communications and organizational events.

**HR Projects \& Continuous Improvement**

**Job Description**
 At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength comes from the people who bring our purpose to life every day. We are committed to creating a workplace where employees feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work.
   

  

 We are seeking an
 **Employee \& Labor Relations Leader, India** 
 to help us build a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing work environment across India. In this leadership role, we will rely on your expertise to guide employee and labour relations strategy, support business transformation, and foster strong relationships across our workforce.
   

  

 Working closely with business leaders, HR partners, managers, employees, and employee representatives, we will partner to address sophisticated workplace matters, strengthen organizational capability, and ensure our people practices reflect both our values and business priorities.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to influence people strategy at a national level, lead a team, and make a lasting impact on employee experience, organizational effectiveness, and business success.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 As Head of ERLR, India, you will help shape and deliver our Employee Relations (ER) and Labour Relations (LR) strategy while supporting a culture of trust, accountability, fairness, and inclusion.
   

  

 You will partner with leaders and HR teams to proactively find opportunities and challenges across the employee lifecycle, providing guidance that supports both employees and strategic objectives.

**Employee Relations**
* Guide the resolution of sophisticated employee relations matters, including grievances, investigations, disciplinary issues, and workplace concerns.
* Partner with leaders and HR teams to ensure consistent, fair, and respectful approaches to employee relations matters.
* Build confidence and capability among managers through coaching, training, and practical guidance.
* Help creates a positive employee experience by fostering open communication, trust, and constructive workplace relationships.


**Labour Relations**
* Lead labour relations strategy and provide oversight for unionized employee populations across India.
* Support the preparation, negotiation, and implementation of Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).
* Foster constructive relationships with union representatives and employee groups.
* Provide guidance on labour relations implications related to business transformation activities, including restructuring, acquisitions, divestitures, outsourcing, and workforce changes.


**Strategy, Governance \& Compliance**

* Use insights and data to identify trends, address risks, and improve workplace outcomes.

* Find opportunities to improve processes, policies, and service delivery models.
* Champion innovative ways of working that improve employee experience and operational effectiveness.
* Support organizational change initiatives that help our workforce and business succeed in a vibrant environment.
