****About The Role****
 The Oracle HR Reports Developer designs and manages enterprise HR reporting and analytics across BIP, OTBI, FDI, and FAW / Lakehouse, turning business requirements into reliable reports, dashboards, data pipelines for global HR, Compensation, Talent, Payroll, and Operations teams.
   

  

 This role partners with the AI System Architect and HR Technology lead to ensure reporting solutions are accurate, scalable, and governance aligned.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Oracle BI Publisher (BIP)**
* Design, develop, and maintain BIP reports and templates (RTF, Excel, and eText) for HCM, Talent, Benefits, and Compensation.
* Build and optimize data models, SQL queries, and flexfield\-based reporting solutions.
* Configure report bursting, scheduling, and automated distribution.
* Develop regulatory, compliance, audit, and operational reporting extracts.
* Manage BIP catalog governance, security, version control, and environment migrations.


**Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI)**
* Develop and maintain OTBI analysis, dashboards, KPIs, and self\-service reporting solutions across Oracle HCM modules.
* Design user\-friendly analytics using filters, prompts, hierarchical views, and interactive dashboards.
* Govern OTBI content through catalog administration, naming standards, usage audits, and lifecycle management.
* Enable business self\-service reporting through user support, training, and best\-practice guidance.
* Assess and remediate report impacts resulting from Oracle quarterly releases and subject area changes.


**Oracle Data Intelligence (FDI)**
* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade FDI dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions supporting HR, Finance, Compensation, Talent Management, and Workforce Planning functions.
* Configure and manage FDI subject areas, semantic model extensions (SME), custom calculations, KPIs, dimensions, and measures to meet evolving business reporting requirements.
* Implement and troubleshoot FDI security, including row\-level security, data access roles, Area of Responsibility (AOR)\-based security, and custom subject\-area access controls.
* Develop interactive dashboards, visualizations, drill\-through analyses, and executive scorecards for leadership teams and business stakeholders.
* Integrate data from Oracle Fusion HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Compensation, and Workforce Management modules into unified analytics and reporting solutions.
* Support quarterly Oracle releases, regression testing, validation activities, and production issue resolution for FDI analytics environments.


**Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) / Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW)**
* Configure, administer, and optimize Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) environments, including pipeline activation, data synchronization, incremental refresh schedules, and semantic model enhancements.
* Extend the FAW/FDI Lakehouse architecture by ingesting and integrating non\-Oracle HR and workforce data sources—including Eightfold AI, Celergo, ADP GlobalView, compensation benchmarking platforms, and other third\-party applications—into Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) using ODI, OCI Object Storage, APIs, and custom ETL frameworks.
* Develop and maintain custom ADW data models, staging structures, and transformation processes to support advanced reporting and cross\-functional analytics.
* Design and publish workforce analytics dashboards covering headcount, attrition, hiring, promotions, compensation, diversity, compliance, and organizational effectiveness metrics.
* Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, refresh jobs, synchronization failures, schema changes, and data quality issues across FDI, FAW, ADW, and ODI environments.
* Maintain data governance standards, documentation, lineage tracking, security policies, and audit\-compliant access controls across analytics platforms.


**Cross\-Platform \& Governance**
* Maintain reporting inventory, ownership, data classification, and refresh schedules.
* Administer row\-level security (RLS) and role\-based access controls.
* Support analytics data integration from Boomi, HCM Extracts, and other enterprise sources.

description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners (HRP) provide high\-judgment HR support to managers across levels at scale, enabling them to become force multipliers for customer impact and positive employee experience. They demonstrate advanced knowledge of HR policies, processes, and tools, acting as trusted consultants to managers and senior managers. HRPs work backwards from the voice of the manager to deliver personalized experiences and drive large\-scale initiatives using technology and simplified processes that match the speed and agility of our business. They operate independently as subject matter experts with deep knowledge of regional programs and policies, collaborating extensively with PXT teams including HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal, and others to provide integrated people solutions. As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers and senior managers collaborate with Senior HR Partners to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes at the country or regional level. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, Sr. HRPs are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders. Sr. HRPs are also expected to partner on complex global and regional strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives. As a subject matter expert, Sr. HRPs mentor and guide junior team members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Performance Management: Partner with managers on complex and nuanced performance management cases including performance improvement plans and assessments. Guide managers in implementing performance management processes and tools effectively. Partner with managers to ensure bias\-free evaluations and effective coaching approaches across teams. Analyze performance data to identify trends, share insights, and develop solutions for systemic issues.
* Employee Relations: Handle complex and nuanced employee relations cases and investigations following established processes and policies. Conduct thorough and impartial investigations, support grievance processes, and lead informal discussions or mediation. Provide guidance to managers on sophisticated ER matters including policy violations and workplace concerns across countries. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations teams to resolve sensitive cases while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Analyze investigation findings, prepare recommendations, and identify trends to prevent future risks.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Drive implementation of employee programs and lead improvements in manager experience. Partner with HR Business Partners and central teams on complex change initiatives across countries. Use data and insights to advocate for and influence process improvements. Design and execute change management strategies to ensure effective adoption across diverse employee groups.
* Process Improvement: Drive complex strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives across India. Partner with global HRP team, other HR teams and CoEs to drive global and regional HRP strategic projects.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool that enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field, or 5\+ years of human resources experience and Bachelor's degree
* Experience delivering results by partnering with and influencing others
* Experience coaching and mentoring at the management level
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience working effectively across cross\-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
* Business and HR acumen, including problem solving skills, critical thinking, and self\-initiative


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources or related field with about 6\-10 years’ work experience. Proven track record of accomplishments in a dynamic environment, which is fast paced and customer driven. Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and make the best use of available resources. Project management and the ability to deliver, with a proven track record of influencing through data\-driven recommendations. Coaching and consulting skills; Ability to work with and influence multiple stakeholders. Experience in dealing with contingent workforce will be an advantage. Presentation skills and knowledge of employment laws.

 Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!
   

  

****Job Description****
**About the Role**
 We are seeking a Learning \& Development (L\&D) Specialist to support employee development initiatives, initially focused on our India campus, with the opportunity to scale programs globally. This role will design, coordinate, facilitate, and continuously improve learning programs that support onboarding, career development, leadership growth, and employee performance.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director, Organizational Development in Canada, the ideal candidate is passionate about creating engaging learning experiences, building scalable programs, and partnering effectively with leaders and subject matter experts across regions. As part of a global HR team, this role requires the ability to work independently while collaborating across multiple time zones to deliver impactful learning solutions aligned with business objectives.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Employee Onboarding \& Integration**
* Manage and enhance the virtual employee onboarding program.
* Partner with business leaders and technical teams to develop role\-specific onboarding programs.
* Measure onboarding effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements.


**Career Development \& Career Pathing**
* Design and implement career development frameworks and career pathing tools to support employee career planning, skill development, and internal mobility.
* Partner with leaders to identify growth opportunities and development pathways for employees.


**Development (Leadership \& Employee)**
* Design, coordinate, and support leadership development programs for emerging and established leaders.
* Develop and deploy employee development programs that build critical professional and technical skills.
* Conduct learning needs assessments and recommend appropriate training solutions.
* Track participation, effectiveness, and learning outcomes using relevant metrics.


**Facilitation \& Program Delivery**
* Create and deliver engaging virtual and in\-person training programs, including the development of eLearning content and learning materials, to enhance employee skills, knowledge, and performance.
* Support local learning initiatives while maintaining alignment with global learning strategies.


**Program Design \& Global Scalability**
* Build learning programs that can be standardized, scaled, and deployed globally.
* Leverage learning technologies and digital platforms to maximize learner engagement and accessibility.


****Qualifications****
* Any Bachelor's degree with MBA or Post Graduation with specialization in Human Resources, Organizational Development or a related field from reputed Institutions.
* 7 years\+ of hard core experience in Learning \& Development, Talent Development, Organizational Development, or related discipline from Global / Multi National Companies with Matrix reporting structure.
* Experience in designing and managing onboarding, leadership, and employee development programs.
* Knowledge of career development frameworks and competency models.
* Strong instructional design and curriculum development skills.
* Experience facilitating virtual and instructor\-led learning programs.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Learning Management Systems (LMS), preferably Oracle, and digital learning platforms.


 Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

 We are looking for an experienced Executive Business Partner to support our GM, India and our Head of Enterprise Sales, based in Mumbai. This person will help both leaders operate with clarity, focus, and momentum across India\-specific priorities, India regional work, and HQ partnership.
   

  

 You will manage highly dynamic calendars, complex travel, internal and external communications, and operating rhythms that keep leaders and teams aligned across markets and time zones. You will also serve as a key point of contact for executives visiting India from HQ, helping coordinate local context, schedules, logistics, and meetings.
   

  

 This is a high\-trust role that requires excellent judgment, discretion, cross\-cultural fluency, and the ability to move quickly without losing precision. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguous, high\-growth environments; enjoys creating order and systems; and is energized by supporting leaders who operate across geographies, functions, and stakeholder groups. Fluency in Hindi and English is required.
   

  

 Our Executive Business Partners serve as trusted advisors and collaborators to OpenAI's executives and leaders, focused on strong communication and operational excellence across teams. With a focus on elevating the impact and efficiency of leadership, we anticipate needs, streamline processes, and provide comprehensive support to ensure our executives can focus on high\-impact initiatives. We play a pivotal role in driving success and achieving key milestones by cultivating strong relationships and leveraging our deep understanding of business objectives. With a commitment to excellence and a proactive approach, we are dedicated to empowering our executives and contributing to the overall growth and success of the company.
   

  

 Our leadership team reflects OpenAI’s culture and core values and is a mission\-driven, kind, and thoughtful group. We take pride in creating a work environment that fosters collaboration, open communication, and authenticity, making OpenAI an excellent place to work for highly accomplished professionals.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Executive Business Partner will be a proactive and adaptable partner to executives, managing complex scheduling, coordinating projects, and optimizing workflows. This role requires independence, task\-level ownership, and a deep understanding of OpenAI’s mission to foster AGI that benefits humanity. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, rapidly\-evolving business priorities, and can drive best practices to help scale exec and team operations.
   

  

 This role is based in Mumbai, India. We follow a hybrid work model of three days in the office each week.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Build strong connections within the immediate team and across other departments, becoming a trusted partner to leaders. This includes an understanding of team dynamics, priorities, and stakeholders, facilitating seamless coordination on high\-stakes projects.
* Excel in sharing information clearly and efficiently, adapting communication styles for a broad range of audiences.
* Balance the calendars and priorities of multiple leaders, demonstrating prioritization skills and agility in adapting to shifts in priorities, while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

 Experience with HR tech, talent intelligence, skills platforms, or people analytics

title: People Partner
description:
***Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!***
*Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs.*
 The People Partner is the primary HR partner for designated business groups at Acceldata. This role sits at the intersection of employee advocacy and business effectiveness \- advising managers, resolving people challenges, and driving the talent and development agenda. You work in close partnership with the People Ops team, bringing the human and organisational side of the business into sharp focus.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Employee Relations \& Experience**
* Be the go\-to HR partner for employees across your business groups \- accessible, trusted, and genuinely invested in their experience.
* Manage employee relations matters with fairness and sound judgment: workplace concerns, conflict resolution, and investigations where required.
* Conduct stay interviews and listening sessions; surface themes and insights to HR leadership with a clear point of view on what needs to move.


**Manager Partnership \& Organisational Health**
* Serve as the primary HR contact for managers \- advising on people decisions, policy interpretation, team dynamics, and employee situations.
* Equip managers with the tools, frameworks, and confidence to lead their teams effectively.
* Monitor the health of your business groups \- engagement signals, retention patterns, performance trends \- and bring recommendations to leadership before issues escalate.
* Support organisational change: communication, manager readiness, and employee adoption.


**Talent Management \& Development**
* Own the talent management agenda for your business groups \- from identifying capability gaps today to building the pipeline the business needs tomorrow.
* Design and maintain competency frameworks that define what great looks like at every level; keep them connected to hiring and real career conversations, not just documentation.
* Build and run structured talent reviews: assess performance and potential, identify high\-potential employees, surface flight risks, and translate outcomes into concrete development and succession plans.
* Own succession planning for critical roles within your business groups \- proactively identifying and developing internal candidates so the business is never caught unprepared.
* Conduct ongoing learning needs assessments across your population; translate findings into targeted development interventions \- whether that's a formal program, a stretch assignment, a mentoring relationship, or an external resource
* Partner with HR leadership and external vendors to design, source, and deliver learning programs that build capability at scale.
* Track the impact of development investments \- participation, application, and outcomes \- and use that data to improve what's working and cut what isn't.
* Support internal mobility by helping employees understand career pathways and actively connecting talent to opportunities across the business.
* Build a culture of continuous feedback and development within your business groups \- making growth a lived experience, not an annual event.


**Performance \& Feedback Culture**
* Support the annual and mid\-year performance process \- ensuring meaningful participation, consistent execution, and clear outcomes.
* Coach managers and employees through goal\-setting, feedback, and development conversations.
* Identify trends emerging from performance cycles and share insights with HR leadership.


**What You Bring**
* 6–9 years of progressive HR experience in a People Partner, HRBP, or Employee Relations role.
* Strong employee relations instincts \- you know how to hold a difficult conversation and reach a fair outcome.
* Track record of building trusted relationships with managers and employees at all levels.
* Experience supporting talent development, career frameworks, and performance processes.
* Comfortable working in a lean team where you own your domain end\-to\-end.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS or tech company.


**YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF**
* You're energised by the complexity of people and organisations \- no two situations are the same and that's what keeps you engaged.
* You give advice that leaders actually take because it's grounded, practical, and delivered with confidence.
* You believe great HR partnership makes the business better, not just more compliant.


***We care for our team***
* Mentorship \& Growth
* ESOPs
* Medical and Life Insurance
* Paid Maternity \& Parental Leave
* Corporate Uber Program
* Learning \& Development Support


***Acceldata for All***
*We are a fast\-growing company, solving complex data problems at scale. We are driven by strong work ethics, high standards of excellence, and a spirit of collaboration. We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual.*
***Why Acceldata?***
*Acceldata is redefining data observability for enterprise data systems. Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud\-first, AI\-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. We address common challenges such as scaling and performance issues, cost overruns, and data quality problems by providing operational visibility, proactive alerts, and monitoring reliability across the various environments.*
*Delivered as a SaaS product, Acceldata's solutions have been embraced by global customers, such as HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Zoominfo, GSK, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hersheys, Dun \& Bradstreet, and many more. Acceldata is a Series\-C funded company and its investors include Insight Partners, March Capital, Lightspeed, Sorenson Ventures, Industry Ventures, and Emergent Ventures.*

description:
**Build Our Future Together**
 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for people with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, while redefining our understanding of health.
   

  

 Regeneron is expanding its international footprint by establishing a new Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Hyderabad, India, in addition to our existing Bangalore office. We are seeking a Senior Director, HR Business Partner, who will serve as the GCC HR Head and lead HR business partnering activities across India. In this role, you will shape and execute the India HR strategy, advise the GCC Leadership Team, oversee locally based HR colleagues supporting global teams, and partner closely with Global HR Centers of Excellence to deliver effective and efficient HR services. You will help strengthen Regeneron’s high\-performance culture, the Regeneron Way, while supporting the continued growth of our India organization and GCC capabilities.
   

  

**When \& Where**
 Hyderabad (hybrid)
   

  

**Discover Your Role**
* Take overall responsibility for the strategic and operational leadership of Regeneron’s HR function in India, while contributing to global and regional HR priorities.
* Develop and execute the India HR strategy, creating solutions that attract, develop, engage, and retain talent through a strong employer brand, market\-competitive total rewards, and agile HR practices.
* Partner with business leaders, employees, and HR colleagues on workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, development, inclusion, employee engagement, employee relations, performance management, and change management.
* Serve as a member of the GCC Leadership Team, advising the GCC Head and helping shape the strategy required for the centre to reach its full potential.
* Lead the daily administration and continuous improvement of core HR activities, including onboarding, talent development, performance management, employee relations, reward, HR policy, engagement, and employee welfare.
* Provide leadership, coaching, support, and development to India\-based HR colleagues, promoting professional standards, capability building, knowledge sharing, engagement, and retention.
* Partner with Global HR Centers of Excellence, including Employee Services, HR Operations and Technology, People Analytics and Insights, Talent Management, and Total Rewards, to deliver locally appropriate and globally aligned programs.
* Oversee the day\-to\-day management and prioritization of locally based HR COE leaders and teams, support blocking issues, and collaborate with Global COE leaders to maximize team impact.
* Ensure compliance with applicable employment legislation, regulations, professional standards, company policies, and procedures.
* Coach and support senior leaders and high\-potential colleagues, while enabling managers to address workforce matters and effectively navigate the annual performance cycle.
* Partner with technology teams to develop and enhance market\-appropriate HR systems, including Workday and ServiceNow.
* Manage the HR budget for the India entity.
* Partner with Regeneron’s Law Department on statutory and employee\-related matters, lead employee relations investigations, and ensure appropriate follow\-up actions are completed.
* Translate business needs into actionable HR priorities, systems, and solutions, while sharing standard processes across the International HR Business Partner team and the extended HR Operations and Solutions Leadership Team.
* Drive continuous improvement by using data, root\-cause analysis, and pragmatic solutions to improve productivity, strengthen leadership capability, and create an effective employee experience.


**This Role Requires**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, a scientific discipline, or a related field; an MBA or master’s degree in Organization Development or Human Resources is preferred.
* Minimum of 15 years of HR experience, including experience in an HR or management role within the Indian pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or biotechnology industry.
* Experience working in a global organization and establishing and growing a Global Capability Centre.
* Broad experience across multiple HR teams, such as Total Rewards, HR Operations, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, and Talent Development.
* Experience supporting or leading across multiple sites is preferred.
* Proven expertise in talent acquisition and talent development within a technically driven organization.
* A proven record of initiative, sound prioritization, and an entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to deliver outcomes effectively.
* Ability to diagnose sophisticated organizational and people challenges, conduct root\-cause analysis, and use data to develop pragmatic solutions.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical capability, with confidence using Microsoft 365 applications, HRIS platforms, and other people\-related systems.
* Learning agility and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, translating sophisticated people and data issues into clear, coherent solutions.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder\-management skills, including the courage to challenge established ways of working and focus on doing the right thing.
* Significant understanding of HR legal and compliance requirements.

**Job Purpose**
 Build strong connect with sales team to effectively partner in building the right values\-based culture.
   

  

 Responsible for driving core HR processes efficiently and effectively with the sales team to create healthy work environment.
   

  

 Ensure capability building for the sales team as per development needs \& company priorities and create a performance\-oriented work culture

 Data collection, consolidating and analyzing to draw up regular reports to help drive relevant action.
   

  

 Provide effective HR/ personnel/ administrative support to the region sales team
   

  

**Primary Roles \& Accountabilities**
 Core HR Processes: Ensure flawless execution of the following Core people processes
   

  

 Performance Management process –
   

  

* Objective Setting of the entire team are SMART \& in line with AOP, business \& people priorities.
* Midyear Review\- Ensure MYR is done between manager \& employee to provide directions on the progress
* Annual Appraisal\- Ensure PDRs are well written, onus for calibration of the region team and fitting the bell curve. Compilation of data to ensure high quality Calibration and pay for performance

 Employee Engagement \& Culture Building

* Ensure that all relevant HR processes are communicated to the frontline and build a strong PepsiCo Employer Proposition.

 Capability Building

 Create Performance improvement plan with RM for the people in concern area.
   

  

 Implementation of change initiatives and supporting continuous improvement in sales function.
   

  

 Facilitate delivery of development and training activities for employees and monitor effectiveness for business results as per the requirement.
   

  

 Administration and MIS
   

  

* Generate, own and maintain various People Process reports/ records/ analysis and must Win Battles Report. Send the reports to HO as per timelines and as required and drive appropriate action plans in partnership with RM \& BUHR
* Ensure that relevant HR Admin support is provided to the employees in a timely manner

The Senior Associate – HR Knowledge Management is responsible for managing and enhancing the HR knowledge ecosystem to support efficient, accurate, and user\-friendly access to HR information. This role combines strategic content management, platform stewardship, and cross\-functional collaboration to ensure HR knowledge is current, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate has a keen eye for detail, a passion for digital knowledge tools, and a proactive mindset in supporting a culture of self\-service and continuous improvement.

**Key responsibilities**

**Knowledge Content Strategy \& Governance**

* Develop and maintain high\-quality HR knowledge content across our internal knowledge platform, ServiceNow.
* Implement and manage content governance processes, including content lifecycle management, version control, and periodic audits.
* Ensure alignment of knowledge content with internal policies, and ensure consistent tone, format, and branding across all HR knowledge materials.

**Platform Ownership \& Optimization**

* Serve as a subject matter expert and administrator for HR knowledge management tools (e.g., ServiceNow Knowledge Base, SharePoint, Confluence).
* Optimize platform structure and taxonomy to improve discoverability, search performance, and user experience.
* Coordinate with DTI and HRI Tech teams to ensure system integrity and feature enhancements.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), HR Business Partners, and and other stakeholders/content owners to gather and validate content updates.
* Collaborate with the HR digital and operations teams to ensure seamless integration of knowledge assets into HR portals and service channels.

**Data\-Driven Improvements**

* Monitor usage analytics and employee feedback to identify knowledge gaps, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* Participate in knowledge audits and content lifecycle management initiatives
* Prepare and present regular performance and compliance reports to stakeholders.

**Enablement \& Support**

* Train and support content contributors and stakeholders on knowledge creation best practices and tool usage.
* Promote a culture of knowledge sharing and employee and manager self\-service through enablement and communication campaigns.

**Project Leadership**

* Lead or support large\-scale knowledge\-related projects (e.g., HR portal redesigns, chatbot integration).
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that streamline access to HR knowledge and enhance service delivery.

**Qualifications**

* 5\-8 years of experience in HR, knowledge management, HR service delivery, or digital HR roles.
* Proven experience with knowledge management systems and content management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, SharePoint)
* Strong understanding of HR processes, policies, and shared services environments.
* Excellent collaboration, communication and technical writing skills.
* Analytical and proactive mindset with experience interpreting content usage metrics and drawing insights.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects in a fast\-paced environment.

title: HR Reporting Analyst
description:
**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a highly analytical and detail\-oriented Senior HRIS Analyst to support the organization's HR reporting, analytics, data governance, and HR systems. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience working with HR data, enterprise HRIS platforms such as Workday, and developing insightful reports and dashboards that enable informed business decisions. This role will partner closely with HR, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, optimize reporting capabilities, and drive process improvements through automation and AI\-enabled reporting solutions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Develop, maintain, and enhance complex HR reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Produce recurring reports on headcount, turnover, recruitment, diversity, absenteeism, leave management, and organizational changes.
* Provide ad hoc reporting and workforce analytics to support HR leadership and business stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve HRIS reporting, dashboards, automation, and AI\-driven reporting capabilities.
* Analyze workforce trends and provide actionable insights and recommendations.
* Support annual HR processes, including salary reviews, performance management cycles, bonus planning, and organizational planning.



**HR Data Management \& Governance** 



* Maintain the accuracy, quality, and integrity of HR data across enterprise HR systems.
* Perform regular data audits, validation checks, and data cleansing activities.
* Ensure compliance with GDPR and organizational data governance policies.
* Develop and maintain reporting standards, process documentation, and data governance guidelines.



**HR Systems Support** 



* Support HR Cloud reporting and future HRIS reporting enhancements.
* Participate in system testing, validation, and implementation of new HRIS features and enhancements.
* Provide end\-user support and training on HRIS reporting tools and functionality.
* Collaborate with HR Operations, IT, and other cross\-functional teams to improve HR systems and reporting capabilities.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).
* Minimum of 5 years of experience working as an HR Analyst, HRIS Analyst, or in an HR data analytics environment.
* Proven experience supporting HR operations within a fast\-paced, global organization.
* Strong understanding of HR processes, policies, and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise HRIS platforms, preferably Workday.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and data interpretation skills.
* High level of confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive employee information.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence and visualization tools.
* Knowledge of SQL and HR data management principles.
* Experience with HR reporting automation and AI\-enabled reporting solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.

**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced HR professional to join HR COE Services VOIS India in Pune. This role focuses on providing HR advisory support and operational HR services to global business functions, working closely with onshore HR Business Partners (HRBPs) across multiple geographies. The successful candidate will help deliver people processes, HR projects, data\-driven insights, reporting, budget management, process excellence initiatives, and employee lifecycle activities through a robust shared services delivery model while ensuring compliance with privacy regulations and service level commitments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Support HR colleagues, primarily HRBPs, across different countries and business units in delivering hire\-to\-retire processes, reports, dashboards, data quality activities, and HR projects
* Act as a key point of contact for business functions, providing guidance and executing HR activities in line with global and local HR procedures
* Resolve complex employee queries by collaborating with appropriate stakeholders within and outside HR when required
* Drive participation, tracking, and completion of cyclical and ad hoc HR activities and projects, including employee engagement surveys, performance reviews, annual budgeting activities, and reward programmes
* Prepare and present business review presentations to internal and international stakeholders
* Maintain monthly and rolling HR budgets, analyse variances, and provide insights to HRBPs across multiple geographies
* Produce weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports, dashboards, and analytical insights on HR metrics from an HRBP perspective
* Monitor and improve organisational and employee data quality through regular audits, root cause analysis, and corrective action tracking
* Partner with HRBPs to identify process improvements, enhance data quality, and provide KPI trend analysis
* Recommend and implement enhancements that improve employee experience, increase process efficiency, and simplify HR operations
* Support the transition of new services into the shared services model and ensure effective knowledge transfer and operational readiness

* Resolve escalations effectively and identify preventive measures to minimise recurrence

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with internal and international stakeholders
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem\-solving, and quantitative analysis capabilities
* Proactive and customer\-focused, with the ability to prioritise competing requirements and respond empathetically to stakeholder needs
* Ability to think from an HRBP perspective while operating within a global shared services environment
* Passion for continuously improving employee experience, service quality, and operational excellence
* Strong understanding of HR data, organisational data, confidentiality requirements, and data governance principles
* Flexibility to align with global stakeholder requirements and work within a hybrid working environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
* Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, and SuccessFactors would be advantageous


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to work closely with global HRBPs and international business stakeholders
* Exposure to end\-to\-end HR operations, strategic HR processes, and employee lifecycle activities across multiple geographies
* Experience in data\-driven HR decision\-making through reporting, analytics, and workforce insights
* Participation in business\-critical HR projects, process transformation initiatives, and service transitions
* Opportunity to contribute directly to employee experience improvements and operational excellence programmes
* Hybrid working model with exposure to a diverse and global work environment


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced stakeholder management across global business functions

* HR budget tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis
* Service delivery management, SLA monitoring, and case management
* Process improvement, operational excellence, and shared services best practices

* Practical application of GDPR and privacy\-by\-design principles within HR operations

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

The Manager, IT – BRM (HR) serves as the primary technology partner to the HR function – someone who can sit in a compensation review or a talent calibration session, understand what’s being discussed, and translate that directly into system solutions. You will own the full HR technology stack, drive implementations, lead a small team of IT professionals, and act as the trusted advisor who bridges the gap between people strategy and technology execution.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Technical Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* 7\+ years of progressive IT experience with at least 4 years in a hands\-on HR technology role – configuring, implementing, and supporting HCM platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, DarwinBox, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated functional HR knowledge across at least three domains: talent acquisition, core HR/HRIS, compensation \& benefits, payroll, learning \& development, or workforce management.
* Proven track record of personally leading end\-to\-end HCM implementations or major module rollouts in a global, multi\-country environment.
* Strong project and program management skills; PMP or equivalent certification preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with HR system integrations, middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Dell Boomi), and HR data reporting/analytics tools.
* Familiarity with HR compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, pay equity regulations, statutory reporting) and how they translate into system configuration.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of HR technology trends including AI\-driven talent tools, skills\-based workforce management, and HR process automation (RPA/AI).
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to engage credibly with HR business leaders and translate operational HR needs into actionable technical solutions.
* Continuous improvement mindset (LEAN/Agile) with a track record of simplifying HR processes through technology.


**Key Accountabilities / How You Will Spend Your Days**
**Hands\-On HR Technology Delivery**
* Serve as a subject\-matter expert and active practitioner on core HCM platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, DarwinBox)
* Lead and personally contribute to HCM transformation projects – from blueprint and design workshops through configuration, UAT, cutover, and hypercare – with direct accountability for system quality.
* Own end\-to\-end HR technology processes across the employee lifecycle: talent acquisition, onboarding, compensation, benefits, payroll, learning \& development, performance management, and offboarding.
* Perform business process analysis alongside HR stakeholders, documenting current\-state workflows, identifying gaps, and designing improved future\-state configurations.


**Deep HR Functional Partnership**
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, L\&D, and Payroll teams – attending functional meetings, understanding operational pain points, and proactively proposing technology solutions.
* Act as the primary escalation point for HR system issues; investigate root causes, engage vendors as needed, and drive resolution with urgency and transparency.
* Translate HR policy and regulatory changes (e.g., pay equity, compliance reporting, new benefit structures) into system requirements and actionable configuration changes.
* Champion data integrity across HR systems – establishing data governance standards, audit routines, and remediation processes in collaboration with HR operations teams.
* Support workforce analytics by ensuring HR data structures, reporting hierarchies, and BI integrations are accurate, timely, and meaningful for HR and business leaders.


**Project \& Portfolio Management**
* Manage the HR IT project portfolio with discipline: scope definition, resource planning, risk management, status reporting, and stakeholder communication – keeping projects on time, within budget, and delivering measurable outcomes.
* Define and maintain a rolling HR technology roadmap, prioritizing investments based on business value, HR strategy alignment, and total cost of ownership.
* Conduct rigorous cost\-benefit analyses for new system investments, upgrades, and vendor decisions, presenting clear business cases to IT and HR leadership.
* Lead post\-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and continuously improve delivery practices.


**Vendor \& Contract Management**
* Own vendor relationships for HR technology platforms and third\-party integrations – managing SLAs, escalating performance issues, and negotiating contract renewals with a value\-for\-money mindset.
* Evaluate new HR technology vendors and solutions with structured RFP/RFI processes, personally assessing demos and conducting reference checks to make informed recommendations.


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Lead and mentor a team of HR IT analysts and developers, providing technical guidance, code/configuration reviews, and career development support.
* Build team capability in HR functional knowledge alongside technical skills – ensuring the IT team understands what HR does, not just how the system works.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and learning from both successes and failures.


**Technology Innovation \& Process Improvement**
* Stay current with HR technology trends – AI\-driven talent intelligence, skills\-based workforce tools, RPA, and employee experience platforms – and pilot relevant innovations in a structured, value\-focused way.
* Identify and lead process automation opportunities across HR operations, reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy.
* Drive adoption of deployed tools through targeted training, user enablement, and change management activities developed in close collaboration with HR leadership.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* 95% of projects delivered on time and within budget.
* Achieve a project success rate of 90% based on defined project objectives.
* Improve application uptime and availability.
* Reduction in application\-related incidents by 20%.
* Adherence to the IT budget with a variance of less than 5%.
* Achieve a team satisfaction score of 85% or higher in annual surveys.
* Proactively identify and mitigate potential risks and vulnerabilities.
* Upgrade outdated, unsupportive IT Infrastructure \& Software, supporting Finance and HR operations, with latest technology to improve system uptime and availability to 99%.


**Key Year One Deliverables**
* Complete a thorough audit of the existing HR technology landscape, documenting gaps, risks, and quick\-win improvement opportunities.
* Establish a trusted partnership with the CHRO and HR leadership team, becoming the go\-to advisor for technology decisions.
* Drive at least one significant HR technology improvement (e.g., HCM module implementation, process automation, or integration) from design through go\-live.
* Publish a 3\-year HR IT roadmap aligned to HR and business strategy.
* Implement operational governance practices for HR system support, change management, and release management.


**Key Leadership Behaviors**
* Lead from the front – models accountability, transparency, and a growth mindset for the IT\-HR team.
* Stakeholder Management – builds deep trust with CHRO, HR Business Partners, and People leadership as a strategic advisor.
* Drives Innovation \& Focus – champions AI, automation, and emerging HR tech to improve workforce outcomes and employee experience.
* Employee \& HR Customer Obsession – places the employee experience at the center of every technology decision and service delivery model.
* Business Acumen – understands HR operating models, workforce economics, and people strategy to ensure IT solutions deliver measurable business value.
* Critical thinking \& problem solving – applies structured analytical thinking to navigate complex HR technology landscapes and competing organizational priorities.

description:
**Head – Global Capability Center (GCC) \- India** 




  





**Objective of the role:** 




  





 The Head – Global Business \& Shared Services Center will provide strategic and operational leadership for our client’s India Global Capability Center (GCC), a critical enabler of its global manufacturing operations. The role will lead a multi\-functional shared services environment supporting IT, Finance, HR, Procurement, Customer Services, and other enterprise functions that directly enable global manufacturing plants, engineering, R\&D, and supply chain operations.
 



  





 The role carries overall responsibility for service delivery, operational governance, transformation, business continuity, process excellence, stakeholder management, and organizational growth across multiple locations, while positioning India as a strategic global capability hub supporting the organization’s worldwide manufacturing footprint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Site Management** 



* Lead the India Global Business \& IT Services Center as a strategic business entity.
* Provide leadership, direction, and governance across multiple plant locations.
* Establish a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Drive execution of the long\-term growth strategy for the India Global Capability Center.



  





**2\.Global Service Delivery Leadership** 



* Ensure reliable end\-to\-end service delivery across:
* IT Services
* Finance \& Controlling
* Human Resources
* Procurement \& Supply Chain
* Customer Services
* Other Global Business Support Functions
* Support multiple global manufacturing plants, R\&D centers, corporate offices, and business units across the Group.
* Drive operational consistency, scalability, and service excellence across all functions



  





**3\.Multi\-Site Operational Management** 



* Oversee operations across multiple locations.
* Optimize resource utilization between locations.
* Eliminate duplication of activities.
* Ensure standardized operating practices across sites.



  





**4\.Process Governance \& Operational Excellence** 



* Establish end\-to\-end process ownership across global functions.
* Define governance frameworks, KPIs, SLAs, and performance metrics.
* Monitor operational performance and drive corrective actions where necessary.
* Ensure business continuity, operational resilience, and risk mitigation.



  





**5\.Transformation \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Lead enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives.
* Standardize and harmonize global business processes.
* Drive Lean, Six Sigma, and Operational Excellence initiatives.
* Improve productivity, quality, cost efficiency, and customer experience.



  





**6\.Digital \& Technology Enablement** 



* Lead digital transformation programs leveraging:
* Artificial Intelligence
* Automation
* Robotics (RPA)
* Workflow optimization
* Analytics
* Self\-service platforms
* Partner with global IT teams to enable technology\-driven service improvements.



  





**7\.Governance, Compliance \& Financial Stewardship** 



* Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory, audit, tax, and internal control requirements.
* Oversee budgeting, resource planning, and investment business cases.
* Support financial governance and business planning for the India entity.



  





**8\.Stakeholder Management** 



* Build trusted relationships with senior leadership across:
* Global Headquarters
* Regional Leadership Teams
* Business Units
* Manufacturing Plants
* CIO / CFO / CHRO organizations, R\&D Centers
* Represent the India Global Business \& IT Services Center in executive leadership forums.
* Influence global decision\-making and strategic initiatives.



  





**9\.Customer \& Service Excellence** 



* Foster a customer\-centric service culture.
* Measure internal customer satisfaction through structured Voice of Customer (VoC) mechanisms.
* Drive continuous improvements based on stakeholder feedback.
* Establish the India center as a benchmark for global service delivery.



  





**10\.Growth \& Strategy** 




 Should have experience:
 


* Building 3–5 year roadmaps
* Scaling organizations
* Expanding service portfolios
* Building new capabilities
* Driving organizational maturity
* Establishing new service lines



  





**Candidate Criteria:** 




  




* 20\+ years of leadership experience in multinational organizations, with a strong background in Global Capability Centers (GCC), Global Business Services (GBS), or Shared Services.
* Proven experience in setting up, scaling, or transforming a Global Business \& IT Services organization supporting IT, Finance, HR, Procurement, Customer Services, and other corporate functions.
* Demonstrated success in leading large cross\-functional teams (300–1,000\+ employees) across multiple locations and global regions.
* Strong experience in global stakeholder management, collaborating with Headquarters, Regional Leadership, Executive Boards, C\-level leaders, Manufacturing Plants, R\&D Centers, and Business Units.
* Proven track record in digital transformation, automation, AI, process harmonization, operational excellence (Lean/Six Sigma), and continuous improvement, delivering measurable efficiency and productivity gains.
* Experience in outsourcing, insourcing, transition management, and managing vendor and strategic outsourcing relationships.
* Strong exposure to ERP platforms, workflow automation, shared services, and case management systems.
* Experience in governance, compliance, audit, statutory controls, financial oversight, budgeting, business continuity, and service delivery management within multinational organizations.
* Experience in mergers, business integrations, post\-merger harmonization, and organizational change management.
* Knowledge of service maturity assessments, benchmarking, KPI/SLA governance, and best\-in\-class global operating models.
* Proven ability to develop and execute 3–5 year growth strategies, expand service portfolios, and position India as a strategic global capability hub.
* Excellent leadership, communication, influencing, and customer\-centric mindset with strong execution capabilities.

description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM, we are committed to delivering exceptional employee experiences through operational excellence, continuous learning, and continuous improvement. The Training function plays a critical role in developing employee capabilities, ensuring process proficiency, and supporting business objectives through effective learning solutions.
   

  

 As an Assistant Manager – Process Training, you will be responsible for leading training initiatives across HR Contact Center operations. You will partner with Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, and Leadership teams to design, deliver, and continuously improve learning programs that enhance employee performance, service quality, and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 This role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in Learning \& Development, Knowledge Management, Training Governance, Employee Experience, and Operational Excellence within a global HR Shared Services environment.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development, delivery, and governance of training programs across HR Contact Center operations.
* Develop structured learning curricula for new hires, cross\-skilling, upskilling, process transitions, and refresher training programs.
* Conduct needs assessments and identify capability gaps through operational performance, quality results, and stakeholder feedback.
* Design engaging learning content, facilitator guides, job aids, process documentation, knowledge articles, and learning resources.
* Deliver instructor\-led, virtual, and blended learning programs across multiple employee groups.
* Assess training effectiveness using evaluations, knowledge assessments, operational performance metrics, and feedback mechanisms.
* Partner with Operations, Quality, and Workforce Management teams to align training interventions with business requirements and service delivery goals.
* Monitor and track learning effectiveness, certification completion, nesting performance, and employee readiness.
* Lead onboarding and induction programs for new hires and support transition initiatives.
* Support process launches, operational changes, system implementations, and transformation programs through targeted training interventions.
* Drive knowledge management initiatives and ensure training materials remain current, accurate, and aligned with business requirements.
* Conduct Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) sessions and support trainer capability development initiatives.
* Analyze training trends and recommend improvements to enhance employee performance, productivity, and customer experience.
* Support governance reviews, audits, compliance requirements, and training\-related reporting activities.
* Identify opportunities for learning innovation, digitization, and automation within the training function.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Education, Learning \& Development, or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in Process Training, Learning \& Development, Contact Center Training, HR Shared Services, or Service Delivery environments.
* Proven experience designing and delivering instructor\-led, virtual, and blended learning programs.
* Strong experience managing end\-to\-end new hire, process, refresher, and cross\-skilling training programs.
* Experience creating learning content, SOPs, process documentation, training decks, job aids, and knowledge repositories.
* Experience evaluating training effectiveness through assessments, operational metrics, and performance outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management experience with Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, and Business leaders.
* Experience supporting process transitions, system implementations, and organizational change initiatives.
* Exposure to learning management systems (LMS) and knowledge management platforms.


**Skills Required**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong presentation, facilitation, and classroom management skills.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Ability to influence employee performance through effective learning interventions.
* Strong instructional design and content development skills.
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Ability to analyze performance data and convert insights into targeted training solutions.
* Strong organizational, planning, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple training initiatives simultaneously.
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and knowledge\-sharing capabilities.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Experience supporting global HR Shared Services or HR Contact Center operations.
* Certification in Learning \& Development, Instructional Design, Facilitation, Coaching, or Training Management.
* Knowledge of adult learning principles, learning effectiveness methodologies, and capability development frameworks.
* Experience working with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms.
* Exposure to Quality, Workforce Management, and Employee Experience functions.
* Experience developing e\-learning modules, microlearning content, and digital learning solutions.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence methodologies.


**Additional Information / Pre\-Employment Requirements**
* Selected candidates will be required to undergo a comprehensive background verification process. This verification may take up to 6 weeks to complete, and employment will be subject to successful clearance.
* Candidates should be willing to work in a global service delivery environment and support multiple regions and time zones.
* Flexibility to support training programs outside standard working hours based on business requirements may be necessary.
* The role requires close collaboration with senior leadership, operational teams, quality functions, and business stakeholders.

**About Global Delivery Services**



Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.



Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.



Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.



Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

We are looking for Senior Consultant (Senior) with expertise in Organization and Workforce transformation to join the People Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services Organization whilst being instrumental in growth of the People Consulting team.

  



Organization and Workforce Transformation comprises of professionals who provides service offerings corresponding to Organization Design, Workforce Planning, Talent Management, Leadership and Culture. title: HR Officer
description:
**Description**
**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES: (including approximate percentage effort)**
**Human Resources Operations \& Compliance (35%)**
* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Ensure HR policies, procedures, and practices are implemented consistently across the organization.
* Maintain employee records and personnel files in compliance with organizational standards and statutory requirements.
* Ensure timely completion of HR documentation, contracts, employment letters, amendments, and employee communications.
* Monitor compliance with statutory requirements, audits, and internal controls.
* Coordinate with external vendors, consultants, and service providers for HR\-related services.
* Support internal and external audits by providing accurate HR documentation and reports.
* Maintain confidentiality and security of employee information and HR records.


**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning (20%)**
* Coordinate and manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes for assigned positions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce needs and support manpower planning.
* Manage candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and onboarding activities.
* Track recruitment metrics including time\-to\-fill, hiring costs, candidate pipeline, and onboarding effectiveness.
* Build and maintain talent pools for future organizational requirements.


**HR Systems, Payroll \& Benefits Administration (15%)**
* Serve as the focal point for HRIS data management and employee records administration.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and validate employee data for payroll processing.
* Administer employee benefits programs including insurance, wellness initiatives, leave management, and statutory benefits.
* Ensure timely updates of employee data in local and global HR systems.
* Generate HR dashboards and reports related to headcount, attrition, recruitment, leave utilization, and workforce demographics.


**Employee Relations \& Engagement (15%)**
* Act as a trusted point of contact for employee inquiries regarding policies, benefits, and HR processes.
* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, wellness programs, recognition activities, and organizational events.
* Promote a positive workplace culture aligned with organizational values.


**Performance Management \& Learning (10%)**
* Support implementation of performance management processes including goal setting, reviews, and development planning.
* Coordinate training programs, learning initiatives, and capacity\-building activities.
* Track learning participation and maintain training records.
* Support succession planning and employee development initiatives.


**May perform other job\-related duties as assigned (5%)**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field. Postgraduate qualification or certification in Human Resources Management preferred.
* 4\-6 years of progressive HR experience with significant exposure to HR operations, employee lifecycle management, recruitment, compliance, and employee relations..
* Knowledge of the NGO business sector; Knowledge of institutional funders for international development, a plus.
* Basic understanding of HR best practices, employment law, and regulatory requirements.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with HRIS or payroll systems is a plus.
* Practical knowledge of the local country generally accepted accounting principles and fiscal statutes.
* Experience with accounting systems

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL) – Centre of Excellence (CoE) – Level 1**
 The Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL) Centre of Excellence Level 1 is a professional role that supports the accurate and timely completion of operational tasks across client engagements. Working closely with Engagement Business Partners (EBPs), this role contributes to profitable growth and effective service delivery, while bringing fresh thinking, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset to the team.
   

  

**Three focus Pillars of the role**
* Quality \& Risk Management – Support early‑stage lifecycle activities: set up engagement/controls files; complete a sub‑set of non‑judgmental PACE tasks (fill in basic components and independence consultations); draft Statements of Work (SoWs); complete Working at Risk processes; prepare NDA, Risk Memo, and Ethical Wall Agreements; and archive projects in relevant systems.
* Engagement Economics – Support the financial health of engagements by creating pricing plans, building and updating budgets, creating engagement codes, completing Estimate‑to‑Complete (ETC) processes, and managing code closure activities.
* Working Capital – Support transactions and financial controls by processing and tracking supplier/subcontractor payments and preparing/issuing client invoices in line with engagement terms.


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* You will monitor and complete assigned tasks accurately and within agreed SLAs; mark tasks complete once fully actioned.
* Escalate any issues to the relevant EBP to enable timely resolution.
* Follow standard processes and suggest process improvements to support efficient working principles.
* Attend and contribute to CoE team calls to share knowledge, experience and best practice.
* Liaise with stakeholders and other teams to gather necessary inputs and share relevant information as needed.
* Actively participate in process changes, providing feedback and helping to embed new ways of working.
* Remain adaptable and open to shifting priorities, supporting the team in areas of greatest demand.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Attention to detail and commitment to high quality.
* Co\-ordination skills with the ability to complete tasks on an accurate and timely basis.
* Ability to plan, manage and prioritise work effectively.
* Ability to exercise good judgement – knowing when to flag issues and when to make own decisions.
* Good numerical and data analysis skills.
* Pro\-active "can do" attitude, reliable team member with the ability to work effectively with others and share information readily.
* Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset—willing to challenge the status quo and suggest better ways of working.
* Flexibility to adapt to changing processes, tools, or team priorities.


**To qualify for the role you must have**

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills demonstrating the ability to plan and prioritise work, meet deadlines and monitor budgets.


**What We Look For**
 Highly motivated, good communicators who can effectively plan and prioritise their work. You will also need to be a team player who is not only looking to enhance their own career but recognises the value in developing others and strengthening the team. We’re especially interested in individuals who are adaptable, open to change, and eager to help shape how we work, bringing ideas forward and embracing change.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with MyReward you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
