title: HR Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented HR Manager to manage the complete HR function for an FMCG organization having both corporate office and manufacturing/factory operations. The role will be responsible for the entire employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, employee engagement, performance management, HR operations, statutory compliance, employee relations, and factory HR activities. HR Operations Manage end-to-end HR operations for corporate office and factory employees. Develop, implement and maintain HR policies, processes and SOPs. Manage employee lifecycle from joining to exit. Maintain employee records and HR documentation. Handle employee queries and provide timely HR support. Monitor attendance, leave, shift schedules and employee movements. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Manage end-to-end recruitment for corporate, sales, factory and support functions. Understand manpower requirements and prepare recruitment plans. Coordinate with department heads and hiring managers for recruitment. Source candidates through job portals, consultants, referrals and other channels. Conduct/coordinate interviews, salary negotiations and offer rollouts. Ensure timely onboarding of new employees. Payroll & Compensation Manage monthly payroll processing in coordination with Finance/payroll teams. Ensure accurate attendance, leave, overtime, incentives and payroll inputs. Manage salary revisions, increments, deductions and full & final settlements. Handle employee queries related to salary, statutory deductions and benefits. Ensure payroll data is accurate and processed within timelines. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Manage PF, ESI, PT, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Shops & Establishments Act, Payment of Wages Act and other applicable regulations. Ensure factory-related statutory compliance and labour documentation. Coordinate with statutory consultants, auditors and government authorities. Maintain statutory registers, records, licenses and required documentation. Support labour inspections, audits and statutory assessments. Ensure timely submission/payment of statutory returns and contributions. Factory HR & Employee Relations Manage HR operations at the manufacturing/factory location. Handle manpower planning for production and support functions. Manage contract labour/workmen-related HR activities. Monitor attendance, shifts, overtime, absenteeism and manpower productivity. Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace issues. Maintain positive employee relations and a productive work environment. Coordinate with factory management on workforce requirements and HR issues. Support compliance related to Factories Act and applicable state labour regulations. Employee Engagement & Culture Develop and implement employee engagement initiatives. Plan and execute employee events, celebrations and recognition programs. Conduct employee engagement surveys and prepare action plans. Drive employee communication and culture-building initiatives. Manage employee recognition and rewards programs. Improve employee satisfaction, retention and workplace experience. Performance Management Manage the annual performance appraisal process. Coordinate goal setting, KRAs/KPIs and performance reviews. Support managers in performance evaluation and improvement plans. Track probation confirmation and employee performance milestones. Develop initiatives to improve employee productivity and performance. Learning & Development Identify training and development requirements across departments. Prepare and coordinate the annual training calendar. Organize technical, functional, behavioural and compliance training. Evaluate training effectiveness and maintain training records. Support leadership and employee development initiatives. HRMS & HR Analytics Manage and maintain the organization's HRMS. Ensure accurate employee master data and HR records. Manage attendance, leave, recruitment, onboarding and performance modules. Generate HR reports and dashboards for management. Track headcount, attrition, absenteeism, recruitment TAT, manpower cost, overtime and employee engagement metrics. Policies & Process Improvement Develop, review and update HR policies in line with business requirements and applicable laws. Standardize HR processes across corporate and factory locations. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. Ensure effective communication and implementation of HR policies. Employee Welfare & Benefits Manage employee welfare initiatives for office and factory employees. Coordinate employee insurance, medical benefits and other welfare schemes. Ensure statutory and company-provided benefits are administered effectively. Address employee concerns related to benefits and welfare. HR MIS & Management Reporting Prepare monthly HR MIS and management dashboards. Provide management with reports on headcount, attrition, recruitment, payroll, absenteeism and manpower cost. Analyze HR trends and recommend corrective actions. Support management in manpower budgeting and workforce planning. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of HR Operations and HR Generalist functions. Excellent knowledge of Recruitment & Talent Acquisition. Strong Payroll & Compensation knowledge. Good understanding of Labour Laws & Statutory Compliance. Experience in Factory/Manufacturing HR. Employee Relations & Grievance Handling. Employee Engagement & Retention. Performance Management and HR Policy Development. HRMS/HRIS Management and HR Analytics/MIS. Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to manage both white-collar and blue-collar workforce. Educational Qualification MBA / PGDM in Human Resources preferred. Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Relevant HR certifications will be an added advantage. Preferred Experience 7-12 years of HR experience, preferably in FMCG, Manufacturing, Food Processing or a similar industry. Prior experience handling both corporate HR and factory HR is preferred. Experience managing staff, workmen and contract labour will be an advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Recruitment TAT and manpower fulfillment. Employee attrition and retention. Payroll accuracy and timeliness. Statutory compliance and audit performance. Employee engagement score. Absenteeism and overtime management. Training effectiveness. Performance appraisal completion. HR process efficiency and employee grievance resolution TAT. HR cost optimization. Overall Role Objective To build and manage a strong, compliant and employee-focused HR function that supports the company's corporate, sales, warehouse and manufacturing operations, while ensuring effective manpower management, employee engagement, payroll accuracy and statutory compliance

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**HR Generalist** 




  





 At BlueMatrix, our people are at the core of everything we do. As we continue to grow our presence across the Asia\-Pacific region, we’re looking for a people\-focused HR professional who is eager to make a real impact. In this role, you will support the full employee lifecycle across multiple APAC locations, working closely with managers and employees to foster a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing workplace. You’ll collaborate with a global HR team, gain exposure to diverse labor markets, and play a hands\-on role in shaping the employee experience across the region. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy balancing operational HR work with strategic thinking, this is the role for you.
 



  





**OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE** 



* Act as a trusted HR point of contact for employees and managers across APAC, providing guidance on HR policies, processes, and best practices
* Support the full employee lifecycle, from onboarding and development to performance management and offboarding
* Ensure HR operations are compliant with local labor laws and regulations across APAC jurisdictions
* Contribute to building a consistent and engaging employee experience aligned with BlueMatrix’s global culture
* Partner with the global HR team to roll out company\-wide initiatives and adapt them to regional needs
* Use HR data and insights to identify trends and support informed decision\-making



  





**DAILY AND MONTHLY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth and welcoming experience for new hires across APAC
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the HRIS system, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality
* Support recruitment efforts by coordinating interviews, liaising with hiring managers, and managing candidate communications
* Assist in the administration of performance review cycles, including tracking timelines, preparing materials, and supporting managers through the process
* Respond to employee queries regarding contracts, benefits, leave entitlements, and HR policies in a timely and professional manner
* Coordinate with local payroll providers and finance teams to ensure accurate and on\-time payroll processing
* Track and report on key HR metrics such as headcount, attrition, and time\-to\-hire on a regular basis
* Support the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives, surveys, and regional team events
* Assist in drafting and updating HR policies and documentation to reflect local legal requirements and company standards
* Liaise with external partners, including recruitment agencies, benefits providers, and legal advisors, as needed



  





**WHAT YOU BRING** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Solid understanding of HR fundamentals, including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, and HR compliance
* Familiarity with labor laws and employment regulations in at least one APAC jurisdiction (e.g., Philippines, India, Japan, Australia, New Zealand)
* Experience working with HRIS platforms and applicant tracking systems
* Proficiency in MS Office / Microsoft 365, including Excel for HR reporting and data analysis
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in an additional APAC language is a plus
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion
* Comfortable working across time zones and collaborating with remote and distributed teams



  





**EXTRA SKILLS THAT MAKE YOU STAND OUT** 



* Genuine curiosity about people and a proactive approach to understanding employee needs
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Adaptability and comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast\-growing, international environment
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization
* Continuous learning orientation and openness to developing expertise in new HR domains



  





**WHO WE ARE \& WHAT WE DO** 




 At BlueMatrix, we build cutting\-edge web applications that power the authoring, distribution, and analysis of investment research. Our solutions also support internal knowledge management and digital communications, streamlining the publishing process on a global scale. We’re not just developing software, we’re redefining the way financial insights are created and shared.
 



  





**WHY JOIN BLUEMATRIX?** 




 We’re a team of ambitious, passionate innovators who have transformed technology development and client service into an art. Many of us have spent years growing the BlueMatrix brand and shaping the investment research landscape.
 



 With offices in North America, Canada, Europe, and the APAC region, we collaborate across continents, bringing together diverse perspectives to drive innovation and impact in the financial technology space.
 



 This position supports our APAC region. The role is open to fully remote candidates within the region.
 



 If you’re ready to be part of something game\-changing, we’d love to have you on board!

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**Position : Head of HR – VALUELINE Group** 




**Location : Hyderabad** 




**Language : Telugu (Mandatory) \+ English \+ Hindi** 




**Industry Type : Manufacturing \& Trading** 




**Working Days : 6 days a week** 




**Salary budget : Upto 24LPA** 




  





  





**Role Objective** 




 The Head of HR will lead the complete Human Resources function of Valueline Group across all business verticals and locations. The role will have end\-to\-end ownership of
 **HR strategy, manpower planning, recruitment, employee lifecycle, performance management, policies, compliance, employee engagement, organizational development and HR systems** 
 .
 



 The role will work closely with Management and Business Heads to ensure the organization has the right people, structure, culture, systems and capabilities to support sustainable growth.}
 



  





**1\. HR Strategy \& Organizational Development** 



* Develop and implement the Group HR strategy aligned with business objectives and growth plans.
* Establish scalable HR systems, processes and governance across locations and entities.
* Partner with Management and Business Heads on organizational structure, manpower planning and people strategy.
* Review organizational effectiveness, reporting structures and manpower deployment.
* Build a culture of performance, ownership, accountability and professionalism.
* Develop succession, retention and leadership development strategies.
* Act as a strategic HR advisor to Management and senior leadership.



  





**2\. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment** 



* Own Group\-wide manpower planning and approved manpower budgets.
* Identify current and future manpower requirements in coordination with Business and Department Heads.
* Standardize Job Descriptions, KRAs and competency requirements.
* Lead recruitment for critical, managerial and leadership positions.
* Establish effective sourcing channels and talent pipelines.
* Ensure quality of hire, recruitment turnaround time and cost\-effective hiring.
* Strengthen employer branding and talent attraction.
* Ensure timely onboarding against approved requirements.



  





**3\. Employee Lifecycle \& HR Operations** 



* Establish standardized processes covering the complete employee lifecycle.
* Oversee joining, documentation, verification, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions and employee records.
* Ensure timely issuance of appointment letters, contracts and HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate, confidential and up\-to\-date personnel records.
* Ensure consistency of HR practices across all Group locations.



  





**4\. Payroll, Attendance \& HRMS** 



* Oversee monthly payroll to ensure accuracy and timely processing.
* Establish controls for attendance, leave, overtime, incentives and payroll inputs.
* Coordinate with Finance for salary processing and statutory deductions.
* Ensure effective implementation and utilization of HRMS for attendance, leave, payroll, records and reimbursements.
* Resolve recurring payroll and attendance issues through process improvements.
* Ensure HR data accuracy, security and confidentiality.



  





**5\. Statutory \& Labour Law Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Oversee PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Bonus, Gratuity and other applicable compliances.
* Ensure timely filings, payments, registers and statutory documentation.
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors, legal advisors and authorities when required.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and periodic audit mechanism.
* Keep Management informed of material changes in labour laws and associated risks.
* Ensure appropriate labour and HR documentation across offices, warehouses, fabrication units and project locations.



  





**6\. Performance Management** 



* Own and drive the Group Performance Management System (PMS).
* Establish KRAs, KPIs and performance evaluation frameworks.
* Ensure timely goal setting, reviews and appraisals.
* Partner with managers to ensure objective and measurable performance assessment.
* Support Performance Improvement Plans for underperforming employees.
* Ensure increments, promotions and career progression are linked to performance and organizational requirements.
* Establish mechanisms to identify and reward high performers.



  





**7\. Talent, Training \& Leadership Development** 



* Identify capability gaps and future talent requirements.
* Develop annual training and development plans.
* Coordinate internal and external training and evaluate effectiveness.
* Develop leadership programs for managers and high\-potential employees.
* Establish career progression and competency frameworks.
* Develop succession plans for critical positions and internal talent pipelines.



  





**8\. Employee Relations, Discipline \& Culture** 



* Act as the senior escalation point for employee relations matters.
* Establish a professional, transparent and accountable workplace culture.
* Oversee grievance resolution and disciplinary processes in accordance with Company policy and applicable law.
* Ensure consistency and fairness in disciplinary action across locations.
* Address behavioural, attendance, performance and policy violations proactively.
* Partner with Business Heads to reinforce discipline, accountability and professional conduct.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of employee relations and disciplinary matters.



  





**9\. HR Policies, SOPs \& Governance** 



* Develop, implement and periodically review Group HR policies, SOPs and guidelines.
* Standardize HR practices across Group entities and locations.
* Maintain the Employee Handbook and HR Guidelines.
* Establish clear frameworks for attendance, leave, WFH, travel, reimbursements, promotions, transfers, performance and employee conduct.
* Ensure employees and managers understand and follow policies.
* Continuously identify process gaps and improve HR systems and controls.



  





**10\. Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Welfare** 



* Develop appropriate compensation structures in consultation with Management.
* Conduct salary benchmarking and internal parity reviews.
* Support annual increment, promotion and compensation planning.
* Ensure compensation decisions consider performance, role responsibility, market benchmarks and business affordability.
* Monitor manpower and HR costs against approved budgets.
* Oversee employee benefits, insurance and welfare initiatives.
* Develop employee recognition and engagement programs.



  





**11\. Separation, Exit \& Full \& Final Settlement** 



* Oversee resignations, notice periods, handovers, clearances and exits.
* Conduct structured exit interviews and analyze attrition trends.
* Coordinate timely Full \& Final Settlement.
* Ensure timely issuance of relieving letters, experience certificates and other exit documentation.
* Develop corrective measures to improve retention.



  





**12\. HR MIS, Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Establish a robust Group HR MIS and reporting framework.
* Provide Management with regular reports covering headcount, manpower cost, recruitment, attrition, attendance, leave, payroll, performance, training, grievances, disciplinary matters and open positions.
* Use HR analytics to identify trends, risks and areas requiring intervention.
* Provide data\-backed recommendations to Management.
* Maintain complete confidentiality of employee information.



  





**13\. Multi\-Location \& Project HR** 



* Oversee HR requirements across offices, showrooms, warehouses, fabrication units and project/site locations.
* Ensure appropriate manpower deployment, attendance and documentation.
* Coordinate site\-related accommodation, travel, welfare and employee requirements where applicable.
* Ensure labour\-law and safety\-related HR documentation at operational locations.
* Maintain consistent HR standards while addressing local requirements.



  





**14\. HR Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor and develop the Group HR team.
* Define clear roles, KRAs and accountability for HR team members.
* Establish HR service standards, review mechanisms and escalation processes.
* Build a proactive HR function capable of independently managing routine operations.
* Review HR team performance and continuously strengthen HR capabilities.



  





**15\. Management Partnership \& Confidentiality** 



* Serve as a trusted HR partner to Management and senior leadership.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of employee, compensation, disciplinary and business\-sensitive information.
* Escalate critical employee, legal, compliance and organizational risks promptly.
* Provide objective, fact\-based recommendations on people decisions.
* Support Management during expansion, restructuring, change management and other strategic initiatives.

**Core principle:** 
 No ambiguity around performance.
 


 3\. Employee Engagement \& Culture
 
 Take ownership of making 10x Global a place where ambitious people
 **want to work and grow** 
 .
 


* Build initiatives to improve employee engagement and morale.
* Regularly measure employee sentiment through surveys, 1:1s and structured feedback.
* Identify cultural issues before they become attrition problems.
* Build a strong internal communication cadence.
* Design employee recognition programmes.
* Drive team\-building, town halls, offsites and cultural initiatives.
* Create an environment that is ambitious, energetic, entrepreneurial and collaborative.
* Ensure employees feel heard while maintaining high organisational standards.



 You will be expected to answer one fundamental question:
 



**"Why should a great person want to spend the next five years at 10x Global?"** 



 4\. Compensation \& Benefits
 * Build and maintain a competitive compensation philosophy.
* Conduct periodic market benchmarking.
* Develop salary bands by role and level.
* Establish clear promotion and compensation frameworks.
* Manage annual increments, bonuses and incentive programmes.
* Design performance\-linked compensation structures.
* Review benefits and employee welfare programmes.
* Ensure internal equity across teams and geographies.


 5\. Learning \& Career Development
 
 Build a culture of continuous learning.
 


* Create career paths for major functions.
* Establish competency frameworks by level.
* Identify skill gaps across teams.
* Build internal and external training programmes.
* Develop leadership programmes for managers and future leaders.
* Create structured onboarding and 30/60/90\-day programmes.
* Encourage internal mobility and cross\-functional exposure.
* Build succession plans for critical positions.


 6\. HR Operations \& Systems
 
 Professionalise the HR infrastructure of the company.
 


* Establish clear HR policies, SOPs and processes.
* Implement/optimise HRMS and employee records.
* Digitise leave, attendance, payroll coordination, performance and documentation.
* Ensure accurate employee data and HR reporting.
* Establish clear SLAs for HR queries and employee requests.
* Build a central HR dashboard for management.
* Ensure statutory and employment compliance across relevant jurisdictions.
* Work closely with finance and external advisors on payroll and employment matters.



**Objective:** 
 HR should become predictable, process\-driven and data\-led.
 


 7\. Employee Relations
 
 Act as a trusted but objective point of contact for employees and leadership.
 


* Handle employee grievances and workplace conflicts.
* Investigate sensitive employee matters objectively.
* Support managers in difficult people decisions.
* Manage disciplinary processes where required.
* Conduct exit interviews and identify recurring organisational issues.
* Ensure consistent application of company policies.
* Maintain confidentiality and professional judgement in sensitive matters.


 8\. HR Analytics \& Management Reporting
 
 Move HR from
 **administration to intelligence** 
 .
 



 Build a monthly HR dashboard covering:
 


* Headcount
* Hiring pipeline
* Time\-to\-hire
* Cost\-to\-hire
* Attrition
* Voluntary vs involuntary exits
* Employee tenure
* Performance distribution
* Compensation
* Absenteeism
* Engagement scores
* Open positions
* Hiring plan vs actual
* Revenue/headcount and productivity metrics



 Provide the CEO and leadership team with
 **actionable insights** 
 , not just reports.
 


 Strategic Responsibilities
 
 As a member of the leadership team, you will also contribute to:
 


* Organisation design
* Workforce planning
* New geography expansion
* Leadership hiring
* Succession planning
* Culture design
* M\&A / integration\-related people matters
* Building international HR infrastructure
* Employer branding
* Organisation\-wide transformation initiatives


 What We Are Looking ForMust Have
 * 8–12 years of progressive HR experience.
* Experience managing HR for a high\-growth organisation.
* Strong understanding of talent acquisition, performance management and employee relations.
* Demonstrated ability to build HR systems from the ground up.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong business understanding — you should understand how the company makes money, not just how HR works.
* High ownership and execution orientation.
* Ability to operate independently in an entrepreneurial environment.


 Strongly Preferred
 * Experience in consulting, professional services, financial services, technology or a high\-growth startup.
* Experience managing multi\-location or international teams.
* Experience working directly with founders/CEOs.
* Experience implementing an HRMS.
* Experience designing performance and compensation frameworks.


 The Ideal Personality
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**High ownership** 
 — doesn't wait to be told what to do.
 



**High empathy, high standards** 
 — cares deeply about people without compromising performance.
 



**Commercially minded** 
 — understands that people decisions ultimately affect growth and profitability.
 



**Hands\-on** 
 — willing to personally solve problems rather than delegate everything.
 



**Data\-driven** 
 — uses evidence rather than anecdotes to make HR decisions.
 



**Discreet and trustworthy** 
 — comfortable handling highly sensitive information.
 



**Energetic** 
 — capable of bringing life and momentum into the organisation.
 



**Firm when required** 
 — capable of having difficult conversations with employees and senior leadership.
 


 First 90 DaysFirst 30 Days — Diagnose
 * Meet every functional leader.
* Understand organisation structure and reporting lines.
* Review current employees, open positions and hiring pipeline.
* Audit existing HR policies and processes.
* Analyse attrition and employee feedback.
* Identify immediate people risks.
* Establish baseline HR metrics.


 Days 31–60 — Build
 * Introduce HR operating calendar.
* Establish hiring process and recruitment SLAs.
* Define performance\-management framework.
* Create HR dashboard.
* Fix critical HR process gaps.
* Establish employee communication cadence.
* Begin compensation benchmarking.


 Days 61–90 — Transform
 * Launch performance framework.
* Implement career levels and role expectations.
* Launch engagement programme.
* Build annual workforce plan.
* Establish talent\-review process.
* Present a
 **12\-month People Strategy** 
 to the CEO.


 KPIs for the Role
 
 The Head of HR will ultimately be measured on:
 


1. **Quality of hiring**
2. **Time\-to\-hire**
3. **Employee retention**
4. **Employee engagement**
5. **Performance\-management effectiveness**
6. **Manager effectiveness**
7. **HR process efficiency**
8. **Employee satisfaction with HR**
9. **Leadership/talent pipeline**
10. **People productivity**


 The ultimate objective:
 
**Build a high\-performance organisation where great people join, perform, grow and stay — while making HR scalable enough to support 10x Global's next phase of growth.**

title: City Director, Kolkata
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The City Director (CD) plays a critical role in unleashing the potential and power of a local movement for educational equity in this metropolis. This individual creates and shapes a vision for the city that is rooted in the local context and develops a long\-term strategy that will fully realise the regional vision. The City Director, therefore, has a five\-fold charge:
 


1. Ensuring that Teach For India Fellows are not only driving transformational outcomes for children in classrooms, but that they’re growing as leaders.
2. Fostering a local, growing Alumni movement that is committed to providing all children an excellent education.
3. Building a local, enduring institution that promotes sustainable funding, talent, and operations – including assembling effective teams and resources, coaching talent to outcomes and leading the site rooted in strong culture
4. Serving as a critical organisational leader for operations that span Teach For India’s vision and mission.
5. Co\-creating the strategy \& roadmap to serve 1 in 10 children from low income communities in the city.



 To achieve that five\-fold charge, the CD works closely with the local program team to create an ecosystem of support for Fellows that enables them to be successful in their roles as teachers and future leaders of the movement. The CD also works to foster a sense of community among Alumni in the city and mobilises them towards shared goals, while also building partnerships with a range of government, corporate, and civil society players to catalyse systemic impact and ensure the long\-term sustainability of our efforts. Last but not least, the CD plays an integral role in building the capability and commitment of members of the City Operations team to contribute to our mission in the long\-term.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Envision, develop and update a contextualized vision for Teach For India’s operations in the city:** 



* Articulate a vision for the city that is rooted in the local context, yet directly aligned to Teach For India's larger national movement
* Phase out the city vision into a short\-mid\-and long term roadmap, with clearly defined goals and measures for success
* Build investment and ownership among Staff, Fellows, Alumni, \& Partners in the vision and goals.



**2\. Develop a strategic and operational plan that is designed to realise the vision:** 



* Design a strategic plan that effectively sets priorities, searches for innovative paths and best practices, and accounts for regional uncertainties and externalities.
* Design short\-term tactical plans to mobilise resources and guide a team to outcomes in the short\-and\-mid term



**3\. Manage the Executive Team in the city:** 



* Establish and/or strengthen infrastructure needed to maximize performance and operations of both talent and resources (processes, structure, systems, communication)
* Select, mentor and develop a group of your direct reports (managees) that is composed of the right skills, knowledge, and mindsets needed to advance transformational progress for children through the City roadmap.
* Build a systematic approach to people development to ensure that team members across the site are growing, performing and flourishing
* Establish clear accountability, decision making responsibilities, and performance expectations that are aligned to the strategic plan



**4\. Build relationships with key partners and stakeholders to foster collective impact and ensure long\-term sustainability:** 



* Build the site into a sustainable organisation rooted in local funding and talent
* Develop the operational infrastructure to enable scale and efficiency
* Engage with local networks, Alumni, education sector stakeholders to make Teach For India a strong voice in regional communities of practice
* Build, engage and strengthen a strong advisory board
* Play a front\-facing role in local fundraising efforts and capacities



**5\. Manage a growing team towards short\-term outcomes and long\-term success:** 



* Manage city vertical leads that span Program, Partnerships (Alumni \& Government) and People (Recruitment, HR, Job Placements, etc.)
* Design systems and processes to manage progress and people across layers
* Build and execute a strong performance management plan to ensure progress



**6\. Establish and uphold a strong culture of inspiration, honesty, support, and accountability among team members:** 



* Foster an internal team culture that is rooted in our organisational values.
* Model culture both internally and externally.
* Build on\-going relationships with our internal community



**7\. Collaborate with teams across clusters at Teach For India (People, Impact \& Operations, Movement Building, Regions, Office of the Senior Leadership team).** 




  





**Additional Responsibilities** 




**As a member of the Leadership team:** 



* Providing feedback on organisational decision\-making and long\-term strategy as a member of the Leadership Team.
* Driving internal alignment and support for Teach For India’s core Programs.
* Serving as an ambassador of the Teach For India brand and an advocate for our work and for educational equity in our country through both internal and external communication.
* Supporting key organisational areas such as Recruitment, Selection, Fundraising, Movement Building, and Alumni Engagement.
* Over time, supporting Teach For India’s Alumni and other external organisations in their journey to our vision with organisational insights.



  





**Minimum Qualifications, Experiences and Expectations** 



* A Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in any field with 8\+ years of relevant work experience
* Previous experience managing large projects and teams to successful outcomes
* Previous teaching/education experience would be an added advantage
* Strategic and critical thinking skills so as to conceptualise multiple approaches to solving a problem and draw out a clear roadmap with roles and responsibilities
* Relationship\-building and networking skills so as to connect individuals, groups, and partners with shared goals
* Influencing and persuasion skills so as to leverage people and relationships to outcomes
* Communication skills so as to deliver a compelling message through oral and written mediums to diverse stakeholders
* People management skills so as to manage diverse teams to outcomes
* Ability to be resourceful and entrepreneurial in the face of uncertainty
* Proficiency in analysing data and making inferences to drive strategies and decisions
* Understanding of Teach For India’s short\-term and long\-term theory of change
* Understanding of Teach For India’s leadership development philosophy and framework

title: People & Operations Associate (HR & Admin)
description:
**About The Role**
 Landeed is growing fast, and this is its first People and Operations hire: one person who owns everything that lets the team do its best work, and who builds the function from zero as the company grows.
   

  

 It is a rare seat for someone early in their career. You will hire, onboard and look after people, and you will also run the office, inventory, the vendors, the travel and the money that flows through all of it. In three years you will be leading the function you built.
   

  

 This is not a typical HR role, and not a comfortable one. It is a builder's role that happens to include HR.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Hiring that moves at the speed we interview, and onboarding that has someone productive in week one
* The office, its vendors, equipment and travel, running so well nobody thinks about them
* Payroll, reimbursements and statutory work, done right and on time
* Events, off\-boarding employees, etc
* In general, clearing bottlenecks and enabling growth of the company, whatever it takes.


**What We're Looking For**
* Zero to three years of experience, and evidence that you have made something run: a college festival that actually happened, a family business, an internship where they gave you the keys, a team you organised when nobody asked
* You measure yourself by whether the company moved
* You notice what is broken before anyone reports it, and fix it before anyone asks
* You are as comfortable negotiating with a landlord as sitting with a new hire on their first day
* Discretion is second nature; you will know salaries and exits before anyone else
* Fluent English and Telugu or Hindi. Based in Hyderabad, at the office


 We will teach you payroll, statutory work and everything else with a rulebook.
   

  

**Compensation**
 ₹5L – ₹7\.5L fixed, plus equity.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
* 90 days — nothing about the office, hiring or people is on a founder's list
* 1 year — a process for every initiative you pick up
* 3 years — you lead the People and Operations function you built


**INTERVIEW PROCESS**
* Intro call (30 min)
* Case (60 min) — three real situations from a month at Landeed; you tell us what happens by Friday
* Founder conversation (45 min)

title: HR Generalist
description:
**About Truveta**
 Truveta is on a mission to save lives with data. We are building the world's largest and most comprehensive health data platform to accelerate scientific discovery, improve patient care, and enable the next generation of AI\-driven healthcare. Our India Development Center (IDC) plays a critical role in scaling our engineering, product, and business operations globally.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an HR Generalist who is passionate about creating exceptional employee experiences and helping build a high\-performing organization.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 As an HR Generalist, you will support the day\-to\-day People operations for our growing India Development Center and help manage the employee lifecycle from onboarding through offboarding. You will work closely with employees, managers, and cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth HR operations and a positive employee experience. As the IDC continues to scale, you will also provide support for Talent Acquisition activities, including sourcing, interview coordination, candidate engagement, and hiring operations.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure across HR operations, employee engagement, Talent Acquisition, and other People initiatives while helping build and scale our People function in India.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle
   

  

* Provide day\-to\-day HR support and guidance to employees and managers.
* Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmations, promotions, internal transfers, documentation, and offboarding.
* Deliver a smooth and engaging onboarding experience for new hires.
* Maintain accurate employee records and ensure HR systems are updated in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, IT, and other teams to ensure seamless HR operations.
* Support employee queries related to HR policies, processes, benefits, payroll, and other People matters.
* Support compliance with company policies, Indian labor laws, and statutory requirements.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes.


 Talent Acquisition Support
   

  

* Support the Talent Acquisition function as hiring continues to scale in India.
* Assist with sourcing and identifying candidates for open positions.
* Coordinate interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels.
* Manage candidate communication, scheduling, and interview follow\-ups.
* Maintain accurate candidate information and hiring status in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Support offer coordination, pre\-joining engagement, and transition of candidates into onboarding.
* Help maintain hiring trackers, reports, and recruitment dashboards.
* Ensure candidates have a positive and well\-coordinated experience throughout the hiring process.


 Employee Engagement \& People Initiatives
   

  

* Support employee engagement, recognition, wellness, and culture\-building programs.
* Assist with employee communications and People\-related events and initiatives.
* Support HR projects and organizational initiatives as the India Development Center continues to grow.
* Partner with the broader People team on programs that enhance the overall employee experience.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.
* 2–4 years of experience in an HR Generalist or HR Operations role.
* Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle.
* Some exposure to Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination, or candidate sourcing is preferred.
* Experience working with HR systems and/or Applicant Tracking Systems.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and integrity.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced and growing environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a fast\-growing technology or product organization.
* Exposure to recruiting for technology or engineering roles.
* Exposure to employee engagement, performance management, and HR analytics.
* Working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience with platforms such as Greenhouse, Workday, BambooHR, or similar HR/ATS systems.
* A proactive, hands\-on approach with the ability to work independently as the organization scales.

**VuNet** is a pioneer in *Business Journey Observability*, leveraging Big Data and Machine Learning to transform digital experiences across the financial services. Our deep\-tech platform provides end\-to\-end visibility into customer journeys — empowering proactive issue resolution, operational resilience, and superior user satisfaction.


If you’ve ever used instant payment systems like UPI, chances are you’ve already experienced the power of our platform — we monitor over *28 billion digital transactions monthly*(that’s equal to watching 3 years of tik\-tok videos)**,** *touching 300 million users* with leading banks and financial institutions*.*


VuNet is Series B funded, part of NASSCOM DeepTech Club, awarded NASSCOM’s AI Gamechanger, recognized in Forbes DGEMS 200 and by several global analysts including Gartner, Omdia.


We’re building a new category of observability purpose\-built for complex digital journeys — across payments, lending, core banking and more — already powering some of the largest banks in India and MEA.


**Your Role: HR Operation Specialist**
======================================

We are looking for an **HR Operations Specialist** to manage and execute day\-to\-day HR operations while ensuring a seamless employee experience, accurate HR data, statutory compliance, and timely delivery of HR processes.


The role will work closely with employees, managers, Finance, IT, Administration, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of employee lifecycle processes. The ideal candidate should be detail\-oriented, process\-driven, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple HR operations simultaneously.


Are you excited to be a part of VuNet's trailblazing team? Join VuNet and make a difference


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


### **1\. Employee Lifecycle Operations**


* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, employee documentation, transfers, confirmations, and exits.
* Ensure joining formalities, documentation, background verification, and HR system updates are completed within defined SLAs.
* Maintain accurate and updated employee master data and personnel records.
* Coordinate with IT and relevant stakeholders to ensure system and access readiness on the employee’s date of joining.
* Ensure timely completion of exit formalities, clearance, documentation, and HR\-related separation activities.

### **2\. Payroll \& Compensation Operations**


* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and ensure accurate and timely submission within payroll cut\-off timelines.
* Validate attendance, leave, loss of pay, new joiner, exit, salary revision, and other payroll\-related inputs.
* Coordinate with Finance/payroll vendors to resolve payroll discrepancies and employee queries.
* Support compensation\-related activities including salary revisions, arrears, reimbursements, and other employee compensation processes.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of payroll and compensation data.

### **3\. Statutory Compliance \& Risk Management**

* Support HR statutory compliance activities and ensure required records are maintained accurately.
* Coordinate compliance requirements related to **POSH, Form D, LWF**, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, declarations, and supporting documentation for audit readiness.
* Coordinate with external consultants/vendors for statutory compliance requirements and resolution of queries.
* Support internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.

### **4\. HRIS, MIS \& Data Governance**

* Maintain accurate employee information in the HRIS/HRMS and ensure timely updates for employee movements and changes.
* Prepare and publish periodic HR MIS, dashboards, headcount reports, and management reports.
* Maintain HR trackers, employee records, MOMs, and operational reports with high accuracy.
* Ensure HR data confidentiality, access control, and appropriate handling of sensitive employee information.
* Support HRIS enhancements, system upgrades, testing, and implementation of new HR processes/modules. Identify data inconsistencies and ensure timely correction

### **5\. Employee Experience \& HR Service Delivery**

* Act as a point of contact for employees on HR operational queries related to policies, payroll, attendance, leave, benefits, HR processes, and documentation.
* Resolve employee queries within defined SLAs and maintain proper query tracking.
* Provide clear, accurate, and consistent guidance on HR policies and processes.
* Identify recurring employee concerns and recommend improvements to HR processes.
* Maintain a professional and service\-oriented approach while handling employee interactions.

### **6\. Employee Engagement**

* Support planning and execution of the annual/monthly employee engagement calendar.
* Conduct new\-joiner pulse checks and coordinate periodic employee feedback initiatives
* Coordinate monthly celebrations, employee activities, team engagement initiatives, and cross\-functional events.
* Work with employee engagement SPOCs to plan and execute activities effectively.
* Track participation, feedback, and outcomes of engagement initiatives.
* Support initiatives focused on employee connect, collaboration, and workplace culture.

### **7\. Talent Acquisition Support**

* Support campus and fresher hiring activities including coordination with colleges, candidates, interview panels, and internal stakeholders.
* Provide recruitment coordination support for lateral hiring across functions.
* Schedule interviews, coordinate feedback, maintain recruitment trackers, and ensure timely candidate communication.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and interview panels to ensure smooth movement of candidates through the hiring process.
* Support recruitment documentation, offer coordination, and pre\-joining activities.
* Contribute to improving candidate experience and hiring turnaround time.

### **8\. Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**

* Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing HR processes and recommend practical improvements.
* Develop, review, and maintain HR SOPs, process documents, checklists, and operational guidelines
* Support automation and digitization initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time.
* Ensure adherence to defined HR processes and controls.
* Support periodic process reviews and implementation of corrective actions arising from audits or operational reviews.

### **9\. Administration \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate procurement of supplies required for employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Manage procurement and distribution of office stationery and HR\-related supplies.
* Raise and track purchase orders/requests and ensure timely delivery of required items.
* Coordinate with vendors and monitor service quality, cost, timelines, renewals, and payments.
* Maintain vendor records and support periodic vendor performance reviews.
* Coordinate procurement of e\-stamp/e\-stamp\-related documentation and agreements through relevant banking/vendor channels.
* Maintain appropriate documentation for administrative purchases and vendor transactions.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**
==============================

### **Mandatory Skills**


* Strong understanding of **HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle Management**
* Good knowledge of **Payroll, Attendance \& Leave Administration**
* Working knowledge of **HR statutory compliance**
* Experience with **HRMS/HRIS and HR data management**
* Strong **MIS and Excel/Google Sheets** skills
* Good stakeholder and employee management skills
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
* Good written and verbal communication
* Ability to manage confidential employee information
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills
* Process\-oriented and solution\-focused approach
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Good understanding of employee engagement and HR processes

**Preferred Experience**
========================


* 6 Months \- 3 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Generalist, HR Shared Services, or a similar role.
* Experience working in a **technology/product/SaaS organization** will be an advantage.
* Hands\-on experience with an **HRMS/HRIS**, payroll coordination, employee lifecycle processes, and HR MIS.
* Exposure to statutory compliance, employee engagement, recruitment coordination, and administration is preferred.

**Key Success Metrics**
=======================


### **Success in this role will be measured through:**

* Timely and accurate employee lifecycle execution
* Payroll input accuracy and adherence to payroll cut\-offs
* Statutory compliance and audit readiness
* HRIS/data accuracy and timely MIS reporting
* Employee query resolution within defined SLAs
* Successful execution of engagement initiatives
* Recruitment coordination and hiring turnaround
* SOP/process improvements and reduction in manual effort

**Why Join Us?**
================


This role offers an opportunity to work across **HR Operations, Employee Experience, HRIS, Compliance, Talent Acquisition, Engagement, and Administration**, providing broad exposure to the complete HR function in a growing organization.


**What We Offer**
=================

### **Life at VuNet: Building the Future Together**


At VuNet, we’re building a world\-class observability platform, proudly **Made in India —** and we're just getting started.


We’re a team of passionate problem\-solvers who love tackling complex challenges. We learn fast, adapt quickly, and stay curious — especially when it comes to exploring and staying ahead of the curve with emerging technologies likeGen AI**.**


More than just a tech company, VuNet is a place where collaboration, learning, and innovation are part of everyday life. We believe in working together, taking ownership, and growing as a team.


If you’re looking to work on cutting\-edge technology, make a real impact, and grow with a supportive team — you’ll feel right at home at **VuNet**.


**Benefits For You**
--------------------


* Health insurance coverage for you, your parents, and dependents.
* Mental wellness and 1:1 counselling support.
* A learning culture that promotes growth, innovation, and ownership.
* Transparent, Inclusive, and high\-trust workplace culture.
* New Gen AI and integrated Technology workspace.
* Supportive career development programs to expand your skills and enhance expertise with various training programs.

description:

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED

Full time

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to creating a sustainable energy future through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. We are looking for a Compensation \& Benefits Analyst to join our Global HR Services team and play a critical role in delivering compensation and benefits support across multiple geographies.


In this role, you will partner with HR teams, business leaders, employees, and external vendors to ensure the efficient administration of compensation programs and employee benefits. You will be responsible for supporting key annual compensation processes, maintaining data accuracy within Workday, providing insightful reporting and analytics, and ensuring a high level of service delivery to stakeholders worldwide.


This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain global exposure while working on complex compensation programs, incentive plans, salary reviews, and benefits administration. You will collaborate with colleagues across regions, contribute to process improvements, and help drive operational excellence within a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


As part of a high\-performing HR Services organization, you will leverage analytical thinking, digital tools, and process expertise to enhance employee experience, ensure compliance, and support strategic business objectives. If you are detail\-oriented, customer\-focused, and passionate about compensation and benefits, this role provides an exciting platform for professional growth and impact.


**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentive (STI) programs, Long\-Term Incentive (LTI) programs, scorecards, and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
* Administer compensation programs across multiple countries and regulatory environments while maintaining compliance with company policies and local requirements.
* Maintain, validate, and monitor compensation\-related employee data in Workday, ensuring data integrity and accuracy across HR systems.
* Generate standard and ad hoc compensation reports, analytics, and insights to support global and regional stakeholders in decision\-making.
* Coordinate and support regional and global employee benefits programs, including vendor management and service delivery activities.
* Manage end\-to\-end compensation transactions, including data validation, calculations, approvals, and payout readiness through established workflows and systems such as ServiceNow.
* Ensure delivery of compensation services in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), maintaining high standards of quality, turnaround time, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) to ensure process consistency and compliance.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service excellence.
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and global teams while leveraging digital and analytical tools to improve productivity and decision\-making.

**Your Background**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in HR Shared Services, Compensation Operations, or Compensation \& Benefits Administration within a global organization.
* Hands\-on experience supporting compensation programs, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentives (STI), Long\-Term Incentives (LTI), salary administration, and compensation reporting.
* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday, including compensation data management, reporting, and process administration.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of PowerPoint, Power BI, and other digital reporting tools.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders across different functions and geographies.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Experience supporting employee benefits administration and vendor coordination is preferred.

**More About Us**

At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure. We foster an inclusive and collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and continuous learning is supported.


Joining our team means working alongside talented professionals across the globe while contributing to meaningful work that supports employees and business success. We offer opportunities for career growth, global exposure, and professional development in an environment built on integrity, safety, and respect.


**Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.**

**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

title: HR Consultant
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

  

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

***What is the HR Consultant responsible for?***
================================================

* Diagnose organizational effectiveness challenges and partner with leaders on organization design, spans/layers analysis, role clarity, operating model effectiveness, and team productivity initiatives.
* Support people managers with guidance on leadership effectiveness, team dynamics, performance conversations, talent development, succession planning, and navigating change.
* Provide day\-to\-day HR consulting support to leaders and managers across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, role transitions, performance management, development, retention, internal mobility, and exits.
* Advise managers on employee relations matters by helping them address workplace concerns, conduct fair and timely fact\-finding, document issues appropriately, and determine practical resolutions in partnership with relevant HR and Legal stakeholders.
* Guide leaders through performance and conduct matters, including setting clear expectations, providing feedback, managing underperformance, supporting corrective actions, and promoting consistent and equitable people practices.
* Support leaders in resolving team concerns and interpersonal conflicts, strengthening manager capability, and fostering an inclusive, respectful, accountable, and high\-performing work environment.
* Identify recurring employee relations themes and people risks, use data and case insights to recommend preventive actions, and partner with leaders on interventions that improve engagement, manager effectiveness, and employee experience.
* Support business transformation initiatives by assessing organizational impacts, managing change adoption, mitigating people risks, and driving employee engagement during periods of change.
* Identify critical roles, assess leadership pipelines, support succession planning discussions, and partner with leaders to develop high\-potential talent.
* Partner with business leaders to forecast workforce requirements, identify capability gaps, assess build\-buy\-borrow talent strategies, and develop workforce plans aligned with business growth objectives.
* Drive initiatives that enhance employee engagement, inclusion, culture, and overall employee experience through the interpretation of employee feedback and business insights.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to develop hiring strategies, improve candidate quality, strengthen employer branding, and ensure talent decisions align with long\-term business capability requirements.
* Partner with other HR CoEs such as Total Rewards, Organization Effectiveness etc. as required.
* Leverage AI, technology, and workforce analytics to improve HR effectiveness, automate processes, generate insights, and enhance leader decision\-making.

* Organizational Diagnosis
* Influencing Without Authority
* Executive Presence

* Workforce Planning

* Data Storytelling
* HR Analytics
* AI Fluency

* Learning Agility
* Comfort with Ambiguity

* Demonstrated experience partnering with managers and senior leaders to solve business and talent challenges, manage organizational change, influence talent decisions, and drive measurable business outcomes through people strategies.

title: HR Manager
description:
**Job Title: HR Manager**  
**Location: Malad (West), Mumbai**  
**Experience: 3 Years to 6 Years**  
**Qualification: Graduate in any discipline**  
**Only Mumbai Suburban\-based candidates apply for this Position (Bhayander to Dadar).**  
**We are 6 days working: Monday to Saturday**

**Objective of the Role:**

The HR Manager will be responsible for driving HR Operations and overseeing Talent Acquisition (20%), while ensuring strong governance, compliance, employee engagement, and cultural alignment. The role demands hands\-on expertise in HR operations, audit compliance (ISO, SOC 2\), performance management, employee relations, and policy framing, along with the ability to leverage AI tools and HR chatbots for operational efficiency.

**Job Description:**

1\. **HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management:**

* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations, including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, role changes, and exits.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records, HR MIS, and documentation.
* Oversee HR workflows to ensure consistency, compliance, and efficiency.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational HR matters.

2\. **Policy Framework, Rules \& Regulations:**

* Address employee concerns and conflicts in a fair and timely manner.
* Ensure policies are aligned with organizational goals, legal requirements, and compliance standards.
* Communicate policies effectively and ensure organization\-wide adherence.
* Periodically review policies to support evolving business and workforce needs.

3\. **Compliance, Audit \& Governance:**

* Ensure HR compliance with ISO standards, SOC 2 controls, and other regulatory/audit requirements
* Prepare and maintain audit documentation, evidence registers, and compliance trackers.
* Coordinate and support internal and external audits; ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Work closely with InfoSec, Legal, and Management teams to ensure governance alignment.

4\. **Performance Management System (PMS):**

* Drive and manage the Performance Management process, including goal setting, reviews, appraisals, and feedback cycles.
* Ensure fair, transparent, and consistent performance evaluation practices.
* Support managers in performance discussions, improvement plans, and capability development.
* Track performance metrics and provide actionable insights to leadership.

5\. **Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution:**

* Act as a trusted partner for employees and managers to address workplace concerns.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and conflict resolution with sensitivity and fairness.
* Ensure adherence to disciplinary processes, corrective actions, and documentation standards.
* Foster a positive and respectful work environment

6\. **Culture Building \& Employee Engagement:**

* Drive initiatives that strengthen organizational culture, values, and employee engagement.
* Promote collaboration, transparency, and ownership across teams.
* Support leadership in embedding cultural values into daily operations and people practices.
* Design and execute engagement initiatives aligned with company culture and growth goals.

7\. **Talent Acquisition Oversight:**

* Oversee recruitment strategy, workforce planning, and hiring timelines.
* Guide recruiters on role requirements, interview frameworks, and hiring quality.
* Participate in final interviews for key positions and provide decision support.
* Monitor hiring metrics and continuously improve recruitment effectiveness.

8\. **HR Technology, AI \& Automation:**

* Leverage HRMS platforms, AI tools, and HR chatbots to streamline HR operations and employee support.
* Implement automation for onboarding, policy dissemination, employee queries, and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to enhance HR efficiency through technology and digital tools.

**Skills \& Competencies Functional \& Technical Skills:**

* Strong expertise in HR operations, compliance, audits, and governance.
* Practical exposure to ISO, SOC 2, and compliance\-driven environments.
* Ability to design and enforce policies, SOPs, and internal regulations.
* Proficiency in HRMS, AI tools, and chatbot\-enabled HR operations.
* Excellent documentation and process orientation.

**Soft Skills \& Behavioral Competencies:**

* Exceptional attention to detail with a strong compliance mindset.
* Quick action and problem\-solving abilities in operational scenarios.
* Strong conflict resolution and employee handling skills.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹480,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
