title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**Meet Our Team:**
------------------



As a member of an innovative team of IT professionals, you will work closely with talented engineers and product owners across the globe to deploy and support enterprise applications that are used to run our business at Pega. The IT Application Support team plays an important role in helping Pega to grow by ensuring that our enterprise applications are working seamlessly in support of Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, Consulting, HR, Order Management, and IT functions internally as well as for our external stakeholders, clients and partners. We strive for excellence and embrace agile methodologies to achieve it.

**Picture Yourself at Pega:**
-----------------------------



Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role you will \- The Application Support Engineer is a key member of the IT Production Support team. You will execute IT application support and release activities. Envision and support adherence to best practices and standards. You will collaboratively work with other application support Engineers on automation initiatives and collaborate effectively with business users to resolve support issues and improve IT developed business applications.


At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.


We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

**What You'll Do at Pega:**
---------------------------


* Provide exceptional technical support to end users by investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving issues within EBS applications using established support tools and best practices.
* Develop a strong understanding of product functionality and leverage that knowledge to deliver effective client\-focused solutions.
* Monitor application health, stability, and performance to ensure a high\-quality user experience.
* Execute code migrations and operational runbooks in accordance with established deployment and change management processes.
* Communicate proactively with clients and stakeholders on issue status, progress updates, and resolution outcomes.
* Collaborate with senior support engineers or Dev teams to identify root causes, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Respond promptly and professionally to client and engineering escalations, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) for response times, and issue resolution.
* Create and maintain knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and documentation for known issues and solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by recommending enhancements to support processes, tools, and best practices based on operational experience.
* Analyze application logs, system diagnostics, and core files to identify recurring trends, underlying issues, and opportunities for proactive problem prevention.
* You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast\-changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
**Who You Are:**
----------------


* Strong hands\-on experience supporting Pega Infinity applications in a production environment.
* Excellent understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Solid knowledge of production support operations, system monitoring, issue triaging, root cause analysis, and incident resolution.
* Proven ability to analyze, troubleshoot, and debug complex production issues independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
* Flexible to work in rotational shifts, participate in on\-call support, and provide quarter\-end production support as per business requirements.
* Good understanding of databases, SQL queries, data analysis, and integration points with upstream and downstream systems.
* Experience in identifying performance bottlenecks and working with cross\-functional teams to ensure system stability and availability.
* Knowledge of Java\-based applications, services, and integrations would be an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to provide clear, concise, and professional updates to stakeholders and clients.
* Strong client\-facing, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self\-motivated professionals with a strong desire to continuously learn, adapt to new technologies, and improve operational excellence.
* Demonstrated analytical thinking, problem\-solving ability, and attention to detail in a fast\-paced production support environment.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure while meeting service level agreements (SLAs) and business commitments.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-powered tools, Generative AI technologies are an added advantage.
* Ability to leverage AI for incident analysis, root cause identification, knowledge management, operational efficiency improvements, and support process optimization will be highly valued.
* Apply critical thinking to all AI\-generated outputs \- validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in testing and production environments.
**What You've Accomplished:**
-----------------------------


* 3\-5 years of experience in Production Support and troubleshooting to ensure high system availability and timely resolution of critical incidents.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related areas
* Working programming knowledge in Pega Infinity and experience
* Ability to rapidly gain in\-depth knowledge of existing internal applications
* Effective oral and written communication skills, including poise in pressure situations
* Ability to identify, propose and implement solutions.
* Experience in Oracle and/or DB2 and MS/SQL
**Pega Offers You:**
--------------------


* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company.
* The opportunity to make a tangible impact on Pega's business operations and ability to scale.

All hiring decisions are made based on human review and judgment. You may have the right to request human review, provide additional information, or raise questions about how such tools are used.

At Pegasystems, we foster an environment where people feel valued and empowered to contribute their best. title: Director, Employee Relations
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Employee Relations Manager
  
  

About JLL
  
  

**JLL (NYSE:** JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our vision is to reimagine the world of real estate, creating rewarding opportunities and amazing spaces where people can achieve their ambitions. In doing so, we will build a better tomorrow for our clients, our people, and our communities. JLL is a Fortune 500 company with annual revenue of $16\.3 billion, operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce of more than 102,000 as of December 2022\. JLL is the brand name, and a registered trademark, of Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated.
  
  

We are looking for an Employee Relations Manager to join our APAC Employee Relations team. The incumbent will be responsible for addressing employee relations matters ranging from policy violations and interpretations and investigating and resolving employee complaints.
  
  

**Key Accountabilities:**  

Partner with PXPs in investigations and fact finding on Employee Relations issues.
  
Resolve straightforward problems by applying relevant policies, past practices and/or best practices to reach a conclusion.
  
Provide consultation, guidance and coaching to Managers and HR Business Partners to address employee behavior and performance concerns and provide guidance and assist with the development and delivery of appropriate feedback or corrective/disciplinary actions.
  
Track and analyze ER data to identify ER trends, propose and implement improvements.
  
Define, design, and deliver ER solutions on topics including HR policies, disciplinary procedures, working time etc. to ensure compliance with statutory requirements.
  
Maintain required documentation within JLL's case management system including intake and investigation notes, supporting documents and final reports and/or evidence of action taken.
  
Advise on highly complex ER cases/problems by evaluating pertinent information, analyzing findings, and applying relevant Company policies and practices to reach a conclusion.
  
Build organizational capability in managing ER matters by educating managers and HR colleagues in ER processes and practices.
  
Actively participate and provide support in projects developing new ER processes and other HR process improvements.
  
Partner with Legal department as needed to ensure JLL policies and practices are compliant with local laws and regulations.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you need:**  

**Skills and Competencies:**  

TECHNICAL
  
HR system experience preferred (ServiceNow or Workday experience a plus)
  
Excellent ability to gather, synthesize, analyze, and report ER data
  
Sound knowledge and experience of POSH
  
Experience in conducting investigations
  
  

INTERPERSONAL
  
Exceptional written and verbal communications skills
  
Excellence in making independent decisions with a high degree of tact and diplomacy
  
Routine application of collaboration, conflict resolution and negotiation skills
  
Ability to recommend and/or apply appropriate action based on policy/procedure and/or business practice while navigating complexities
  
Effective in exercising good judgment, articulating reasoned rationale for ER recommendations to persuade business partners
  
History of well\-developed integrity and ethical behavior and maintaining confidentiality
  
Ability to maintain neutrality and calm demeanor in tense and conflicting situations

description:
**RAMCO CONGLOMERATE** 




  





 Ramco Systems is part of the
 **$1 billion\+ diversified Ramco Group** 
 , a legacy enterprise with deep roots in industries such as cement, textiles, engineering, software, energy, and biotech. With over 75 years of heritage and innovation, the Ramco Group is a global powerhouse that blends traditional business values with modern technologies.
 



**Ramco Systems** 
 is the Group’s technology arm, delivering
 **next\-gen enterprise software** 
 across
 **Global Payroll** 
 ,
 **HR** 
 ,
 **Aviation MRO** 
 ,
 **ERP** 
 , and
 **Logistics** 
 . Headquartered in Chennai, India, Ramco serves over 1,000 customers across 35\+ countries and is recognized for its
 **AI/ML\-based** 
 ,
 **bot\-enabled** 
 , and
 **cloud\-native** 
 solutions.
 



 Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high\-growth enterprises alike.
 



 If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications
 **Ramco is the place to be.** 




  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 The
 **Manager / Senior Manager – Payroll Bureau** 
 oversees payroll compliance across a region or multiple countries, leading a team to ensure accurate, timely, and high\-quality statutory compliance within the payroll product.
 



 The role is pivotal in strengthening compliance governance, driving statutory development cycles, and enabling scalable, standardised processes across countries.
 



 The individual is the primary owner of compliance delivery for assigned regions — representing the compliance function to internal and external stakeholders, holding service quality, and building a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Regional Compliance Ownership \& Governance** 



* Lead compliance operations across the assigned region and ensure full statutory coverage in the payroll product.
* Ensure end\-to\-end statutory updates —
 **monitoring, interpretation, communication, development, testing, release** 
 — are executed with precision and timeliness.
* Act as the escalation point for complex compliance interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes.
* Own relationships with authorities, consultants, and regulatory bodies for assigned geographies.
* Build compliance governance frameworks, SOPs, and audit\-ready documentation standards.



**Regulatory Interpretation \& Technical Oversight** 



* Review product requirements, interpretation notes, change impact assessments, and compliance documentation prepared by the team.
* Guide the team on complex multi\-country regulatory analysis and accurate statutory interpretation.
* Evaluate regulatory changes for business impact, system updates, and operational feasibility.
* Provide clear guidance on ambiguous legal scenarios and edge cases.



**Leadership, Team Management \& Capability Building** 



* Lead the team with effective workload allocation, quality checks, and timely delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and upskill team members through structured training, feedback, and development plans.
* Drive a culture of accuracy, ownership, accountability, and excellence in interpretation and documentation.
* Conduct performance evaluations, workforce planning, and capability development initiatives.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Customer Confidence** 



* Partner with Product Engineering and other cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation of regulatory requirements in the product.
* Lead end\-to\-end review of existing statutory setups for critical countries and implement product enhancements.
* Ensure timely, clear communication of regulatory changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee responses to complex customer compliance queries, ensuring accuracy, logical reasoning, and consistency.
* Represent Payroll Bureau in customer meetings and compliance deep\-dives, building credible relationships with clients, consultants, and internal partners.



**Strategic Initiatives \& Innovation** 



* Lead initiatives to scale compliance operations through automation, templates, frameworks, and standardised processes.
* Partner with technology teams on AI\-driven compliance research tools, dashboards, analytics, and automation projects.
* Build compliance assets including whitepapers, statutory summaries, and marketing and thought\-leadership content.
* Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement, standardisation, and future\-readiness.



**Training \& Knowledge Enablement** 



* Drive internal and external training programmes on payroll compliance, regulatory frameworks, and statutory updates.
* Strengthen organisation\-wide compliance capability through structured enablement sessions.



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 



* Full statutory coverage for the region, delivered ahead of regulatory effective dates.
* Complex interpretations and disputes resolved at this level rather than escalated upward.
* A team whose documentation needs progressively less correction.
* Customers and consultants who trust the Bureau’s statutory position without needing to verify it.
* Compliance operations that scale through standardisation rather than added headcount.



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)** 




*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head – Payroll Bureau and reviewed on the cadence noted.* 



* **Statutory coverage and release timeliness** 
 — statutory updates for the region delivered into the product ahead of their effective dates, with full coverage maintained.
 *(Per release)*
* **Compliance accuracy** 
 — statutory defects reaching production for the region, and defects traced to an interpretation error.
 *(Per release)*
* **Governance and escalation** 
 — frameworks, SOPs, and documentation standards current and audit\-ready; complex interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes resolved within the agreed timeline.
 *(Quarterly)*
* **Technical review quality** 
 — team documentation reviewed and signed off, and rework arising after sign\-off.
 *(Monthly)*
* **Team capability and performance** 
 — performance evaluations and development plans completed, and capability gaps closed against plan.
 *(Half\-yearly)*
* **Customer and stakeholder confidence** 
 — complex compliance queries resolved accurately within the agreed window, and customer deep\-dives supported to a satisfactory outcome.
 *(Quarterly)*
* **Scale and enablement** 
 — automation, template, or framework initiatives delivered, and training programmes and compliance assets published against plan.
 *(Half\-yearly)*



**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS** 



* Qualified
 **Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Lawyer** 
 with 7 to 10 years of relevant payroll compliance experience, or another qualification with 10\+ years in multi\-country payroll or statutory compliance roles.
* Experience in team leadership, stakeholder engagement, and managing multi\-country compliance.
* Strong analytical, logical, and interpretation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex regulations into clear, implementable guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* High integrity, professionalism, and ownership, with pride in the quality of work and curiosity to keep learning.
* Builds strong working relationships within and across teams, and coaches team members to succeed through guidance and clarity.
* Adapts quickly to changing demands and shifting priorities, and takes ownership to deliver solutions.
* Builds trust with internal teams, customers, and external partners, and gives them confidence through clear communication of statutory coverage in the product.
* Brings structure and strategic thinking to compliance operations, and continuously improves processes.



**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Knowledge of Ramco tools is an added advantage.
* Experience owning authority and regulator relationships in more than one jurisdiction.
* Exposure to compliance automation, analytics dashboards, or AI\-assisted regulatory research tooling.



**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS** 



* Own payroll compliance for a full region on a platform used across 35\+ countries.
* Direct influence on how regulation is built into the product.
* Lead a compliance team and represent the function to clients and regulators.
* Be part of a fast\-evolving, innovation\-led enterprise software company.

**Assistant Manager\- HRBP** 

Location: Royapettah, Chennai

Job Type: Full\-Time \| Work from Office

**About MrMed**

MrMed is a fast\-growing digital healthcare platform committed to making specialty and life\-saving medicines accessible and affordable across India. We support patients battling chronic and critical illnesses by simplifying access to high\-cost therapies and providing end\-to\-end assistance throughout their treatment journey.

At MrMed, we work closely across multiple teams including warehouse operations, logistics, billing, and city operations to ensure timely and safe delivery of medicines to patients. Our operations team plays a critical role in maintaining accuracy, speed, and quality across the supply chain.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and hands\-on \*\*HR Business Partner (HRBP)\*\* to own the end\-to\-end HR process for our operations teams — including warehouse, logistics, billing, and city operations. This role requires someone who can work closely with business leaders and frontline teams on the ground, driving hiring, employee engagement, performance management, and compliance, while ensuring HR practices support the speed and accuracy that our supply chain demands.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can balance people\-first thinking with business priorities, and who is comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for operations roles — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing positions within defined timelines
* Coordinate smooth onboarding and induction for new hires across warehouse, logistics, billing, and city operations teams

**Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries, grievances, and concerns
* Drive employee engagement initiatives to improve morale, retention, and workplace culture
* Conduct regular floor/site visits to stay connected with ground\-level teams

**Performance Management**

* Support goal\-setting, performance reviews, and appraisal cycles in coordination with department heads
* Identify performance gaps and work with managers on improvement plans

**HR Operations \& Compliance**

* Maintain accurate employee records, attendance, and HRMS data
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements (PF, ESI, labour laws, etc.) relevant to operations staff
* Handle documentation for joining, confirmation, transfers, and exits

**Policy Implementation \& Advisory**

* Roll out and reinforce HR policies, processes, and code of conduct across teams
* Partner with business leaders to advise on workforce planning, org structure, and people decisions

**Learning \& Development**

* Identify training needs for operations staff and coordinate relevant learning interventions
* Support skill\-building programs to improve efficiency and safety on the ground

**Exit Management**

* Manage the full exit process including exit interviews, clearance, and full \& final settlement coordination

**Qualifications**

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or related field
* Minimum 5 years of experience as an HRBP or HR Generalist, preferably supporting operations, warehouse, logistics, or blue\-collar/frontline workforce teams
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS tools and MS Office/Excel
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work on the ground with cross\-functional and frontline teams
* Comfortable working from office in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Payroll Administration**
* Execute payroll administration activities and support end\-to\-end payroll processes in partnership with payroll vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Validate and process payroll inputs, including new hires, terminations, salary changes, allowances, deductions, and one\-time payments.
* Perform payroll data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure payroll accuracy and compliance.

* Support payroll audits, controls, compliance reviews, and statutory reporting requirements.
* Collaborate with Finance, Payroll Vendors, and local stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely payroll delivery.
* Maintain payroll documentation and ensure adherence to internal controls and audit requirements.


**Benefits Administration**
* Oversee benefits\-related processes such as enrolment, life events, and terminations.
* Provide expert support to employees regarding benefit programmes, policies, and provider escalations.
* Ensure compliance with local legal requirements and internal policies related to benefits administration.


**Time \& Attendance**
* Manage time and attendance processes, ensuring accurate tracking of working hours, absences, and leave records.
* Support managers and employees in resolving time management issues and interpreting policies.
* Ensure compliance with local labour laws, collective agreements (where applicable), and internal policies.


**Operational Excellence**
* Ensure consistent adherence to global and local HR policies, labour regulations, and data protection requirements (including GDPR).
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and robust process controls, including segregation of duties and 4\-eye reviews.
* Support internal and external audits through timely and accurate documentation.
* Contribute to operational reporting, SLA monitoring, KPI analysis, root cause identification, and implementation of corrective actions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality, efficiency, and employee experience.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* 3–5 years of experience in HR Operations, Payroll Administration, or Shared Services, preferably within a pharmaceutical or regulated environment.
* Strong understanding of payroll processes, statutory compliance requirements, and employee lifecycle management.
* Strong working knowledge of local labour laws and HR compliance requirements.
* Advanced experience with HRIS systems (e.g., Workday, SAP, ServiceNow) and payroll/time management tools.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships.
* Strong interpersonal, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, matrix organisation.
* Deep understanding of operational metrics, service levels, quality controls, and audit requirements.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

description:

 **\#BuildWithHeart**

 Within Community Operations, Workforce Management plays a critical role in ensuring we have the right capacity, in the right place, at the right time. Our Global Command Center provides centralized operational oversight across our support network, helping teams proactively manage service levels, capacity, intraday performance, partner execution, and operational risks.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Uber is looking for an experienced
 **Program Lead Workforce Management \- Global Command Center** 
 to lead the strategy, governance, and performance of our outsourced Global Command Center operations.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our Global Command Center operates as a high\-performing, data\-driven function that enables proactive workforce management across Uber's customer support network. A key part of the role will be partnering closely with our outsourced service providers to establish strong governance, drive accountability, improve operational performance, and continuously identify opportunities to increase efficiency.
   

  

 You will establish operating standards, performance mechanisms, and governance across partners while collaborating closely with Workforce Management, Operations, Finance, Technology, and other cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 You will use data, technology, automation, and AI to anticipate operational risks, identify performance opportunities, improve decision\-making, and drive continuous improvements in workforce efficiency and customer experience.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead Global Command Center Operations: Own the operating model, governance, and performance of Uber's outsourced Global Command Center operations, ensuring consistent execution of real\-time workforce management and short\-range planning across the network.
* Drive Partner Performance: Establish strong governance with outsourced partners through performance scorecards, business reviews, action tracking, and escalation mechanisms. Hold partners accountable for service, quality, productivity, and efficiency outcomes.
* Strengthen Real\-Time Workforce Management: Ensure effective monitoring and management of volumes, staffing, capacity, adherence, service levels, and backlog, enabling early identification of operational risks and timely corrective action.
* Turn Data into Action: Use workforce and operational data to diagnose performance gaps, identify root causes, quantify opportunities, and translate insights into clear actions for partners and internal stakeholders.

* Strong understanding of Workforce Management disciplines, including forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real\-time management, service\-level management, and performance management.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience using data to identify root causes, quantify opportunities, and drive business decisions.
* Experience establishing operational KPIs, partner scorecards, governance mechanisms, and performance improvement plans.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex operational topics into clear recommendations for partners and senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a global, cross\-functional, and fast\-changing environment.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced degree.
* Experience leading a regional or global Workforce Management, Real\-Time Management, or Command Center function.
* Experience managing multinational teams and large\-scale outsourced operations across multiple BPO partners and locations.
* Demonstrated experience driving measurable productivity, efficiency, and cost optimization initiatives with outsourced partners.
* Strong knowledge of contact center technologies, routing platforms, workforce optimization tools, and operational analytics.
* Experience with data visualization, SQL, or other analytical tools used to investigate and communicate operational performance.
* Strong understanding of automation and AI\-enabled workforce management , with the ability to identify practical opportunities to use AI to improve productivity, forecasting, decision\-making, and operational execution.
* Demonstrated success leading transformation, process simplification, or continuous improvement initiatives across complex operational environments.
* Ability to influence partners and senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, and drive accountability without relying on direct authority.
* Strong business judgment, ownership mindset, and ability to balance customer experience, operational performance, workforce efficiency, and cost.

description:
* Hyderabad, India
* Permanent
**ABOUT FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT**


Flutter Entertainment is the **world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator** with **15\.9 million** Average Monthly Players worldwide and an annual revenue of **$16\.4 billion** in 2025\. We have a **portfolio of iconic brands** , including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair, PokerStars, Sisal, and Sportsbet.  



Flutter Entertainment is listed on the **New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).** We’re proud to be recognized by **TIME** as one of the **World’s Best Companies 2025** — a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.  



Working at Flutter is a chance to work with a growing **portfolio of brands** across a range of opportunities. We will support you every step of the way to help you grow. Just like our brands, we ensure our people have everything they need to succeed.


**FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA**


Our office in the heart of **Hi\-Tech City** , Hyderabad, serves as **Flutter Entertainment’s Global Capability Center (GCC).** Now home to 1,000\+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data \& Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech \& Analytics.  



Our Values define us. They are \- **Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Every day.**
  

They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day.  



With ambitious growth plans for the future and the global and local scale to achieve them, we continue to serve our customers and care for our **communities** with the talent and passion of our **colleagues** .
  

  

**OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE**


Flutter Functions' AI \& Automation team is seeking an experienced **you** to build and lead a high\-performing pod of 2–3 AI developers. You'll own the technical vision and execution of Flutter's **enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms** — intelligent systems that leverage our vast internal data assets to enhance productivity and decision\-making across our sports betting and gaming operations at global scale.


As an AI Engineering Lead, you'll combine deep technical expertise with strong people leadership, mentoring a talented team while driving the architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering practices that power next\-generation AI solutions. You'll have direct impact on both the platform's capabilities and the growth trajectory of your team members.


Working in a hybrid environment that blends remote flexibility with collaboration in our modern Hyderabad offices, you'll partner with product leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambitious AI initiatives into production\-grade systems serving over 20 million customers across 20\+ regulated markets.


**What You'll Do**

**Technical Leadership \& Architecture**

* **Platform Vision \& Strategy:** Establish the technical direction for Flutter's enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms, making architectural decisions around LLM inference, agentic frameworks, guardrails, and system design that balance innovation with operational excellence.
* **LLM Inference \& Optimization:** Lead the selection, deployment, and optimization of LLM inference systems — **LiteLLM, AWS Bedrock** , and emerging alternatives — establishing patterns that your team follows, including model routing strategies, cost management, and latency optimization.
* **Context Engineering \& Prompt Architecture at Scale:** Design sophisticated, production\-grade context pipelines and prompt architectures — establishing team best practices, code patterns, and evaluation frameworks that ensure consistency and quality across all platform components.
* **Model Tokenomics \& Trade\-off Analysis:** Mentor your team in understanding and reasoning about token economics, latency budgets, context window trade\-offs, and capability\-to\-cost ratios — embedding this thinking into architectural review processes and technical decisions.
* **Guardrails, Safety \& Compliance:** Architect robust model constraint and guardrail systems aligned with Flutter's Responsible AI Policy and regulatory obligations. Lead the security\-first mindset across the pod, ensuring AI outputs remain safe, compliant, and auditable across 20\+ regulated markets.
* **Agentic Framework Mastery:** Deep expertise across multiple agent frameworks ( **LangChain, LangGraph, Strands, ADK** ) — make informed choices about which frameworks and patterns solve which problems, establish team standards, and guide your developers in building sophisticated multi\-agent orchestrations.
* **Full\-Stack Problem Ownership:** Model end\-to\-end ownership — architecting solutions from LLM integration through backend services to user\-facing interfaces, and cultivating this mindset within your team so complex problems don't get siloed or handed off prematurely.
* **API \& Integration Design:** Design clean, scalable APIs and integration patterns using AWS services (Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway), **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** , and modern standards — establish team conventions that make integration predictable and maintainable.

**People Leadership \& Team Development**

* **Team Building \& Mentorship:** Hire, onboard, and actively mentor a pod of 2–3 AI developers — helping them grow from their current level towards technical leadership, fostering a culture of learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
* **Technical Skill Development:** Guide your team through the rapidly evolving AI landscape — mentoring on LLM inference systems, context engineering, agentic patterns, and security practices; helping them stay current with emerging tools and frameworks.
* **Code Review \& Technical Standards:** Establish and enforce technical standards across the pod — conducting rigorous code reviews, catching architectural issues early, and using review processes as teaching moments rather than gatekeeping exercises.
* **Incident Leadership \& Problem\-Solving:** Lead the team through production incidents, post\-mortems, and challenging technical problems — modelling a blameless culture while ensuring systemic improvements emerge from failures.
* **Career Development \& Growth Paths:** Create individual development plans for each team member, identify growth opportunities, and actively sponsor their advancement within Flutter — whether toward senior IC roles or their own leadership tracks.
* **Psychological Safety \& Culture:** Foster a team environment where curiosity is rewarded, failure is learnable, and people feel empowered to propose ideas, challenge assumptions, and take calculated technical risks.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Delivery**

* **Product \& Stakeholder Partnership:** Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions — balancing ambition with delivery realities and keeping the team focused on high\-impact work.
* **Data Science \& Engineering Partnerships:** Collaborate with data scientists and platform engineering teams across Flutter's organisation to integrate AI solutions into existing infrastructure, ensuring consistency and operational excellence.
* **Technical Communication:** Articulate complex AI concepts to non\-technical audiences, present architectural decisions to leadership, and translate business needs into technical priorities for your team.

**Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI**

* **Security\-First Mindset Leadership:** Champion a security\-oriented approach across all AI development — ensuring the pod reasons about prompt injection risks, data leakage vectors, authentication flows, access control, and sensitive data handling from day one.
* **Responsible AI Governance:** Ensure all platform development aligns with Flutter's Responsible AI Policy and regulatory compliance requirements — conducting design reviews, establishing testing practices, and creating guardrail frameworks that scale.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE**
**Core Requirements**

* **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, or a related STEM field, with **5\+ years of software development experience, of which 2–3\+ years focused on AI/ML or agentic systems development.**
* **Proven Leadership:** Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring technical teams (even informally) — showing ability to grow people, establish technical direction, and drive delivery through others.
* **Deep Python \& Backend Expertise:** Advanced Python proficiency with experience in production frameworks (FastAPI, Flask), async patterns, and the ability to architect scalable backend systems.
* **LLM Inference Systems Mastery:** Hands\-on expertise with **AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM** , and similar inference platforms — deep understanding of model routing, API design, cost optimization, and deployment patterns at production scale.
* **Context Engineering \& RAG Expertise:** Demonstrated ability to design and evaluate sophisticated context pipelines, retrieval\-augmented generation systems, and prompt architectures — with understanding of trade\-offs and best practices.

**About the Company:**
 Messe Muenchen India is a wholly owned subsidiary of Messe München GmbH, one of the world's leading trade fair organizers, headquartered in Germany. We play a critical role in building industry\-defining B2B platforms that connect global expertise with India's fast\-evolving markets. Our portfolio includes flagship trade fairs such as analytica Lab India, IFAT India, drinktec India, productronica India, laser World of Photonics India, air cargo India, and bauma CONEXPO INDIA, each operating at the intersection of business growth, innovation, and thought leadership.
   

  

 As an organization, we operate with strong governance, global standards, and a deep respect for people and culture. Leadership at Messe Muenchen India is rooted in building capable teams, enabling performance through clarity and accountability, and creating an inclusive, values\-led workplace. We value leaders who combine operational excellence with long\-term people development, and who can scale systems, nurture talent, and strengthen culture while delivering business impact.
   

  

**Role Summary:**
 The Director \- People \& Culture (P\&C) will partner closely with the Chief People Officer to co\-create and drive MMI's People \& Culture agenda, building the capabilities, talent, organizational practices and people infrastructure required for continued growth.
   

  

 MMI operates in a high\-growth environment where the business continues to evolve and reinvent itself at pace. The role therefore requires a business growth mindset, agility, pace \- building people practices, capabilities and systems that can grow with the organization in tandem.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring strategic perspective, strong execution and comfort operating through change, ambiguity and evolving priorities.
   

  

**Org Structure alignment:**
* Director \- People \& Culture reports to the Chief People Officer
* The People \& Culture Team (of 3 professionals) reports to Director \- People \& Culture


**Roles and Responsibilities, include but are not limited to:**
**Capability Building**
* Translate business priorities into future leadership, managerial and functional capabilities
* Build focused interventions to close critical capability gaps
* Strengthen leadership effectiveness, with emphasis on feedback, performance and accountability
* Measure capability through application and impact, not participation in capability development participation alone


**Organizational Effectiveness**
* Diagnose organizational challenges across structure, roles, accountability and ways of working
* Shape organization design as the business grows in scale and complexity
* Use business, people and listening insights to identify systemic opportunities for improvement
* Build greater adaptability and readiness for continued change


**Talent Infusion**
* Anticipate the talent MMI will need next and translate this into clear workforce priorities
* Build proactive pipelines for critical, niche and leadership talent
* Strengthen quality of hire, with direct involvement in senior and critical talent decisions, as per needs
* Balance external talent infusion with internal mobility, succession and career progression


**People Operations \& Governance**
* Continually improve People Operations for relevance, keeping it simple, scalable, reliable and people\-centric
* Design people processes, policies and systems for the organization's future scale
* Accelerate digitization, automation and self\-service while simplifying the people experience
* Ensure strong governance across payroll, benefits, compliance, policies, records and people data


**P\&C Leadership \& Business Partnership**
* Co\-create P\&C strategy and priorities with the CPO, bringing perspective, insight and constructive challenge objectively
* Partner senior leaders on critical organization, capability and talent priorities
* Lead, coach and mentor the P\&C team while remaining hands\-on in high\-impact work
* Build a function that operates with pace, ownership, commercial orientation and a scale mindset


**What success in this role looks like:**
* P\&C keeps pace with the business and anticipates what scale will require next
* Critical capabilities and talent are built or infused ahead of demand
* Structures and ways of working evolve effectively as the organization grows
* A stronger culture of performance, ownership and accountability is visible
* People Operations become simpler, more digital and scalable
* The P\&C team demonstrates agility, commercial orientation and strong execution
* The CPO and Director operate as a complementary leadership partnership with clear alignment
* The P\&C team reporting to you looks up to you as a strong addition to the team and would love to learn more in your leadership


**Requirements**
* 14\-18\+ years of progressive P\&C experience, with breadth across capability building, organizational effectiveness, talent and people operations
* Experience building and scaling people practices in high\-growth, evolving or transformation\-intensive environments
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into pragmatic people solutions
* A digital\-first mindset, with hands\-on experience using HRMS/HRIS platforms, automation and technology to simplify and scale P\&C
* Strong analytical orientation. Comfortable slicing and dicing data in Excel when deeper diagnosis is required from scratch, rather than relying only on pre\-visualized dashboards
* Experience leading P\&C teams and a genuine interest in coaching and mentoring team members as their roles and capabilities evolve
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and changing priorities with sound judgment; able to simplify complexity without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
* A genuine passion for People \& Culture as a profession and craft \- someone who actively stays curious, builds expertise and wants to keep evolving as a P\&C leader
* Independent thinking and the confidence to challenge constructively, then align and collectively own decisions


**Benefits**
* A leadership role shaping the growth of a leading B2B trade fair organization across India, Middle East, and Africa
* Exposure to global exhibition networks and international best practices
* A culture that values foresight, innovation, and performance excellence
* Work\-Life Integration with people focused policies, for e.g. Flexi working hours, Paid time\-offs, WFH x 4 days/ month
* Performance\-Linked Incentives

description:

 **$50M Series C**

 As the

 .
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 




**Culture, Learning \& Engagement**

 , onboarding, functional upskilling, and leadership development.

 certification, and internal NPS.

**Compliance, ESG \& Governance** 



* Lead
 **ESG initiatives**

* Drive HR due diligence for fundraising, investor requirements and M\&A.
* Own all regulatory compliance including labour laws (PF, ESI, Shops \& Establishments), POSH, audits, and statutory filings.
* Set up robust frameworks for
 **HR governance** 
 , grievance redressal, policy standardization, and documentation across all geographies.



  





**Compensation, Rewards \& ESOPs** 



* Structure
 **market\-aligned compensation** 
 , including fixed pay, variable bonuses, long\-term incentives, \&
 **ESOPs** 
 .
* Design ESOP frameworks that align with business goals and employee retention.
* Link rewards directly to performance metrics, business outcomes, and cultural contribution.



  





**People Strategy \& Org Design** 



* Collaborate with the CEO to define org design and resourcing strategy.
* Build scalable systems for
 **OKRs, performance management** 
 , and
 **succession planning** 
 .
* Lead org\-wide
 **talent reviews** 
 and leadership capability mapping.



  





**People Operations \& Automation** 



* Digitize processes across HR ops i.e. onboarding, leave, attendance, payroll, etc.
* Build dashboards to track metrics like
 **TAT, attrition, engagement** 
 , and productivity.
* Deploy HR tech solutions to streamline workflows across India and global teams.



  





**HR Team Leadership** 



* Build and mentor a high\-performing HR team across Talent Acquisition, HRBP, L\&D, Ops, and Engagement.
* Embed a culture of agility, ownership, and continuous improvement across the HR function.



  





**You Bring** 



* 12 \- 15 years of experience in strategic HR leadership roles.
* Proven track record managing HR for organizations with 500\+ employees across geographies.
* Experience in driving ESG, audit, compliance, ESOP structuring, Great Place to Work initiatives.
* Strong pedigree in designing and executing quality hiring, OKRs, process digitization, and culture transformation.
* Deep expertise in automation tools, HR analytics, and data\-backed decision\-making.
* Exceptional leadership, people mentorship, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Tier\-1 institute background (IIMs, XLRI, or equivalent) preferred.



  





**Ideal Traits** 



* **Founder’s mindset** 
 , ownership, agility, and bias for action.
* Strong people leader who can inspire teams across execution, audit, and training.
* Ability to work in
 **structured chaos** 
 and bring in scalable order.
* Deep orientation towards
 **employee satisfaction and process** 
 .
* Ready to travel and understand real challenges at different office locations.



  





**Why Flipspaces?** 



* A rare blend of
 **tech x design x manufacturing.**
* Leadership team with strong IIT/startup DNA.
* High ownership, customer\-first culture.
* Rapid global expansion, be part of the journey.



  





**Ready to Lead the Next Leap?** 




**Write to:** 
 omesh.makhija@flipspaces.com

description:

* To establish an excellent internal communication system through regular and transparent communication as well as cross\-functional collaboration to maximize synergies.
* To lead, inspire, develop and engage a talented workforce that supports the strategic and future needs of the business and drives for efficiency and improves effectiveness


**Operational**
* Develops effective best practice work and business procedures for Adani Group
* Collaborates with executive leadership to define the organization's long\-term mission and goals, identifying ways to support this mission through talent management.
* Identifies and executes key performance indicators for the organization on commercial, operations, finance, human resource, etc. to ensure relevant KPIs are executed and reviewed on a quarterly basis.
* Understanding of operational departments \[Guest Services, Facilities Management, Housekeeping, Culinary, Food \& Beverage, Customer Engagement, Quality Assurance, etc.] and work with country and local leadership to ensure it is functioning in line with the standards set by partners and HQ.
* Ensures corporate policies and procedures are being utilized and recommends improvements.
* Drives the overall business using technology to improve efficiency and achieve maximum operational efficiencies including but not limited to automation and optimization.
* Leads the City or Country in the event of a Crisis working closely with HQ.
* Actively participates in addressing internal and external audit findings by working with relevant stakeholders and taking necessary corrective action promptly.
* Lead the Executive Committee \[ExCom] and hold meetings at least once a month by focusing on the company’s overall priorities and goals from a City and Country level.
* ExCom must define specific strategic plans and actions that will be undertaken to drive and increase revenue, profit, productivity, market share, staff development, technology and attach them to measurable KPIs. The minutes of ExCom meetings will be shared between the leadership Steering Committee members.


**Revenue, Growth and Profit Maximization**
* Sets comprehensive goals for department performance and growth
* Liaises with Commercial Leadership to develop and execute commercial strategies in each location.
* Directly accountable for driving the budget and forecast by implementing a commercial strategy and business plan through execution, utilizing all available business tools and intelligence.
* Ensures the delivery of budgeted revenues across all revenue streams.
* Utilizes Business Intelligence tools to analyze data and performance, providing actionable information for making informed business decisions.
* Optimizes manpower costs by analyzing trends and costs, setting systemic standards for teams to follow, and tracking the results of planned efforts.
* Prepares the annual business plan and budgets including but not limited to manpower, etc.
* Works with the various airport General Managers, Assistant General Managers, Finance PIC, Human Resources PIC including Operations PIC to ensure profits are maximized in line with budgeted revenue and profit targets set.
* Ensures regular business reviews are conducted with all relevant stakeholders, including pricing and rate strategies are in place to achieve positive business results.


**Pre – Opening**
* Drives collaboration across all departments and stakeholders to ensure pre\-opening, refurbishment, or delisting projects are opened or closed within the set time frame.
* Communicate with the Project Team and Project Manager for the project completion timeline.
* Review the Pre\-Opening critical path to schedule key project milestones, work streams, and activities.
* Manage and approve resources requirements for pre\-opening as needed.
* Communicate and liaise with leadership to define project priorities and implementation opportunities and challenges and keep them up to date with project risks and opportunities.
* Ensure company standards are reflected in the projects in terms of Marketing, Branding, IT, F\&B, HR requirements/standards.


**Financial and Commercial Acumen**
* Supports the country finance teams with clear guidelines, responsibilities and ways of working that benefit the Corporate, Shared Services and Country\-Level Finance team
* Reviews, monitors and analyses financial performance in collaboration with the Country Finance against established goals and benchmarks by managing relevant revenue workstreams including driving cost efficiency and savings without impacting customer or brand experience.
* Supports the collection of accounts receivable by collaborating with respective Country Finance and Commercial teams, including HQ and other stakeholders.
* Conducts necessary monthly meetings covering commercial and revenue management strategies, credit collection, operational, strategic planning and execution, etc.
* Manages underperforming or loss\-making outlets, developing short\-to\-long action plans for each business unit to restore profitability.


**Business Development**
* Represents the business units in presentations to the Investment Committee, Steering Committee, and other relevant entities as necessary.
* Forges strategic partnerships and relationships with clients, vendors, agencies, venue partners, and all other professional business relationships.
* Be a key stakeholder collaborating with the legal team on contract management, including but not limited to contributing to the development of effective and efficient contract terms and conditions.
* Growth Management aggressively promotes the business unit maximizing its utilization and negotiating lease agreements as determined necessary and in the best interest of the company.
* Conducts frequent sales and calls with clients to stay updated on the business status and trends.
* Develops and maintains strong relationships with all internal and external stakeholders including but not limited to airport authorities, owners, business units, etc.
* Develops and aligns with Country and HQ business development teams on strategic plans for expansion and growth of the country’s business
* Works with business development and finance stakeholders to analyze ROI for capital projects before committing funds and assesses if anticipated results were achieved upon completion.
* Works with various stakeholders to provide efficient and accurate assessments on project leads and opportunities including inherent risk in the event of underperformance or early termination.
* Proposes relevant new concepts and designs to various stakeholders for review and consideration with the objective to expand and grow the business through quality product differentiation.


**Qualifications**
* Degree or relevant qualification in a relevant field to the role.
* 15–20 years of progressive industry experience across business development, revenue generation, P\&L management, and operations, with a proven track record of driving business growth and operational excellence.
* Minimum 15\+ years in a senior management role within the Travel, Airline or Hospitality Industry.
* A mix of experience from management to operations of Airports, Hotels, F\&B and/or Travel industry.
* Proven prior experience in a leadership role with analytical, strategic and tactical decisions making including evaluating and identifying business opportunities.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience presenting financial, commercial and operational plans.
* Working experience in various countries and regions would be an advantage.
* Strong and proven leadership skills with an emphasis on leading, engaging, recognizing, developing and mentoring employees.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, handle pressure, and establish clear expectations.
* Experience working in a collaborative and hierarchal environment.
* Fluent in written and spoken English as well as other key languages.

Delivers solutions to enhance employee experience, drive efficiency, and are compliant with local legislation and company policy

**3\-6 years of relevant experience \-**

* Coaches employees and managers on all employee lifecycle activities including inquiries on HR processes, programs and initiatives to deliver enhanced experiences and offer always on support (e.g. compensation, performance, onboarding, new hires, separation, disciplinary and other HR processes).
* Resolves conflicts and provides coaching and counseling on employment matters

* Ensures delivery is in accordance with established standards and in adherence to HR policies and procedures; monitors legislative compliance and takes action to ensure all requirements and agreements are met within the geography.
* Ensures the consistent application of HR knowledge for click and connect support to effectively resolve employee and manager queries.

title: Senior HR Analyst
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior HR Analyst
   

  

**About The Role**
 The People Analyst will be a key member of the Regional People Data \& Analytics team, delivering workforce insights, analytics, and strategic decision support across multiple business units globally. This role combines analytics, data management, reporting, program management, and emerging AI capabilities to enable data\-driven talent decisions across Mastercard.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented problem solver with strong SQL and data modeling expertise, a passion for data quality, and an interest in leveraging Generative AI to improve workforce analytics and business outcomes. This individual will help transform complex people data into actionable insights while driving consistency, scalability, and innovation across reporting and analytics solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Workforce Analytics \& Reporting
   

  

 Serve as the primary point of contact for operational reporting, workforce metrics, and analytics requests from global stakeholders.
   

  

 Partner with business leaders to understand underlying business challenges and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
   

  

 Collaborate with the Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) CoE to support monthly headcount reporting, forecasting, and workforce analysis.
   

  

 Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide meaningful workforce insights.
   

  

 Data Management \& Quality
   

  

 Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of workforce data across systems and reporting solutions.
   

  

 Partner with HR Systems, Data Management, and Engineering teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
   

  

 Establish controls and validation processes to improve trust and reliability of workforce metrics.
   

  

 Drive data governance standards and ensure compliance with privacy and security requirements for people data.
   

  

 Data Modeling \& Analytics Engineering
   

  

 Design and maintain scalable analytical data models to support reporting, self\-service analytics, AI use cases, and workforce planning.
   

  

 Apply dimensional modeling principles and create efficient data structures for workforce analytics.
   

  

 Leverage SQL to query, analyze, validate, and optimize large and complex datasets.
   

  

 Collaborate with Data Engineers and Analysts to improve analytical data foundations and reporting capabilities.
   

  

 AI \& Innovation
   

  

 Explore and leverage Generative AI solutions to improve reporting efficiency, automate insights generation, and enhance workforce analytics.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to incorporate AI\-driven capabilities into reporting, analytics, and decision support processes.
   

  

 Partner with analytics teams to evaluate emerging technologies and improve the employee analytics experience.
   

  

**All About You**
 Essential Qualifications
   

  

 Experience working with organizational, workforce, HR, or people\-related data.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes behind business questions.
   

  

 Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, analyzing, troubleshooting, and optimizing large datasets.
   

  

 Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, relationships, keys, hierarchies, and analytical data structures.
   

  

 Proven ability to improve data quality, data integrity, and reporting accuracy across multiple systems and data sources.
   

  

 Advanced Excel experience including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, conditional formatting, charts, and data analysis.
   

  

 Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Experience building scalable reporting solutions, dashboards, and self\-service analytics capabilities.
   

  

 Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across global teams and multiple time zones.
   

  

 Ability to work within data governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks.
   

  

 Flexible, proactive, and able to adapt to changing business priorities.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience with HRIS platforms, preferably Workday.
   

  

 Experience managing and analyzing structured and unstructured data using SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies.
   

  

 Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Domo, or similar platforms.
   

  

 Familiarity with ETL and data integration tools such as Alteryx, Informatica, or similar technologies.
   

  

 Exposure to Generative AI technologies and AI\-powered analytics solutions.
   

  

 Experience designing analytical datasets, semantic layers, feature stores, or enterprise reporting models.
   

  

 Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and enterprise data quality frameworks.
   

  

 Experience influencing stakeholders and driving adoption across large, matrixed organizations.
   

  

 Knowledge of workforce planning, talent analytics, organizational effectiveness, or employee experience analytics.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Associate Director - Global Talent Operations
description:
**Job Description**
**Associate Director, Global Talent Operations**
 Location: Pune, India (global role) \| Reports to: Global Head of People / CHRO \| Experience: 12 to 20 years \| Type: Full time
   

  

**About The Role**
 Anchanto is a global enterprise grade B2B SaaS company. We provide cloud software for brands, retailers, and logistics providers to manage orders, warehouses, inventory, marketplaces, and omnichannel commerce. We operate across 12 countries, support more than 300 enterprise and mid\-market customers, and process over 150 million commerce transactions a year.
   

  

 As Anchanto scales, the People function has to run with the same reliability, speed, and discipline we expect from our own platforms. This role builds and runs that execution engine. Internally, think of this as the operational backbone of the People function. The CHRO owns people strategy and transformation. HRBPs own business partnership and performance. Talent Acquisition owns hiring. This role owns execution reliability across the Anchanter lifecycle. The expectation is operational excellence, not administrative processing.
   

  

 This is a build and scale mandate. You start with a small team and are expected to grow the function and its capability as Anchanto grows. It is not a maintenance seat.
   

  

**One Anchanter experience for all 300 \+ Anchanters across 19 nationalities, everywhere. From Korea to France and every country in between, the operational experience an Anchanter receives should be consistent, reliable, and enterprise grade.** 
 Making that true across all 12 countries is this role's responsibility. This is operational consistency in onboarding, lifecycle, support, systems, and service levels. It is not cultural uniformity, which sits with other parts of the People function.
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 Today, too much people work runs on manual effort, inconsistencies and spreadsheets, and too much of it lands on HRBPs and leaders. This role exists to fix that. The mission is to build a Talent Operations function that is trusted, scalable, data driven, AI enabled, compliant, and enterprise grade, so that HRBPs and leadership can focus on organisation effectiveness, leadership, and growth.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 The role owns eight areas. The list is deliberately broad because this is the function owner, but the bar is the same throughout: systems and data over manual effort, clear ownership, and reliable execution for every Anchanter.
   

  

* Global Anchanter lifecycle operations


 Run enterprise grade lifecycle operations across geographies: onboarding and induction, employment documentation and contract governance, confirmation and probation, internal mobility and transfers, promotion and status changes, records integrity, exit and offboarding, and asset and access recovery. Identify recurring pain points and bottlenecks proactively and fix them at the root. Outcome: smooth transitions, fast and consistent turnaround, no operational ambiguity.
   

  

* Payroll inputs, benefits, and compliance operations


 Payroll is run by an external provider. This role owns the inputs to that provider and the operational integrity around them, not the payroll run or filing itself. That means accurate and on time payroll inputs across countries, benefits administration, leave and attendance, insurance and claims, coordination with the payroll provider and country partners, and audit readiness on the input side. Outcome: payroll inputs are clean and on time every cycle, the provider has exactly what it needs, and compliance risk is managed before it surfaces.
   

  

* HR systems and talent technology


 Own and modernise the People technology stack: HRMS, ATS and hiring workflows, integrations, access and permissions, workflow automation, data governance, and self\-service. People Operations should run through systems, not spreadsheets. You also own the operational vendor relationships that sit underneath this, including HRMS, the payroll provider, insurance, background verification, and engagement platforms, holding them to service levels and value. Outcome: reduced manual dependency, a clean and trusted system of record, and vendors that deliver.
   

  

* People analytics and workforce intelligence


 Operate people data as a decision system, not an activity report. Build workforce and headcount dashboards, attrition and retention analysis, hiring and funnel reporting, workforce cost visibility, and early warning indicators. Leadership reporting should answer where workforce risk is emerging, where managers are struggling, where hiring is stuck, which attrition patterns matter, and which cost trends need intervention.
   

  

* Anchanter experience and service delivery


 Deliver an enterprise grade operational experience across every touchpoint: onboarding, lifecycle transitions, support interactions, communication workflows, and exits. Run Anchanter query and support management to a high standard of responsiveness, professionalism, ownership, and service orientation, with clear SLAs, defined escalation paths, and accountable resolution. Communicate policy clearly so Anchanters know where they stand, and keep simplifying process so the experience improves over time. Anchanters should experience clarity, responsiveness, professionalism, and reliability.
   

  

* Policy governance and risk management


 Create operational trust through governance: policy lifecycle and rollout, acknowledgment tracking, documentation controls, compliance tracking, audit support, and country policy coordination. Outcome: policies are understood, documentation is reliable, governance is consistent and fair.
   

  

* Modernisation and AI enablement


 Anchanto expects AI to reshape internal operating models. This role identifies repetitive manual work and removes it through automation, digital first workflows, and AI assisted support where it adds real value. Examples: AI assisted Anchanter support, automated onboarding, workflow reminders and bots, intelligent reporting, and digital documentation. We want a builder, not a maintainer.
   

  

* Team leadership and capability building


 Build and lead the Talent Operations team. Set clear ownership and accountability, raise operational discipline, and grow the capability of the function as Anchanto scales. Foster a culture of continuous improvement where the team solves problems rather than escalates them, and develop people so the function gets stronger over time, not just busier. Outcome: a capable, accountable, self\-improving team that leadership can rely on.
   

  

**Cross Functional Operating Model**
 Success depends on clean handoffs and clear ownership boundaries with:
   

  

**Partner**
**On What**
 CHRO / Head of People
   

  

 People strategy, organisation design, transformation
   

  

 HRBP teams
   

  

 Hiring to onboarding handover, performance and talent cycles
   

  

 Talent Acquisition
   

  

 Offer to onboarding transition, candidate to Anchanter handoff
   

  

 Finance
   

  

 Cost control, payroll funding and reconciliation, audit. Payroll is run by an external provider; this role owns and submits the inputs
   

  

 IT and Security
   

  

 HR systems, integrations, access and permissions
   

  

 Business leaders
   

  

 Operational experience, workforce reporting, decision support
   

  

**What Good Looks Like After 12 To 18 Months**
 Leadership should be able to say:
   

  

* People Operations feels enterprise grade.
* Payroll inputs and lifecycle operations are highly reliable.
* People data is trusted, accurate, and easy to access.
* Anchanters get faster and clearer support.
* Manual work and operational friction have dropped significantly.
* HRBPs and leaders spend far less time on administrative coordination.
* Talent Operations runs proactively, not reactively.
* The operational experience is consistent across all countries, not just the largest ones.
* The Talent Operations team is capable, accountable, and improving on its own.


**Skills And Experience**
* 12 to 20 years across Talent Operations, HR Operations, People Operations, or HR shared services, with time spent leading the function, not only running it.
* Experience in technology, SaaS, internet, or fast scaling companies.
* Multi country People Operations experience.
* Strong payroll and compliance governance exposure, with a clear view of where the Finance boundary sits.
* Hands on experience implementing and running HRMS and ATS platforms.
* Strong data and reporting orientation, comfortable building dashboards and reading them for risk.
* Experience managing operational teams and vendors.
* Exposure to automation and AI enabled workflows preferred.
* Able to operate in ambiguity and build structure in a scaling environment.


**Leadership Behaviours We Expect**
 Managers at Anchanto are expected to operate with high ownership, solve problems rather than escalate confusion, use systems and data over opinions, communicate clearly and directly, build trust through reliability, improve processes continuously, collaborate without bureaucracy, and act with urgency and accountability.
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
 To be clear about scope, this role is not:
   

  

* Payroll only administration.
* An HRBP substitute.
* A policy policing function.
* A culture only role.
* A maintenance only operations seat.


**This is a leadership role responsible for building scalable operational capability.**
**Where Operations Supports Culture and Engagement**
 Operations does not own townhalls, office events, the Anchanto Cricket League, employer brand, or culture building. Those sit with HRBPs, People Experience, and leadership, because they need judgement about what Anchanto believes and how it should feel.
   

  

 Where asked, Operations provides the rails underneath: systems, attendance and participation data, vendor and budget coordination, and reliable logistics. It enables these by exception, not by default, and never owns the message or the culture.
   

  

**Success Measures**
 Indicative KPIs:
   

  

**Indicative KPI**
**What It Measures**
 Payroll input accuracy
   

  

 Percentage of payroll input cycles submitted to the provider with zero errors
   

  

 Payroll input timeliness
   

  

 Percentage of cycles where inputs reach the provider on schedule, all geographies
   

  

 Lifecycle SLA adherence
   

  

 Onboarding, confirmation, transfer, exit turnaround against SLA
   

  

 HRIS data accuracy
   

  

 Percentage of clean, validated records in the system of record
   

  

 Service responsiveness
   

  

 Employee query resolution time and SLA adherence
   

  

 Onboarding experience and NPS
   

  

 New joiner experience score in first 30 days
   

  

 Audit and compliance
   

  

 Number of audit and compliance findings, trending down
   

  

 Automation coverage
   

  

 Percentage of high volume workflows automated or self service
   

  

 Reporting reliability
   

  

 Accuracy and timeliness of workforce and attrition reporting
   

  

**Closing**
 At Anchanto, enterprise grade customer experience starts with enterprise grade internal execution. This role builds that foundation. If you like building systems, simplifying complexity, modernising operations, and creating reliable execution at global scale, this is a chance to shape the next chapter of Anchanto's growth.
