 primary statutory welfare service, ensuring high standards of food hygiene, quality, and subsidized
 



 nutritional offerings for all workers.
 



 ● Oversee employee transportation including e.i staff buses, taxis, and company vehicles to ensure safe,
 



 reliable daily commuting for a smooth employee experience.
 



 ● Manage plant facilities, timely uniform distribution, printing/stationery, and overall site amenities to
 



 maintain a functional, comfortable working environment.
 



 ● Manage and govern welfare budgets (Capex and Opex), oversee purchasing/contract renewals, and
 



 track vendor performance to ensure uninterrupted delivery of worker\-centric services.
 



 ● Oversee plant security operations and implement the Structured Security Operating Manual and SOPs
 



 to protect employees, conduct site audits, and maintain business continuity.
 



  





 Statutory compliance \& liaison:
 



 ● Directly manage and maintain statutory welfare provisions under statutory code, driving occupational
 



 health and hygiene in collaboration with safety officers through periodic health surveillance, worker
 



 medical examinations, clean drinking water supply, gender\-segregated latrines/urinals, and PPE
 



 utilization monitoring.
 



 ● Oversee 100% worker enrollment under ESI and EPF schemes, process Maternity Benefit applications,
 



 manage Workmen's Compensation claims, and advise workers on leave, gratuity, and statutory
 



 entitlements.
 



 ● Maintain direct relations with government administration and statutory authorities—including the
 



 District Collectorate, Labour/Factory Inspectors, Police, and local bodies—to ensure full legal
 



 compliance, best practice adoption, and smooth plant operations.
 



  





 Engagement \& grievance handling:
 



 ● Resolve worker grievances, maintain the Welfare Complaints Register, counsel employees on
 



 personal or domestic challenges, and facilitate active Works Committee and Joint Welfare Committee
 



 meetings.
 



 ● Conduct orientation sessions for new hires, lead health/safety awareness drives, and organize
 



 employee engagement, sports, and cultural events to foster workplace morale.
 



  





 Qualifications:
 



 The incumbent should be a graduate with a Degree or Diploma in Social Work / Labour Welfare / Personnel
 



 Management / Social Science from a recognised institution.
 



 The incumbent should have handled welfare activities for manufacturing set up in the past for a minimum
 



 two years.

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
**About Pavo Ads**

We are building a forward\-thinking AdTech platform revolutionizing digital advertising for modern brands. By utilizing advanced technology, data\-driven insights, and impactful media formats, we excel at creating meaningful brand\-consumer connections. Our mission is to redefine advertising through innovation, creativity, and strategic media placement. At Pavo Ads, we empower brands to amplify their reach, engage audiences effectively, and leave lasting impressions in the digital age.

**About the Role**

This is not a regular internship. As part of the Founder's Office, you will work directly with the CEO on day\-to\-day operations, business development, hiring, and strategy. No two days will be the same one day you're running a hiring round, the next you're building a pitch deck or managing social media. If you want to learn how a startup actually runs from the inside, this is the role.

**What You'll Do**

**Operations \& Coordination**

* Assist the Founder in day\-to\-day business operations and execution
* Track tasks, follow up on pending items, and ensure things don't fall through the cracks
* Coordinate between different vendors, candidates, and partners on behalf of the Founder

**Digital Marketing**

* Manage Pavo Ads' social media presence — Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook
* Create and schedule content using Canva
* Assist in GMB management, website updates, and SEO activities
* Track analytics and share weekly performance reports

**Hiring \& HR Support**

* Post job openings on various portals — Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna
* Screen resumes, schedule interviews, and coordinate with candidates
* Draft offer letters, rejection mails, and onboarding communications

**Research \& Business Development**

* Conduct market research — competitors, pricing, industry trends
* Identify potential retail partners and brand clients for outreach
* Prepare reports, presentations, and data summaries as required

**Miscellaneous**

* Whatever the business needs — you figure it out and get it done

**Who We're Looking For**

✅ Fresher or up to 1 year of experience — any background welcome  
✅ Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English  
✅ Comfortable with MS Office / Google Workspace  
✅ Basic knowledge of Canva and social media platforms  
✅ Self\-starter who doesn't wait to be told what to do next  
✅ Curious, organised, and comfortable with ambiguity  
✅ Available full\-time from our Preet Vihar, Delhi office (Hybrid)

**What You Get**

\- Stipend: ₹8,000 – ₹12,000 per month (based on skills)  
\- Direct mentorship from the Founder \& CEO  
\- Real exposure to how a startup is built from scratch  
\- Certificate \+ Letter of Recommendation on completion  
\- Pre\-placement opportunity based on performance

**Duration:** 3–6 Months  
**Location:** Preet Vihar, Delhi (Hybrid)  
**Joining:** Immediate

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a 3\-line note on why you want to work in a Founder's Office to:  
\- HR@pavoads.com

Pay: ₹8,743\.49 \- ₹10,261\.23 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: In person

description:

**Associate/Sr. Associate \- HR \& Administration**
===================================================


**Location:** Centre for Civil Society, New Delhi


**Type:** Full\-time


**Application Deadline:** 20 September 2026



**About CCS**
-------------


Centre for Civil Society (CCS) is India's leading public policy think tank advancing social change through public policy. Founded in 1997, CCS works to expand opportunity and choice through evidence\-based research, pilot interventions, policy engagement, and capacity\-building initiatives.


CCS works across education, livelihoods, governance, and institutional reform. Through rigorous research and practical implementation, CCS seeks to generate evidence that informs policy, improves programme effectiveness, and strengthens public institutions.


We are looking for a people\-oriented and organised HR professional and help build a workplace where people can learn, grow and do their best work.


This is a hands\-on role that brings together HR, Learning \& Development and Administration. The right person should enjoy working with people, be comfortable managing processes, and have the ability to take things from planning to execution.


**What will you do?**
---------------------


### **Learning \& Development**


* Work with the L\&D Lead to plan and run CCS's annual learning and development initiatives.
* Coordinate training programmes, workshops, mentoring and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Work with managers and employees to understand learning and development needs.
* Track participation, feedback and learning outcomes, and improve programmes based on what we learn.
* Support employees in making the most of internal and external learning opportunities.

### **HR \& Employee Experience**


* Support key HR processes across the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, performance management and exits.
* Help create a positive employee experience and keep communication with employees clear and timely.
* Support performance and feedback processes and help managers with the tools and processes they need.
* Organise employee engagement and culture\-building initiatives.
* Maintain employee records and ensure HR processes and policies are followed.

### **Administration**


* Manage day\-to\-day administrative requirements and respond to employee requests.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers and ensure office requirements are taken care of.
* Help improve administrative processes, reduce unnecessary manual work and introduce simple systems where useful.
* Support office planning, procurement and other operational requirements.

### **Systems \& Reporting**


* Maintain HR, L\&D and administrative trackers and dashboards.
* Help employees adopt and use CCS's internal systems and tools effectively.
* Prepare periodic reports and updates for the L\&D Lead and leadership team.
* Look for ways to make our people and administrative processes simpler and more efficient.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We are looking for someone who is:


* People\-oriented and approachable, with good interpersonal skills.
* Organised and dependable, with strong follow\-through.
* Comfortable managing multiple things at the same time without losing attention to detail.
* A good communicator who can work with employees, managers, leadership and external partners.
* Comfortable working with data, systems and technology.
* Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Curious and willing to learn, experiment and improve existing ways of working.
* Discreet and mature when handling confidential employee information.

**Experience \& Qualifications**
--------------------------------


* **3–6 years of relevant experience** in HR, L\&D, People Operations or a related area.
* A **Master's degree** in HR, Management, Psychology, Business Administration or a related field would be preferred.
* Experience in a non\-profit or mission\-driven organisation is an advantage, but not essential.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across teams and leadership.
* Ability to balance and reconcile diverse stakeholder needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Compensation**
----------------


Compensation will be offered in line with industry standards, commensurate with experience and qualifications.


Eligible employees will receive PF benefits as per applicable organisational policy and statutory requirements.


Employees will be covered under the organisation's health insurance/medical benefits as per the applicable policy. Additional employee benefits will be provided in accordance with CCS policies.

------------


Interested candidates should fill out this application form: **Application Form**

The last day for submission is **20 September 2026**. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interviews.

title: Training & Development Lead
description:
**Training \& Development Lead**

**Location:** Noida

**Department:** Human Resources / Quality \& Operations

**Reports To:** HR Manager / dotted line reporting to Head of Quality (QMS)

**Job Purpose**

The Training \& Development Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and governing an end\-to\-end employee learning framework using the ADDIE model. This role bridges general HR/organizational development and technical competency mapping, ensuring all training processes comply with **ISO 9001:2015 (Clause 7\.2 \- Competence)** standards.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. End\-to\-End Training Management (ADDIE Model)**

· **Analysis:** Conduct organization\-wide Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across general, HR, soft\-skills, and technical product/process domains.

· **Design \& Development:** Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to build structured training modules, SOPs, and On\-the\-Job Training (OJT) frameworks.

· **Implementation:** Schedule, coordinate, and facilitate both internal technical deep\-dives and external certification programs.

· **Evaluation:** Measure training effectiveness post\-30/60 days via performance data, manager sign\-offs, and skill evaluations.

**2\. QMS \& ISO 9001 Governance**

· Maintain and update the organization’s **Training SOP** and centralized QMS documentation.

· Maintain auditor\-ready records, including Skills Matrices, signed attendance logs, training plans, and effectiveness sign\-offs.

· Lead internal and external audit readiness for Clause 7\.2 (Competence, Training, and Awareness).

**3\. Technical \& Operational Competency Mapping**

· Partner with engineering, firmware, hardware, and assembly leads to map technical roles to required skill levels.

· Formalize peer review mechanisms, OJT sign\-offs, and high\-voltage/lab safety training logs.

**4\. Metrics \& Reporting**

· Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Training Completion Rate (\>90%), Training Effectiveness Rate (\>85%), and Skill Gap Reduction.

· Present quarterly training metrics and compliance reports to management during Management Review Meetings (MRM).

**Qualifications \& Key Requirements**

· **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

· **Experience:** 4–7 years of experience in Learning \& Development (L\&D) or Training, ideally within engineering, electronics, automotive, or tech manufacturing startups.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per year

title: Strategy Lead
description:
The Strategy Lead is a senior, high\-ownership role at the centre of Impact Beacon's growth. Designed for someone who can operate across strategy, organisational building, and innovation, this person will work in close partnership with senior leadership, taking on meaningful responsibilities and enabling the organisation to operate at its highest value.
 




  






 This is not an implementation\-only role. It requires someone who can think at the level of the organisation, identify where the business needs to go next, design the structures that will get it there, and take ownership of new initiatives from concept through execution. Critically, this person must be equally comfortable in a room with clients as they are behind a strategy document, representing Impact Beacon with credibility, depth, and presence.
 




  






 The ideal candidate brings direct experience in or with the nonprofit sector, understands how these organisations function across their different departments, and can translate that understanding into sharp advisory thinking. They are as comfortable building frameworks as they are getting things done.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Strategy and Planning***



* Lead the development and maintenance of organisational strategy, ensuring clarity on direction, priorities, and resource allocation.
* Support senior leadership in designing and executing key strategic initiatives across Impact Beacon's advisory practice.
* Conduct research, market analysis, and landscape scans to inform strategic decisions and identify new opportunities.
* Prepare strategic briefs, position papers, and decision\-support materials that allow leadership to move with speed and confidence.



  





***Organisational Building***



* Build and maintain systems and processes that allow the organisation to operate effectively as it scales.
* Drive internal capability building, including onboarding frameworks, knowledge management, and performance systems.
* Identify and resolve structural or process gaps that limit organisational effectiveness.



  





***Innovation and New Initiatives***



* Lead the development of new offerings, market extensions, or strategic partnerships from concept through viability assessment and launch.
* Monitor the external landscape for trends, adjacent opportunities, and emerging client needs that Impact Beacon should respond to.
* Translate strategic ideas into structured briefs and execution\-ready plans.



  





***Client Engagement and Advisory Support***



* Lead or support client\-facing conversations, including discovery calls, engagement reviews, and senior stakeholder meetings.
* Represent Impact Beacon with clarity and credibility in conversations with Executive Directors, boards, and leadership teams of nonprofit organisations.
* Contribute to proposal development, client scoping, and advisory output at a standard that reflects the firm's quality bar.
* Build relationships with clients and partners that reinforce Impact Beacon's position as a trusted strategic partner.



  





***Execution and Coordination***



* Ensure continuity and follow\-through across strategic priorities, tracking decisions, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Maintain situational awareness across all active initiatives and surface risks or misalignments early.
* Serve as a coordination anchor across internal teams and external partners where required.



  





**Role Expectations** 





 This role requires a high degree of ownership, intellectual rigour, and the ability to operate without a clear playbook. The successful candidate will be as comfortable building a strategy framework as they are leading a client conversation or developing a new service offering. They will take initiative, exercise good judgment, and bring structure to ambiguity.
 




  






 Impact Beacon works closely with nonprofit leaders who are navigating real operational and strategic pressure. The person in this role must understand that world, not from the outside, but from direct exposure to how these organisations are built and how they function across departments.
 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 5 to 8 years of experience in strategy, consulting, organisational development, or a combination of these.
* Direct experience working in or with nonprofit organisations. This is a must\-have, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Working knowledge of how multiple departments within a nonprofit function, including fundraising, finance, programs, HR, and governance.
* Proven ability to lead or contribute to client\-facing conversations at a senior level, with clarity and confidence.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to move from insight to action.
* Excellent written communication, clear, precise, and capable of tailoring to different audiences.
* Experience designing or contributing to organisational structures, systems, or people strategies.
* Ability to develop new ideas into well\-structured, viable initiatives.
* High degree of ownership and follow\-through, comfortable working independently on complex problems.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments where priorities shift and clarity must be created, not inherited.



  





**Who Will Thrive Here** 





 You will thrive in this role if you are energised by building things, not just improving them. You think at the level of the organisation, not just the task in front of you. You are comfortable moving between high\-level strategy and ground\-level execution. You understand how nonprofits work from the inside, the pressures their leaders face, the constraints they operate within, and what it actually takes to help them move. You can hold a room with a client and hold a complex strategic workstream at the same time. Leadership can hand you a half\-formed problem and trust that something clear, considered, and actionable will come back.
 




  





**Growth Opportunity** 



* Direct exposure to senior leadership decision\-making across strategy, growth, and organisational design.
* Ownership of high\-impact initiatives at a pivotal stage of the firm's growth.
* Exposure to advisory work across a growing portfolio of nonprofit and social impact clients globally.
* Opportunity to shape Impact Beacon's future offerings, market position, and internal architecture.





 ﻿
 





**About Impact Beacon** 





 Impact Beacon is a strategic knowledge partner that mission\-driven organisations rely on to succeed. We combine deep nonprofit understanding with data\-driven tools and systems to turn potential impact into measurable results. We help organisations strengthen critical but non\-core functions so they can focus on their mission. Our solutions span Donor Lifecycle and Community Management, People, Culture and Talent Systems, Governance and Financial Systems, and Operational Continuity and Internal Systems.

title: Assistant Manager HR Operations & Administration
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive
 **Assistant Manager HR Operations \& Administration** 
 to manage and oversee key HR operational processes along with administrative activities across the organization.
 



  





 The role will be responsible for ensuring smooth execution of
 **Payroll, HRIS/HRMS management, employee lifecycle processes, HR data management, compliance support** 
 , and
 **administrative/vendor management activities** 
 .
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in HR Operations and Administration, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, employees, management, and external vendors.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. HR Operations** 




 Payroll Management
 


* Manage and coordinate the complete monthly payroll process in collaboration with Finance and relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure accurate collection and validation of attendance, leave, salary revisions, incentives, reimbursements, deductions, and other payroll\-related inputs.
* Coordinate with payroll vendors, Finance, and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate salary processing.
* Address employee queries related to salary, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll.
* Ensure payroll records and documentation are maintained accurately and confidentially.
* Support statutory and compliance\-related payroll requirements.



  





 HRIS \& HRMS Management
 


* Manage and maintain employee data on the organization's
 **HRIS/HRMS platform** 
 .
* Ensure accurate employee information, including onboarding details, employee records, reporting structures, attendance, leave, and other HR data.
* Coordinate with HRMS/HRIS vendors for system\-related issues, enhancements, and process improvements.
* Monitor data accuracy and ensure regular audits of HRMS records.
* Support implementation of new HR modules, processes, and automation initiatives.
* Generate HR reports and dashboards from the HRMS as required by management.
* Train and support employees and managers in using HRMS systems and processes.



  





 Employee Lifecycle Management
 


* Oversee HR operational activities across the employee lifecycle, including:
* Joining and onboarding documentation
* Employee data management
* Confirmation processes
* Transfers and internal movements
* Salary revisions and promotions
* Employee exits and separation documentation
* Ensure all employee records and HR documentation are updated accurately and maintained as per company policies.



  





 HR Operations \& Process Improvement
 


* Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR operational processes and SOPs.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency.
* Ensure timely completion of HR operational activities and adherence to defined timelines.
* Support HR audits and provide necessary documentation and reports.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper handling of employee information.



  





**2\. Administration \& Vendor Management** 




 Administrative Operations
 


* Oversee day\-to\-day administrative operations to ensure smooth functioning of the office.
* Coordinate with internal teams to address administrative requirements and operational needs.
* Support office infrastructure, facilities, and workplace management activities.
* Ensure administrative processes are efficient, cost\-effective, and aligned with company policies.



  





 Vendor Management
 


* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors related to administrative and facility requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors for services including office facilities, housekeeping, security, transport, maintenance, supplies, and other administrative requirements.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure services are delivered as per agreed standards.
* Coordinate vendor contracts, renewals, invoices, and payment\-related documentation.
* Work closely with Finance and internal stakeholders for timely processing of vendor payments.
* Negotiate and manage vendor relationships to ensure quality service and cost efficiency.
* Maintain proper records of vendor agreements, invoices, and service\-related documentation.



  





 Facilities \& Office Management
 


* Ensure smooth functioning of office facilities and infrastructure.
* Coordinate maintenance and repair requirements with relevant vendors.
* Monitor office supplies and administrative inventory.
* Support workplace safety, security, and general office administration.
* Handle administrative escalations and ensure timely resolution of operational issues.



  





 Key Skills \& Competencies
 


* Strong knowledge of
 **HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle Management**
* Hands\-on experience in
 **Payroll Management**
* Experience working with
 **HRIS and HRMS platforms**
* Strong understanding of attendance and leave management systems
* Vendor and stakeholder management experience
* Good knowledge of HR documentation and operational processes
* Strong analytical and reporting skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong problem\-solving and coordination abilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in
 **Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field**
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant specialization will be preferred.



  





**Experience** 




**5\-8 years of relevant experience** 
 in:
 


* HR Operations
* Payroll Management
* HRIS/HRMS Administration
* Employee Lifecycle Management
* Administration and Facilities Management
* Vendor Management



  





 Experience in managing both
 **HR Operations and Administration** 
 will be highly preferred.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for a proactive HR Operations professional who can take ownership of critical HR systems and processes while also effectively managing administrative operations and external vendors.
 



  





 The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring smooth employee operations, accurate payroll and HR data management, efficient HRMS processes, and seamless day\-to\-day administrative support across the organization.

title: Global Learning & Talent Development Specialist (m/f/d)
company: Hellmann Worldwide Logistics SE & Co. KG
description:
**About Us**
============


Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.  

For the better. Together.

  


Are you ready to take the next step in your career? As a Global Talent and Organization Development Senior (m/f/d) at Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, you will play a key role in shaping our global HR landscape. This position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting HR transformation journey—where you take ownership, drive innovation, and collaborate with a team of passionate professionals. **About the job**


Learning strategy and capability building

* Develop and deliver a global learning and capability\-building strategy aligned with business priorities and our people strategy.
* Run learning needs analyses and identify capability gaps across functions, regions and talent groups.
* Build capability frameworks and learning roadmaps that support organizational growth and transformation.
* Translate business requirements into practical, sustainable learning solutions.


Learning design and development

* Design, develop and continuously improve learning solutions for classroom, virtual, hybrid and self\-paced digital formats.
* Create facilitator guides, participant materials, toolkits, assessments, videos, e\-learning modules and blended programs.
* Apply modern instructional design methods and adult learning principles to keep learning engaging and effective.
* Keep content scalable, learner\-centered and globally relevant, while allowing for local adaptation.


Talent and leadership development

* Design and manage global talent and leadership development programs, including offers for emerging leaders, high potentials and critical talent groups.
* Build career development pathways and learning journeys that support career growth and internal mobility.
* Partner with stakeholders on succession\-related development and targeted capability building.
* Support onboarding, upskilling and reskilling as part of an integrated talent approach.


Organizational development

* Contribute to organizational development work such as capability modeling, role architecture and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the design of career frameworks and organizational capability assessments.
* Bring a learning lens to change and transformation initiatives.


Learning technology and measurement

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
* Manage learning content deployment, learner experience, reporting and analytics.
* Measure learning effectiveness through data, feedback and business impact, and act on what you find.
* Track external trends and emerging technologies to keep our learning ecosystem current.

**About you**


Must\-have

* At least five years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design or a related field.
* Experience designing and delivering global learning and talent programs in a multinational organization.
* A track record of building learning solutions across classroom, virtual, hybrid and digital channels.
* Experience designing leadership development or talent acceleration programs.
* Experience building learning journeys, development pathways or career frameworks.
* Experience working with a learning management system.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design methods, for example ADDIE, SAM, design thinking or learning experience design, and a solid grounding in adult learning theory.
* A degree in HR, organizational psychology, education, learning sciences, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, and a global, intercultural mindset.
* The ability to balance strategic work with hands\-on execution.


Nice\-to\-have

* Certification in instructional design, learning experience design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching or leadership development.
* Familiarity with learning analytics and evaluation frameworks such as Kirkpatrick.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning solutions and adaptive learning platforms.
* Experience developing large\-scale global leadership academies or enterprise reskilling initiatives.
* Knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning or change management methodologies.
* Familiarity with skills\-based talent management and career architecture frameworks.
* Additional language skills beyond English.

**How you work**


We are looking for someone whose way of working reflects our values:

* Caring. You build trusted relationships, listen well and keep learners and colleagues at the center of what you design.
* Entrepreneurial. You take ownership, show initiative and stay focused on the impact your work has on the business.
* Forward\-Thinking. You bring curiosity and a digital mindset, and you keep improving how we learn and develop.
* Reliable. You deliver quality work on time, follow through on commitments and measure whether it worked.


Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!


If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY!

description:

 We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award\-winning success.
   

  

* Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy

* Obtain 360\-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early\-stage to seasoned leader


**About The Role**
 A Payroll Specialist\&Compliance is responsible for supporting the end‑to‑end payroll process for the assigned country, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery for internal clients. The role includes managing all payroll‑related activities, executing regular payroll cycles, administering employee benefits, along with a strong understanding of local regulations is essential, and candidates should be able to propose adjustments to ensure alignment with state and federal laws.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of Indian labor laws and applicable state and federal employment regulations.
* Review and evaluate company policies to ensure compliance, recommending changes to meet legal requirements.
* Ensure records are maintained in line with local regulations and data privacy standards.
* Assist with internal and external audits, including those conducted by clients and labor authorities
* Coordinate with the payroll vendor and finance team each month to finalize payroll timelines, ensuring timely execution and minimizing errors for a smooth payroll process.
* Ensure payroll inputs are accurately consolidated from all data sources—including emails, payroll portals, Workday, and payroll partners—and validate these inputs in alignment with payroll policies and defined processes.
* Respond to complex queries and escalations received from employees, HR, authorities, or other departments
* Responsible for executing monthly and ad‑hoc payroll control reports related to benefits‑in‑kind to ensure tax and payroll compliance.
* Create and maintain internal documentation for audit.
* Execute internal monthly payroll control reports and investigate payroll issues using problem solving technics
* Initiate process improvements and bring new ideas to increase efficiency and quality of provided service
* Responds to payroll queries from the finance team and manages finance‑related payroll audits.


**What You Need**
* University or College degree, preferably in Business Administration
* Minimum 1\-3 Years of experience in India Payroll and Compliance role or related field.
* Should have handle employee grievances related to social security matters (PF) and collaborate with Rewards and Procurement to ensure compliance with wage and employment regulations for both direct and third\-party employees.
* Maintains strong working knowledge of labor laws, best practices, and current trends and developments in the field.
* India payroll processing experience and Time management experience
* Proficiency in English communication
* Proficient level knowledge of Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel
* Workday knowledge
* Showing ability to work with confidential information
* Being able to work with priorities and deadlines
* Project management experience
* Basic Payroll accounting knowledge


**Bonus Points if You Have**
* Master’s or University/College degree in HR/Payroll field
* APAC payroll experience
* Maintain records in accordance with local regulations and data privacy policies.
* Support internal and external audits, including those by clients and labor authorities.
* Experience with Shared Service Center environment
* Service Now knowledge (ticketing system)
* Employee Customer Service experience


**What Makes You Eligible**
* Be willing to work from Bangalore office
* Full\-time employment
* Be willing to travel max 10%


**What We Offer**
* Access to employee discounts on world\-class products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, and more)
* Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University
* Competitive wellness benefits
* “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program.
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development


**You Belong Here**
 HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
   

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
 Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
   

  

 Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
   

  

 If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

title: Deputy General Manager- HR
description:
1 JOB DESCRIPTION Designation: Deputy General Manager Human Resources, IR & Admin Grade: L6 Function: Human Resources Reporting To: GM Operation & HR Business Coverage: JAPL | JSPL | JMPL Role Scope: Group-wide HR leadership across all three business verticals and manufacturing operations Location: Bangalore Team: Business/Plant HR teams and HR support functions 1. Role Purpose To lead and institutionalize the people, organization and workforce agenda across JAPL, JSPL and JMPL, partnering closely with the GM Operation& HR, Business/Plant Heads and functional leadership. The role will be accountable for building a scalable, productive, performance-driven and future-ready organization by strengthening organization design, manpower productivity, talent acquisition, performance management, capability building, succession, employee relations, HR governance and people analytics. The DGM – HR is expected to operate as a business HR leader, moving HR from predominantly transactional support to a function that measurably contributes to business growth, productivity, leadership capability and organizational effectiveness. 2. Key Accountabilities A. Strategic HR Business Partnership Partner with the GM Operation & HR and business leadership to translate business plans into people, organization and capability priorities. Develop annual and 3-year HR plans for JAPL, JSPL and JMPL aligned with growth, capacity, productivity and organizational requirements. Advise leadership on organization structure, manpower, capability, performance, talent and people risks. Build a consistent HR operating model across the three businesses while allowing appropriate business-specific flexibility. Participate in business reviews and ensure people-related actions have clear ownership and closure. B. Organization Design & Manpower Productivity Drive organization structure reviews across businesses/functions. Establish approved manpower norms and budgets linked to production volume, capacity and business plans. 2 Review spans, layers, role clarity and reporting relationships. Drive workforce optimization without compromising safety, quality or delivery. Track manpower productivity, overtime, absenteeism, contract labour utilization and employee cost. Establish clear role charters and accountability across critical positions. Key outcome: Right structure Right manpower Right capability Right cost. C. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Pipeline Own workforce planning and recruitment governance across JAPL, JSPL and JMPL. Ensure timely closure of leadership, managerial, technical and critical shop-floor positions. Build sustainable pipelines through ITI/Diploma institutions, engineering colleges, apprenticeships, trainees, referrals and specialist hiring channels. Strengthen selection quality, onboarding and early-tenure retention. Build succession-oriented internal hiring and career mobility before external recruitment. D. Performance & Accountability Culture Institutionalize a robust Performance Management System across businesses. Ensure goals cascade from: Business Function Department Individual. Strengthen measurable KRAs/KPIs and differentiate performance objectively. Facilitate performance reviews, calibration and consequence management. Link performance with business outcomes such as productivity, quality, delivery, cost, projects, capability and people development. Build stronger managerial accountability for team performance. E. Talent Management, Succession & Leadership Pipeline Identify critical roles and critical talent across all three businesses. Establish succession coverage for key leadership and specialist positions. Conduct structured talent reviews and identify HiPos. Establish Ready Now / Ready in 1–2 Years / Longer-term succession categories. Drive Individual Development Plans for critical talent. Strengthen internal mobility and cross-functional/business exposure. Reduce dependency on individual incumbents and external hiring for key positions. F. Learning, Capability & Skill Architecture Build capability architecture covering operators, technicians, engineers, managers and leadership levels. Establish functional/technical competency matrices. Drive multi-skilling and skill certification for shop-floor workforce. Build structured development journeys for supervisors and managers. 3 Use the 70:20:10 development philosophy for identified leadership talent. Measure training through capability improvement and business impact rather than training hours alone. G. Industrial / Employee Relations & Workforce Governance Maintain a stable, disciplined and productive employee-relations environment across the businesses. Establish robust grievance and disciplinary processes. Ensure appropriate handling of domestic enquiries and employee-relations matters. Govern permanent, trainee, apprentice and contract workforce practices. Partner with operations leadership to proactively address workforce risks. Strengthen employee communication and shop-floor connect mechanisms. H. Statutory Compliance & HR Governance Ensure compliance with applicable labour and employment legislation and factory-related people requirements. Establish compliance calendars and periodic audits across JAPL, JSPL and JMPL. Govern contractor compliance and documentation. Ensure timely closure of audit observations and statutory deviations. Coordinate with legal counsel and government/labour authorities where required. Maintain zero tolerance for material people-related statutory non-compliance. I. Employee Engagement, Culture & Change Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, performance and continuous improvement. Strengthen communication between leadership, managers and employees. Drive structured employee-engagement interventions based on data and business needs. Support organizational transformation, restructuring, digitalization and new ways of working. Build change readiness among managers and employees. Actively identify and address behaviours that impede organizational change. J. HR Operations, Systems & Analytics Standardize critical HR processes across the three businesses. Drive HRMS/digital adoption and improve employee/manager self-service. Establish a monthly HR Business Dashboard for the GM Operation& HR Use workforce analytics for decision-making rather than retrospective reporting. Ensure employee master data, attendance, payroll inputs, lifecycle transactions and documentation are accurate and controlled. 4 3. Key Performance Indicators Dimension Illustrative KPI Manpower Actual manpower vs approved manpower/budget Productivity Revenue/value-add/output per employee Employee Cost Employee cost vs budget / revenue Recruitment Critical vacancy closure TAT Attrition Regrettable/critical talent attrition Attendance Absenteeism & overtime Capability Critical skill coverage / multi-skilling Performance PMS completion & quality of goal setting Succession % critical roles with identified successors Talent HiPo/critical talent retention & development Engagement Engagement/change-readiness improvement IR Lost man-days / significant grievances / disputes Compliance Statutory compliance & audit closure HR Operations HRMS/data/process accuracy Leadership Internal fill rate for critical managerial roles 4. Decision Rights Recommend organization structures and manpower plans to the COO. Challenge manpower additions not supported by productivity/business justification. Approve routine HR decisions within delegated authority. Drive HR policy and process implementation across JAPL, JSPL and JMPL. Intervene in significant performance, discipline, talent and employee-relations matters. Recommend promotions, succession moves, critical hiring and organization changes. Escalate material, people, IR, compliance and leadership risks directly to the COO. 5 5. Key Interfaces Internal: GM Operation & HR | Business/Vertical Heads | Plant Heads | Functional Heads | Finance | Operations | Quality | SCM | PPC | Engineering | EHS | L5/L5+ Managers | Plant/Business HR teams External: Recruitment partners | Training/coaching partners | Educational institutions | Apprenticeship/skill ecosystem | Labour/legal consultants | Government/statutory authorities | Contractors/service providers 6. Candidate Profile Education Essential: Full-time MBA/PGDM/MSW in Human Resources / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations from a recognized institution. Preferred: Additional qualification/exposure in Labour Laws, Organization Development, HR Analytics or related areas. Experience 15–20 years of progressive HR experience, preferably with substantial exposure to engineering/manufacturing organizations. The candidate should ideally have: 1. Multi-plant / multi-business HR exposure. 2. Strong manufacturing HR experience. 3. Experience partnering directly with senior Operations/Business leadership. 4. Hands-on manpower planning and workforce productivity experience. 5. Strong talent management, PMS and succession exposure. 6. Plant HR/ER/IR and statutory compliance experience. 7. Experience leading HR teams across multiple locations/businesses. 8. Exposure to organizational transformation, growth or scale-up environments. 7. Leadership Competencies The candidate should demonstrate: Business Acumen – understands manufacturing economics and connects HR decisions with productivity, cost and business performance. 6 Strategic Thinking – anticipates organization and capability requirements rather than responding only to immediate vacancies/problems. Execution Excellence – converts HR strategy into disciplined execution across three businesses. Influencing Capability – can challenge and influence senior operational leaders constructively. People Judgement – strong ability to assess talent, performance and potential. Change Leadership – able to drive behavioural, structural and process change. Data Orientation – uses workforce data and analytics for decisions. Courage & Integrity – willing to take evidence-based positions on manpower, performance, talent, discipline and compliance. Developing Others – builds HR capability as well as leadership capability across the businesses.

title: Director Human Resources
description:
HR Director, India & Global Capability Centre Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
 Department: People and Talent
 Reports to: Chief People Officer (UK based)
 Direct Reports: HR Manager and wider HR team of professionals Role Overview We are seeking an experienced HR Director to provide strategic and operational leadership for our Bangalore office and Global Capability Centre. This is a senior leadership role responsible for building and leading the India people function, with the HR Manager reporting into this post and a wider HR team of four professionals supporting delivery across recruitment, HR operations, compliance, payroll governance, employee relations, engagement and people experience. The HR Director will partner closely with the UK-based Chief People Officer to develop a more strategic and globally consistent people agenda. The role will translate global people priorities into the local India context, ensuring the Bangalore GCC can scale effectively while supporting the companys ambition to grow from a UK-headquartered start-up into a global business. Key Responsibilities 1. HR Leadership, Team Management & Functional Strategy Lead the India People function as the senior HR leader for the Bangalore GCC, setting the direction, priorities and operating rhythm for the local HR team. Line manage the HR Manager, ensuring they are developed beyond operational delivery into a more strategic HR leadership role. Oversee a wider HR team of four professionals, ensuring effective delivery across talent acquisition, HR operations, compliance, employee relations, payroll governance, reporting and employee experience. Build capability within the HR team through coaching, mentoring, clear accountability, succession planning and exposure to strategic people projects. Ensure the HR function operates as a proactive, commercially minded and trusted partner to employees, managers, India leadership and the UK head office. 2. India HR Governance, Operations & Compliance Ensure full compliance with Indian labour laws and statutory regulations including: Shops & Establishments Act (Karnataka) Payment of Wages Act Minimum Wages Act Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) Employees’ State Insurance (ESI) Payment of Bonus Act Payment of Gratuity Act Maternity Benefit Act Equal Remuneration Act POSH Act (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) Maintain statutory registers, filings, and documentation. Coordinate with legal advisors and external consultants where required. Lead internal audits and prepare for labour inspections. Oversee employment contracts and policy documentation aligned with Indian legal standards. Provide senior oversight of India HR risk, ensuring local statutory requirements are met while maintaining alignment with UK head office governance standards. 3. Talent Strategy, Workforce Planning & GCC Growth Own the India talent strategy for the Bangalore GCC, ensuring hiring plans support current delivery requirements and future global growth. Partner with India leadership and the UK CPO to translate business strategy into workforce plans, organisational design and capability priorities. Ensure compliant, competitive and scalable recruitment processes, offer governance and employment documentation for the Indian market. Strengthen employer brand and talent attraction in Bangalore, positioning the company as an ambitious UK-headquartered global business. Support the set-up and growth of the Bangalore operation, ensuring hiring activity is compliant with healthcare, technology and local market requirements. Develop scalable workforce planning approaches that balance start-up pace, cost discipline, quality of talent, compliance and long-term global capability building. 4. Reward, Payroll & Compensation Governance Oversee payroll processing in compliance with Indian statutory requirements. Ensure timely EPF, ESI, TDS, and professional tax deductions and filings. Administer gratuity, bonus calculations, and leave encashments. Support CTC structuring aligned with Indian taxation norms. Work with the UK CPO to develop reward principles that are locally competitive in India while supporting the company’s broader global reward philosophy. 5. Employee Relations, Culture & Performance Provide senior oversight and escalation for complex employee relations matters, ensuring issues are resolved fairly, consistently and in line with Indian labour law. Lead the development of a high-performance culture across the Bangalore GCC, aligned to company values, UK head office expectations and the realities of the local India workplace. Embed performance management practices that build manager capability, support accountability and enable growth across a scaling organisation. Champion employee engagement, inclusion, wellbeing and retention strategies that are meaningful in the Indian talent market and consistent with the company’s global people agenda. 6. Global People Agenda, Policy & Governance Partner with the UK-based Chief People Officer to develop a globally consistent people agenda that supports the company’s growth ambitions while remaining adaptable to local employment contexts. Translate UK head office people strategy, values, governance and cultural expectations into practical India policies, processes and manager guidance. Ensure all India policies comply with Karnataka and central labour regulations, including statutory training and POSH governance requirements. Build policy and governance frameworks that can scale beyond India and support the company’s transition from start-up to global organisation. 7. Leadership Capability, Learning & Organisation Development Identify capability gaps across the Bangalore GCC and develop learning priorities that support business growth, manager effectiveness and future global scale. Support India leadership development, ensuring managers build the skills required to lead in a start-up, GCC and globally connected environment. Facilitate required statutory and conduct training, including POSH, Code of Conduct and other India-specific compliance requirements. Work with the UK CPO to develop consistent global leadership expectations, behaviours and people management standards. 8. People Analytics, Reporting & Strategic Insight Ensure HR systems, employee records and reporting processes are accurate, secure, compliant and fit for a growing global business. Develop people dashboards and leadership reporting covering hiring, attrition, engagement, performance, diversity, compliance, capability and organisational risk. Use data and insight to advise the UK CPO and India leadership on strategic people decisions, workforce investment and operational priorities. Establish reporting disciplines that provide visibility across the India GCC and can evolve into a global people reporting framework. 9. Strategic HR Leadership in a Start-Up, GCC and Global Growth Environment Partner with the UK-based Chief People Officer to shape and execute a global people strategy that supports international growth, operational scale and cultural alignment. Act as the senior India people leader, ensuring the Bangalore GCC is integrated into the wider business while remaining responsive to Indian employment law, culture, talent expectations and market dynamics. Create scalable HR processes, governance frameworks and leadership practices suitable for a start-up moving from founder-led ways of working to a structured global operating model. Advise senior leaders on organisation design, capability building, workforce planning, culture, engagement, change management and people risk as the business expands globally. Demonstrate the judgement, pace and resilience required to lead through ambiguity, build from first principles and create structure without slowing down commercial momentum. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field. MBA / PGDM in HR preferred. 10–15+ years of progressive HR experience, including senior HR leadership experience in India. Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance. Experience handling payroll and compliance for Karnataka-based employees. Experience operating as a strategic HR leader in a high-growth organisation where people foundations, governance and leadership capability are being built alongside rapid delivery. Proven experience leading HR managers and multi-disciplinary HR teams, with the ability to develop operational HR leaders into strategic business partners. Experience partnering with overseas head office stakeholders, ideally in a UK-headquartered business, GCC, captive centre, multinational, start-up or scale-up environment. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Indian employment legislation. Excellent stakeholder management skills. High attention to compliance and documentation detail. Strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Confidentiality and integrity. Ability to shape strategy, influence senior leaders and translate global people priorities into practical local execution. Strong commercial judgement, cultural awareness and change leadership capability, with the confidence to operate in ambiguity and build scalable global people practices. Preferred Experience Experience in IT, technology, product, or multinational environments. Previous experience building HR infrastructure in a start-up, scale-up or newly established Global Capability Centre. Experience leading HR for a growing employee base, ideally within India, a start-up, scale-up, GCC or globalising organisation. Experience contributing to global people strategy, operating model design or international HR integration would be advantageous. Exposure to labour law transitions under the new Labour Codes (if implemented). Experience managing third-party payroll vendors. What Success Looks Like 100% statutory compliance with no penalties. Structured, legally robust and scalable HR processes that support both day-to-day operations and future growth. Strong employee engagement, effective manager support and healthy retention across the Bangalore GCC. Clean, accurate documentation and audit-ready systems across employee records, statutory compliance and HR governance. A high-performing HR function, led through the HR Manager and wider team of four professionals, delivering both operational excellence and strategic people outcomes. The India people strategy, governance and culture are aligned with the UK head office while effectively supporting the Bangalore GCC, local talent market and the company’s global growth agenda. The HR Director is viewed as a trusted strategic partner by the UK CPO, India leadership team, employees and external partners, with clear influence on global people priorities.

title: Relationship Manager - B2B
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Acquire and manage corporate, institutional, and facility-level contracts. This is a field-heavy, relationship-driven role you will be out meeting decision-makers, walking sites, and servicing accounts in person across NCR. Contract value is high and margins are thin, so accuracy in scoping and SLA discipline matter more than volume. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Corporate Acquisition & Prospecting Build and work a territory-mapped prospect list across societies, offices, hubs, and hospitals in your assigned NCR zones. Drive pipeline through cold outreach, in-person meetings, and referrals. Own the full cycle from first meeting to signed contract. 2. Site Survey & Scope Definition Visit the client site before quoting. Assess manpower requirement, task volume, coverage hours, and operational complexity. Under-scoped contracts destroy margin an accurate on-ground survey is the first line of defence. 3. Commercial Negotiation & Contracting Prepare and present proposals with correct pricing; negotiate rate cards, SLAs, payment terms, and contract duration. Coordinate with the Business Head for approval on any deal below the defined margin floor. Never sign below the approved margin threshold without escalation. 4. Documentation & Compliance Own the paperwork end-to-end proposals, work orders, agreements, MSAs, vendor registration, GST and statutory documentation, and client-side compliance formalities. B2B clients often have long vendor-onboarding processes; drive these to closure rather than waiting on the client. 5. SLA Management & Service Delivery Oversight Coordinate with the Operation Manager and Operations Executives to ensure contracted SLAs are met. Conduct periodic on-site service audits at every managed account. Document performance against SLA this record is the basis for the compliance premium we charge and for renewal negotiations. 6. Account Management & Renewals Maintain regular in-person contact with every active account; conduct quarterly business reviews. Identify expansion opportunities within the account additional sites, additional service lines. Own renewal well before expiry; a contract renewed late is a contract at risk. 7. Collections Support Track invoicing and follow up on receivables with the client. B2B payment cycles are long active follow-up is part of the role, not an afterthought. 8. Reporting & CRM Log every visit, meeting, and commitment in the CRM the same day, with visit photographs and notes where required for audit trail. Submit weekly pipeline and account-health reports to the Business Head. 
 Requirements 2 to 5 years in B2B, institutional, or corporate sales preferably facility management, staffing, logistics, or business services. Must own a two-wheeler or four-wheeler with a valid driving licence and be willing to travel daily across NCR. Thorough familiarity with NCR geography Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, and Ghaziabad. Strong documentation and proposal-writing ability; comfortable with contracts and compliance paperwork. Confident dealing with facility heads, admin heads, RWA committees, and hospital administrators. Graduate; MBA preferred but not mandatory. 
 Good to Have Existing relationships with RWAs, facility management companies, or hospital administration in NCR. Experience managing SLA-based service contracts. Understanding of GST, vendor onboarding, and tender / RFP processes. 
 Field Coverage Non-Negotiable This role requires travel and on-ground presence across the entire NCR region (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, and surrounding areas), including: 
 Residential societies and RWAs society management committees, facility offices, AOA/RWA bodies. Corporate offices and business parks admin heads, facility managers, HR and procurement teams. Commercial hubs and marketplaces cluster acquisition and multi-tenant contracts. Hospitals and healthcare institutions administration, patient services, documentation desks. Hotels, co-living spaces, and institutional campuses. Government and semi-government offices where documentation services apply. Any other client location within NCR as directed by the Operation Manager or Business Head. 
 Field visits are required for prospecting, site surveys, contract negotiation, service audits, escalation handling, and periodic relationship reviews. Candidates unwilling or unable to travel across NCR should not apply. 
 Salary & Perks Fixed + incentive on contract value and gross margin. Travel reimbursement as per company policy. Paid holidays as per company policy. Opportunity for growth. Supportive work environment.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for supporting end-to-end recruitment, HR operations, employee engagement, onboarding, employee records, and day-to-day HR activities .The candidate should have strong communication and coordination skills, a positive attitude, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple HR activities simultaneously in a fast-paced IT environment.

HR OPERATIONS Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR documentation . Manage employee onboarding and exit formalities. Coordinate employee attendance and leave-related activities. Maintain and update employee information in Keka HRMS . Handle day-to-day employee queries and provide appropriate HR support. Support employee confirmation and appraisal processes. Maintain HR policies, processes, forms, and related documentation. Ensure proper documentation and record-keeping for HR activities. Support the HR Manager in implementing and improving HR processes. Coordinate with employees and internal departments for various HR requirements. Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR-related documents. 3. ONBOARDING & EXIT MANAGEMENT Coordinate the complete employee onboarding process. Ensure timely completion of joining documentation and required formalities. Coordinate with IT/Admin teams for system, workstation, access, and other joining requirements. Conduct or coordinate HR induction for new employees. Ensure new employees are introduced to company policies, processes, and culture. Coordinate employee exit formalities, documentation, and clearance processes. Conduct exit discussions/interviews where required. Maintain accurate onboarding and exit records. 4. EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT & CULTURE Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities throughout the year. Organize Fun Fridays, team-building activities, games, celebrations, and employee activities . Plan and coordinate Employee of the Month (EOM) activities and recognition programs. Coordinate employee birthday celebrations and special occasions. Plan and decorate the office for festivals and celebrations. Coordinate annual events, picnics, outings, celebrations, and other employee programs. Collect employee feedback and identify opportunities to improve employee experience. Suggest and implement new engagement initiatives based on employee feedback. Work closely with employees to promote a positive and collaborative workplace culture. 5. EVENT & VENDOR COORDINATION Coordinate with external vendors for HR and employee engagement activities. Manage vendors for food, gifts, decorations, event arrangements, venues, and other requirements . Obtain quotations and coordinate with vendors as required. Ensure events and activities are executed smoothly and within approved budgets. Coordinate logistics and arrangements for company events and celebrations. Maintain records of vendors, quotations, bills, and event-related expenses. 6. HR REPORTING & DOCUMENTATION Maintain accurate HR trackers and reports. Prepare recruitment and employee-related reports as required. Maintain employee databases and HR documentation. Track recruitment status, joining status, attrition, attendance, and other HR metrics. Experience working with HRMS/ATS systems; knowledge of Keka is preferred. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Strong coordination and follow-up skills. Good organizational and time-management abilities. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. Proactive, approachable, and positive attitude. Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee and company information. 
 KEY COMPETENCIES Recruitment & Talent Acquisition HR Operations Employee Relations Employee Engagement Communication Skills Stakeholder Coordination Vendor Management Event Management Problem Solving Time Management Documentation & Reporting Team Collaboration

 About LLM Axis 
 LLM Axis Private Limited is an AI education and workforce development company focused on helping international students and working professionals become AI-ready for the evolving global job market. We are building one of India's fastest-growing AI upskilling brands through practical learning, mentorship, industry-aligned curriculum, and outcome-driven training. 
 As we scale our sales operations, we're looking for a Talent Acquisition professional who can help us identify, attract, and hire high-performing EdTech sales talent. 
 Role Overview 
 As a Human Resource Generalist at LLM Axis , you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, with a primary focus on hiring Sales and Business Development professionals. 
 We are specifically looking for someone who understands the dynamics of EdTech hiring and can independently source, screen and close candidates. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the end-to-end recruitment cycle from sourcing to candidate joining. Primarily hire for Business Development, Inside Sales and other revenue-focused roles. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna, referrals and other relevant platforms. Conduct initial screening calls and evaluate candidates based on communication, sales experience, stability, compensation and role fit. Schedule and coordinate interviews with founders and respective hiring managers. Manage salary discussions, offer rollouts, documentation and joining coordination. Follow up actively with offered candidates to minimize offer dropouts and no-shows. Build and maintain an active pipeline of qualified sales candidates for upcoming requirements. Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and candidate databases. Track key recruitment metrics including sourcing volume, interviews, selections, offers and joining ratios. Support hiring for other business functions as the company expands. Contribute to employer branding and job postings across recruitment platforms and social channels. Manage the team and take care of the leave approvals This role includes tasks which are not mentioned above but required as per the business needs, considering as a HR Generalist role. 
 Candidate Requirements 
 1 to 2 years of hands-on recruitment / Talent Acquisition experience. Prior experience hiring EdTech Sales / BDA / BDE / Inside Sales professionals is MANDATORY . Good understanding of the EdTech sales talent market. Strong sourcing experience using platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed and Apna. Ability to independently conduct initial HR and candidate screening. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good negotiation and candidate-closing abilities. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with hiring targets. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets and recruitment trackers or ATS platforms. Candidates with an existing network of EdTech sales professionals will have an advantage. 
 What We're Looking For 
 We want someone who thinks beyond simply scheduling interviews. The ideal candidate should be able to understand what makes a good EdTech salesperson & other functions too , identify the right candidates quickly and take ownership of converting qualified candidates into successful joiners. 
 This role is suitable for someone who wants significant ownership of Talent Acquisition while growing along with LLM Axis. 
 Why Join LLM Axis? 
 Build teams in one of the fastest-growing sectors Artificial Intelligence. Take ownership of recruitment for a rapidly growing AI education company. Work closely with the founders and leadership team. Opportunity to build and shape the company's recruitment processes from an early stage. Performance-linked earning opportunities. High ownership and rapid career growth. Startup culture with fast decision-making and real responsibility. 
 Working Hours 
 Full-time, On-site (Bengaluru) Flexible working hours with an output-based culture. Availability during business hours is expected for candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination and follow-ups. 
 How to Apply

Coordinate with payroll vendors, Finance, and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate salary processing. Address employee queries related to salary, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll.  HR Operations & Process Improvement Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR operational processes and SOPs. Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency. Ensure timely completion of HR operational activities and adherence to defined timelines. Support HR audits and provide necessary documentation and reports. description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Description HR & Payroll Manager Position: HR & Payroll Manager
 Industry: Construction / Contracting / Waterproofing
 Department: Human Resources & Administration
 Location: Mumbai / Site & Head Office
 Reporting To: Director / Management Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and responsible HR & Payroll Manager to manage end-to-end human resource functions and payroll operations for our construction contracting business. The role will be responsible for managing office and site manpower, attendance, payroll, recruitment, employee records, labour compliance, statutory deductions, and employee-related administration . The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of construction-site manpower management, labour laws, payroll processing, PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, Bonus, Gratuity, and other applicable statutory compliances . Key Responsibilities 1. HR & Manpower Management Manage the complete employee lifecycle from recruitment to separation . Maintain employee master data, personnel files, joining documents and KYC records. Coordinate recruitment of site engineers, supervisors, skilled workers, helpers, operators, and office staff . Plan manpower requirements in coordination with Project Managers and Site Engineers. Coordinate deployment and transfer of manpower between different project sites. Maintain records of employee attendance, leave, overtime and absenteeism. Develop and maintain company HR policies, procedures and employee guidelines. Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace issues. 2. Payroll Management Manage monthly payroll processing for office and site employees. Verify attendance, overtime, leave and wage inputs before payroll processing. Prepare salary sheets, wage sheets, payslips and bank payment statements. Calculate deductions such as PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS, advances, loans and other recoveries . Ensure timely processing of monthly salaries and wages. Maintain payroll records and employee salary history. Coordinate with the Accounts Department for salary disbursement and accounting entries. Reconcile payroll data with attendance and bank payment records. 3. Labour & Statutory Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements . Manage monthly compliance relating to: Provident Fund (PF) ESIC Professional Tax (PT) Labour Welfare Fund (where applicable) TDS on salaries Bonus Gratuity Minimum wages Payment of wages Working hours and overtime Leave and other applicable labour requirements Maintain statutory registers and records. Coordinate with consultants, government authorities and statutory agencies whenever required. Ensure timely filing of returns and payment of statutory dues. Monitor changes in applicable labour regulations and advise management accordingly. 4. Construction Site HR Management Maintain proper manpower records for all active project sites. Coordinate site attendance and biometric/manual muster records . Verify daily manpower deployment and prepare monthly attendance statements. Coordinate worker onboarding, induction and documentation before deployment. Ensure workers have required identification and statutory documentation. Coordinate with site teams regarding labour availability and productivity. Monitor overtime and additional manpower requirements. Maintain records of skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled workers. Support site management in resolving worker-related issues. 5. Subcontractor & Labour Contractor Management Maintain records of manpower deployed through labour contractors/subcontractors. Verify contractor labour attendance and wage records. Ensure labour contractors comply with applicable statutory requirements. Collect and verify PF, ESIC, wage registers, challans, attendance and other compliance documents from contractors. Coordinate with Accounts for processing subcontractor/labour contractor bills after compliance verification. Monitor manpower deployment against contractual requirements. 6. Recruitment & Employee Onboarding Prepare job descriptions and coordinate recruitment activities. Source candidates through job portals, consultants, references and other channels. Conduct initial screening and coordinate interviews. Prepare offer letters, appointment letters and joining documentation. Conduct employee induction and orientation. Ensure all required documents are collected and properly maintained. 7. Exit & Full & Final Settlement Manage resignation, termination and employee separation processes. Conduct exit interviews where required. Prepare full & final settlement calculations. Coordinate settlement of salary, leave encashment, advances, deductions and other dues. Ensure timely issuance of relieving and experience letters. 8. HR MIS & Reporting Prepare and maintain regular HR reports, including: Employee headcount Site-wise manpower Attendance and absenteeism Overtime Salary and wage summary New joiners Resignations and attrition Labour contractor manpower PF/ESIC compliance Leave records Manpower cost Project-wise manpower cost

description:

 Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. **About The Job**
* Design and build engaging eLearning modules for a range of learning and development initiatives, from onboarding and compliance to leadership and functional skills.

* Apply instructional design principles to turn complex topics into clear, structured, learner\-friendly experiences.
* Administer and maintain our learning management system (LMS365\): manage courses and catalogues, user accounts and permissions, enrolments, learning paths, and certificates.

 Must\-have

* Solid grounding in instructional design and structuring content for adult learners.

* Professional written and spoken English, since you will work with colleagues across regions.

* Knowledge of accessibility standards (such as WCAG) and SCORM or xAPI publishing.
* Exposure to a global or multi\-site organization.

* Workday upskilling content is live, widely used, and kept current.
* LMS365 runs smoothly: content, users, and enrollments are well organized, and issues are resolved quickly.
* Stakeholders and learners get fast, reliable support and see this person as their go\-to for anything learning related.
* Reporting on completion and compliance is accurate, regular, and trusted by the teams that rely on it.
* Content is clear, accessible, on brand, and rarely needs rework after release.
* A more structured, repeatable way of building content and running the platform is in place.
* Learning content is rolled out smoothly and consistently across the relevant regions and teams.
* The person owns both their content projects and platform administration end to end.
