title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
**Job Description – Chief Financial Officer (CFO)**

**Organization:** VITS Kamats Hospitality Group  
**Location:** Corporate Office – Mumbai

**Role Overview**

VITS Kamats Hospitality Group is looking for an experienced, strategic, and result\-oriented **Chief Financial Officer (CFO)** to lead the organization’s overall financial strategy, governance, financial planning, risk management, and business performance.

The CFO will be responsible for driving **financial sustainability, profitability, cash flow optimization, compliance, and strategic decision\-making** across the corporate office and multiple hotel units.

The role will work closely with the **Managing Director, Promoters, Senior Management, Operations, Projects, HR, Legal, Purchase, and other business functions** to support business growth, expansion, new hotel projects, and long\-term organizational objectives.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Financial Strategy \& Leadership**

* Develop and lead the organization’s overall financial strategy in alignment with business objectives
* Provide strategic financial insights and recommendations to the Promoters and Senior Management
* Drive long\-term financial planning, profitability, growth, and financial sustainability
* Evaluate business performance and identify opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost optimization
* Establish financial targets, KPIs, and performance benchmarks across business units
* Support management in evaluating strategic business decisions, investments, and expansion plans

**2\. Financial Planning, Budgeting \& Forecasting**

* Lead the annual budgeting and business planning process across corporate and hotel units
* Develop financial forecasts, business projections, and scenario\-based financial models
* Monitor actual performance against budgets and forecasts and recommend corrective actions
* Evaluate financial feasibility of new hotels, projects, leases, management contracts, and other business opportunities
* Develop financial models for expansion, capital expenditure, and new business initiatives
* Provide periodic financial performance reviews to Senior Management

**3\. Corporate Finance \& Financial Operations**

* Oversee the overall finance and accounting functions of the organization
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, MIS, P\&L, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and management reports
* Strengthen financial systems, processes, controls, and reporting structures across all units
* Ensure effective revenue accounting, credit control, collections, procurement controls, expense management, and inventory controls
* Ensure proper accounting practices and financial reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS
* Drive standardization of finance processes and reporting across all hotel properties

**4\. Cash Flow \& Working Capital Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of organizational cash flow and working capital management
* Develop and monitor short\-term and long\-term cash flow projections
* Optimize receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital cycles
* Monitor fund requirements across corporate and hotel units
* Establish appropriate controls over cash, banking, collections, and payments
* Maintain strong relationships with banks and financial institutions
* Evaluate and manage funding requirements for business operations and expansion

**5\. Banking, Funding \& Financial Institutions**

* Manage relationships with banks, financial institutions, lenders, and other financial stakeholders
* Evaluate and negotiate working capital facilities, loans, credit lines, and other financial arrangements
* Monitor interest costs, borrowing structures, repayment schedules, and financing arrangements
* Support the organization in raising funds for expansion and new projects where required
* Ensure timely submission of financial information and documentation to lenders and financial institutions
* Optimize the organization’s overall financing structure

**6\. Business Expansion \& Investment Evaluation**

* Provide financial leadership for new hotel projects, acquisitions, leases, management contracts, and strategic investments
* Conduct financial feasibility studies and ROI analysis for proposed projects
* Review project budgets, capital expenditure, operating projections, and funding requirements
* Assess financial risks and returns associated with new business opportunities
* Support Senior Management in investment and expansion decisions
* Monitor financial performance of new projects from development through stabilization

**7\. Compliance, Governance \& Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, Companies Act, and other applicable statutory requirements
* Ensure timely filing of statutory and regulatory returns
* Establish and strengthen financial governance and internal control systems
* Identify and mitigate financial, operational, tax, and business risks
* Ensure adherence to internal financial policies, SOPs, and delegated authority frameworks
* Maintain appropriate financial controls across corporate and hotel operations
* Work closely with legal and professional advisors on financial and regulatory matters

**8\. Audit \& Financial Controls**

* Oversee internal, statutory, tax, and other financial audits
* Coordinate with auditors and ensure timely closure of audit observations
* Strengthen internal audit mechanisms and financial control systems
* Ensure accuracy, transparency, and integrity of financial information
* Identify control gaps and implement appropriate corrective measures
* Establish effective risk management and fraud prevention controls

**9\. Hospitality Finance \& Property Performance**

* Monitor financial performance across all hotel properties and business units
* Review hotel\-level revenue, GOP, departmental profitability, operating costs, and key financial indicators
* Monitor food cost, beverage cost, manpower cost, room cost, utility expenses, and other operating expenses
* Drive cost optimization and profitability improvement initiatives across properties
* Review hotel budgets and monthly financial performance with Unit Heads and Operations
* Ensure implementation of financial SOPs and controls across all hotels
* Provide financial support for hotel pre\-openings and new property transitions

**10\. MIS, Analytics \& Management Reporting**

* Establish effective financial MIS and reporting systems for Senior Management
* Develop dashboards and reports covering revenue, profitability, cash flow, working capital, cost, and business performance
* Provide actionable financial insights to support management decision\-making
* Analyze business trends, variances, risks, and opportunities
* Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting across all business units

**11\. Team Leadership \& Organizational Development**

* Lead and mentor the corporate finance and accounts function
* Build a strong, accountable, and performance\-driven finance team
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, KPIs, and reporting structures
* Develop finance talent and succession plans across the organization
* Conduct periodic performance reviews of finance teams
* Promote a culture of financial discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement

**12\. Cross\-Functional \& Senior Management Coordination**

* Work closely with the Promoters, Managing Director, Senior Management, and Business Heads on financial matters
* Partner with Operations, HR, Legal, Purchase, Projects, Sales, and other functions to improve business performance
* Provide financial inputs for strategic and operational decisions
* Support management in negotiations involving vendors, landlords, lenders, business partners, and other stakeholders
* Ensure alignment between financial objectives and operational priorities

**Key Skills \& Competencies Required**

* Strong experience in **corporate finance and hospitality finance**
* Proven expertise in financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, and business planning
* Strong knowledge of cash flow and working capital management
* Excellent understanding of taxation, statutory compliance, audit, and financial governance
* Strong financial modelling and investment evaluation skills
* Experience in banking, funding, and financial institution management
* Strong understanding of hotel operations and property\-level financial performance
* Excellent analytical, commercial, and strategic decision\-making skills
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* Strong knowledge of ERP, Tally, hotel accounting systems, MS Excel, and financial reporting tools
* Ability to work effectively in a **multi\-unit, fast\-growing hospitality organization**

**Qualification \& Experience**

* **CA / MBA (Finance) / equivalent professional qualification** preferred
* Extensive experience in **Finance \& Accounts**, preferably within the hospitality, hotel, real estate, or service industry
* Proven experience in handling **multi\-unit / multi\-location financial operations**
* Experience in a senior finance leadership role with responsibility for strategic financial decision\-making
* Strong exposure to business expansion, project finance, budgeting, cash flow, compliance, and financial controls
* Candidates with experience in **hotel groups / hospitality chains / growing organizations** will be preferred

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Associate Consultant serves as the operational subject matter expert (SME) for the contingent workforce program within their designated location(s) and group(s). This role will support India professional contingent worker engagements for India Foods and GIC and will provide backup support for D\&T engagements. This role is responsible for the day\-to\-day management of program activities, ensuring the achievement of operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and maintaining high quality standards. The Associate Consultant will provide guidance to resource managers and vendors on program processes and contribute to data\-driven improvements in the contingent workforce program.  



**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* **Operational Management:**


	+ Oversee and manage all day\-to\-day operations of the contingent workforce program within the designated location(s) / group(s).
	+ Act as the primary point of contact for contingent workforce program\-related issues.
	+ Ensure compliance with local labor laws, regulations, and company policies related to contingent workers.
* **Performance Monitoring \& Achievement:**


	+ Develop and implement strategies to improve performance and address any identified gaps.
	+ Maintain high quality standards in all aspects of the contingent workforce program.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in a timely and effective manner.
* **Program Initiatives \& Improvement:**


	+ Identify areas for improvement within the contingent workforce program and propose solutions to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance.
	+ Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for contingent workforce management.
* **Stakeholder Management:**


	+ Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, including resource managers, HR business partners, and procurement teams.
	+ Provide guidance to resource managers on contingent workforce program processes and requirements.
	+ Collaborate with resource managers to understand their talent needs and ensure appropriate use of contingent workers.
* **Vendor Management:**


	+ Partner with vendors to facilitate sourcing of contingent staffing needs.
	+ Collaborate with vendors to ensure a thorough understanding of staffing requirements, enabling effective sourcing of qualified contingent workers and timely, efficient fulfillment.
	+ Verify vendor adherence to program policies
	+ Maintain vendor POC lists
* **Reporting \& Analysis:**


	+ Monitor program performance, including KPIs, SLAs, and cost savings.
	+ Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
	+ Present findings and recommendations to program leadership.
	+ Identify and report on cost savings opportunities within the contingent workforce program.
* **Compliance:**


	+ Ensure compliance with all applicable labor laws and regulations related to contingent workers in India.
	+ Ensure compliance with program requirements.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:**
* At least 3 years of experience in contingent workforce management, HR operations, or a related field.
* **Skills:**


	+ Strong understanding of contingent workforce management principles and best practices.
	+ Knowledge of local labor laws and regulations related to contingent workers in India.
	+ Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
	+ Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	+ Experience with Vendor Management Systems (VMS), specifically Workday VNDLY.
	+ Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	+ Strong organizational and time management skills.
* **Key Competencies:**


	+ Results\-Oriented: Demonstrates a strong focus on achieving results and meeting deadlines.
	+ Problem\-Solving: Identifies and resolves problems effectively and efficiently.
	+ Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively with all stakeholders.
	+ Teamwork: Works collaboratively with others to achieve common goals.
	+ Adaptability: Adapts to changing priorities and requirements.
	+ Continuous Improvement: Seeks opportunities to improve processes and performance.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

 Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.
   

  

 The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.
   

  

 Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Global People Services Associate acts as a support in a central hub for transactional HR activities. The Global People Services Associate provides efficient, consistent support to all employees and managers.
   

  

* Employee Support: Responding to HR\-related questions from employees and managers (benefits, policies, time\-off).
* Ticket Management: Act as the first point of contact for employee HR inquiries (benefits, payroll, leave, policies) via Freshservice, managing, prioritizing, and resolving tickets within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Data Management: Accurate data entry for new hires, terminations, promotions, transfers, and updating employee records in HRIS.
* Onboarding/Offboarding: Administering the hiring process, creating offers, tracking probation, and processing leavers.
* Payroll \& Benefits: Assisting with basic payroll processing, managing benefit enrollments, and pension administration.
* Process Adherence: Following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure consistency.


**Qualifications**
 University Degree, or equivalent experience, preferably in HR or business administration.

 When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
   

  

 We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
   

  

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

title: Director - Backup & Recovery - Infrastructure Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Role Overview**


We are seeking a seasoned **Techno\-Leadership Director** to lead the **Engineering function for Backup, Recovery, and Cyber Resilience** across hybrid enterprise environments. This role will drive strategy, architecture, and execution of advanced backup and recovery solutions spanning **Azure, AWS, and on‑premise private cloud**, ensuring operational resilience and regulatory compliance for mission\-critical systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Leadership \& Strategy**


	+ Provide visionary leadership for enterprise backup and recovery engineering teams.
	+ Define and execute long\-term strategies for **backup, disaster recovery (DR), point\-in\-time recovery, and cyber vault recovery (clean room environments)** across hybrid cloud platforms.
	+ Partner with senior executives, risk governance, and compliance stakeholders to align recovery capabilities with regulatory mandates.
* **Engineering \& Operations**


	+ Architect, engineer, and optimize enterprise backup solutions leveraging **Cohesity, Rubrik, Azure, AWS, and private cloud platforms**.
	+ Lead design and implementation of **cyber recovery vaults, immutable backups, and clean room recovery environments**.
	+ Establish and enforce standards for **data protection, recovery SLAs, and resilience testing** across global infrastructure.
	+ Drive automation, orchestration, and modernization of backup workflows to improve efficiency and reduce recovery times.
* **Risk \& Compliance**


	+ Ensure adherence to industry frameworks (NIST, ISO, COBIT, DORA, PRA, Federal Reserve, CSA CCM, CIS Controls).
	+ Partner with risk and audit teams to demonstrate compliance with financial industry regulations.
	+ Lead resilience exercises, cyber recovery simulations, and regulatory reporting.
* **Team \& Stakeholder Management**


	+ Lead and mentor engineering teams across regions, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
	+ Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and cybersecurity leaders to ensure seamless recovery integration.
	+ Present recovery strategies and outcomes to executive leadership and regulators.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 18\+ years in **backup and recovery engineering** within large enterprises, preferably **financial organizations**.
* **Technical Expertise:**


	+ Deep hands\-on experience with **Cohesity, Rubrik, Azure, AWS, and private cloud backup platforms**.
	+ Strong knowledge of **backup architecture, disaster recovery, point\-in\-time recovery, cyber vault recovery, and clean room recovery**.
	+ Expertise in cloud and hybrid backup strategies, automation, and orchestration.
* **Leadership Skills:**


	+ Proven track record of leading large\-scale engineering teams.
	+ Ability to influence senior stakeholders and regulators with clarity and confidence.
* **Certifications (preferred):** TOGAF, ITIL, CCSP, Azure/ AWS Solutions Architect, Terraform, CISSP, or equivalent.

**Key Attributes**

* Strategic thinker with a **process\-driven approach** to resilience.
* Strong communicator with ability to **translate technical recovery strategies into executive\-level narratives**.
* Passion for **operational resilience, cyber recovery, and regulatory compliance**.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

description:
**About the Department** 




 Invest India is the National Investment Promotion and Facilitation Agency under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. It hosts teams working with various government initiatives such as Make in India, Startup India and PMG
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Onboarding \& Offboarding** 




 Own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle transitions to ensure every joiner and leaver experiences a well\-structured, compliant, and professional process.
 


* Design and continuously improve the onboarding journey \- pre\-boarding communication, documentation, induction, and role/team integration
* Own the offboarding process end\-to\-end \- resignation/separation formalities, clearance coordination, full and final settlement, and knowledge transfer
* Conduct structured exit interviews; analyse findings to identify attrition drivers and feed insights back into retention strategy
* Track onboarding and offboarding TAT, new\-hire satisfaction, and early attrition metrics; report trends to leadership
* Maintain accurate, audit\-ready employee records and documentation throughout the lifecycle



**2\. Performance Management System (PMS)** 




 Own the design, governance, and execution of the organization's performance management framework.
 


* Design and administer the annual/bi\-annual performance review cycle \- goal\-setting, mid\-year check\-ins, final appraisals, and calibration
* Partner with functional and business leaders to ensure fair, consistent, and timely rating calibration across teams
* Build manager and employee capability on goal\-setting, feedback, and performance conversations through training and toolkits
* Administer performance improvement plans (PIPs) in partnership with business leaders and ensure documentation and due process are followed
* Link performance outcomes to rewards, promotions, and development planning in coordination with relevant stakeholders
* Continuously evaluate and refine the PMS framework based on organizational maturity, feedback, and best practice benchmarking



**3\. Grievance Management \& Employee Relations** 




 Serve as a trusted, neutral point of contact to ensure a fair and psychologically safe workplace.
 


* Own the grievance redressal mechanism end\-to\-end \- intake, investigation, resolution, and closure — with strict confidentiality
* Ensure full compliance with the POSH Act and other applicable labor and workplace regulations, including committee coordination and reporting
* Advise managers and employees on policy interpretation, conflict resolution, and disciplinary processes
* Maintain grievance and case\-management logs; analyze recurring themes and recommend systemic/policy\-level fixes
* Escalate high\-risk or sensitive matters to leadership and legal counsel as appropriate, with sound judgment and discretion



**4\. HR Automation** 




 Drive the digitization and automation agenda to make HR processes efficient, consistent, and scalable.
 


* Identify manual, high\-effort HR processes (onboarding, PMS, grievance tracking, documentation, letters) and lead automation
* Partner with HRMS vendors on system implementation, configuration, enhancement, and issue resolution
* Drive employee and manager adoption of self\-service HR tools and workflows
* Own data hygiene, access controls, and process governance across HR systems
* Stay current on HR\-tech trends and evaluate new tools/platforms that could improve HR service delivery



**5\. HR Analytics \& Dashboards** 




 Turn HR data into a decision\-making asset for leadership.
 


* Build and maintain live dashboards covering headcount but not limited to attrition, engagement, PMS completion, L\&D participation, and grievance trends
* Deliver monthly/quarterly HR MIS and insight decks to leadership, highlighting risks and opportunities
* Standardize HR metrics definitions and reporting cadence across the function for consistency and accuracy
* Conduct ad\-hoc, leadership\-requested analyses (e.g., attrition deep\-dives, cost\-to\-serve, span\-of\-control reviews)
* Ensure data governance, accuracy, and confidentiality of all HR reporting outputs



**6\. Other HR Operations** 




 Support the broader people agenda beyond the core pillars above.
 


* Draft, review, and update HR policies and the employee handbook in line with evolving organizational needs and regulations
* Design and drive employee engagement, wellness, and culture\-building initiatives
* Partner with Finance, IT, Admin, and Legal on cross\-functional people matters



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a related discipline from a recognized institute
* 10–13 years of progressive HR experience, with demonstrable ownership of PMS, L\&D, and core HR operations in a mid\-to\-large organization
* Proven experience implementing or scaling HRMS/HR automation and building HR analytics/dashboards
* Strong working knowledge of labor laws, POSH compliance, and grievance redressal frameworks
* Experience managing end\-to\-end onboarding and offboarding at scale



  




* **Functional Skills**
* HR analytics and BI tools (Excel, Power BI, or equivalent)
* HRMS/HRIS configuration and process automation
* Employee Lifecycle Management
* Performance management design and calibration facilitation
* Policy drafting and statutory/compliance management



  




* **Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* Sound judgment, discretion, and integrity in handling sensitive matters
* Structured, data\-driven problem\-solving
* Ownership mindset with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands\-on execution
* Ability to lead and develop team members

Provide oversight and support the end\-to\-end recruitment delivery across actuarial, technical and non\-technical roles, requisition management, sourcing and interviewing through to onboarding.

While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
   

  

 We are seeking an operational HR Operations Specialist with 2 to 6 years of experience to manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle operations, maintain HRIS data integrity, support payroll inputs, and ensure smooth daily administrative processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Employee Lifecycle Management: Coordinate seamless onboarding and offboarding workflow, conduct orientations, and manage exit clearances.
* HRIS \& Data Integrity: Maintain and update master employee records across HR platforms, perform regular data audits, and compile routine HR reports for leadership.
* Payroll \& Benefits Support: Collate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave balances, variable pay, and exit settlements and liaise with Finance for timely execution.
* Query Management: Act as the first point of contact for routine employee inquiries regarding policies, benefits, leave tracking, and HR portal assistance.
* Compliance \& Policy Adherence: Assist in maintaining audit\-ready personnel files, ensuring operational alignment with statutory requirements and internal company policies.
* Process Optimization: Help identify operational bottlenecks and partner with cross\-functional teams to automate and streamline routine HR workflows.


**Required Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 2 to 5 years of core experience in HR operations, HR administration, or HR shared services.
* Technical Skills: Working knowledge of modern HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, BambooHR, Darwinbox, SuccessFactors) and intermediate\-to\-advanced proficiency in MS Excel (pivot tables, lookup functions).
* Skills \& Competencies: Solid understanding of statutory compliance basics, strong attention to detail, and a high level of discretion handling sensitive employee data.


**About Monks**
 Monks is the global, digital\-first, data\-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high\-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long\-term impact.
   

  

 Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022\-25\) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020\-24\). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023\) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting\-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025\), runner\-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024\), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024\). Additionally, Monks achieved a record\-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

title: Team Leader - Advisory , Australia
description:
**Job Description**
 In line with our strategy for growth and improve the quality of what we do we are looking to strengthen our GCC in India through the appointment of a Team Leader\- Advisory to help manage and drive the business forward.
   

  

 We are looking for an individual with proven experience and results in establishing, growing and leading an offshoring center – and the functions within it \- for a major organization to help us deliver this strategy.
   

  

* Team Leader\- Advisory will Lead and spearhead the development of the Advisory GCC team by ensuring alignment, cohesion, and high\-performance delivery across GCC.
* Develop and implement an GCC Strategy (aligned to the Australian strategy) and work with each Business Unit and appropriate international colleagues, to identify areas where we can expand our services and improve the output
* As a strategic influencer and people\-centric leader, the incumbent will play a pivotal role in building centers of excellence and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and collaboration between GCC and the Australia Regions.
* The mission is clear: to strengthen the GCC’s role as a enabler of Advisory excellence, ensure sustainable growth, and enhance WSP’s competitive advantage through integration, innovation, and people empowerment. This includes:
* Strategic Alignment \& Partnership: Build trusted relationships with global and regional leaders to ensure alignment of priorities and effective execution of the GCC strategy.
* Transformation \& Capability Development: Lead the GCC team through transformational change, strengthening delivery capability, integration, and overall performance across regions.
* Growth \& Opportunity Enablement: Identify and translate market and business insights into scalable initiatives that drive growth, enhance utilization, and expand the GCC’s strategic value.
* This role is pivotal in shaping the future of the organization — not just by managing complexity, but by creating clarity, driving action, and enabling progress across borders.
* By working closely with key stakeholders, the Head \- Advisory ensures that the GCC is positioned as a strategic enabler and growth partner, driving collaboration, market expansion, and impact across geographies.


**Responsibilities**
* Drive Advisory team’s growth by building trusted relationships with GCC and Australia Advisory Leadership teams, ensuring GCC actively build integrated and high\-performing teams.
* \- Develop and implement the GCC l Advisory operating model in partnership with the Australia Region, defining the balance between centralized and decentralized teams, and tracking progress against commercial KPIs.
* \- Engage with other GCC functional leaders to influence and align critical cross\-functional strategic decisions and ensure organizational coherence.
* \- Develop and maintain a global network of ambassadors to advocate for GCC initiatives, share best practices and strengthen collaboration across WSP regions.
* \- Drive the creation of Centers of Excellence within the GCC setting up operating platforms that promote innovation and best practices.
* \- Actively identify opportunities for digital enablement across the Advisory function (e.g., proposal automation, digital delivery models) to improve efficiency and scalability.
* \- Promote continuous improvement and collaboration between regions and GCC teams through structured engagement, team interactions, and performance reviews that elevate the GCC Advisory brand globally.


 Key Competencies / Skills
   

  

* \- People centricity, with a strong focus on attracting, retaining, and motivating Advisory GCC teams through engagement, empowerment, and inclusion.
* \- Strategic and commercial thinker, able to define a clear vision for the optimal GCC Advisory model while driving implementation through world\-class practices and global benchmarks.
* \- Leads by influence, not by control, with the ability to build trust and alignment across regions, inspiring collaboration and shared ownership of outcomes.
* \- Transformation leadership, driving large\-scale organizational change, capability development, and performance improvement across diverse teams.
* \- Cross\-cultural agility, adapting leadership style to different geographies and cultural contexts to strengthen cohesion and collaboration.
* \- Executive communication and presence, capable of engaging confidently with C\-suite stakeholders and articulating complex ideas with clarity and impact.
* \- Innovation and digital mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to modernize processes, leverage technology and enhance efficiency and client value.


**Qualifications**
* \- Relevant academic qualifications, including a Postgraduate or Honours Degree, Bachelor of
* Science, MBA, or equivalent Diploma in Business, Management, Economics, or a related discipline.
* \- Minimum 15 years’ experience in business strategy, operations, consulting, or leadership roles within a professional service or advisory environment.
* \- Proven record of delivering strategic and operational outcomes across complex, multi\-region organizations.
* \- Experience in leading large, distributed teams, ideally across global capability centers or shared service environments.
* \- Background with Big 4 or top\-tier management consultancy is highly desirable, with demonstrated exposure to transformation, benchmarking, or advisory excellence.
* \- Strong financial and commercial acumen, with ability to manage budgets, track KPIs, and drive performance outcomes.
* \- Demonstrated expertise in stakeholder management, including influencing senior executives, managing cross\-functional relationships and aligning diverse priorities.
* \- Exposure to digital enablement and innovation programs, particularly in enhancing service delivery or operational efficiency.
* \- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate strategic insights.


 Client / External focus
   

  

* Maintain strong colleague relationships and contribute to the teams’ performance in delivering exceptional client satisfaction
* Contribute to knowledge sharing in internal and external forums and including technical input to your team
* Remain up to date with market and competitor knowledge across our industry
* Engage directly with clients throughout the project lifecycle – either independently or as part of a broader delivery team.


 People
   

  

* Inclusively lead people, clearly articulating the vision, defining responsibilities, delegating effectively and providing constructive feedback
* Inspire and motivate our people towards technical progression
* Be self\-motivated to take on a leadership role in project work with a clear focus on timeliness, quality and technical excellence.
* Managing people through change and develop succession plans
* Create and support innovation
* Deal with conflict appropriately
* Carry out and report on staff appraisals and performance development reviews
* Recruitment to achieve budgeted and programmed team growth


 Business Focus
   

  

* Proactively influences Health, Safety and Wellbeing, including for example Safety in Design
* Deliver successful commercial performance by clearly understanding and monitoring the area of work and ensure agreed targets are met
* Explore ways to add value and improve personal and team performance
* Ensure budget utilisations are met or exceeded
* Ensure budgeted earning capacity is met or exceeded.


 BGV:
   

  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

 We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist with proven experience hiring US Healthcare Recruiters, Senior Healthcare Recruiters, Team Leads and Managers. Candidates with general IT/Non\-Healthcare recruitment experience will not be considered.

* Experience in healthcare staffing or healthcare recruitment.
* Strong networking and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Data\-driven recruitment and reporting skills.
* Knowledge of employer branding and talent attraction strategies.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Industry\-leading compensation and attractive recurring incentives.
* Complimentary meals and pick \& drop facilities.
* Rewards \& Recognition programs.
* Collaborative and growth\-oriented work culture.
* Learning and career advancement opportunities.

title: Workday Functional Consultant
description:
**About Us**
CLOUDSUFI, a Google Cloud Premier Partner, is a global leading provider of data\-driven digital transformation across cloud\-based enterprises. With a global presence and focus on Software \& Platforms, Life sciences and Healthcare, Retail, CPG, financial services and supply chain, CLOUDSUFI is positioned to meet customers where they are in their data monetization journey. **Our Values**
We are a passionate and empathetic team that prioritizes human values. Our purpose is to elevate the quality of lives for our family, customers, partners and the community. **Equal Opportunity Statement**
CLOUDSUFI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation and national origin status. We provide equal opportunities in employment, advancement, and all other areas of our workplace. Please explore more at https://www.cloudsufi.com/ **Experience:** 3–6 years**Location:** Remote**Employment Type:** Contractual
**Shift Timing**\-3pm to 12am#### **Job Summary**


We are looking for a **Workday Functional Consultant** with strong hands\-on experience in **Workday Core HCM**, along with exposure to **Absence Management and Time Tracking**. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of the **end\-to\-end Recruit\-to\-Retire (R2R) lifecycle** and will be responsible for supporting Workday configuration, enhancements, testing, troubleshooting, and business requirements.  

The role requires someone who can work closely with HR and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective Workday solutions.#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and support **Workday Core HCM** modules and business processes.
* Work on **Absence Management and Time Tracking** configuration and support.
* Understand and support the complete **Recruit\-to\-Retire lifecycle**, including:
	+ Recruiting and onboarding
	+ Core HCM
	+ Job/position management
	+ Compensation
	+ Absence and Time Tracking
	+ Employee movement and lifecycle events
	+ Termination/offboarding
* Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into Workday functional solutions.
* Configure **business processes, condition rules, validations, security, and notifications** as required.
* Troubleshoot functional issues and provide root\-cause analysis and solutions.
* Support **Workday releases, enhancements, testing, and regression testing**.
* Prepare functional specifications, test scenarios, and process documentation.
* Work with HR, IT, and other stakeholders to deliver Workday enhancements and projects.
* Support integrations by working with technical/integration teams to resolve functional issues.
* Provide production support and ensure timely resolution of Workday incidents.

#### **Required Skills**

* **4–6 years of experience in Workday functional consulting/support.**
* Strong hands\-on experience in **Workday Core HCM**.
* Good experience with **Workday Absence Management and Time Tracking**.
* Strong understanding of **Hire\-to\-Retire / Recruit\-to\-Retire HR processes**.
* Experience with Workday **business process configuration and troubleshooting**.
* Good understanding of Workday security concepts and functional configuration.
* Experience in **testing, UAT, regression testing, and Workday releases**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as with cross\-functional teams.

#### **Good to Have**

* Workday certification in **Core HCM / Absence / Time Tracking**.
* Experience supporting **Workday implementations or enhancement projects**.
* Exposure to Workday integrations and reporting.
* Experience working with global HR processes and multiple geographies

  

Mid level Workday functional resource \- workday core HR \- absence, time tracking, \- recruit to retire cycle

title: AM1 - Talent Management
description:
**About Us:**

  

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

  

We build long\-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND** **RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

**Note:** The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

**Job Purpose**
---------------


The Assistant Manager \- Talent Management will support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of talent management initiatives across the organization. The role focuses on performance management, succession planning, leadership development, employee engagement, competency frameworks, career management, and talent review processes to build a high\-performing workforce and strengthen the leadership pipeline.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Talent Management \& Succession Planning**

* Facilitate talent review discussions and calibration exercises across business functions.
* Support the identification and development of high\-potential employees.
* Maintain succession planning frameworks and critical role pipelines.
* Track talent readiness and leadership bench strength metrics.

### **Performance Management**

* Manage the end\-to\-end performance management cycle, including goal setting, mid\-year reviews, and annual appraisals.
* Analyze performance data and provide insights to leadership.
* Ensure consistency and fairness in performance evaluation processes.
* Conduct training sessions for managers on performance management best practices.

### **Learning \& Leadership Development**

* Identify talent development needs based on business strategy and workforce planning.
* Coordinate leadership development programs, coaching initiatives, and assessment centers.
* Monitor Individual Development Plans (IDPs) and career progression plans.
* Partner with L\&D teams to design capability\-building interventions.

### **Competency Management**

* Develop and update competency frameworks aligned with organizational objectives.
* Integrate competencies into recruitment, performance, and career development processes.
* Support competency assessments and gap analyses.

### **Employee Engagement \& Retention**

* Analyze engagement survey results and recommend action plans.
* Support retention strategies for critical talent and high performers.
* Monitor employee experience initiatives and career development programs.

### **HR Analytics \& Reporting**

* Generate and analyze talent\-related dashboards and reports.
* Track KPIs such as attrition, internal mobility, succession coverage, performance distribution, and leadership pipeline health.
* Present insights and recommendations to HR leadership and business stakeholders.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders to understand talent requirements.
* Act as a trusted advisor on talent development and workforce planning initiatives.
* Ensure alignment of talent management practices with organizational goals.

**Desired Qualifications**
--------------------------

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources, Organizational Development, or related field.
* 5\-8 years of experience in Talent Management, Organizational Development, Learning \& Development, or HRBP roles.
* Experience in performance management, succession planning, and leadership development programs.
* Knowledge of competency frameworks and talent assessment tools.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI, HRMS, and HR analytics.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Talent Management \& Succession Planning
* Performance Management Systems
* Leadership Development
* Organization Development
* HR Analytics \& Data Interpretation
* Stakeholder Management
* Project Management
* Communication \& Presentation Skills
* Problem Solving \& Strategic Thinking
* Change Management

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

* Succession coverage ratio for critical positions
* Completion rate of performance management cycle
* High\-potential talent retention rate
* Internal promotion and mobility percentage
* Leadership development program effectiveness
* Employee engagement improvement metrics
* Talent review completion and action closure rates
**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**  

**Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described. Regular eye\-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6\-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Infrequently, Team Member must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs. Team Member may experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.  

A job description is only intended as a guideline and is only part of the Team Member’s function. The company has reviewed this job description to ensure that the essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

title: Human Resource Manager
description:
Job Description – People \& Culture Manager

**Company:** Elcom Digital Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** People \& Culture Manager  
**Location:** Noida  
**Experience:** 6–10 Years  
**Industry:** SaaS / IT / Technology Preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

Elcom Digital Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and people\-focused **People \& Culture Manager** to lead and strengthen our People \& Culture function.

The role will be responsible for managing **Talent Acquisition, Employee Experience, HR Operations, Performance Management, Employee Engagement, HR Policies, and People Development initiatives**. The ideal candidate should be a strong HR professional who can work closely with business leaders, understand organizational needs, and translate them into effective people practices.

This role requires a combination of **strategic thinking, hands\-on execution, strong stakeholder management, and people leadership**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning

* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across Sales, Technology, Corporate, and other business functions.
* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and workforce plans.
* Develop effective sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, consultants, and other channels.
* Manage senior, managerial, specialist, and critical hiring requirements.
* Drive salary discussions, negotiations, offer management, and offer\-to\-joining conversion.
* Build strong talent pipelines for current and future business requirements.
* Track and improve recruitment metrics including **Hiring TAT, Time to Hire, Cost per Hire, Quality of Hire, and Offer\-to\-Joining Ratio**.
* Manage recruitment consultants and external hiring partners.
* Strengthen employer branding and recruitment initiatives.

2\. People \& Culture Strategy

* Develop and implement People \& Culture initiatives aligned with business goals.
* Partner with leadership to identify people\-related challenges and provide practical HR solutions.
* Contribute to building a strong, collaborative, performance\-driven, and employee\-centric culture.
* Identify opportunities to improve employee experience and organizational effectiveness.
* Support leadership in people planning, organization structure, and workforce\-related decisions.

3\. Performance Management

* Drive the performance appraisal and review cycle.
* Support managers in setting **KRAs, KPIs, goals, and performance expectations**.
* Facilitate performance discussions and provide guidance on performance improvement plans.
* Identify high performers and support talent development and succession planning.
* Ensure performance management practices are consistent and aligned with business objectives.

4\. Employee Engagement \& Experience

* Design and execute employee engagement initiatives and people programs.
* Conduct employee feedback, surveys, 1:1 discussions, and engagement activities.
* Identify employee concerns and work with managers to resolve them effectively.
* Promote a positive workplace culture based on collaboration, accountability, learning, and growth.
* Support employee recognition and retention initiatives.

5\. HR Operations \& Policies

* Oversee core HR operations including onboarding, induction, employee lifecycle management, transfers, promotions, and exits.
* Ensure employee records and HR documentation are accurate and up to date.
* Oversee attendance, leave, HRMS, payroll inputs, and other HR processes.
* Develop, review, and implement HR policies and processes as required.
* Ensure HR processes are consistent, efficient, and employee\-friendly.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders on statutory compliance and HR documentation.

6\. Employee Relations \& Conflict Management

* Act as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers on people\-related matters.
* Handle employee grievances and workplace concerns with confidentiality and professionalism.
* Support managers in resolving employee relations and performance\-related issues.
* Facilitate constructive communication between employees and management.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and follow\-up on employee\-related cases.

7\. Learning \& Development

* Identify training and development needs across teams.
* Coordinate internal and external learning initiatives.
* Support leadership development and manager capability\-building programs.
* Encourage continuous learning and professional development across the organization.

8\. HR MIS \& Analytics

* Prepare and present HR MIS and people dashboards for leadership.
* Track key people metrics including:
* Headcount \& Attrition
* Hiring \& Recruitment TAT
* Employee Turnover
* Absenteeism
* Performance \& Productivity
* Employee Engagement
* Cost\-related HR metrics
* Use HR data and insights to support business and people\-related decisions.

9\. Team \& Stakeholder Management

* Build strong relationships with business leaders, managers, and employees.
* Guide and mentor junior HR/P\&C team members.
* Ensure effective delegation, follow\-up, and execution of HR activities.
* Work closely with Finance, Admin, Business, and Leadership teams on cross\-functional initiatives.
* Take ownership of HR projects and drive them from planning through implementation.

Requirements

* **6–10 years of experience in Human Resources / People \& Culture.**
* Experience in **Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Engagement, Performance Management, and Employee Relations**.
* Experience in **SaaS, IT, Technology, or a fast\-growing organization** is preferred.
* Strong understanding of the complete employee lifecycle.
* Proven experience in managing stakeholders and working directly with business leaders.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment and talent management practices.
* Hands\-on experience with **HRMS/ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, and HR analytics/MIS**.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with maturity and confidentiality.
* Strong ownership, decision\-making, follow\-up, and execution skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment.
* **MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent qualification preferred.**

Key Competencies

* People \& Culture Leadership
* Strategic HR Thinking
* Talent Acquisition
* Stakeholder Management
* Employee Relations
* Performance Management
* Employee Engagement
* Conflict Resolution
* HR Analytics \& MIS
* Policy \& Process Management
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Communication \& Negotiation

description:

Industry leaders with a history of innovation, Cineverse is powering the future of Entertainment.
   

  

 Job Title: Global Payroll Coordinator
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly detail‑oriented Payroll Specialist to provide operational and compliance support to our Payroll Managers across the US, Europe, and India. This role is ideal for someone who excels in U.S. state tax/UI setup, jurisdiction compliance, data validation, and cross‑functional coordination. You will not own or process payroll directly; instead, you will ensure payroll managers have accurate data, correct state registrations, reconciled reports, and compliant system setups. You’ll also support payroll‑related accounting tasks and help maintain the integrity of our payroll processes globally.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Payroll Support – U.S., Europe \& India
   

  

* Provide day\-to\-day operational support to Payroll Managers for each region.
* Work with payroll managers and HR to ensure all data has been captured for the current payroll run (new hires, terminations, compensation changes, variable pay).
* Audit payroll reports for accuracy before final approval by Payroll Managers.


 U.S. State Tax \& UI Setup \+ Compliance
   

  

* Manage state tax and unemployment insurance (UI) account registrations and ongoing maintenance.
* Set up new jurisdictions in payroll systems and verify rates, SUI accounts, and withholding requirements.
* Monitor compliance updates and partner with Payroll Managers to implement changes.
* Maintain documentation of tax accounts, filings, and notices across all applicable states.


 Global Payroll Coordination
   

  

* Support local payroll leads (Europe, UK, Moldova, India) with data collection, audit files, and reporting needs.
* Track statutory changes globally and escalate potential impacts to the appropriate payroll owner.
* Coordinate with external payroll vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies or missing data.


 Accounting \& Reporting Support
   

  

* Prepare payroll journal entries and assist with monthly close activities in partnership with Finance.
* Reconcile payroll accounts, statutory payments, and benefits invoices.
* Assist with year\-end reporting activities (e.g., W‑2 reconciliation, global equivalents).


**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* 3–5\+ years of experience in payroll support, payroll operations, or related roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience in US State tax setup, SUI registration, and multi\-state compliance.
* Experience supporting multi\-country payroll teams (US required; EU/India preferred).
* Working knowledge of accounting concepts and payroll GL reconciliation.
* Proficiency with payroll or HRIS systems (you can customize with your company’s stack).
* Strong Excel skills and comfort working with complex data sets.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to operate with confidentiality.


**Preferred**
* Payroll certifications (FPC or CPP).
* Experience in high\-growth or multi\-entity environments.
* Familiarity with Workday, BambooHR, Rippling, ADP, Deel, Remote.com, or similar platforms.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Highly organized and able to manage work across multiple time zones.
* Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to identify discrepancies quickly.
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

title: Assistant Manager Learning & Development
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive team member training and development programs to enhance team skills and performance; assessing training needs, designing and updating training courses to ensure that the training content matches the team members' job responsibilities and career paths; managing training budgets to ensure maximum return on training investment. As an
 **Assistant Manager Learning \& Development** 
 , you’re not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
   

  

* Develop training programs: Design, plan, and deliver hotel training programs in alignment with corporate goals and industry standards, inclusive of topics such as harassment\-free workplace, diversity, new team member orientation, leadership, and service
* Monitor and review performance: Conduct meetings with department managers, trainers, and team members to review performance trends, develop action plans, and recognize achievements
* Deliver continuous improvement: Assess existing training initiatives, identify opportunities for enhancement, and recommend solutions to address specific department needs
* Manage training records: Track, maintain, and audit individual team member training records using designated systems and tools
* Oversee departmental training programs: Manage and monitor department\-specific training programs such as alcohol awareness, food safety, job skills checklists, and educational assistance
* Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment


**Qualifications**
 At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
   

  

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
 **Hospitality** 
 . Acting with
 **Integrity** 
 and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
 **Leadership** 
 . A belief that
 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now** 
 , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
   

  

**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**
* Minimum 3 years in L\&D or HR, with a strong track record in designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs.
* Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Hospitality Management, or related field preferred.
* Skilled in instructional design, adult learning principles, and modern training methods (e.g., e\-learning, blended learning).
* Proficient in assessing training effectiveness and aligning programs with business goals.
* Experienced with Learning Management Systems (LMS), digital training tools, and Microsoft Office.
* Strong verbal and written skills; able to engage and motivate diverse teams.
* Committed to continuous learning and staying updated on emerging training trends.
* Proven ability to work cross\-functionally to identify needs and support performance improvement.
* Capable of managing training teams and multiple projects effectively.


**About Us**
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**
 At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
   

  

 Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
   

  

 Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

* Document configurations, solution design, and operational procedures.

* Strong understanding of payroll legislative rules and statutory compliance.
* Experience with BIP, OTBI, and SQL for troubleshooting.


**Functional Skills**
* Solid understanding of Core HR, Absence Management, Time \& Labor is a plus.
* Ability to analyse payroll issues and propose effective solutions.

* Excellent communication and client\-facing abilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Warehouse Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager with 5+ years of hands-on experience in D2C/E-commerce warehouse operations . The ideal candidate will manage end-to-end warehouse activities, ensuring inventory accuracy, timely order fulfilment, efficient manpower utilisation, and smooth coordination with logistics and internal teams. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Warehouse Operations Manage complete day-to-day warehouse operations. Oversee inwarding, GRN, put-away, storage, picking, packing and dispatch . Ensure orders are processed and dispatched within defined TAT. Maintain proper warehouse layout, storage systems and material movement. Implement SOPs to improve operational efficiency. 
 Inventory Management Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure regular stock reconciliation. Conduct cycle counts and periodic physical stock audits. Monitor stock variance, damages, shortages and excess inventory . Ensure proper SKU identification, bin management and FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable. Track fast-moving, slow-moving and non-moving inventory. 

 D2C Order Fulfillment Manage high-volume D2C/e-commerce order processing. Monitor Order-to-Ship, Pick-to-Pack and Dispatch TAT . Ensure accurate picking and packing with minimum errors. Coordinate with marketplaces, D2C platforms and logistics partners. Monitor RTO, NDR, cancellations and customer returns . 
 Logistics & Dispatch Coordinate with courier/logistics partners for timely pickups and deliveries. Track shipment exceptions and resolve operational issues. Monitor courier performance, delivery TAT and RTO percentage. Ensure proper documentation for dispatches and returns.

title: Assistant Welfare Manager (Immediate Joiner, Garment Manufacturing)
description:
Position: Assistant Manager, Welfare
 Industry: Garment Manufacturing
 Department: HR / Welfare
 Gender: Female
 Location: Bengaluru
 Reporting To: HR Manager / Factory Head 
 1. Job Purpose To manage and strengthen employee welfare activities at the garment manufacturing facility, ensuring a safe, supportive, compliant, and employee-friendly workplace, with particular focus on the needs of women employees. The role will be responsible for employee welfare facilities, grievance handling, statutory welfare requirements, employee engagement, counselling/support, and coordination with internal departments and external agencies. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Absenteeism, Attrition & Employee Retention Management Monitor and analyse daily, weekly, and monthly absenteeism and attrition trends. Identify root causes of absenteeism and employee turnover through employee interactions, feedback, stay interviews and exit interviews. Track department-wise, line-wise, shift-wise and tenure-wise absenteeism and attrition. Identify high-risk employees and groups and take proactive retention measures. Follow up with frequent/long-absent employees and understand their concerns to support their return to work. Conduct regular employee connect sessions to identify and resolve workplace and welfare-related concerns. Develop and implement employee engagement and retention initiatives, particularly for women employees. Coordinate with HR, Production, and supervisors to address issues related to work environment, supervisors, transport, canteen, accommodation, working hours, and other welfare concerns. Monitor early attrition, particularly employee exits within the first 30/60/90 days, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare regular absenteeism, attrition, and retention MIS reports and present key findings and action plans to management. Measure the effectiveness of retention initiatives and continuously recommend improvements to reduce absenteeism and attrition. 
 B. Employee Welfare & Facilities Manage day-to-day employee welfare activities within the factory. Ensure availability and proper maintenance of welfare facilities such as: Canteen Drinking water Rest areas Washrooms Changing rooms First-aid facilities Transport facilities Childcare/crche facilities, where applicable Conduct regular welfare-facility inspections and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure welfare facilities are clean, hygienic, safe and accessible to employees. 
 C. Women Employee Welfare Act as a key point of contact for women employees regarding welfare-related concerns. Handle women employees' grievances with sensitivity and confidentiality. Support awareness initiatives related to workplace safety, dignity and respectful behaviour. Coordinate with relevant committees and management on matters concerning women employees. Support implementation and awareness of the organisation's POSH policy and related processes. Monitor issues affecting women employees and escalate serious concerns to HR management. 
 D. Employee Grievance Handling Receive, understand, and document employee grievances. Conduct employee interaction sessions and floor-level feedback activities. Coordinate with HR, Production, Compliance, and other departments to resolve grievances. Maintain proper records of grievances and closure status. Identify recurring employee issues and recommend preventive actions. 
 E. Statutory & Social Compliance Support HR/Compliance teams in meeting applicable labour and welfare requirements. Maintain welfare-related records and documentation required for audits and inspections. Coordinate preparation for customer/social-compliance audits. Ensure welfare practices are implemented in line with company policies and applicable statutory requirements. Support inspections by government authorities and other external agencies when required. 
 F. Employee Engagement Plan and coordinate employee engagement and welfare activities. Organise events and programmes such as:
 Employee awareness programmes Health and wellness activities Women's Day programmes Sports and cultural activities Employee recognition programmes Festival celebrations Counselling / awareness sessions Promote positive employee relations and improve employee participation. 
 G. Communication & Awareness Conduct regular employee awareness sessions on welfare-related topics. Communicate HR and welfare initiatives effectively to employees. Coordinate toolbox talks, awareness campaigns, and employee meetings. Ensure employees understand available welfare facilities and support systems. 
 H. Employee Support & Counselling Maintain regular interaction with employees at the shop-floor level. Identify employee concerns relating to work environment, accommodation, transport, canteen, health, safety or personal difficulties. Provide basic counselling/support within the scope of the role and escalate sensitive or serious matters appropriately. Maintain confidentiality of employee information. 
 I. Reporting & Documentation Prepare periodic welfare reports for management. Track welfare complaints, actions and closure. Maintain records of welfare activities, inspections, meetings and employee engagement programmes. Analyse employee feedback and recommend improvements. Provide MIS reports to the HR Manager / Factory Head as required. 
 3. Key Skills & Competencies Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good employee-handling and grievance-management skills. Empathy and patience when dealing with employees. Strong understanding of workplace welfare practices. Ability to communicate effectively with women employees and shop-floor workers. Good coordination and problem-solving skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Good documentation and reporting skills. Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with cross-functional teams. Basic knowledge of MS Office / Excel / HR systems. 
 4. Qualification Master's degree in HR, Social Work, Labour Welfare, MBA or related discipline. 
 5. Experience 6-10 years of relevant experience in employee welfare / HR/labour welfare, preferably in the garment, textile, manufacturing or factory environment . Experience handling a predominantly female workforce will be an advantage. Experience in social-compliance audits and employee grievance handling is preferred. 
 6. Preferred Knowledge Employee welfare practices Labour welfare requirements Grievance handling Women employee welfare POSH awareness and process coordination Social compliance requirements Factory welfare facilities Employee engagement Basic HR documentation and MIS Audit preparation and documentation 
 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely closure of employee grievances. Employee satisfaction with welfare facilities. Welfare facility inspection and corrective-action closure. Employee engagement and participation levels. Compliance with welfare-related requirements. Audit observations and timely closure. Effectiveness of employee communication and awareness programmes. Reduction in recurring employee welfare complaints. 
 8. Personal Attributes The candidate should be: Mature and responsible Approachable and empathetic Trustworthy and confidential Assertive when required Patient and calm under pressure Proactive in identifying employee issues Comfortable interacting with shop-floor employees Capable of handling sensitive employee matters professionally 
 Note: The position involves regular interaction with employees and may require frequent movement across the factory floor and welfare facilities.
