 ABOUT UD FOOD PRODUCTS U.D. Food Products is a Ghaziabad-based food manufacturing company with 250+ employees operating across two business verticals: B2B Food Raw Materials : Manufacturing corn and rice-based raw ingredients for snacks manufacturers across India. SOP-driven, quality-focused production with FSSAI compliance and hygiene emphasis. FMCG Snacks : Consumer brand "Kutkut" packaged snacks and namkeen products distributed through modern trade, e-commerce, and traditional retail. The company operates a 6600+ sq. meter manufacturing facility with production lines, QC labs, and warehousing. Workforce split: ~60% factory/operations, ~40% office/functional staff. Company Status: Profitable and in growth phase (15% revenue CAGR). Expanding into new product lines and distribution channels. Planning to scale to 350+ employees over 3 years. THE ROLE We are looking for a hands-on Plant HR Manager who can: Independently manage 250+ employees (factory + office)
 Own recruitment, attendance, payroll, compliance, discipline, and performance
 Build HR from transactional to strategic
 Work closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Logistics and other heads
 Report directly to senior management This is NOT a recruitment-only role or HR admin desk job. This is full ownership of plant HR operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Recruitment & Manpower Planning Prepare manpower plans; manage recruitment for factory + office positions Handle sourcing through joining; build recruitment pipeline Monitor time-to-hire, recruitment cost, quality of hiring 2. Plant / Factory Operations Day-to-day HR management for manufacturing workforce (blue-collar + supervisory) Maintain attendance discipline; address absenteeism and manpower gaps Coordinate with Production/HODs on workforce issues Ensure factory compliance with company policies and SOPs 3. Attendance & Payroll Coordination Maintain accurate attendance and leave records (biometric systems) Verify overtime, leave, deductions, incentives Coordinate monthly payroll with Accounts; ensure on-time processing Identify abnormal patterns; control payroll costs 4. Labour Law & Statutory Compliance Ensure compliance with UP labour laws and factory regulations Manage PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Board requirements Maintain statutory registers and documentation Coordinate labour inspections and statutory correspondence Zero tolerance for compliance violations 5. Employee Relations & Discipline Handle grievances, complaints, misconduct cases objectively Investigate and recommend disciplinary action Issue warning letters, show-cause notices, termination letters Manage factory-level employee relations Maintain fair, firm, professional work environment 6. Performance Management & Development Implement structured appraisal process Set KPIs with department heads Monitor probation/confirmation Identify underperformers; coordinate improvement plans Organize training (induction, technical, safety, compliance) 7. HR Systems & SOPs Develop and implement HR policies and SOPs Standardize processes: recruitment, onboarding, attendance, discipline, separation Maintain org charts, job descriptions, role matrices Reduce dependency on person-specific processes 8. HR MIS & Reporting Prepare monthly HR dashboards for management: Manpower (total, dept-wise, vacancies, new joinings, separations) Absenteeism, overtime, leave trends Recruitment status and cost Attrition, performance, training, disciplinary cases Use Excel for MIS analysis and data-driven recommendations IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE Must-Have Qualifications: 815 years of hands-on HR experience (NOT recruitment only)

title: Org Design HR Analyst
description:
As an Org Design HR Analyst, you will support the design and health of Clearwater’s organization structure; helping ensure teams are structured, sized, and leveled in a way that supports the business. You’ll work closely with the People Analytics and HR Business Partner teams to build reporting and support the analysis behind organizational design decisions. You’ll also support the Organizational Effectiveness \& Innovation Lead, helping keep team topology, governance forums, and innovation programs running as Clearwater scales new structures and initiatives.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Dashboards \& Reporting: Support regular reports and dashboards on org structure, headcount, and workforce metrics, drawing on data maintained in the HRIS.
* Data Quality Flagging: Review org and position data for inconsistencies or errors, and flag and track discrepancies through to resolution with Regional HR Ops, who own manual HRIS data entry and Workday changes.
* Org Design Analysis: Support analysis of span of control, layers, job leveling, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies and inform org design recommendations.
* Reorg \& Scenario Support: Assist in building and modeling organizational scenarios during restructures, reorganizations, and headcount planning cycles.
* Team Topology \& Governance Support: Support the Organizational Effectiveness \& Innovation Lead in maintaining team topology (flat structures, single\-threaded ownership, small co\-located teams) and in coordinating cross\-functional governance forums (e.g., architecture and commercial review boards), including scheduling, agendas, and decision tracking.
* Innovation Program Support: Help track and report on innovation program activity (e.g., Ideathon\-style mechanisms), monitoring idea\-to\-launch velocity and compiling status updates for leadership.
* New Business Line Support: Assist with the structural setup of new business line stand\-ups, gathering the org data and documentation needed so org design follows strategy from day one.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Work with HR Business Partners, Regional HR Ops, Talent Acquisition, and business stakeholders to gather organizational data and understand structural change requests.
* Documentation: Help document org design principles, templates, and processes to build a consistent, repeatable playbook for future organizational changes.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in HR, People Analytics, Org Design, or a related analytical role.
* Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, data cleaning) and comfort building reports/dashboards; experience with a BI tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.
* Familiarity with an HRIS (e.g., Workday) sufficient to review data for accuracy, even though data entry sits with Regional HR Ops.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail when reviewing sensitive organizational data.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data and insights to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfort supporting fast\-moving cross\-functional forums and tracking action items to closure.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple data requests and deadlines simultaneously.

title: Workforce Transformation HR Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Workforce Transformation Analyst supports the design, analysis, and implementation of initiatives that reshape how the organization's workforce operates — including workforce planning, skills\-based talent strategies, organizational restructuring, automation/AI adoption impacts, and change management. This role combines data analysis, strategic thinking, and project execution to help the organization anticipate future talent needs and adapt its workforce model to meet evolving business demands.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze current workforce data (headcount, skills, roles, costs, attrition) to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and transformation opportunities
* Support workforce planning models that forecast future talent needs based on business strategy, technology adoption, and market trends
* Assess the impact of automation, AI, and process changes on roles, skills requirements, and staffing levels
* Develop skills taxonomies and competency frameworks to support reskilling/upskilling initiatives
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders to design organizational structures that align with strategic goals
* Build dashboards and reports (e.g., in Excel, Power BI, Tableau) to track workforce transformation KPIs and present findings to leadership
* Support change management efforts, including communication plans, training needs assessments, and stakeholder engagement
* Conduct benchmarking and market research on workforce trends, labor market shifts, and industry best practices
* Assist in developing business cases for workforce restructuring, redeployment, or reduction initiatives
* Document processes, playbooks, and standard methodologies for workforce transformation projects


**Required Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Organizational Psychology, or related field
* 2–5 years of experience in HR analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, management consulting, or a related analytical role
* Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, modeling); experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) a plus
* Familiarity with HRIS systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar)
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings to non\-technical stakeholders
* Project management skills and comfort working across cross\-functional teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in a related field, or HR certification (SHRM\-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR)
* Experience with change management frameworks (Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter's model)
* Exposure to workforce automation, AI impact assessments, or future\-of\-work research
* Consulting background in organizational transformation or workforce strategy
* Experience with statistical analysis tools (SQL, R, or Python) for advanced workforce modeling


**Key Competencies**
* Analytical rigor and data\-driven decision making
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Stakeholder management and influence
* Adaptability in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Strong written and verbal communication

 We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
   

  

 Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
   

  

**Senior Manager Human Resources (Business Facing) – Atit, India**
 The Sr Manager HR Atit India will act as a trusted partner to the site leadership team, driving people strategies that enable operational excellence and workforce engagement. This role requires a hands\-on HR professional who can balance strategic initiatives with day\-to\-day HR operations, ensuring compliance with Indian labor laws while aligning with global HR people plan.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with site leadership to understand business strategies and priorities and translate them into actionable HR strategies.
* Collaborate with global Centers of Excellence (COEs) and People Services to deliver the Annual People Plan, ensuring alignment with global HR goals and local manufacturing needs.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives tailored to the unique challenges of a remote manufacturing workforce.
* Support leaders with coaching, talent development, and succession planning to build leadership capability and team effectiveness.
* Champion performance management processes to foster a high\-performance culture.
* Lead site workforce planning and resource management to ensure optimal staffing levels.
* Collaborate with ER COE on employee relations, grievance handling, and disciplinary processes in compliance with Indian labor regulations.
* Promote inclusion and wellbeing initiatives, leveraging global programs adapted to local context.


**Experience**
* Proven professional HR experience in manufacturing or industrial environments, ideally managed a remote and/or unionized site.
* Strong track record of driving transformation and change in complex, matrixed organizations.
* Ability to operate as a true business partner with a growth mindset.
* Prior exposure to global HR operating models and collaboration with COEs and People Services.
* International experience outside India is advantageous.
* Minimum 12 \-15 years of progressive HR experience with at least 8 years in HRBP/Strategic HR role


**Education \& Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws and employment practices, with awareness of APAC cultural context.
* Expertise in HR processes including performance management, organization design, talent \& succession planning, employee engagement, total rewards, and wellbeing.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to influence multiple stakeholders in a matrix environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience leading HR projects and applying data\-driven decision\-making.

 Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
   

  

 Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
   

  

 Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

 Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
   

  

**Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging**
 At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

title: HR Software Engineer
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**What you will do**
--------------------


Technology is changing every part of the Volvo Group employee experience. We're looking for people who are passionate about contributing meaningfully to that change!

  

In our team, we design and deliver digital solutions that make work simpler, smarter, and more human through deploying targeted hyperautomation, artificial intelligence\-enabled solutions where applicable, and digital products within our scope of action.

  

Join our People \& Culture Digitalization and People Experience team and help shape the next generation of HR technology used by employees, managers, HR Business Partners and HR professionals across the globe.

  

We are looking for a full\-time **HR Software Engineer** to join our team starting **1 November 2026**, with a flexible location in **Bangalore, India** or **Wroclaw, Poland.**

  

In this role, you will design, build and support digital HR products, automations, integrations and AI\-enabled solutions. Your time will be split between delivering strategic digitalization initiatives, evolving our technology landscape and ensuring the long\-term stability and continuous improvement of the solutions we own through maintenance.

  

Our team operates in an Agile product delivery model, led by a single Digital Product Owner responsible for product vision, prioritization and delivery outcomes. You will report functionally to the Digital Product Owner and hierarchically to the Head of Digitalization and People Experience.

  

The People \& Culture Digitalization Team consists of four complementary areas working together to drive HR digital transformation. Business Enablement transforms business needs into solutions through business analysis, requirements management and product support. Digital Delivery, the team this role belongs to, designs, develops, maintains and continuously improves digital products, automations and integrations across the HR technology landscape. Process Excellence ensures HR processes are designed, standardized and optimized before being digitalized. Finally, the Poland Digitalization Team focuses on local digitalization initiatives, compliance requirements and country\-specific solutions. While the Poland Digitalization Team serves local needs, the Business Enablement, Digital Delivery and Process Excellence teams operate globally.

 **Our technology portfolio or scope of action is centered around:**

  

* UiPath Hyperautomation
* SAP SuccessFactors Accenture Document Composer
* Adobe Sign e\-Signature Solutions
* Microsoft Power Platform

  

Hands\-on experience with one or more of these technologies is required, as they represent the core platforms owned, developed and supported by our team.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

* Design, develop, test and maintain digital solutions supporting People \& Culture processes.
* Build secure, scalable and maintainable software products, automations and integrations.
* Configure, develop and support solutions within UiPath, SAP SuccessFactors Accenture Document Composer, Adobe Sign and Microsoft Power Platform.
* Take ownership of solutions from technical design and development through deployment, operation, maintenance and continuous improvement.
* Develop intelligent automation solutions that improve employee experience, operational efficiency and service quality.
**Who are you?**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field.
* Experience in software development, automation engineering, application configuration or digital product development.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of the following technologies: UiPath, SAP SuccessFactors Accenture Document Composer, Adobe Sign or Microsoft Power Platform.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations and enterprise applications.
* Understanding of modern software engineering practices, testing methodologies and DevOps principles.
* Experience working within Agile product teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions.
* Self\-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Proactive and collaborative communication style
* Capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience within HR technology, People \& Culture processes or Employee Services environments is considered a strong advantage.
**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------

* Opportunity to shape the future of HR through technology.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge automation, AI and digital product initiatives.
* Work within a global Agile product organization with high visibility and business impact.
* End\-to\-end ownership, from understanding business challenges to delivering value through technology.
* Collaboration with HR and Digital \& IT professionals across Volvo Group.
* International projects with global reach and impact.
* Engaging assignments using modern technologies and platforms.
* Flexible work arrangements and hybrid work model.
* Comprehensive onboarding and support from experienced colleagues.
* Continuous learning opportunities through Volvo Group University.
* Professional growth opportunities within software engineering, hyperautomation, AI and digital transformation.
**Ready for the next move?**
----------------------------


If you are excited about building digital solutions, leveraging automation and AI, and creating better experiences for employees across Volvo Group, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Join our Global Digital Delivery team and help us make HR simpler, smarter and more human through technology.**

  

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**  

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

  

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

  

At **Group People \& Culture**, a part of Volvo Group, we create the foundation and frameworks for people growth and organizational development, to drive the people agenda that enables the realization of the Volvo Group aspirations through people strategy and commitment. You will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead.

title: Principal Product Manager - HR Platforms & Technology
description:
**We're looking for a** 
****Principal Product Manager \- HR Platforms \& Technology****
**This role is** 
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
**Principal Product Manager \| HR Technology \& Platforms \| Hyderabad**
**Summary**
 Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to grow our performance and talent management agent portfolio, leading the delivery of AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing AI\-native product management role for a hands\-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI\-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross\-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems. As our agent portfolio grows, individual agents increasingly work together to compound value for customers, and this role will help shape how new agents fit into that broader picture.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is highly execution\-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor
   

  

**About The Team**
 You'll join a growing product team building AI\-native agents for the performance and talent management domain, part of a broader portfolio of enterprise outcome agents at Cornerstone. Our agents help enterprise customers connect everyday work to business outcomes, from goal\-setting to performance reviews to coaching and development. As the portfolio expands, we're increasingly focused on how individual agents can work together to create more value than any single agent alone. This role is an opportunity to help shape that next chapter, taking ownership of new agent areas as the team grows.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 In your first 6 to 12 months, you will:
   

  

* Take end\-to\-end ownership of one or more new agent initiatives within the performance and talent domain, from customer discovery through working prototype.
* Build strong relationships with customers, FDEs, and engineering partners, establishing a fast, repeatable feedback loop between discovery and prototype iteration.
* Ship a working AI\-native prototype that customers and internal stakeholders can review, test, and validate against real business problems.
* Identify meaningful opportunities for your agent(s) to complement others in the portfolio, contributing to how the team thinks about multi\-agent value.
* Establish yourself as a trusted, execution\-oriented voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into shipped product direction with minimal oversight


**In This Role You Will**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of new AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents within the performance and talent management domain, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch.
* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes in performance management, goal\-setting, and talent development.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined.
* Identify opportunities for new agents to complement existing ones in the portfolio, contributing to a cohesive experience as agents are increasingly deployed together.
* Build and evolve working prototypes using AI\-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms, using prototypes as the new PRD motion so customers, FDEs, and engineering can review, test, and refine solutions directly.
* Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch, working in tight feedback loops to confirm value and shape deliverable product capabilities.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go\-to\-market teams to bring validated concepts into production.
* Turn customer specific outcome agents into re\-sellable out\-of\-the box agents.
* Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt.
* Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business\-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes.


**You Have Got What It Takes If You Have**
* 5\+ years of experience in product management, including significant experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or platform products.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
* Strong track record in customer\-facing product delivery for enterprise SaaS or AI\-native products.
* Demonstrated ability to go from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes and launched solutions.
* Experience collaborating closely with customers and technical delivery partners such as FDEs to iterate rapidly and launch customer\-ready solutions.
* Strong product execution skills, including prioritization, prototype validation, release planning, cross\-functional coordination, and delivery tracking.
* Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into structured product requirements and testable product experiences.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-moving, matrixed environments and drive alignment across technical and business teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the performance management or broader HR technology space, for example goal\-setting platforms, performance review tools, or coaching and enablement platforms.
* Experience contributing to a multi\-product or multi\-agent portfolio, with an understanding of how individual products can be designed to work well together.
* Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow agents, or decision\-support products.
* Demonstrated success using rapid prototyping to accelerate product\-market fit and customer adoption.
* Experience working in close partnership with customer success, services, sales, and solution delivery teams.


**Our Culture**
 Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. title: HR Intern
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

* 📍 Location: Koramangala, Bangalore
* 🕒 Working Days: 6 days/week, 1 rotational weekly off
* ⏰ Shift Timings: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Standard office hours)
* 💼 Experience: Fresher (0–1 year)
* 📅 Contract Duration: 3 Months


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly motivated and highly organized Talent Acquisition Intern to join our team at Instawork. In this role, you will get hands\-on experience working on end\-to\-end recruitment, serving as the critical bridge between our hiring teams and prospective candidates.
   

  

 If you enjoy speaking with people, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to build a strong foundation in human resources and talent acquisition, this opportunity is a great starting point.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage End\-to\-End Recruitment: Support the full recruitment lifecycle for various open positions.
* High\-Volume Outreach: Source, screen, and make 100–150 outbound calls daily to prospective candidates.
* Interview Coordination: Take ownership of lining up and scheduling interviews between candidates and internal hiring teams.
* Candidate Communication: Manage ongoing follow\-ups, gather feedback, and ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Data Management: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of calls, candidate statuses, and interview schedules.


**Requirements**
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a confident and professional phone presence.
* Strong organizational skills, multitasking abilities, and exceptional attention to detail (crucial for interview coordination).
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume calling environment.
* Prior experience in HR, recruitment, or customer\-facing roles is preferred but not mandatory.


**Compensation \& Benefits** 
  

  

* 💰 Base Stipend: ₹20,000 per month
* 🍱 Food Allowance: ₹200 per day
* Perks \& Benefits:
+ Collaborative team culture and vibrant office environment.
+ Hands\-on exposure to full\-cycle talent acquisition and HR operations.
+ Strong career growth opportunities by learning the core mechanics of tech and business hiring.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

**About The Role**
**Role Description:**

Working under general direction, this role applies established methodologies and specialized knowledge to support job architecture, job levelling, and functional and global career framework activities. The role analyses job and organization information, prepares preliminary levelling recommendations, and maintains accurate documentation.
   

  

 The role partners with Compensation colleagues and other HR stakeholders to support fair and consistent placement of roles within internal and external career frameworks. It also contributes to process improvements and the responsible use of approved AI\-enabled tools.

* Coordinate defined workstreams supporting functional career progression frameworks, including stakeholder inputs, meeting materials, milestones, and documentation.
* Use approved AI\-supported job analysis tools to summarize job content, compare roles against established framework criteria, and improve consistency, while applying appropriate human review and confidentiality controls.
* Contribute to the testing and implementation of process and technology enhancements with the Total Rewards Technology Manager and Compensation partners by documenting requirements, validating outputs, and reporting issues.
* Research relevant practices and trends in job architecture, career frameworks, job evaluation, AI, and HR technology; synthesize findings and share practical observations with the team.

title: HR Business Partner – People & Culture | Hyderabad
description:
**People Are at the Heart of Impact.**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, our work is about creating opportunities for young people.**

**But sustainable impact doesn't happen without the people behind it.**

Great Centre Heads.  
Committed facilitators.  
Passionate outreach teams.  
Strong program leaders.  
People who show up every day because they believe the work matters.

**We're looking for an HR Business Partner who can help these people thrive.**

This is a hands\-on, field\-facing HR role where you'll work closely with leaders and teams across Hyderabad, understand what is happening on the ground, solve people challenges, strengthen HR practices, and help build a culture where employees can do their best work.

If you see HR as more than policies and processes — and believe that **strong people practices create stronger social impact** — this could be your opportunity.

**About Lighthouse Communities Foundation**

**Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF)** works in the areas of skilling, employability, and livelihoods for underserved youth.

Our Lighthouse model brings together **Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Communities** through a Public\-Private Partnership to create sustainable pathways towards employment and socio\-economic transformation.

Our centres are built around collaboration — with different stakeholders contributing resources, expertise, networks, and capabilities to help young people access better opportunities.

**Our work is guided by:**

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

**Your Role: Be the Bridge Between People \& Purpose**

As an HR Business Partner, you'll partner with regional leadership, Centre Heads, program teams, and employees to make sure our people practices support both **employee experience and organisational outcomes**.

You'll work across:

**Hiring → Onboarding → Development → Performance → Employee Relations → Culture → Organisational Growth**

And because our teams work across centres and communities, this is a **field\-facing HR role**.

You won't just hear about people challenges in meetings.

**You'll go where the teams are. Listen. Understand. Solve. Build.**

**What You Will Do**

**Partner With Leaders \& Teams**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers across the assigned region.
* Partner with Centre Heads and program leaders on people\-related matters.
* Understand team dynamics, people challenges, and organisational needs.
* Provide practical HR guidance to managers and employees.
* Coach leaders on people management and employee\-related issues.
* Ensure HR support is timely, accessible, and solution\-oriented.

**Build Teams That Can Deliver Impact**

**Great programs need great people.**

**You'll support the complete employee journey, including:**

* Recruitment coordination.
* Candidate screening.
* Interview processes.
* Offer and joining coordination.
* Employee onboarding.
* New\-hire orientation.
* Early\-stage employee support.

**You'll work closely with hiring managers and central HR to ensure we bring in people who are not only capable, but also aligned with our values and mission.**

**Help People Grow**

* Partner with central HR teams to implement learning and development initiatives.
* Identify capability\-building needs across teams.
* Support training and development programs.
* Encourage a culture of continuous learning.
* Work with managers to identify development opportunities for their teams.

**Make Performance Management Meaningful**

**Performance management should be more than an annual form.**

**You'll support managers and employees with:**

* Goal setting.
* Performance reviews.
* Development planning.
* Regular feedback.
* Performance conversations.
* Capability\-building interventions.
* Performance improvement processes where required.

**The goal is to create clarity, accountability, and growth — while ensuring performance practices are fair and aligned with organisational expectations.**

**Support Employee Relations**

* Serve as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers.
* Listen to employee concerns and help identify appropriate solutions.
* Support resolution of workplace issues in a fair and timely manner.
* Help managers navigate sensitive people situations.
* Promote a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
* Ensure organisational policies and processes are understood and followed.

**Strengthen HR Practices Across Centres**

**Our teams work across different centres and communities.**

**You'll help ensure consistency while remaining sensitive to local realities.**

**This includes:**

* Implementing HR policies and processes.
* Supporting compliance requirements.
* Ensuring employees understand relevant policies.
* Identifying gaps in HR processes.
* Working with central HR to improve employee experience.
* Ensuring HR practices are aligned with organisational goals, values, and requirements.

**Use Data to Understand People**

**Good HR decisions need more than intuition.**

**You'll:**

* Monitor HR metrics and trends.
* Track hiring, onboarding, retention, performance, and other relevant people indicators.
* Identify patterns and areas requiring attention.
* Generate insights for leadership.
* Recommend practical solutions to improve HR effectiveness.

The question isn't just:

**“What is the number?”**

It's:

**“What is the number telling us about our people?”**

Be Present Where the Work Happens

This role involves **up to 70% travel across centres in the assigned region**.

**You'll spend significant time with teams on the ground, building relationships, understanding local realities, and providing hands\-on HR support.**

**If you're someone who enjoys being close to the action rather than spending every day behind a desk, you'll enjoy this role.**

**Who Are We Looking For?**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration**, or a related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.

Experience

* **3–4 years of HR experience**.
* Experience in areas such as:
* Talent acquisition
* Employee relations
* Performance management
* Learning \& development
* People management
* Organisational development

**Experience in a nonprofit, social\-impact, education, skilling, or field\-based organisation is an advantage.**

**Communication**

* Excellent communication skills in **English and Hindi**.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees across different roles and backgrounds.
* Strong listening, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If...**

**You're someone who:**

* Sees HR as a business and people partner — not just a process owner.
* Is comfortable having difficult conversations with empathy and clarity.
* Can coach a manager through a people problem rather than simply quoting policy.
* Enjoys meeting people where they work.
* Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and operational problem\-solving.
* Is curious about what is happening on the ground.
* Can work with people from very different backgrounds and roles.
* Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Can work independently and take ownership.
* Believes that inclusion is something you **build into everyday decisions**, not just something you write in a policy.
* Is genuinely motivated by the idea that better people practices can lead to better outcomes for young people.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In this role, success isn't simply:**

**“HR processes were completed.”**

It's when:

* The right people are hired at the right time.
* New employees feel welcomed and supported.
* Managers become stronger people leaders.
* Employees know what is expected of them.
* Performance conversations happen with clarity and fairness.
* Teams feel heard and supported.

* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

* Experience delivering cross\-functional integrations and enterprise\-scale solutions.
* Proven success operating in fast\-paced, global environments with complex operational needs.
* Strong organizational, analytical, strategic thinking, and problem\-solving skills.

* Advanced business process framework configuration and security administration.
* Expertise in Advanced Reporting and complex calculated fields.
* Strong integration development and troubleshooting skills, including Workday Studio and EIBs.
* Experience supporting SOX and audit compliance initiatives.
* Solid business acumen with the ability to think strategically and execute tactically.
* Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn, experiment, and adopt new technologies in an agile environment to improve platform scalability, resilience, and reliability.

title: Executive-HR Shared Services
description:
Job Title Executive - HR Shared Services
 Department Human Resources 
 Location Gurgaon

 Job Profile: 
To manage the end-to-end HR Shared Services activities for the Cadet Pilot Program, ensuring seamless coordination of candidate assessments, documentation, onboarding, LOI execution, training tracking, stakeholder management, and compliance with defined SLAs and organizational policies. The role is responsible for delivering an exceptional candidate experience while ensuring process governance, data accuracy, and audit readiness throughout the cadet lifecycle. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Cadet Selection & Assessment Coordination 
 Coordinate end-to-end assessment activities including psychometric tests, Group Discussions (GD), and Personal Interviews (PI). Manage scheduling and communication with candidates, Flight Operations, panelists, FTOs, and Talent Acquisition teams. Track assessment outcomes and ensure timely status updates in SuccessFactors (SF). Ensure process adherence and SLA compliance throughout the selection lifecycle. 2. Documentation & Compliance Management 
 Validate candidate documents as per program requirements. Coordinate background verification, medical fitness, drug test clearances, and statutory documentation. Maintain complete and accurate records of all candidate files. Ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. 3. Letter of Intent (LOI) & Agreement Management 
 Prepare and coordinate Letter of Intent (LOI), Specialized Training Agreements (STA), Surety Agreements, and related documents. Liaise with internal stakeholders for approvals and digital signatures. Ensure timely issuance, execution, and repository management of signed documents. Maintain agreement trackers and document audit trails. 4. Candidate Onboarding & HR Operations 
 Facilitate onboarding activities from pre-joining to induction. Coordinate with HR, TA, Flight Operations, Medical, and Finance teams. Ensure timely creation and activation of employee records and required system updates. Support candidates throughout onboarding for seamless transition into training programs. 5. Training Monitoring & Tracker Management 
 Maintain Cadet Training Trackers and monitor progress across FTOs. Track milestones including training commencement, ground school completion, and overall program timelines. Identify and escalate delays, risks, and red flags to stakeholders. Generate periodic MIS reports and management dashboards. 6. Stakeholder Coordination 
 Act as the primary HRSS SPOC for Cadet Program operations. Coordinate with Flight Operations, Talent Acquisition, Flight Training Organizations (FTOs), Finance, Legal, Medical, and 6E People teams. Manage stakeholder communications and ensure timely resolution of queries and issues. Drive process improvements and standardization initiatives. 
 7. Data Governance & Process Compliance 
 Ensure data accuracy across trackers, HR systems, and records. Maintain audit readiness for all HRSS-managed cadet processes. Support SOP creation, process documentation, and continuous improvement projects. Adhere to defined SLAs and governance standards. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 SLA adherence for onboarding and documentation activities Assessment coordination accuracy Tracker accuracy and data quality Timely issuance of LOI/STA agreements Training milestone tracking compliance Stakeholder satisfaction score Audit observation closure rate Process turnaround time (TAT) adherence 
 Qualifications 
 Education 
 Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline. MBA/PGDM in HR preferred. Experience 
 3-5 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, Employee Lifecycle Management, Recruitment Operations, or Onboarding. Experience in aviation HR operations will be an added advantage. 
 
 Required Skills 
 Functional Skills 
 HR Operations & Shared Services Candidate Lifecycle Management HR Documentation & Compliance MIS Reporting & Analytics SuccessFactors ServiceNow Ticket Management Technical Skills 
 Advanced Microsoft Excel PowerPoint Microsoft Forms SharePoint Behavioral Competencies 
 Attention to Detail Stakeholder Management Process Orientation Customer Centricity Communication Skills Planning & Coordination Problem Solving Ownership & Accountability

**Position Title:** 
 Digital HR Analyst
   

  

**Position Type:** 
 Regular \- Full\-Time
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 41957
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Digital HR Analyst supports the design, configuration, testing, and optimization of HR technology systems whether through hands on implementation or strong business partnering with Technology resources. This role focuses on system functionality, access governance, elevated troubleshooting, and continuous enhancement.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone with strong hands\-on HR technology experience, playing a larger role in system configuration of HR processes, can communicate strongly to ensure HR needs translate into sound system logic and influence design, enjoys working cross functionally and has strong project management skills.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
 .
   

  

**Driving Technology Advancement**
* Appropriately solve HR problems with sustainable technical solutions in line with HR strategy, proactively managing impacts across systems, people and process.
* Configure and maintain HR systems according to requirements, updating settings, foundational data, workflows and security roles with precision.
* Serve as a key escalation point for complex system issues, partnering with IT and vendors to troubleshoot and resolve root causes.
* Own the full UAT lifecycle for their enhancements, including test script development, tester coordination, and validation that system updates support accurate and efficient business processes. Documents results, mitigates risks before deployment, identifies change impacts requiring communication or training, and surfaces process gaps to guide future enhancements.

**Access Management**

* Partner with IT to align HR systems with enterprise security standards.


**User Enablement**
* Keep clear and consistent technical documentation, job aids and user guides updated, ensuring relevance and health of HR technology content.
* Contributing content to, and answering questions from, Digital Training initiatives to support HR staff in interacting with our technology.


**Cross Functional Collaboration**
* Provide expert input on system capabilities, constraints, and configuration options related to prioritized strategic initiatives.
* Facilitate working sessions to gather requirements, validate designs, and resolve issues where required.
* Represent HR in digital or process improvement initiatives as a subject matter contributor.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 3\-5 years of hands\-on HR Technology or business analyst experience.
* Certification in one or more of our key HR platforms (Time and attendance platform (UKG Workforce Pro is Preferred) and ServiceNow, Phenom, SuccessFactors).
* Strong understanding of HR processes (employee lifecycle, onboarding, timekeeping, talent management, performance, etc.)
* Proven ability to identify and manage change impacts of technology redesign.
* Strong ability to analyze issues, conduct root cause analysis and provide technically sound and sustainable solutions to problems, proactively mitigating impacts.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross functional teams.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
* Enhancement coordination from facilitating requirement building for large process areas, design blueprinting, configuration, unit testing, user acceptance testing, change, deployment, operationalization.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working in an agile manner, i.e. sprint\-based execution.
* Experience using Agile tools to track work.

* System changes deployed smoothly with fewer defects and minimal post\-release issues because validation is thorough and aligned with business processes.
* Recurring issues trend downward because root causes are being addressed.
* UAT cycles run efficiently, with clear scripts, coordinated testers, and well documented results. Defects are caught early, reducing rework and preventing production disruptions.
* Adoption improves because systems are configured to meet broad business problems, have sustainable solutions the support HR processes, there are fewer process breakdowns and increased user experience.
* SOPs, test scripts and configuration notes are current, reducing knowledge gaps, streamlining project discovery and operations are more predictable/scalable.
* You are recognized as a trusted problem solver and reliable partner who understands both HR processes and technology.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.


With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.


Focused on S4HANA, Data \& Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.


Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision\-making, our client\-first and open\-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for an experienced SAP System Architect with strong HR/HCM expertise to lead the design and implementation of the HR Mini Master (HRMM) solution within an SAP S/4HANA transformation program.


The role focuses on the HR data and processes required within S/4HANA, rather than the full SAP HCM suite. You will be responsible for defining the solution architecture, ensuring effective integration with surrounding systems, and supporting the solution throughout implementation and deployment.

**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Define and own the solution architecture for HR Mini Master (HRMM) in SAP S/4HANA.
* Design the HRMM solution based on business and technical requirements, covering the relevant subset of SAP HCM functionality required in S/4HANA.
* Define how employee and organizational data is represented and maintained within S/4HANA.
* Design and oversee integrations between HRMM and other SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable solution designs.

title: Learning & Development Specialist - GCC (Night Shift Operations)
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**
 Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.
   

  

**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**
 At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.
   

  

 Impact In This Role
   

  

 This role partners closely with HR, Operations, Quality, Product, and Team Leads but does not own employee relations, policy interpretation, payroll, benefits, leave, disciplinary action, or formal performance management processes. Employee questions or matters outside the learning scope should be redirected to the appropriate HR or management owner.
   

  

 Shift alignment: Operates in the North America shift with partial overlap into the India day shift to support coordination across global L\&D, Operations Product, and HR stakeholders as needed for learning program alignment.
   

  

 Daily learning operations support: Coordinate and support routine L\&D activities including training schedules, onboarding learning logistics, LMS tracking, learner communications, training completion follow\-up, and new\-hire learning progress reporting.
   

  

 What You’ll Be Doing
   

  

**Areas of Responsibility:**
* Training Delivery \& Facilitation
* Onboarding \& Foundational Training: Facilitate onboarding learning programs for new hires covering company platforms, proprietary software, company workflows, and core product knowledge.
* Skill\-Based Workshops: Deliver training sessions on customer service, professional communication, and quality standards.
* Continuous Upskilling: Conduct regular training sessions on technical system updates, new AI tools, and evolving process workflows.
* Refresher Training: Run quarterly skill reinforcement sessions to fix knowledge gaps and maintain high process adherence among existing staff.
* Blended Learning Delivery: Select and use appropriate learning formats (classroom, virtual, self\-paced, or blended) based on the audience and business needs.
* Content Development \& Stakeholder Management
* Material Creation: Design and build clear instructional assets, including facilitator guides, participant workbooks, presentation decks, quick\-reference job aids, and basic e\-learning modules.
* Content Maintenance: Partner with internal stakeholders, product experts, and team managers to update training materials, process guides, and job aids whenever software, tools, or customer support procedures change.
* Strategic Alignment: Partner with Customer Service (CS) leadership to forecast future growth and map out upcoming training needs for the team.
* Coaching \& Performance Evaluation
* Training Needs Analysis: Review call, email, and workflow examples in partnership with Team Leads and Quality/Ops stakeholders to identify recurring gaps and training needs.
* Skill Coaching: Provide targeted learning reinforcement and practice support to help team members apply training concepts, improve workflow understanding, and strengthen customer support.
* New\-Hire Learning Progress: Track new\-hire learning progress through their first 30\-60\-90 days, coordinating with Team Leads to identify training gaps and provide targeted refresher support. Effectiveness Tracking: Evaluate training effectiveness using knowledge checks, assessments, learner feedback, completion data and post\-training skill application trends.
* Training Coordination, Admin \& LMS
* Logistics Management: Organize training schedules, handle calendar invites, prepare materials, and accurately track session attendance.
* LMS Administration: Manage the Learning Management System (LMS) by uploading digital courses, assigning learning tracks, and keeping user records clean and updated.
* Reporting \& Dashboards: Compile clear reports, summaries, and dashboards on training completion rates, learner feedback, assessment results, refresher needs and learning progress for leadership.
* Vendor Support: Assist with the administrative management of external training vendors, facilitators, or content providers as required.
* Culture \& Leadership Enablement
* Leadership Enablement: Help Team Leads understand training outcomes, reinforce learning expectations, and identify where additional learning support may be needed for their teams.
* Advanced Facilitation: Assist in running workshops focused on global mindsets, strategic thinking, and collaborative leadership.
* Living our Core Values: Help reinforce company culture and core values across the GCC through learning activities, workshops, onboarding content, and manager enablement resources.


 Desired Traits:
   

  

**Education \& Experience**
 Degree: Bachelor's degree (Education, Business, Human Resources, Engineering or a related field is a plus). Training certifications (like Train\-the\-Trainer) are a bonus.
   

  

 Experience: 2–4 years of relevant experience in training facilitation and content development, (classroom, virtual, or blended). Up to 10 years of overall working experience (ideally in customer service or a GCC).
   

  

**Technical Skills**
 LMS: Comfortable using an LMS (Learning Management System) and quick to learn new software.
   

  

 MS Office: Strong skills in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word to create reports and presentations.
   

  

 Process Focus: Ability to read technical data, system updates, and manual procedures, and translate them into simple training points.
   

  

**Core Skills \& Attributes**
 Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication. Confident speaking in front of groups and handling feedback sessions smoothly.
   

  

 Data \& Tracking: Ability to track and interpret learning data, including attendance, completion rates, assessment results, learner feedback, and post\-training application indicators.
   

  

 Organization: Strong planning skills to manage training schedules, deadlines, and materials without losing attention to detail.
   

  

 Mindset: Understands the daily pace of customer support/GCC work, works well with teams, and handles learner data, training records, and sensitive learning feedback with maturity.
   

  

 Travel: Open to domestic and international travel if required.
   

  

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
 We’re actively seeking teammates who:
   

  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates


 We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Senior Director, People Development and Enablement
description:
India, Hyderabad
   

  

 Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents.
   

  

 While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
   

  

 At Lonza, we are looking for a Senior Director, People Development and Enablement to lead the development and execution of our global Learning \& Enablement strategy, shaping how our people and leaders build the capabilities needed to support Lonza’s long\-term success. This strategic leadership role will oversee a diverse portfolio spanning learning products, digital platforms, leadership development, employee engagement, and enterprise capability solutions.
   

  

 Based in Hyderabad, you will partner with senior leaders and the global HR community to translate business and capability needs into scalable, innovative solutions. You will lead cross\-functional and agile teams, drive the evolution of our digital learning ecosystem, and use employee insights and data to strengthen engagement, leadership effectiveness, and organizational capability across Lonza.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and evolve Lonza’s global Learning \& Enablement strategy, frameworks, standards, and governance, ensuring alignment with business priorities and organizational capability needs.
* Lead the global portfolio of learning products and solutions, driving consistency, quality, scalability, adoption, and continuous improvement across the enterprise.
* Diagnose business challenges and capability gaps, translating complex requirements into practical, innovative, and reusable learning solutions, toolkits, playbooks, and frameworks.
* Shape the strategy and evolution of Lonza’s digital learning ecosystem, including Learn@Lonza, creating an engaging learner experience and driving sustainable adoption of digital learning solutions.
* Define and embed global leadership development frameworks and solutions that strengthen leadership capability and support Lonza’s culture and strategic priorities.
* Lead the global employee engagement survey strategy, enhancing insights and reporting while translating employee feedback into targeted actions that improve engagement, performance, retention, and the overall employee experience.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, HR Business Partners, and key stakeholders, providing expert consultation and building alignment around learning, leadership, engagement, and capability priorities.
* Lead cross\-functional and agile teams to design and implement enterprise solutions, while bringing external trends, market insights, and innovative practices into Lonza’s People Development agenda.
* Establish meaningful metrics and analytics to measure effectiveness, learner engagement, adoption, business impact, and ROI, using insights to continuously improve solutions and services.
* Manage the learning and enablement ecosystem of external partners, consultants, and technology vendors, ensuring quality, value, innovation, and alignment with Lonza’s requirements.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in Learning \& Development, leadership development, organizational capability, talent, employee engagement, or related People/HR disciplines.
* Deep expertise in developing and executing global learning, leadership development, and organizational capability strategies within complex, multinational organizations.
* Proven experience designing and managing enterprise learning products, programmes, frameworks, toolkits, and scalable capability\-building solutions.
* Strong expertise in digital learning technologies, learning platforms, and learner experience, with demonstrated success driving adoption and sustainable use of digital solutions.
* Experience developing leadership capability frameworks and solutions that strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational culture, and business performance.
* Proven experience leveraging employee engagement surveys, workforce insights, analytics, and employee feedback to inform decisions and drive targeted organizational interventions.
* Strong consulting and business partnering skills, with the ability to diagnose business needs, influence senior stakeholders, and translate requirements into pragmatic and scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated success leading global, cross\-functional, and agile teams and driving change, innovation, and continuous improvement in complex matrix environments.
* Strong data orientation with experience measuring effectiveness, adoption, business impact, and ROI, combined with solid portfolio, vendor, and budget management capabilities.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Human Resources or a related discipline required. Business fluency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.


 Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
   

  

 People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.
   

  

 Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
