title: General Manager - Human Resources
description:
General Manager – Corporate Human Resources

**Location:** Corporate Office, Mumbai  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reporting To:** Senior Vice President  
**Scope:** All Hotels \& Business Units across India

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **General Manager – Corporate Human Resources** to lead and oversee the Human Resources function across all hotels and business units of the group in India.

The role will be responsible for driving the overall HR strategy, ensuring consistency in HR practices across properties, strengthening the Unit HR function, building leadership capabilities, managing talent and manpower planning, ensuring employee engagement and compliance, and partnering with business leaders to create a high\-performance and people\-focused culture.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **hospitality HR**, excellent leadership and communication skills, and the ability to manage HR operations across multiple properties and geographies.

Key Responsibilities1\. Corporate HR Strategy \& Leadership

* Develop and implement the group's overall HR strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Lead and guide the HR function across all hotels and corporate offices.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies, systems, processes, and best practices across all properties.
* Act as a strategic HR partner to Senior Management, GMs, HODs, and business leaders.
* Provide HR insights, recommendations, and solutions to the Corporate Leadership Team.
* Drive a strong performance\-oriented, employee\-centric, and accountable HR culture.

2\. Unit HR Management

* Lead, mentor, and monitor all Unit HR Managers/HR teams across India.
* Establish clear KRAs, KPIs, and performance expectations for Unit HR teams.
* Conduct regular reviews with Unit HR teams and General Managers.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of HR reports, manpower reports, attendance, training, compliance, and other HR MIS.
* Identify gaps in Unit HR performance and implement corrective action plans.
* Standardize HR practices and ensure effective communication between Corporate HR and hotel HR teams.

3\. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment

* Drive manpower planning and budgeting across all hotels.
* Review manpower requirements and ensure recruitment is aligned with approved manpower budgets.
* Oversee recruitment for key positions across properties.
* Strengthen recruitment channels and talent pipelines for hospitality roles.
* Ensure proper recruitment controls, approvals, selection processes, and documentation.
* Develop strategies for reducing vacancies and improving time\-to\-fill.
* Build a strong internal talent pool for future leadership requirements.

4\. Talent Management \& Succession Planning

* Develop and implement talent management and succession planning initiatives.
* Identify high\-potential employees and future leaders across properties.
* Drive career progression, internal mobility, promotions, and development programs.
* Strengthen leadership development initiatives for GMs, HODs, and emerging leaders.
* Monitor critical positions and ensure succession plans are in place.
* Develop retention strategies for key and high\-performing employees.

5\. Learning \& Development

* Establish the group's annual Learning \& Development strategy.
* Identify training needs across hotels and departments.
* Monitor implementation of training calendars and development plans.
* Drive leadership, functional, behavioural, compliance, and hospitality\-specific training.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and ROI.
* Develop structured development programs for employees at different career levels.

6\. Performance Management

* Lead the annual performance management process across the group.
* Ensure KRAs, KPIs, goal setting, performance reviews, and appraisals are implemented effectively.
* Work with GMs and HODs to address performance gaps.
* Drive performance improvement plans wherever required.
* Establish a high\-performance culture with clear accountability.

7\. Employee Engagement \& Retention

* Develop and drive employee engagement initiatives across all properties.
* Monitor employee satisfaction, engagement, attrition, and retention trends.
* Conduct regular employee engagement reviews and identify key concerns.
* Develop action plans to reduce employee turnover.
* Promote a positive workplace culture and strong employee relations.
* Ensure effective grievance handling and resolution.

8\. HR Policies \& Process Excellence

* Develop, review, update, and implement corporate HR policies and SOPs.
* Ensure uniform implementation of policies across all hotels.
* Continuously identify opportunities to simplify and improve HR processes.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to approved HR procedures.
* Drive HR digitization and automation wherever possible.

9\. Compensation \& Benefits

* Oversee salary structures, compensation benchmarking, increments, promotions, and benefits.
* Review manpower budgets and salary budgets in coordination with Finance and Business Heads.
* Ensure compensation practices are competitive and internally equitable.
* Monitor attrition trends and recommend appropriate retention measures.
* Review employee benefits and welfare initiatives.

10\. Employee Relations \& Industrial Relations

* Handle and guide Unit HR teams on complex employee relations matters.
* Ensure proper disciplinary processes and documentation.
* Support management in handling employee grievances, misconduct, disciplinary actions, and separations.
* Ensure appropriate coordination with legal/consulting teams wherever required.
* Maintain a positive and professional employee relations environment across properties.

11\. Statutory Compliance \& HR Governance

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements across all properties.
* Monitor statutory registers, licenses, notices, audits, and required HR documentation.
* Coordinate with Unit HR teams and external consultants for compliance requirements.
* Conduct periodic HR audits across hotels.
* Identify compliance risks and ensure timely corrective action.

12\. HR MIS \& Analytics

* Establish standardized HR dashboards and reporting formats across the group.
* Monitor key HR metrics including:
* Headcount
* Manpower budget vs. actual
* Vacancy levels
* Attrition
* Recruitment turnaround time
* Employee cost
* Training hours
* Absenteeism
* Employee engagement
* Promotions and internal movements
* Retention
* Present HR analytics and recommendations to Corporate Leadership.

13\. HR Audits \& Governance

* Conduct periodic HR audits across hotels.
* Review adherence to Corporate HR policies and SOPs.
* Identify gaps in HR processes, documentation, manpower, attendance, recruitment, training, and compliance.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Strengthen HR governance and accountability at property level.

14\. Culture \& Employer Branding

* Build and strengthen the organization's employer brand.
* Develop initiatives to position the group as an employer of choice within the hospitality industry.
* Promote internal career opportunities and employee success stories.
* Strengthen employee communication and recognition programs.
* Support initiatives that improve employee experience across the group.

15\. Business Partnership

* Work closely with General Managers and business leaders to understand operational challenges and provide HR solutions.
* Participate in strategic business discussions and pre\-opening/expansion initiatives.
* Support organizational restructuring, new hotel openings, acquisitions, and business growth.
* Provide HR recommendations on organizational design, manpower, productivity, and people costs.

Key Deliverables / KRAs

The position will be accountable for:

* Effective HR governance across all hotels in India.
* Improved employee retention and reduced attrition.
* Timely closure of critical vacancies.
* Strong manpower planning and cost control.
* Development and retention of high\-potential talent.
* Effective succession planning for critical positions.
* Consistent implementation of HR policies across properties.
* Improved performance management and employee productivity.
* Strong employee engagement and workplace culture.
* 100% statutory and HR compliance.
* Effective development and performance of Unit HR teams.
* Accurate and timely Corporate HR MIS.
* Successful implementation of Corporate HR initiatives and programs.

Candidate ProfileEducation

* MBA / PGDM / Master's degree in Human Resources or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* Hotel Management qualification would be an advantage.

Experience

* **15\+ years of progressive HR experience**, preferably within the hospitality industry.
* Strong experience managing HR across **multiple hotels/properties and locations**.
* Prior experience in a **Corporate HR / Regional HR / Cluster HR leadership role** is preferred.
* Experience managing and mentoring a large HR team across multiple locations.

Required Skills

* Strong leadership and people\-management skills.
* Excellent knowledge of hospitality HR practices.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Strategic thinking with strong business acumen.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and decision\-making ability.
* Ability to influence and work with Senior Management and General Managers.
* Strong negotiation and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Excellent knowledge of HR policies, processes, and systems.
* Strong presentation and HR MIS skills.
* Ability to travel extensively across India.

Leadership Competencies

* Strategic HR Leadership
* Business Partnership
* People \& Talent Management
* Decision Making
* Stakeholder Management
* Change Management
* Problem Solving
* Employee Advocacy
* Commercial Awareness
* Team Development
* Execution Excellence
* Integrity \& Confidentiality

Travel Requirement

**Extensive travel across India** will be required to visit hotels, conduct HR reviews and audits, meet Unit HR teams and General Managers, support business requirements, and drive Corporate HR initiatives.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on, strategic, and business\-oriented HR leader** who can manage HR at both the corporate and property level, build strong relationships with GMs and Unit HR teams, and ensure that people practices directly support the group's growth and operational objectives.

title: Sr. Manager - Employee Relations (International) - 2246
description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 The Employee Relations (ER) Manager will be responsible for strengthening Medline’s International employee relations framework and practice by proactively addressing workplace issues, coaching managers \& employees, ensuring legal compliance, and promoting a culture of openness and fairness.
   

  

 This role will work in close collaboration with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) across all International markets to ensure consistent, timely, and effective handling of people matters and to enable managers to build high\-performing, compliant, and engaged teams.
   

  

 The role will also be accountable for managing investigations into cases raised via EthicsPoint (Medline´s case management system for concerns raised by employees).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Employee Relations \& Compliance Management**
 Act as an advisor to local HR teams on employee relations matters and partner with HRBPs for holistic case handling. Conduct fair, thorough, and unbiased investigations into workplace concerns, escalated via EthicsPoint or through other channels, domestic enquiry, grievances, misconduct, or policy violations, in accordance with Medline policy and with adherence to principles of natural justice. Maintain detailed case documentation, track trends, and share monthly insights with internal stakeholders. Partner with Legal on cases involving significant risk and ensure preventive risk mitigation. Liaisons with corporate ER and legal team for reporting and global process alignment Support statutory and internal audits related to employee relations, disciplinary actions, and compliance processes. Monitor adherence to HR policies and escalate deviations; recommend policy upgrades as needed. Manages the templates for formal communications that are outcomes of investigations and provides coaching \& guidance for local HR to complete them appropriately, in line with local requirements Provide guidance on the consistent application of disciplinary actions, PIPs, coaching plans, and corrective processes.
   

  

**Manager \& HRBP Enablement, Culture \& Process Strengthening**
 Upskill HRBPs and investigators around the management of the International investigation processes to ensure consistency and fairness in process Work closely with HRBPs to coach managers on handling performance issues, conflict resolution, conduct concerns, and difficult conversations. Build preventive ER capability through manager training, employee awareness sessions, playbooks, checklists, and communication resources. Strengthen team\-level trust, psychological safety, and communication by identifying patterns and early\-warning indicators. Collaborate with L\&D to embed ER best practices into manager development programs, including the facilitation of upskilling sessions for HR. Support HRBPs by reviewing performance documentation, PIP design, and ensuring process robustness. Partner with the international HR leadership team to identify, analyse and action plan recurring issues across our markets as an input to our employee relations agenda Ensure transparent, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders on ER matters.
   

  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 15 years of experience in Employee Relations roles, with demonstrated capability to operate in multinational organizations
* Experience operating in multiple countries in the context of a global capability center (as a center of expertise that provides corporate guidance and coaching across markets)
* Strong communication skills, with ability to engage at senior leadership level with credibility and impact
* Track record in strong cross functional collaboration, including with Legal and Compliance stakeholders. Coaching, influencing, documentation and follow\-up must be strengths.
* Hands\-on experience in managing investigations and drafting formal legal notices and letters.


**About Medline India**
 Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500\+ strong and growing team of technology, finance \& and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024\.
   

  

 We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered \& engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
   

  

**About Medline Industries, LP**
 Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
   

  

 At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the \#1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

title: Global Benefits Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Global Benefits Manager, you will manage and evolve BCG’s employee benefits programs across multiple regions, with a focus on health, life, disability, and business travel coverage. You will bring deep benefits expertise and strong analytical judgment to ensure programs remain competitive, well\-governed, compliant, and responsive to evolving business and employee needs.
   

  

 As part of the Global Benefits Centre of Expertise, you will manage complex benefits programs and initiatives, turn data and market insights into practical recommendations, and drive improvements across processes and the employee benefits experience. You will work closely with global and regional colleagues and external partners, providing guidance on complex benefits matters and helping shape consistent approaches across markets.
   

  

* Manage the delivery, review, and improvement of global benefits programs across multiple regions.
* Lead benchmarking, cost, and claims analyses to shape plan design, renewal, and wellbeing recommendations.
* Assess insurance contracts and plan documentation, identifying opportunities to improve value and manage risk.
* Lead global program renewals, partnering with brokers and insurers to drive high\-quality outcomes.
* Translate benefits data and market developments into practical insights and recommendations for decision\-making.
* Partner with HR and Finance teams to address complex benefits issues, manage costs, and improve program delivery.
* Drive improvements to benefits processes, documentation, governance, and the MyBenefits digital experience.
* Identify and manage program risks while supporting alignment with global standards and local regulatory requirements.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* You bring 6\- 8\+ years of experience in benefits management, broking, or consulting.
* You have deep knowledge of employee benefits, insured programs, and insurance market practices.
* You use strong analytical skills and judgment to turn complex data into practical recommendations.
* You bring advanced Excel skills and experience developing clear, decision\-focused presentations.
* You confidently manage complex priorities and programs across a global, matrixed environment.
* You communicate effectively with diverse audiences and influence decisions through clear, evidence\-based recommendations.
* You have experience with digital benefits platforms and identifying opportunities to improve employee experience.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will be part of BCG’s Global Benefits Centre of Expertise, working with colleagues across regions to shape and deliver high\-quality benefits programs. You will partner closely with global, regional, and local HR and Finance teams, bringing benefits expertise and practical recommendations to complex program and operational decisions.
   

  

 You will also build productive relationships with benefits brokers, insurers, and other external partners, working together to manage renewals, address emerging issues, and improve program performance. Across these relationships, you will help connect global priorities with local needs and drive greater consistency and effectiveness in how benefits are delivered.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 BCG is an E \- Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E\-Verify.

title: Head of Operations
description:
**HEAD OF OPERATIONS** 




**ContractBazaar \| Noida / Delhi NCR** 




**Experience:** 
 6–10 years
 



**Education:** 
 MBA /BBA / Operations or relevant experience
 



**Reports to:** 
 Founder
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




 As Head of Operations, you will be responsible for the
 **end\-to\-end operational efficiency of the legal services function.** 




 You will ensure:
 



**Right person → Right work → Right process → Right timeline → Right client experience** 




 You will work closely with the Founder, lawyers and cross\-functional teams to create a legal services operation that is
 **scalable, measurable, technology\-enabled and less dependent on individual intervention.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. Run Day\-to\-Day Operations** 



* Own the daily functioning of the legal services operation.
* Ensure all matters/tasks have clear ownership and deadlines.
* Monitor work allocation across the team.
* Ensure priorities are clearly communicated.
* Identify bottlenecks and resolve them proactively.
* Conduct regular operational reviews.
* Ensure the team operates with discipline and accountability.



**2\. Drive Team Efficiency \& Productivity** 



* Monitor individual and team productivity.
* Track workload, capacity and utilisation.
* Identify overloading, under\-utilisation and inefficiencies.
* Establish measurable performance standards.
* Create dashboards and performance reports.
* Work with team leads to improve productivity.
* Ensure team members are accountable for their deliverables.



**3\. Own Timely Delivery** 




 This will be one of your most important responsibilities.
 


* Establish and monitor TATs and SLAs.
* Track every active matter and its status.
* Identify upcoming deadlines and delayed matters.
* Ensure proactive follow\-ups.
* Escalate internally before issues reach the client.
* Analyse reasons for delays and eliminate recurring causes.
* Continuously improve turnaround time.



**Our clients should not have to chase us for work that we have committed to deliver.** 




**4\. Build Processes \& SOPs** 




 You will be expected to
 **build the operating system** 
 , not simply manage an existing one.
 


* Map existing workflows.
* Identify process gaps.
* Design and implement SOPs.
* Create checklists and standard workflows.
* Standardise repetitive activities.
* Define ownership at every stage.
* Build escalation mechanisms.
* Continuously improve processes based on data and feedback.



 You should naturally look at a messy process and think:
 



**“How do we make this simpler, faster and more reliable?”** 




**5\. Manage Client Escalations** 



* Own operational/service\-related client escalations.
* Coordinate with lawyers and internal teams to resolve issues.
* Ensure timely communication with clients.
* Handle difficult conversations professionally.
* Track escalation resolution time.
* Identify root causes of recurring escalations.
* Implement corrective processes to prevent recurrence.



 The objective is not merely to
 **solve the escalation** 
 .
 



 It is to ensure
 **the same escalation doesn't happen again.** 




**6\. People Management** 



* Set clear expectations and responsibilities.
* Monitor team performance.
* Conduct regular reviews.
* Identify performance gaps.
* Drive accountability.
* Improve coordination between team members.
* Support hiring and onboarding where required.
* Build a culture of ownership and execution.



 You should be comfortable managing strong professionals and having difficult performance conversations when necessary.
 



**7\. MIS \& Management Reporting** 




 Own the operations dashboard and provide management with clear visibility on:
 


* Active matters
* Completed matters
* Pending matters
* Ageing
* TAT/SLA performance
* Team productivity
* Capacity/utilisation
* Client escalations
* Rework
* Bottlenecks
* Pending client actions
* Other operational KPIs



 Your reporting should answer:
 



**What is happening? Why is it happening? What needs to be done?** 




 Not simply provide numbers.
 



**8\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 




 Work closely with:
 


* Legal Team
* Sales
* Customer Success
* Accounts
* Technology/Product
* HR
* Founder/Management



  





**WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO BUILD** 




 We are looking for someone who can eventually create an operation where:
 


* Every matter has an owner.
* Every task has a deadline.
* Every deadline is tracked.
* Every delay has a reason.
* Every escalation has an owner.
* Every process is documented.
* Every team member knows their KPIs.
* Management has real\-time visibility.
* Technology reduces manual intervention.
* The Founder doesn't need to chase execution.



**The ultimate goal:** 




**Build an operation that runs efficiently without constant Founder intervention.** 




  





**SUCCESS METRICS** 




 Your performance will primarily be measured on:
 



**Delivery** 



* SLA/TAT adherence
* Reduction in delayed matters
* Reduction in ageing matters



**Efficiency** 



* Team productivity
* Lawyer utilisation
* Work allocation efficiency



**Client Experience** 



* Number of escalations
* Escalation resolution TAT
* Repeat complaints



**Process** 



* SOP implementation
* SOP adherence
* Process improvement initiatives



**People** 



* Team accountability
* Performance management
* Employee productivity



**Technology** 



* CRM/platform adoption
* Automation of manual processes
* Data accuracy



**Management** 



* Quality and timeliness of MIS
* Ability to identify and solve operational bottlenecks



  





**WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?** 




 We are looking for an
 **operator** 
 , not necessarily a lawyer.
 



**Preferred backgrounds** 



* MBA
* Company Secretary
* Law
* Business Operations
* Service Delivery
* Professional Services
* Legal Operations
* Startup Operations
* SaaS Operations
* Consulting



**Experience** 




**6–10 years of relevant experience** 
 , preferably with experience managing teams and running a service\-oriented operation.
 



 Experience in
 **legal services, legal\-tech, professional services, SaaS, consulting or other high\-touch businesses** 
 will be an advantage.
 



  





**MUST\-HAVE QUALITIES** 




**Ownership** 




 You don't wait to be told what needs to be done.
 



**Execution** 




 You get things done and follow through.
 



**Process Thinking** 




 You don't repeatedly solve the same problem manually. You build a system.
 



**People Management** 




 You know how to hold people accountable while keeping the team motivated.
 



**Problem Solving** 




 You identify the root cause rather than treating symptoms.
 



**Client Orientation** 




 You understand that delays and communication gaps directly impact customer trust.
 



**Data Orientation** 




 You use numbers to understand and improve operations.
 



**Technology Orientation** 




 You look for ways to use technology to make the operation faster and more scalable.

title: General Manager
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced **Manager – Business \& Stakeholder Management** to support the growth and day\-to\-day management of the organization. The role requires a strong combination of **people management, business development, relationship management, strategic thinking, and execution skills**.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable interacting with **senior management, investors, business partners, high\-value clients, and other key stakeholders**, while also leading and developing internal teams to achieve organizational objectives.

This position requires a professional who can convert business objectives into actionable plans, build strong relationships, identify opportunities, and ensure effective coordination between senior stakeholders and operational teams.

Key Responsibilities1\. People Management \& Leadership

* Lead, motivate and manage a team to achieve business and organizational objectives.
* Set clear goals, responsibilities and performance expectations for team members.
* Monitor team performance and provide regular feedback, coaching and guidance.
* Develop employees through mentoring, training and capability\-building initiatives.
* Identify performance gaps and take appropriate corrective and developmental actions.
* Foster a professional, accountable and collaborative work culture.
* Ensure effective communication between management and team members.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and development of key team members.

2\. Senior Stakeholder Management

* Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with **senior management, investors, business owners, HNI clients, financial partners and other strategic stakeholders**.
* Represent the organization in meetings with senior stakeholders and business partners.
* Prepare and present business updates, proposals, reports and strategic recommendations.
* Understand stakeholder expectations and ensure timely follow\-up and execution.
* Coordinate with internal teams to deliver commitments made to key stakeholders.
* Handle sensitive business discussions with professionalism, discretion and maturity.
* Act as a bridge between senior management and operational/business teams.

3\. Business Development \& Growth

* Identify and develop new business opportunities aligned with the organization's investment and financial services offerings.
* Build and maintain a strong network of potential clients, investors, business partners and referral sources.
* Participate in client meetings, business presentations, networking events and industry engagements.
* Support the development of business proposals, presentations and commercial strategies.
* Track market developments and identify opportunities for business expansion.
* Work with senior management to develop strategies for increasing revenue, client acquisition and long\-term business relationships.

4\. Client \& Relationship Management

* Build long\-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with relevant teams to provide appropriate solutions.
* Ensure high standards of professionalism and responsiveness in client interactions.
* Handle escalations and sensitive client matters in coordination with senior management.
* Maintain confidentiality of client, investment and business information.

5\. Business Planning \& Execution

* Translate organizational strategies into practical business plans and action points.
* Establish priorities and monitor execution against agreed objectives.
* Prepare periodic business reports and management updates.
* Track key performance indicators, business targets and team deliverables.
* Identify operational or business challenges and recommend solutions.
* Ensure timely completion of strategic initiatives and management directives.

6\. Internal Coordination

* Work closely with Finance, Operations, Compliance, Sales, HR and other relevant functions.
* Ensure smooth flow of information across departments.
* Coordinate cross\-functional projects and business initiatives.
* Follow up on critical actions and ensure accountability for deliverables.
* Escalate significant business risks or issues to senior management in a timely manner.

Key Skills \& Competencies

* Strong **people management and leadership skills**
* Excellent **communication and presentation skills**
* Strong relationship\-building and networking ability
* Ability to interact confidently with **senior stakeholders**
* Business development and commercial acumen
* Strategic thinking with strong execution capability
* Negotiation and influencing skills
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability
* Strong interpersonal and organizational skills
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information
* Professional maturity and high ethical standards
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating with senior management and teams

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Commerce or a related discipline.
* MBA / PG qualification in Finance, Business Management, Marketing or related fields will be an advantage.

Experience

* **5–10 years of relevant professional experience**, preferably in financial services, investment management, wealth management, banking, NBFC, consulting, corporate finance or a related sector.
* Proven experience in **team management and stakeholder management**.
* Experience interacting with senior management, investors, HNI clients, business owners or institutional stakeholders will be preferred.

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Position : Human Resource Executive Experience : 12 Years Reporting To : Founder / CEO or Designated Manager Employment Type : Full-time Salary: Up to 20K /Month 
 About the Role : 
 We are looking for an HR Executive who can take care of the regular HR work in the office and keep things properly organized. The person will mainly handle recruitment, employee joining, attendance, leave, documentation, employee coordination and other day-to-day HR activities. This role is suitable for someone who is comfortable talking to people, follows up on work regularly and does not wait for someone to remind them about every task. 
 What You Will Be Doing : 
 You will be responsible for handling recruitment activities, starting from finding candidates and checking CVs to arranging interviews, speaking with candidates, following up with them and coordinating their joining. You will keep track of open positions and make sure candidates are followed up properly. If there is a delay in hiring, you should be able to identify it and bring it to the manager's attention. You will also take care of the joining process for new employees, including collecting documents, KYC, induction, access, KRAs and initial training coordination. Attendance and leave records need to be maintained properly. Employee documents and other HR records should also be kept updated and confidential. You will coordinate with managers regarding employee KRAs and performance reviews and make sure the required information and follow-ups are completed on time. Employees may come to you with regular questions or concerns. You should be able to understand the issue, handle it where possible and involve management when the matter needs a decision. You will also help organize employee activities such as training, birthdays, small team events and other engagement activities. When an employee leaves the company, you will coordinate the exit process, including notice period follow-up, handover, company asset return, exit interview and documentation. A weekly HR update will also need to be prepared covering recruitment status, attendance, new joining's, employee issues, pending documentation and other important HR matters. If you notice repeated issues with attendance, employee behavior or any other HR matter, you should bring them to the management's attention instead of ignoring them. 
 What We Are Looking For : 
 Good communication skills (English) and the confidence to speak with employees and candidates. Someone who is comfortable making regular follow-up calls and messages. Good knowledge of basic HR and recruitment activities. Ability to conduct initial candidate discussions and understand whether a candidate is suitable for the position. Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with HRMS or other HR software will be an advantage. Good documentation and record-keeping habits. Ability to handle employee information with confidentiality. Someone who can remain calm while dealing with employee issues or difficult conversations. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes responsibility for their work and gets things done without needing constant supervision. 
 The Right Person For This Role : 
 The right person will be friendly and approachable with employees but will also know when to be firm. You should be comfortable working independently, following up with people and keeping track of several things at the same time. We do not expect you to make management-level decisions. We do expect you to identify problems, keep the management informed and make sure routine HR work does not get stuck. 
 Please Note : 
 Final decisions related to hiring, salary, increments, promotions, termination and major disciplinary matters will be taken by the Founder, CEO or the authorized manager.

Job Title: HR-People & Organization Manager Company: Sage Healthy Global Location: Avadi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India(Work from office) Position Type: Full-time; based in the Avadi office 
 Build a workplace where strong people join, grow, and stay. 
 Sage Healthy provides medical billing and revenue cycle management services to healthcare practices across the United States. Our Avadi team works with colleagues in North America to improve billing accuracy, reimbursement, and service delivery. Our people and technology underpin the quality and continuity of that work. 
 Position Summary: 
 The People & Organization Manager leads the full HR function for Sage Healthy Global, with accountability for recruitment, retention, rewards, recognition, employee relations, policies, and reliable HR administration. This is a hands-on management role that turns business needs into practical people initiatives and measurable improvements in hiring, employee experience, and team stability. 
 The manager partners with India operations, department leaders, Business Operations & Finance, and corporate leadership to build capable teams and support fair, consistent management. The role owns HR service quality and coaches or supervises assigned HR support staff, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and approval controls. 
 Responsibilities: 
 1. Recruitment and Onboarding Agree staffing priorities, job profiles, selection criteria, and hiring timelines with department managers within approved headcount and budgets. Build candidate pipelines through local networks, referrals, institutions, and relevant recruitment channels; lead structured screening, interviews, and offer coordination. Own joining readiness and onboarding, including documentation, induction, manager handoffs, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day check-ins; track early performance and retention. 
 2. Retention and Employee Engagement Identify preventable turnover through employee feedback, stay conversations, departure feedback, and analysis by team and tenure; agree corrective actions with managers. Run a practical engagement calendar and short employee surveys; communicate findings and follow through on agreed improvements. Support career conversations, internal mobility, and a positive employee experience for office-based and remote India staff. 
 3. Rewards and Recognition Review market information and internal pay consistency; recommend salary ranges, increments, benefits, and incentives with Finance and leadership approval. Administer approved compensation review and reward processes with documented criteria, budget checks, and clear employee communication. Build timely, fair recognition for individual and team contributions, service milestones, and company values; monitor participation across teams and work locations. 
 4. Performance and Development Coordinate goal setting, probation reviews, performance discussions, and development plans with clear deadlines and completion tracking. Coach managers on feedback, performance concerns, documentation, and fair treatment; support appropriate improvement plans and escalation. Identify training needs with department heads, coordinate delivery, and assess whether learning improves job performance and readiness for greater responsibility. 
 5. Employee Relations and Policies Provide an accessible, confidential channel for employee concerns; handle matters promptly, document outcomes, and escalate sensitive cases to designated leadership or advisers. Maintain clear people policies and support consistent application across hiring, attendance, leave, conduct, performance, and separation. Coordinate applicable employment compliance, workplace dignity and harassment-prevention processes, required training, and records with qualified local advisers. Promote respectful conduct and embed Sages values: One Team, Excellence, See It Through, Courage, and Growth. 
 6. HR Administration and Payroll Coordination Own accurate employee records, employment documentation, attendance and leave data, benefits administration, and timely updates in the HR system. Validate and submit payroll inputs, including joiners, leavers, attendance, and approved salary changes; resolve discrepancies with Business Operations & Finance. Coordinate employee benefit and statutory administration with Finance and advisers, maintaining clear owners and calendars for required actions. Manage separations, handovers, employee communications, and final-settlement inputs; coordinate access removal and asset return with Infrastructure & Support. 
 7. People Planning and Process Improvement Maintain a practical people plan aligned with staffing demand, organizational changes, and management priorities; flag capacity and succession risks early. Standardize HR workflows and service expectations, delegate routine tasks where resources permit, and improve HR system use and data quality. Coordinate confidentiality and security training with relevant teams; restrict employee information to authorized users and maintain appropriate records. 
 8. Reporting and Accountability Provide a concise monthly dashboard covering time to fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, voluntary turnover, engagement feedback, and recognition participation. Track timely onboarding, probation and performance reviews, payroll-input accuracy, and closure of employee concerns and agreed actions. Establish baselines and agree realistic targets with leadership within the first 60 days; review results monthly and own corrective actions with department managers. Operate within delegated authority. Obtain approval for headcount, compensation changes, incentive budgets, policy changes, and significant employment decisions. 
 Requirements: Ability to combine hands-on HR delivery with ownership of recruitment, retention, and employee engagement outcomes. Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through when handling sensitive employee and management matters. Ability to coach managers, resolve problems constructively, and collaborate across functions and locations. Clear written and spoken English and effective Tamil communication for the local workforce. Experience: Typically 58 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years leading HR initiatives or a team, with evidence of improved hiring, retention, or engagement. Functional knowledge: Practical experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, compensation reviews, and HR administration. Local knowledge: Working knowledge of employment requirements and HR practices relevant to Tamil Nadu, with the judgment to seek specialist advice. Systems and analytics: Proficiency in an HR platform such as Keka, Microsoft Excel, and concise management reporting; ability to turn data into action. Industry exposure: Experience in medical billing, healthcare services, BPO, IT-enabled services, or a comparable service organization is preferred. 
 Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and role scope, paid monthly on the last working day. Annual vacation and personal time off follow company policy and applicable requirements. Bonus eligibility after the first year is subject to the approved scheme and employment terms. The role offers opportunities for professional growth.

* Provide HR insights and recommendations to business leaders based on people trends, workforce data and business requirements.

* Own and manage employee relations matters across the assigned region, ensuring fair, consistent and timely resolution.
* Partner with store and regional management teams on employee grievances, disciplinary matters, workplace conflicts and behavioral concerns.
* Investigate employee complaints and concerns objectively, ensuring appropriate documentation and confidentiality.
* Advise managers on appropriate courses of action in relation to employee relations matters.
* Support disciplinary processes, including counselling, warning letters, performance\-related actions and other corrective measures in line with company policies.
* Maintain accurate documentation of employee relations cases, investigations, actions and resolutions.
* Identify recurring employee relations issues and recommend preventive measures to business and HR leadership.
* Escalate sensitive or high\-risk matters to the appropriate HR and leadership stakeholders.

* Support timely hiring for stores and ensure manpower availability in line with business requirements.
* Train and guide Store Managers on effective interviewing and selection practices in accordance with Skechers standards.
* Participate in the selection of key retail positions and provide HR inputs on candidate suitability.
* Monitor staffing levels, vacancies, attrition and manpower productivity across the region.
* Identify recurring hiring challenges and work with TA and business teams to develop appropriate solutions.
* Support workforce planning for new store openings, expansions, replacements and seasonal requirements.
* Performance Management
* Drive effective implementation of the performance management process across the region.
* Guide Store Managers and Regional/District Managers on goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement.
* Coach managers on handling underperformance and developing appropriate performance improvement plans where required.
* Monitor completion and quality of performance reviews across the region.
* Identify high performers and critical talent in partnership with business leaders.
* Support the creation of individual development plans for identified talent and high\-potential employees.
* Career Progression \& Succession Planning
* Drive career development and internal mobility initiatives across the retail workforce.
* Identify high\-potential employees and critical talent in collaboration with business leadership.
* Support the development and maintenance of succession plans for key retail positions, including Store Managers and other critical roles.
* Create talent pipelines for future leadership requirements across the region.
* Partner with L\&D to identify capability gaps and recommend relevant development interventions.
* Facilitate career conversations and encourage internal growth opportunities.
* Monitor internal movements, promotions and readiness of identified successors.
* Learning \& Development
* Partner with the L\&D team to identify training and capability\-building requirements across stores.
* Assess training needs based on business performance, employee feedback, performance reviews and manager inputs.
* Support implementation of leadership, behavioral, product and functional training initiatives.
* Coach Store Managers and retail leaders on people management, employee relations, interviewing and performance management.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training interventions and recommend improvements.
* Employee Engagement \& Retention
* Drive employee engagement initiatives across the region in partnership with the HR and Retail teams.
* Identify key drivers of employee engagement and attrition through regular store visits, employee interactions and HR data.
* Develop and implement initiatives to improve employee experience and retention.
* Conduct regular connect sessions with Store Managers and employees to understand concerns and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with business leaders to address key engagement and retention challenges.
* Support recognition initiatives and reinforce a positive employee culture across the retail network.
* HR Policy, Compliance \& Employment Legislation
* Ensure adherence to Skechers policies, processes and employment practices across all stores.
* Maintain working knowledge of applicable state\-specific employment laws, labour regulations and statutory requirements relevant to retail operations.
* Guide managers on the appropriate application of employment legislation and company policies.
* Ensure statutory and employment\-related notices, policies and information are appropriately displayed at stores, wherever applicable.
* Partner with the Legal/Compliance and HR teams on employment\-related regulatory matters.
* Identify potential compliance risks and ensure timely escalation and corrective action.
* Support implementation of workplace health, safety and employment\-related requirements across stores.
* HR Reporting \& Analytics
* Prepare and analyze regional HR reports covering key people metrics.
* Track and report on:
+ Headcount and manpower availability
+ Attrition and retention
+ Hiring and vacancies
+ Internal movements and promotions
+ Performance management
+ Employee relations cases
+ Absenteeism
+ Training and development
+ Engagement initiatives

* Analyze trends and provide actionable insights to Retail and HR leadership.
* Use HR data to identify potential people risks and recommend interventions.
* Compensation \& HR Governance
* Monitor regional compensation guidelines and ensure adherence to approved salary structures and policies.
* Review compensation exceptions and provide recommendations based on business requirements and internal equity.
* Partner with HR leadership and relevant stakeholders on compensation\-related decisions.
* Ensure consistency and governance in people practices across the region.
* Store Visits \& Field HR Presence
* Travel extensively across the assigned region to maintain strong HR visibility and connect with employees and managers.
* Conduct regular store visits to understand employee experience, operational challenges and people\-related issues.
* Conduct HR audits/checks to ensure adherence to HR policies and processes.
* Interact with Store Managers, sales associates and retail leadership to understand ground\-level challenges.
* Provide on\-the\-ground coaching and support to store leadership teams.
* Ensure that HR initiatives are effectively translated from corporate strategy to store\-level execution.
* Stakeholder Management
* Build strong and productive relationships with:
+ Retail Operations
+ Regional/District Managers
+ Store Managers
+ Talent Acquisition
+ Learning \& Development
+ Compensation \& Benefits
+ HR Operations
+ Legal \& Compliance
+ Finance and other corporate functions

* Serve as a trusted HR advisor to business leaders.
* Balance employee advocacy with business requirements and organizational priorities.
* Demonstrate strong influencing and negotiation skills when dealing with complex people matters.
* HR Projects \& Process Improvements
* Lead and participate in regional and organization\-wide HR projects as assigned.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and improve HR processes within the retail environment.
* Support the implementation of new HR policies, systems and initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement in the retail employee experience.
* Ensure timely execution and completion of assigned HR projects.


**KEY SUCCESS PARAMETERS / KPIs**
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through**
* Regional attrition and retention levels.
* Timely closure of retail vacancies and manpower availability.
* Employee relations case management and resolution timelines.
* Effective implementation of performance management processes.
* Store\-level HR compliance and policy adherence.
* Employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Internal promotions and career progression within the region.
* Succession coverage for critical retail positions.
* Training and capability development outcomes.
* Effectiveness of HR interventions and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Quality and frequency of field HR engagement.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

**Experience**

* Strong hands\-on experience in employee relations, performance management, workforce planning and people management.

* High level of confidentiality and integrity
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* Strong coaching and people management skills
* Data\-driven approach to HR decision\-making

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENT**

 **extensive travel across North \& Upper North India** 
 , including regular visits to stores and regional locations based on business requirements.
   

  

 The incumbent should be comfortable working in a highly field\-oriented environment and engaging directly with employees and retail leadership across multiple locations.
   

  

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**
 The ideal candidate will be a
 **strong, business\-oriented Retail HRBP** 
 who combines strategic HR thinking with hands\-on field execution. The candidate should be comfortable working closely with Store Managers and Regional/District leaders, managing complex employee relations situations, driving people processes across a distributed workforce and influencing business decisions through strong HR insights.

title: HR Executive
description:
**About Growthym** 




 Growthym is an AI\-first growth marketing agency based in Noida. We help B2B, SaaS, D2C and services brands in India, the US, the UK, the UAE, Europe and Australia get found on Google and in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity), and we run their paid media, social media, creative and websites. We are a lean team that values ownership, speed and clean execution.
 



**The role** 




 We are hiring an HR Executive to run day\-to\-day hiring and HR operations for our growing team. You will work closely with the leadership team and own the process from job post to joining, and from joining to exit. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is organised, follows up without reminders and can be trusted with confidential information.
 



**What you will do** 



* Post and refresh job openings on LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed and other portals; source candidates through search and referrals
* Screen CVs and run first\-level calls to check experience, current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and fit
* Schedule interviews and assignments, collect interviewer feedback and keep candidates updated at every stage
* Maintain a live hiring tracker in Google Sheets (role, source, stage, CTC, notice period, next step), updated daily
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters and joining documents from approved templates
* Run onboarding: document collection, laptop and asset allocation, tool access and day\-one induction
* Maintain attendance, leave records and employee files; share monthly payroll inputs on time
* Track probation timelines and send reminders for 3\-month reviews and confirmations
* Handle exits: resignation acknowledgement, handover checklist, relieving and experience letters, and full and final coordination
* Plan simple engagement activities such as birthdays, festivals and monthly team moments



**What you need** 



* 0 to 1 year of experience in recruitment, HR operations or an HR internship
* MBA/PGDM in HR, BBA or a related degree
* Clear spoken and written English and Hindi
* Working knowledge of Google Sheets or Excel, Google Docs and job portals
* Strong follow\-up discipline and attention to detail
* Ability to keep salary and personal data confidential



**Good to have** 



* Prior experience or an internship at a digital marketing, advertising or creative agency
* Exposure to hiring for marketing, design, SEO or sales roles
* Familiarity with an HRMS (Keka, Zoho People, greytHR or similar) or Naukri RMS
* Basic understanding of PF, ESI and statutory compliance



**What you get** 



* End\-to\-end HR exposure in a fast\-moving agency, not a single slice of the function
* Direct work with the leadership team
* A clear path to Senior HR Executive based on ownership and results



**Work details** 



* Location: Suite 2, H\-36, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh (work from office)
* Working days: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM
* Employment type: Full\-time
* Experience: 0 to 1 year (freshers with HR internships can apply)
* Immediate joiners will be preferred



**Hiring process** 



1. Screening call (15 minutes)
2. Short practical task: screen CVs against a job description and build a hiring tracker
3. Final interview at our Noida office



**How to apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn and answer all screening questions, including current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

description:
HR Operations Team Leader
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly\-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly\-Clark, it’s all here for you \- innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

 You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes people and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your HR operations leadership, judgment, and customer focus to lead a team delivering critical cross\-entity HR services. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.
   

  

**About You**
 In this professional role, based in Pune, you’ll lead the HR Operations Coordinator team and be accountable for the end\-to\-end implementation and consistent execution of mapped cross\-entity HR processes. You will ensure coordinators understand the process, systems, decision rules, and service expectations required to manage requests accurately and efficiently.
   

  

 You will oversee case dispatch and workload allocation, monitor service levels, manage escalations, coach the team, and maintain strong governance and audit readiness. Strong leadership, sound judgment, confidentiality, analytical thinking, and a customer service mindset are critical to success in this role.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities Include**
* Own the implementation and end\-to\-end execution of mapped cross\-entity HR processes in line with agreed design and governance.
* Ensure every coordinator understands the relevant processes, systems, decision rules, roles, and scope; onboard, upskill, and continuously coach the team.
* Assign and dispatch incoming cases to coordinators in ServiceNow, balancing workload and priority as team capability and volume evolve.
* Manage day\-to\-day operations including capacity planning, queue management, shift and holiday coverage, and backlog control.
* Monitor case volumes, turnaround times, quality, and service levels; report performance and act on trends before they become issues.
* Serve as the single escalation point for cross\-organization managers, HR Operations, Centers of Excellence, and HR Business Partner teams.
* Resolve or route complex and non\-standard cases, engage process owners when required, and communicate clear outcomes to stakeholders.
* Conduct quality reviews, provide regular feedback and development plans, recognize strong performance, and address performance gaps promptly.
* Ensure delegated\-authority transactions are properly authorized, accurately documented, compliant, and audit\-ready.
* Safeguard sensitive and confidential employee information and ensure data privacy obligations are met across both companies.
* Identify recurring process gaps, operational risks, and system limitations, and partner with process owners on redesign and corrective action.
* Lead change adoption and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen service delivery and manager and employee experience.


 To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* This is a fixed\-term contract lasting 18–24 months, with the shift running from 1:00PM to 10:00PM IST.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6–8 years of experience in HR Operations or HR Shared Services, including at least 2–3 years of experience leading or supervising a team.
* Proven experience implementing or stabilizing an HR process or service model, ideally within transformation, integration, or shared services.
* Solid end\-to\-end HR process knowledge across the hire\-to\-retire lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with case management tools such as ServiceNow, including queue management, case assignment, reporting, and SLA monitoring; working knowledge of HRIS platforms such as Workday.
* Demonstrated ability to manage workload allocation, service levels, escalations, coaching, feedback, and performance for a distributed team.
* Strong judgment, analytical thinking, problem\-solving, customer service, stakeholder management, and communication skills across levels and cultures.
* Proven discretion with sensitive employee data and sound understanding of data privacy, compliance, governance, and audit requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a Global Business Services or HR Shared Services environment.
* Experience supporting global HR operations across different time zones and organizational cultures.
* Experience partnering with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, and non\-HR partner functions.
* Experience using operational data to identify process gaps, risks, service trends, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting HR transformation, integration, transition, or People Solutions activities.


 Led by Purpose. Driven by You.
   

  

 To Be Considered

 In the meantime, please check out the careers website.

 For Kimberly\-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world. About Tryfecta Management Solutions

Tryfecta Management Solutions Pvt Ltd provides professional **HR and management services** to businesses, helping organisations establish structured, professional and technology\-enabled HR systems.

Our work includes **HR policies and documentation, employee management, HR process implementation, HRMS implementation, payroll support and ongoing HR management** for clients.

We are looking for a **full\-time HR Executive** to join our team and take responsibility for HR operations, HR documentation, Zoho systems and supporting the HR requirements of our clients.

This is a **hands\-on role** involving HR operations, technology, documentation, process implementation and direct interaction with clients.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The HR Executive will be responsible for supporting **Tryfecta's internal HR activities** as well as managing assigned HR activities for our clients.

The role will involve working extensively with **Zoho People, Zoho Payroll and Zoho Workplace**, along with preparing HR policies, employee handbooks, employment documents, HR processes and reports.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable understanding different businesses, identifying HR requirements and implementing practical HR solutions.

* Maintain HR trackers, registers and databases.
* Assist with performance management processes.
* Support employee communications.
* Assist with employee grievances and HR\-related matters.
* Support exit and separation processes.
* Ensure HR records are accurate, complete and up to date.

Zoho People

* **Zoho Mail**

* **Zoho Cliq**
* **Zoho Writer**
* **Zoho Sheet**

* Organising HR documents and files in WorkDrive.

* Preparing policies and HR documents using Zoho Writer.
* Preparing HR trackers and reports using Zoho Sheet.

* Maintaining appropriate organisation and confidentiality of HR information.
* Supporting clients in adopting and effectively using relevant Zoho applications.

**Hands\-on experience with Zoho People, Zoho Payroll and Zoho Workplace will be an advantage.**

3\. HR Policies \& Documentation

Responsibilities include:

title: Manager – HRBP & ER
description:
**About The Team**
 Our HR team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced HR professional to lead two equally important charters: HR Business Partnering for the 3P/contract workforce and Employee Relations.
   

  

 The role will manage a team of 6 direct reports supporting office, work\-from\-home, and field\-based employees across multiple businesses and locations. The incumbent will partner closely with Business Leaders, HR Leadership, Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Payroll, Ethics and Investigations, and staffing partners.
   

  

 The role requires strong business understanding, people leadership, ER expertise, data\-driven decision\-making, and the ability to manage complex and sensitive matters with fairness, maturity, and speed.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with Business Leaders and Finance teams on workforce planning, headcount budgeting, organizational design, productivity, cost optimization, and workforce deployment.


* Maintain visibility on headcount, hiring, vacancies, redeployments, contract renewals, non\-renewals, attrition, organizational structure, and workforce costs.
* Partner with managers on performance management, talent development, succession planning, retention, and performance improvement plans.
* Use workforce data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities and recommend appropriate business and people interventions.
* Lead the Employee Relations charter across businesses and locations, ensuring fair, consistent, and timely resolution of employee concerns.
* Manage complex cases involving misconduct, fraud, harassment, absenteeism, behavioural concerns, conflicts of interest, dual employment, bribery, and policy violations.
* Lead or oversee workplace investigations, including complaint assessment, interviews, evidence review, documentation, findings, and recommendations.
* Partner with Legal, Ethics and Investigations, POSH committees, Business Leaders, and HR Leadership on complex or high\-risk matters.
* Guide HRBPs and managers on grievance handling, corrective action, disciplinary processes, performance concerns, and sensitive employee conversations.
* Ensure ER decisions follow organizational policies, applicable laws, principles of natural justice, and established precedents.
* Provide governance oversight for hiring, onboarding, background verification, attendance, payroll inputs, insurance, contract renewals, and exits.
* Monitor compliance with minimum wages, statutory requirements, labour laws, contractor obligations, and internal policies.
* Conduct periodic audits, review vendor performance, and strengthen SOPs, controls, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
* Lead, coach, and develop six direct reports across the HRBP and ER charters, with clear goals, accountability, and operating rhythms.
* Build team capability in business partnering, investigations, documentation, data analysis, labour\-law compliance, and stakeholder management.
* Review key deliverables and escalations while enabling team members to independently manage their respective businesses and responsibilities.


**What You Will Need**
* 6 \- 10 years of progressive HR experience, with significant exposure to both HR Business Partnering and Employee Relations.


* Experience managing a large, distributed contract, third\-party, fixed\-term, field, operations, or high\-volume workforce.
* Proven experience handling complex ER cases, workplace investigations, disciplinary actions, grievances, performance concerns, and fraud\-related matters.
* Strong experience partnering with senior leaders on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, performance, talent, and attrition.
* Good understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance, minimum wages, contractor governance, and audit requirements.
* Experience managing staffing partners and governing employee\-lifecycle processes.
* Prior experience leading and developing an HRBP or ER team is essential.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, conflict resolution, investigation, documentation, and data\-analysis capabilities.
* Sound judgment, high ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to handle confidential matters independently.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and high\-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel and support teams across multiple locations.
* MBA/PGDM or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Human Resources. Certification in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, POSH, or workplace investigations will be an added advantage.

title: HR Manager
description:
A global bank has been quietly building an India technology and operations centre for the past two years, and the India HR function, currently a team of three, needs a Manager who can own the full employee lifecycle for a headcount that is set to double this year. This bank has partnered with Flexiple to hire this role into its India centre.
 



**The mandate** 




 You will own HR operations, employee relations and statutory compliance for a mixed population of technology, operations and control\-function employees across two India locations, reporting into the India HR Head.
 



**What lands on this desk** 



* End\-to\-end employee lifecycle management, from onboarding and confirmations through transfers and exits
* Employee relations cases, including performance management and disciplinary matters, handled with the documentation rigour a regulated employer expects
* Statutory compliance across PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments and the Contract Labour Act, working closely with payroll and legal
* Coordination with employee forums where they exist, and audit readiness for internal and regulatory reviews
* Manager coaching on policy interpretation, calibration cycles and difficult conversations



**Compliance and the fine print** 




 Because this is a regulated bank, HR decisions here carry documentation weight: every exception needs a paper trail, every policy change needs a sign\-off chain, and every audit finding needs a closure plan. You will be the person who keeps that machinery running without slowing the business down.
 



**What we need you to have already done** 




 Seven to ten years in HR generalist or HR business partner roles, with at least three of those inside a bank, NBFC or other tightly regulated employer. You should be fluent in Indian labour law as it actually gets applied, not just in theory, and comfortable being the person managers call when a termination gets complicated. Prior experience with a unionised or works\-council population is a strong plus.
 



**Where and how** 




 This role is based out of Mumbai, Bengaluru or Delhi NCR, with Remote (India) available for the right candidate, though a hybrid presence is preferred given the employee\-relations caseload.
 



**Getting to an offer** 




 Applications move through an HR screen, a case\-study discussion built around a real employee\-relations scenario, a round with the hiring manager, and a closing conversation with the India leadership team.
 



 This application will also be considered for other HR leadership mandates Flexiple is currently hiring for, not only this one.
