title: Human Capital Management - Employee Relations - Vice President - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**OUR IMPACT**
 As a division, Human Capital Management (HCM) is at the forefront of supporting business growth and change at Goldman Sachs by recruiting, developing, and rewarding the people of Goldman Sachs. Our teams advise, design, and implement strategies, processes, and technologies that help our people advance professionally, drive productivity, and help the firm and our clients achieve superior results. We look for individuals with strong problem solving and analytical skills, innovative thinking and intellectual curiosity who want to make an impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset, our people.
   

  

**THE EMPLOYEE RELATIONS (ER) TEAM**
 The Employee Relations team, which is part of the Human Capital Management division, is dedicated to advising and coaching managers and employees on all aspects of the employment relationship. Working with managers and employees to prevent, advise and resolve challenging and complex workplace situations, the ER Advisor will work to protect and support the firm's culture in accordance with firm policies, our business principles, and applicable legal standards. The work is invariably of a sensitive nature and requires a unique combination of skills to deliver workable solutions on a diverse range of issues.
   

  

**YOUR IMPACT**
 Are you looking for a new opportunity to showcase your employment relationship, performance management, disciplinary actions, and business restructurings skills? Do you have excellent communication, problem solving and leadership skills? We have an excellent position in the Human Capital Management (HCM) division’s Employee Relations function, located in the firms’ Bengaluru or Hyderabad Office.
   

  

 You will be valued for your intellectual curiosity and your innovative approach to problem\-solving. You will have direct impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset: Our people.
   

  

**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**
* Handle HR investigations to confirm issues are solved in adherence to policies.
* Senior contact for disciplinary actions, escalations \& issue remediation.
* Provide advice to managers regarding all aspects of the employment relationship, including performance management, disciplinary actions, terminations, and business restructurings.
* Investigate allegations of unfair or unlawful treatment and/or inappropriate behavior.
* Counsel individual employees regarding problems in the office and advising on health and personal issues that may impact work.
* Oversee adherence to firm policies regarding, among others, use of firm resources including e\-mail and Internet access, protection of confidential information, etc.
* Oversee all terminations and implementation of severance policy.
* Assist in formulating, interpreting, and communicating policies that pertain to employee relations issues.
* Conduct training programs to educate employees about firm policies regarding employee relations issues.
* Liaise with internal and external legal counsel as necessary to resolve employee issues.
* Stabilize, motivate, bind teams create and uphold strong Goldman Sachs culture.


**Skills \& Experience We’re Looking For**
 Highly motivated HR professional or Employment Lawyer, with a solid understanding of employment issues and a proven track record of the following:
   

  

* 9\+ years of relevant work experience in HR and Employee Relations
* Managing complex issues, identifying potential risk, and driving resolution
* Leveraging analytical, teamwork and project management skills to undertake thorough investigations.
* Ability to develop and build relationships at all levels, with a proven track record of acting in an advisory capacity.
* Developing and building effective relationships at all levels to advise and influence effectively.
* Bringing groups with diverse views/priorities to a common resolution through use of strong negotiation and facilitation skills
* Approaching issues strategically; anticipating consequences and navigating around unforeseen obstacles
* Listening actively and thinking creatively to deliver commercially pragmatic solutions and resolve conflicts.
* Ability to demonstrate approachability and empathy so that employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Well\-developed organizational and multi\-tasking skills, with strong attention to detail


**About Goldman Sachs**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

title: Senior PA/PY Specialist
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 You are an experienced P\&C professional with minimum 7\+ years who enjoys working with people, processes and data – and understands how important accuracy, compliance and empathy are in People Services. You bring solid expertise in HR and personnel administration, including payroll\-related processes, taxation and legal requirements, and you feel confident working with HR systems and tools (such as Success Factors, Service Now, Global View or equivalent) as well as Microsoft Office.
   

  

 You are comfortable taking ownership of your tasks and working independently, while also valuing collaboration and diverse perspectives. You express your ideas openly, listen carefully to others and make thoughtful, well balanced decisions. You are reliable and ready to step up when challenges arise – someone your team can depend on.
   

 Clear communication and active listening come naturally to you. You are a collaborative team player who works towards shared goals and builds positive relationships with ease.
   

  

 You like structure and clarity, and you understand the value of following established processes step by step to ensure high\-quality outcomes. At the same time, you are curious and persistent: when something doesn’t look right, you take the time to investigate, understand the root cause and resolve issues thoroughly and accurately.
   

 You feel confident navigating in complexity and at the same time organizing data and managing documentation in a clear and structured way is your natural talent.
   

  

 You have a problem solving mindset and act quickly when action is needed. You learn from experience and proactively introduce improvements, controls or safeguards to prevent issues from recurring. You enjoy out of the box thinking and drive ideas that support continuous improvement.
   

  

 You think end to end, understanding how your work impacts colleagues, stakeholders and the wider organization. You are comfortable working with KPIs, supporting service quality and leading initiatives that deliver meaningful results. You enjoy taking responsibility and are motivated by achieving and exceeding agreed goals.
   

  

 You care about your growth, understand what you look for in your career journey, actively develop and learn continuously. You are self aware, open to feedback and keen to build your expertise further.
   

  

 Australia HR operations process experience is mandate. This role requires you to have a strong knowledge of Success Factors, Service Now or equivalent applications. ADP Global View Knowledge is an added advantage.
   

  

 This role is situated within Bangalore and will report directly to the GBO People Services Team Leader or GBO People Services Manager in India.
   

 Also, this role requires to work in 5:30 am to 2:30 pm shift timing to support Australia Customers on a rotational basis and it is a hybrid model of 3 days working from office per week.
 



  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





 As part of the People Services team, you will play a key role in delivering end to end People Services for co workers, line managers and P\&C partners supporting Australia. Your work ensures that personal data is handled with care, accuracy and confidentiality – from employment contracts and employee changes to payroll related records and reporting.
   

 You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across HR and GBO, contributing to reliable operations and a positive co worker experience.
   

  

 You will be responsible for:
   

 • Undertake responsibility in your area of competence to deliver high\-professional, accurate, timely, compliant and consistent services according to KPIs and SLAs
   

 • Ensure that Personnel Administration / Payroll processes are in line with global processes/directions, legal and taxation standards, country specific requirements and comply with legislative obligations and internal auditing requirements

 • Monitor the quality of services in your area of responsibility and partner with other internal and external departments and HR locations to improve customer satisfaction
   

 • Actively involved in coaching and developing Junior co\-workers
   

 • Assume responsibility for other tasks and projects assigned.
   

 • Accept and perform additional tasks delegated by team leader.
 



  





**ABOUT THIS WORK AREA** 




  





 Global Business Operation (GBO) is a function within the IKEA Group of companies. We work with transactional services in the field of Finance and HR. We deliver our services through our regional hubs, located in Poznan, Shanghai, Bangalore and Baltimore. To provide professional, service minded, support to the core business – that’s our business! To secure best practice, efficient end\-to\-end HR administration processes from the co\-worker, line manager \& HR unit to GBO for service delivery. Working together to achieve IKEA performance goals by freeing the business to focus on the core objectives

title: HCM Analyst, Bengaluru, India
description:
**Job Summary**
 The HCM Systems Analyst – Dayforce is a hands\-on configuration role responsible for building, configuring, maintaining, and optimizing the organization’s Dayforce HCM platform across Core HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance/Workforce Management, Recruiting, Performance, Compensation, and Learning.
   

  

 This role serves as a functional and technical Dayforce resource, partnering with HR Operations, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Learning, HR Business Partners, IT, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective and scalable system solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on Dayforce configuration experience and is comfortable independently researching issues, building solutions, testing changes, troubleshooting complex problems, and continuously improving the platform within a complex, global HCM environment.
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
* Configure, maintain, and optimize Dayforce modules, including:
+ Core HR / People
+ Payroll
+ Time \& Attendance / Workforce Management
+ Recruiting
+ Performance Management
+ Compensation
+ Learning

* Build and modify Dayforce configuration, including workflows, forms, approval processes, eligibility rules, business rules, security roles, notifications, and other system functionality.
* Translate business requirements into effective Dayforce solutions while considering system scalability, usability, data integrity, and downstream impacts.
* Partner with HR and Payroll teams to design and implement system enhancements and process improvements.
* Troubleshoot complex system, configuration, and data issues; identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support configuration and system administration for recurring HR processes, including payroll, performance reviews, compensation cycles, recruiting activities, learning programs, and employee lifecycle events.
* Perform impact analysis, configuration, testing, and validation for system changes, enhancements, releases, and new functionality.
* Develop and execute test scenarios and support user acceptance and regression testing.
* Monitor Dayforce releases and product updates, evaluate potential impact, and recommend opportunities to leverage new functionality.
* Maintain system security and role\-based access in accordance with organizational and data privacy requirements.
* Support Dayforce reporting, data imports and exports, interfaces, integrations, and data validation activities.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity across the HCM platform and assist with identifying and resolving data quality issues.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, simplify workflows, and improve the employee and manager experience.
* Maintain system configuration documentation, process documentation, and change records.
* Provide technical and functional support to HR system users and assist with training and knowledge transfer as needed.
* Partner with Dayforce Support and external vendors to research and resolve product or configuration issues when necessary.
* Participate in HCM projects, implementations, integrations, acquisitions, and other HR technology initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders and team members across multiple countries and time zones.


**Education and Certification**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
* Dayforce certifications are preferred.
* Additional HR technology, payroll, project management, or systems certifications are an advantage.
* Equivalent combinations of education and relevant hands\-on Dayforce experience will be considered.


**Competencies, Skills And Experience**
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience configuring, administering, and supporting Dayforce in a complex organizational environment.
* Strong Dayforce configuration experience across multiple modules; experience with Core HR and Workforce Management is strongly preferred, with experience in additional modules such as Payroll, Recruiting, Performance, Compensation, and Learning highly valued.
* Experience supporting a global or multi\-country HCM environment preferred.
* Ability to independently configure and troubleshoot Dayforce rather than relying primarily on vendor or implementation partner resources.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and the employee lifecycle, including organizational management, employee data, payroll, time and attendance, recruiting, performance management, compensation, and learning.

title: Benefits Operations Specialist
description:
The Benefits Operations Specialist plays a critical role in supporting the administration, execution, and continuous improvement of employee benefits programs. This position serves as a key operational partner to Corporate Benefits, HR, Payroll, vendors, and employees to ensure the accurate delivery of health, welfare, retirement, and wellbeing programs for our U.S. population.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with exceptional attention to detail and a passion for delivering high\-quality employee experiences. This role requires expertise in benefits administration, HR systems, vendor management, data governance, compliance, and operational excellence in a fast\-paced global environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Benefits Administration \& Operations
   

  

* Administer employee benefit programs including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, retirement, spending accounts, and wellness programs.
* Support ongoing benefits administration processes by reviewing transactions, performing eligibility audits, researching exceptions, and coordinating issue resolution with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Support annual Open Enrollment activities, including system testing, data validation, audit reporting, and issue resolution.

 Systems, Data Management \& Integrations

* Review and reconcile eligibility, enrollment, payroll deduction, and carrier files.

title: Human Resources Payroll
description:
**Associate Manager / Senior Associate – Payroll \& Compliance** 




**Zolo \| Human Resources** 




**Own payroll accuracy. Drive labour compliance. Protect business trust.** 




  





**Why this role exists** 




 Payroll is one of the strongest indicators of employee trust.
 



 Labour compliance is one of the strongest indicators of organizational discipline.
 



 Every month, employees expect to be paid accurately and on time. Every regulator expects statutory compliance without exceptions. Every vendor is expected to meet labour compliance requirements before partnering with Zolo.
 



 The challenge is not processing payroll—it is ensuring accuracy, compliance, and governance across a fast\-growing, multi\-location business.
 



 Most payroll and compliance failures happen because:
 


* Payroll inputs are inaccurate or incomplete
* Statutory timelines are missed
* Vendor compliance is not tracked proactively
* Documentation is not audit\-ready
* Compliance risks are identified too late



 This role exists to ensure every employee is paid accurately, every statutory obligation is met on time, and every labour compliance requirement is managed with discipline.
 



 If this role is strong, employees trust the organization, audits run smoothly, vendors remain compliant, and business risk stays low.
 



 If this role is weak, payroll errors increase, compliance gaps emerge, penalties arise, and employee confidence is impacted.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Own end\-to\-end payroll accuracy and timely processing
* Drive labour law compliance across all business locations
* Ensure vendor compliance is complete and audit\-ready
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners
* Maintain disciplined documentation with zero compliance gaps
* Protect the organization from payroll and statutory risks



**This is not a payroll processing role. It is a governance, compliance, and business continuity role.** 




  





**About Zolo** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.
 



 Behind every great employee experience is a strong HR foundation. Payroll and Compliance ensure that trust is built not only with employees, but also with regulatory authorities, partners, and the business.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




**1\. Own Payroll Accuracy** 



* Process monthly payroll accurately and within defined timelines
* Validate attendance, leave, incentives, reimbursements, and payroll inputs
* Coordinate with payroll vendors to resolve discrepancies
* Ensure timely salary disbursement
* Resolve employee payroll queries promptly



**2\. Drive Labour Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements
* Track statutory filing timelines and ensure timely submissions
* Maintain statutory registers and compliance records
* Stay updated with changes in labour legislation
* Support inspections and regulatory requirements



**3\. Manage Vendor Compliance** 



* Coordinate with manpower agencies and labour contractors
* Review vendor statutory documents including PF, ESI, PT, and other compliance records
* Track pending submissions and ensure timely closure
* Escalate compliance risks proactively



**4\. Maintain Documentation \& Audit Readiness** 



* Maintain complete payroll and statutory documentation
* Ensure records remain accurate and audit\-ready
* Support internal and external compliance audits
* Respond to audit observations with timely documentation



**5\. Drive Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Work closely with HR, Finance, Operations, payroll vendors, and compliance consultants
* Resolve payroll and compliance queries within agreed timelines
* Provide accurate reports and timely updates
* Build strong working relationships across stakeholders



**6\. Improve Processes \& Governance** 



* Identify opportunities to improve payroll and compliance processes
* Recommend automation wherever possible
* Reduce manual errors through better controls
* Support continuous improvement initiatives



  





**What success looks like after 6–12 months** 




 Accurate payroll processed every month without delays
 



 Zero major statutory compliance lapses
 



 Strong vendor compliance across all locations
 



 Audit\-ready documentation with minimal observations
 



 High payroll accuracy with minimal employee escalations
 



 Strong stakeholder confidence in payroll and compliance processes
 



  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 



 You enjoy working with structured processes and deadlines
 



 You pay close attention to details and accuracy
 



 You are comfortable coordinating with multiple stakeholders
 



 You take ownership of confidential and critical business processes
 



 You remain calm during high\-pressure payroll cycles
 



 You believe discipline and consistency build trust
 



  





**Experience we value** 




 2–5 years of experience in Payroll and Labour Compliance
 



 Hands\-on experience in payroll processing and statutory compliance
 



 Experience working with payroll vendors or labour contractors
 



 Good understanding of labour laws, PF, ESI, PT, LWF, and statutory filings
 



 Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel
 



 MSW (Master of Social Work) is good to have
 



 Strong communication skills in English, Hindi, and Kannada
 



  





**The impact you will have** 




 You will ensure every employee is paid accurately and on time.
 



 You will protect Zolo from statutory and compliance risks.
 



 You will strengthen trust across employees, vendors, and regulatory authorities.
 



 You will contribute directly to operational discipline and business continuity.
 



  





**Why join now** 




 As Zolo continues to scale across cities and business units, payroll accuracy and labour compliance become even more critical.
 



 This role offers the opportunity to build expertise in payroll governance, labour compliance, vendor management, and statutory operations while working at the core of a fast\-growing organization.
 



  





**If you believe operational excellence comes from accuracy, discipline, and ownership—this is the right opportunity** 
 .

title: Senior Director - India HR Leader
description:

The Executive Human Resources Leader for India will be a pivotal figure within Huron's human resources organization and the India country leadership. This role requires a collaborative and dynamic leader who can successfully navigate a matrixed organization model, ensuring cooperation and alignment both within the HR function and between the HR function and the business. title: People Advisor (HR)
description:
**About Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced People Advisor to help establish and grow our new Technology \& Innovation hub based in Hyderabad.
 



  





 You will help play a key role in shaping the people environment of our Innovation Hub. Partnering closely with business leads and cross\-functional teams to establish people policies and processes, support operational readiness and build an engaging, inclusive and high\-performing workplace.
 



 You will bring strong HR business partnering and employee relations experience, together with practical knowledge of Indian statutory requirements, shift\-based workforce management and the establishment or scaling of a GCC, GBS, captive centre or shared services operation.
 



  





**Key Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**People partnering and stakeholder management** 



* Act as the primary People Advisor for leaders and employees at the Hyderabad hub.
* Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness and people priorities.
* Coach managers on performance management, employee relations and day\-to\-day people matters.
* Build strong relationships with regional and global stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into practical and sustainable people solutions.



**Site establishment and HR operations** 



* Support the setup and operations for the Hyderabad Technology \& Innovation hub site
* Work with Legal, Finance, Compliance, Facilities, Payroll, Talent Acquisition and other teams to support site readiness.
* Develop and implement site\-level people policies, processes and governance.
* Act as the key HR contact for people\-related matters affecting the Hyderabad site.
* Support workforce administration and ensure an effective employee experience as the site grows.



**Statutory compliance and risk management** 



* Ensure site\-level compliance with applicable Indian employment laws and statutory requirements.
* Support the statutory requirements associated with establishing and operating a global business services or technology centre in Hyderabad.
* Manage statutory documentation, reporting, audits and inspections.
* Maintain accurate and audit\-ready employee and compliance records.
* Partner with Legal, Finance and Compliance teams to identify and manage people\-related risks.



**Employee relations and lifecycle management** 



* Independently manage employee relations matters, including grievances, performance concerns, disciplinary processes and workplace investigations.
* Coach managers through sensitive or complex employee situations.
* Oversee onboarding, employee movements, policy implementation and offboarding activities.
* Maintain accurate employee information and HR documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve employee lifecycle processes and service delivery.



**Shift and workforce management** 



* Support teams working across global time zones, including shift\-based or extended\-hours operations.
* Help develop and implement practical shift\-related policies and workforce processes.
* Advise leaders on shift management, employee wellbeing and workforce continuity.
* Monitor workforce trends and identify potential operational or employee risks.
* Support contractor onboarding, compliance and offboarding.



**Culture, engagement and inclusion** 



* Help create the culture and employee experience for a new and growing site.
* Lead engagement, wellbeing, inclusion, recognition and retention initiatives.
* Support communication and change\-management activities as the hub develops.
* Build connections between Hyderabad employees and the wider global organization.
* Use employee feedback and workforce insights to recommend practical improvements.



**Vendor and site administration** 



* Partner with external vendors supporting staffing, facilities, transportation, employee services and site operations.
* Monitor vendor service delivery, compliance and employee experience.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational issues affecting employees.
* Support effective governance of contractors and third\-party workers.



  





**About You** 




**Skills \& experience** 



* Significant generalist HR, People Partner, HRBP or People Advisory experience in Hyderabad
* **Experience supporting the establishment, expansion or transformation of a GCC, GBS, captive centre, shared services centre or technology hub**
* Strong
 **working knowledge of Indian employment legislation and statutory compliance** 
 .
* Demonstrated experience independently managing employee relations matters.
* Experience supporting shift\-based, 24/7, technology or globally distributed workforces.
* Strong business partnering and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with senior leaders.
* Practical experience developing or implementing HR policies and governance processes.
* Experience managing external vendors, contractors or site\-level employee services.
* Strong project management, organisation and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a developing environment where processes are still being established.
* Excellent written and spoken English.



  





**Qualifications \& Education** 



* **At least 5 years of proven experience in HRBP/Generalist or People Advisor role working within a global technology, GCC, GBS or shared services environment**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources
* Experience helping launch or scale a new site
* **Strong knowledge of Hyderabad\-specific employment and statutory requirements**
* **Experience supporting employees working US, European or rotational shifts**
* A track record of building culture and engagement during periods of rapid growth or organizational change

As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
   

  

 The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling \& Staffing Support**
* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.


**Capacity, Utilization \& Workforce Analytics**
* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.

description:
**ROLE SUMMARY** 




  





 The Payroll Specialist / Deputy Manager for Thailand, Malaysia and Philippines is responsible for the accurate, timely and compliant delivery and governance of payroll within a shared services payroll environment. Acting as the country Payroll SME, the role oversees payroll providers, validates payroll inputs and outputs, ensures statutory and tax compliance, maintains effective payroll controls, and supports payroll\-related queries and continuous improvement.
 



  





 The role partners closely with HR, Finance and external service providers to ensure payroll is delivered accurately, compliantly and in line with country\-specific labor, tax, social security and employment regulations as well as established processes, controls and payroll calendars while delivering a high\-quality employee payroll experience.
 



**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





 The role encompasses the following core responsibilities across Thailand, Malaysia and Philippines, with additional country\-specific requirements outlined below to reflect local payroll, statutory and regulatory requirements.

* Own and coordinate the end\-to\-end payroll cycle, including payroll calendars, cut\-offs, data collection, validation and timely submission for processing.

* Experience working in a Global Business Services (GBS), Shared Services or other centralized payroll environment.
* Experience supporting payroll across multiple countries or remotely from a centralized location.
* Experience with Workday HRIS and ADP or other outsourced payroll solutions.

* HR MIS \& Reporting \- Prepare regular HR MIS and management reports covering: Headcount, Attrition, Recruitment, Payroll, Attendance \& Leave, Employee movements, Compliance, Cost and manpower analysis. \- Maintain accurate HR dashboards and reports for management review.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 4–6 years of relevant experience in HR Generalist / HR Operations / Payroll \& HR roles. \- Strong hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end payroll processing. \- Good understanding of Indian statutory compliance and labour laws. \- Experience in recruitment and employee lifecycle management. Hands\-on experience with at least one HRMS such as Keka, Zoho People, greytHR, Darwinbox, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar platforms. \- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and ability to work with HR MIS. \- Good communication and interpersonal skills. \- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality. \- Ability to independently manage multiple HR processes and work in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate should be a hands\-on HR professional rather than someone focused only on recruitment or HR administration.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Can Independently Handle**
 Payroll \+ Compliance \+ HR Operations \+ Recruitment \+ HRMS
   

  

 and act as a single\-point HR operations resource for the organization.
   

  

 Looking for candidates who can join immediately or at the earliest possible date.

 Payroll \& HR Operations \- Statutory Compliance \- Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition \- Employee Lifecycle Management \- HRMS Administration \- HR MIS \& Analytics \- Labour Law Knowledge \- Employee Relations \- Process Automation \& Improvement \- Strong Excel \& Data Management Skills

title: Director's office
description:
**About SAR Transport:** 




  






 SAR is one of the leading Logistics companies in India in the supply chain and logistics industry on the international level. SAR Logistics is 1000\+ people strong and one of its kind on the national and international level in the logistics domain. The annual turnover of the group company is estimated at around INR 2200 Cr\+. The organization has been working continuously to provide customer satisfaction to its clients by providing various services and offers to its loyal customers who are working in the same domain. Reliability and years of experience have made the company stand where it is now.
 




  





**Job Description:** 





 This role sits closest to a business leader — present in every important review and decision, trusted to turn their instincts and priorities into a tracked, time\-bound plan, and expected to hold the immediate team accountable without being told twice.
 




  






 SAR's management style is direct, fast\-moving with process for its own sake. This role exists to bring structure into that environment without slowing it down — and to represent the business's real numbers and constraints upward, even when that means pushing back.
 




  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* Act as the director's operating partner — converting verbally communicated priorities into a tracked, time\-bound action plan.
* Own the core business metrics by segment: Volume, Revenue, GP, EBITDA, PBT, AR ageing, AP ageing etc.
* Chase, follow up, and hold Sales, Operations and Finance leads accountable for their numbers and commitments — repeatedly, and without waiting to be asked.
* Flag problems and risks proactively, before they surface in a review — no surprises upward or downward.
* Represent the business's data and constraints directly to management, and negotiate priorities and timelines realistically.
* Identify recurring problems and propose — not build — data or systems solutions, working with the Strategy and Data \& Technology teams to get them built.
* Write detailed business and functional  requirement documents for the Data \& Technology team, covering data sources, logic, edge cases, and what “done” looks like.



  





**Qualification:** 




**Preferred Background** 



* 3\-5 years of experience, ideally including time working directly for or with a founder, promoter, or business owner in an unstructured environment — an SME, family business, or founder\-led company.
* A demonstrated ability to hold senior people accountable using data and persistence, not positional authority.
* High tolerance for ambiguity, fast pivots, and a management style that can be direct and demanding.
* Strong Excel/Sheets fluency — comfortable being the numbers person in the room, not just the messenger.
* A background in logistics, trading, manufacturing, or another asset\-heavy, execution\-intensive industry is a plus.

title: Process Mining Consultant
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a Process Mining Consultant with 10\+ years of total experience including 2\-3 years of experience reading, interpreting, and translating process mining insights into decisions that process efficiency and/or effectiveness. This role will partner with business stakeholders, process owners, continuous improvement (CI) analysts, and digital and technology (D\&T) to deliver use cases using process mining technology, to create as\-is process maps, and convert data\-driven findings to business\-actionable insight. Sitting within the Strategy \& Operational Excellence function, this person will be responsible for supporting key initiatives under General Mills' CI and process mining program.


The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and process\-improvement discipline with a practical understanding of how process mining and business intelligence outputs work, enabling them to partner effectively with Process Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and D\&T. This person should be able to translate technical process mining output into structured, plain\-language narratives that business stakeholders can act on and help drive improvement opportunities from insight to committed action.


**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Business Partnership \& Process Discovery**

* Partner with process owners and SMEs to scope use cases, define KPIs, and co create current\-state process maps.
* Interpret exception patterns, rework loops, and conformance gaps. Turn findings into clear visuals and actionable business narratives.
* Facilitate cross\-functional workshops to share findings and build pipeline of improvement opportunities.

**Insight \& Value Delivery**

* Quantify cycle\-time, Order Touches, Lead Time, waiting\-time, rework impact, and correlate findings to business KPIs (DSO, OTIF, cycle time etc.).
* Classify activities as value\-add, non\-value\-add, or required non\-value\-add. Build an automation roadmap for D\&T prioritization.
* Build insights dashboards for process owners and sponsors presentations. Participate in monthly readouts and create action tracker as per discussion and deliver outcomes as required.
* Validate process\-mining outputs for accuracy and completeness. Identify data or coverage gaps for D\&T to resolve.
* Translate D\&T’s technical data work into practical business insights grounded in reliable source data.
* Understand how source systems feed the process\-mining tool. Use this knowledge to challenge findings and ask informed questions.

**Capability Building**

* Help internal teams on how to read and apply process mining insights.
* Contribute to the process\-mining playbook and methodology.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.
* 10\+ years of professional experience, including 2\-3 years in process mining or business analysis using Signavio.
* Hands\-on experience with Signavio, or another process\-mining tool from user side.
* Experience working across markets, systems, geographies, and time zones in a large, matrixed organization.

**Process and Technical Knowledge**
-----------------------------------

* Ability to turn process\-mining, analytics, or BI outputs into actionable business insights.
* Strong knowledge of process mapping, variant analysis, conformance checking, and KPI design, in partnership with D\&T.
* Strong working knowledge of P2P, R2R, and O2C processes.
* Ability to apply process\-mining techniques to identify rework, cycle\-time issues, exceptions, and control gaps.
* Working knowledge of data flows, dashboards, analytics platforms, source\-system integration, and process\-level data models.

**Core Skills**
---------------

* Ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong communication, stakeholder\-management, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Lean/Six Sigma Green Belt/ Black Belt
* Certification in a recognized process mining platform (preferably in Signavio or Celonis Data Analyst)
* Background in a large, complex enterprise environment with exposure to core business processes such as Supply Chain Operations, HR, or Finance.
* Exposure to change management, process improvement, or product delivery practices

  


**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management (IAM Engineer)
description:
**Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management**

The Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Engineer is responsible for supporting, administering, engineering, and continuously improving enterprise identity and access management services. This role works as part of the Digital Identity \& Access team to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient identity services across the organization. The IAM Engineer will support identity lifecycle management, authentication, Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, application integrations, certificates, and related identity technologies. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capabilities with disciplined operational practices, documentation, change management, and collaboration across Technology and Information Security teams. This is a hybrid role and work hours are 2pm – 11pm IST.  

**Responsibilities:**

**Identity \& Access Management**

* Support the administration and engineering of enterprise identity and access management platforms and services.
* Configure and maintain Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), authentication policies, and Conditional Access controls.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory identity services.
* Support identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, modification, deprovisioning, and access changes.
* Troubleshoot complex authentication, authorization, and access\-related issues.
* Support application onboarding and integration with enterprise identity platforms using technologies and standards such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and related authentication protocols.
* Support identity federation and authentication integrations with SaaS, cloud, and internally developed applications.
* Assist with the administration and support of Auth0 and other enterprise authentication platforms.
* Support role\-based access control and group\-based access management.

**Identity Security \& Governance**

* Partner with Information Security to implement and maintain identity security standards and controls.
* Support periodic access reviews, certifications, audit requests, and compliance activities.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of appropriate separation\-of\-duties controls.
* Identify excessive, inappropriate, or outdated access and work with appropriate stakeholders to remediate identified issues.
* Support privileged identity and access management processes where applicable.
* Assist with investigation and remediation of identity\-related security events.
* Ensure identity configurations and processes align with organizational security standards and established governance requirements.

**PKI \& Certificate Management**

* Support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate\-management processes.
* Monitor certificate expiration and coordinate certificate renewals to prevent service disruption.
* Assist application and technology teams with certificate requests, renewals, deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate documentation and visibility into enterprise certificates and associated ownership.

**Engineering \& Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IAM activities and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain scripts and automation supporting identity administration, reporting, provisioning, and operational processes.
* Support integrations between IAM platforms, enterprise applications, HR systems, and other technology services.
* Participate in identity\-platform upgrades, enhancements, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of IAM architecture, standards, technical documentation, and operational procedures.

**Service Management \& Operations**

* Manage IAM incidents, requests, problems, and changes in accordance with established service\-management processes.
* Develop implementation, testing, validation, rollback, and communication plans for production changes.
* Ensure changes are appropriately documented, reviewed, approved, and communicated prior to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely visibility into assigned work, projects, changes, risks, and commitments.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and support runbooks.
* Participate in troubleshooting and resolution of major incidents involving identity or authentication services.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions.

**Collaboration \& Customer Experience**

* Partner with Digital Workplace, Information Security, Infrastructure, Application Development, Enterprise Systems, HR, Service Management, and other technology teams.
* Provide technical guidance to application owners integrating applications with enterprise identity services.
* Communicate technical issues, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Balance security requirements with the need to provide reliable and intuitive authentication and access experiences for practitioners.
* Demonstrate a collaborative, accountable, and service\-oriented approach to delivering identity services.

**Essential traits:**

* 3–5\+ years of experience supporting or engineering enterprise Identity \& Access Management technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.
* Experience implementing or supporting Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Conditional Access.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications using SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, or similar authentication standards.
* Experience troubleshooting complex authentication and access\-related issues.
* Understanding of identity lifecycle management, including provisioning, deprovisioning, access changes, and role/group management.
* Working knowledge of identity security principles, least privilege, role\-based access control, and separation of duties.
* Experience working within formal change, incident, request, and problem\-management processes.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across technical teams and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

title: Senior Manager - Human Resource Business Partner
description:
The Senior Manager/ Manager – Human Resources will be responsible for partnering with the Retail Business and Store Operations teams across North, Upper North of India to drive the people agenda and ensure effective execution of HR policies, processes and initiatives across the region.  

The role will act as a strategic and hands\-on HR Business Partner to Regional/District leadership, Store Managers and retail teams, providing HR guidance across the complete employee lifecycle including workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, performance management, employee relations, capability development, career progression and succession planning.  

The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that HR practices are consistently implemented across stores while balancing business requirements with Skechers' people policies, values and employment practices.  

The role requires strong field presence, excellent stakeholder management skills, sound knowledge of employment legislation and the ability to independently manage complex employee relations matters across a geographically dispersed retail workforce.**Designation:** Senior Manager

**Role:** HRBP (North \& Upper North)

**Function:** Human Resources

**Business:** Retail – Skechers India

**Location:** Delhi (CP)

**Reporting To:** Senior General Manger \- HR

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. HR Business Partnership – Retail**

* Partner closely with Regional/District Managers, Store Managers and Retail Operations leadership to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people strategies.
* Act as the primary HR point of contact for the assigned region and provide timely, practical and business\-oriented HR solutions.
* Drive the implementation of HR policies, processes and initiatives across all stores within the region.
* Maintain strong working relationships with store management, field leadership, retail operations and corporate HR teams.
* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of HR policies across locations.
* Provide HR insights and recommendations to business leaders based on people trends, workforce data and business requirements.
* Maintain strong HR visibility across stores through regular field visits and interactions with employees and managers.

**2\. Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution**

* Own and manage employee relations matters across the assigned region, ensuring fair, consistent and timely resolution.
* Partner with store and regional management teams on employee grievances, disciplinary matters, workplace conflicts and behavioral concerns.
* Investigate employee complaints and concerns objectively, ensuring appropriate documentation and confidentiality.
* Advise managers on appropriate courses of action in relation to employee relations matters.
* Support disciplinary processes, including counselling, warning letters, performance\-related actions and other corrective measures in line with company policies.
* Maintain accurate documentation of employee relations cases, investigations, actions and resolutions.
* Identify recurring employee relations issues and recommend preventive measures to business and HR leadership.
* Escalate sensitive or high\-risk matters to the appropriate HR and leadership stakeholders.

**3\. Recruitment \& Workforce Planning**

* Partner with Talent Acquisition and Retail Operations to understand manpower requirements and workforce plans across the region.
* Support timely hiring for stores and ensure manpower availability in line with business requirements.
* Train and guide Store Managers on effective interviewing and selection practices in accordance with Skechers standards.
* Participate in the selection of key retail positions and provide HR inputs on candidate suitability.
* Monitor staffing levels, vacancies, attrition and manpower productivity across the region.
* Identify recurring hiring challenges and work with TA and business teams to develop appropriate solutions.
* Support workforce planning for new store openings, expansions, replacements and seasonal requirements.

**4\. Performance Management**

* Drive effective implementation of the performance management process across the region.
* Guide Store Managers and Regional/District Managers on goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement.
* Coach managers on handling underperformance and developing appropriate performance improvement plans where required.
* Monitor completion and quality of performance reviews across the region.
* Identify high performers and critical talent in partnership with business leaders.
* Support the creation of individual development plans for identified talent and high\-potential employees.

**5\. Career Progression \& Succession Planning**

* Drive career development and internal mobility initiatives across the retail workforce.
* Identify high\-potential employees and critical talent in collaboration with business leadership.
* Support the development and maintenance of **succession plans for key retail positions**, including Store Managers and other critical roles.
* Create talent pipelines for future leadership requirements across the region.
* Partner with L\&D to identify capability gaps and recommend relevant development interventions.
* Facilitate career conversations and encourage internal growth opportunities.
* Monitor internal movements, promotions and readiness of identified successors.

**6\. Learning \& Development**

* Partner with the L\&D team to identify training and capability\-building requirements across stores.
* Assess training needs based on business performance, employee feedback, performance reviews and manager inputs.
* Support implementation of leadership, behavioral, product and functional training initiatives.
* Coach Store Managers and retail leaders on people management, employee relations, interviewing and performance management.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training interventions and recommend improvements.

**7\. Employee Engagement \& Retention**

* Drive employee engagement initiatives across the region in partnership with the HR and Retail teams.
* Identify key drivers of employee engagement and attrition through regular store visits, employee interactions and HR data.
* Develop and implement initiatives to improve employee experience and retention.
* Conduct regular connect sessions with Store Managers and employees to understand concerns and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with business leaders to address key engagement and retention challenges.
* Support recognition initiatives and reinforce a positive employee culture across the retail network.

**8\. HR Policy, Compliance \& Employment Legislation**

* Ensure adherence to Skechers policies, processes and employment practices across all stores.
* Maintain working knowledge of applicable **state\-specific employment laws, labour regulations and statutory requirements** relevant to retail operations.
* Guide managers on the appropriate application of employment legislation and company policies.
* Ensure statutory and employment\-related notices, policies and information are appropriately displayed at stores, wherever applicable.
* Partner with the Legal/Compliance and HR teams on employment\-related regulatory matters.
* Identify potential compliance risks and ensure timely escalation and corrective action.
* Support implementation of workplace health, safety and employment\-related requirements across stores.

**9\. HR Reporting \& Analytics**

* Prepare and analyze regional HR reports covering key people metrics.
* Track and report on:
	+ Headcount and manpower availability
	+ Attrition and retention
	+ Hiring and vacancies
	+ Internal movements and promotions
	+ Performance management
	+ Employee relations cases
	+ Absenteeism
	+ Training and development
	+ Engagement initiatives
* Analyze trends and provide actionable insights to Retail and HR leadership.
* Use HR data to identify potential people risks and recommend interventions.

**10\. Compensation \& HR Governance**

* Monitor regional compensation guidelines and ensure adherence to approved salary structures and policies.
* Review compensation exceptions and provide recommendations based on business requirements and internal equity.
* Partner with HR leadership and relevant stakeholders on compensation\-related decisions.
* Ensure consistency and governance in people practices across the region.

**11\. Store Visits \& Field HR Presence**

* Travel extensively across the assigned region to maintain strong HR visibility and connect with employees and managers.
* Conduct regular store visits to understand employee experience, operational challenges and people\-related issues.
* Conduct HR audits/checks to ensure adherence to HR policies and processes.
* Interact with Store Managers, sales associates and retail leadership to understand ground\-level challenges.
* Provide on\-the\-ground coaching and support to store leadership teams.
* Ensure that HR initiatives are effectively translated from corporate strategy to store\-level execution.

**12\. Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong and productive relationships with:
	+ Retail Operations
	+ Regional/District Managers
	+ Store Managers
	+ Talent Acquisition
	+ Learning \& Development
	+ Compensation \& Benefits
	+ HR Operations
	+ Legal \& Compliance
	+ Finance and other corporate functions
* Serve as a trusted HR advisor to business leaders.
* Balance employee advocacy with business requirements and organizational priorities.
* Demonstrate strong influencing and negotiation skills when dealing with complex people matters.

**13\. HR Projects \& Process Improvements**

* Lead and participate in regional and organization\-wide HR projects as assigned.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and improve HR processes within the retail environment.
* Support the implementation of new HR policies, systems and initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement in the retail employee experience.
* Ensure timely execution and completion of assigned HR projects.

**KEY SUCCESS PARAMETERS / KPIs**


Success in this role will be measured through:

* Regional attrition and retention levels.
* Timely closure of retail vacancies and manpower availability.
* Employee relations case management and resolution timelines.
* Effective implementation of performance management processes.
* Store\-level HR compliance and policy adherence.
* Employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Internal promotions and career progression within the region.
* Succession coverage for critical retail positions.
* Training and capability development outcomes.
* Effectiveness of HR interventions and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Quality and frequency of field HR engagement.
* Accuracy and timeliness of HR reporting and analytics.
* Successful execution of HR projects and initiatives.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

* Postgraduate degree/MBA in **Human Resources / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations** from a reputed institution.
* Additional qualifications in Labour Laws / Employment Relations will be an advantage.

**EXPERIENCE**

* **10–14 years of overall HR experience**, with significant experience in an HR Business Partnering role.
* Prior experience in **retail, fashion, footwear, apparel, FMCG, hospitality or another large frontline workforce environment** is strongly preferred.
* Strong hands\-on experience in employee relations, performance management, workforce planning and people management.
* Experience managing HR across a **large, geographically dispersed store/network environment** is preferred.
* Proven experience partnering with senior retail/business stakeholders.

**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**

**Functional Skills**

* HR Business Partnering
* Employee Relations
* Retail HR / Field HR
* Performance Management
* Talent Management
* Succession Planning
* Career Development
* Workforce Planning
* Employee Engagement \& Retention
* Recruitment \& Selection
* Learning \& Development
* Compensation \& Benefits
* HR Analytics \& Reporting
* Employment/Labour Laws
* HR Policy \& Compliance

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong business acumen
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong influencing and stakeholder management capability
* Sound judgement and decision\-making ability
* Conflict resolution and problem\-solving skills
* High level of confidentiality and integrity
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* Strong coaching and people management skills
* Data\-driven approach to HR decision\-making
* Adaptability and ability to work in a fast\-paced retail environment

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENT**


The role requires **extensive travel across North \& Upper North India**, including regular visits to stores and regional locations based on business requirements.


The incumbent should be comfortable working in a highly field\-oriented environment and engaging directly with employees and retail leadership across multiple locations.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**


The ideal candidate will be a **strong, business\-oriented Retail HRBP** who combines strategic HR thinking with hands\-on field execution. The candidate should be comfortable working closely with Store Managers and Regional/District leaders, managing complex employee relations situations, driving people processes across a distributed workforce and influencing business decisions through strong HR insights.


The individual should have the maturity and confidence to operate as a **trusted advisor to Retail leadership**, while maintaining strong employee connect and ensuring consistent implementation of Skechers' policies, culture and people practices across the region.

**About Skechers**


Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

 With brands like

 , we offer healthy and delicious alternatives to the junk food epidemic. It’s time to rediscover the nutritious traditions of our ancestors and embrace the power of millets like Ragi, Jowar, Bajra and Foxtail Millet.

 At Wholsum Foods, we believe our team is our greatest asset. Our core values —
 **Relationship First, Dependable, Passionate and Growth Mindset** 
 — shape how we work and how we grow together.
   

  

 We are also
 **Great Place to Work Certified** 
 .
   

  

 If you enjoy being close to the business, solving real people challenges and building things rather than just following playbooks, you’ll enjoy this role.
   

  

 WHAT WILL YOU DO AT WHOLSUM FOODS?
   

  

 As a
 **Manager – HR Business Partner** 
 , you will be a strategic and hands\-on people partner to our business leaders.
   

  

 You will work closely with leaders and managers to understand where the business is headed, what the organisation needs to get there, and how HR can enable that journey.
   

  

 This is not a role limited to HR processes. You will be expected to understand the
 **business, people, numbers and culture** 
 , and translate business priorities into meaningful people actions.
   

  

 You will own the HR agenda for assigned functions across
 **workforce planning, talent acquisition, performance, talent management, employee engagement, organisation effectiveness and employee lifecycle** 
 , while partnering closely with leadership on critical people decisions.
   

  

 The role requires someone who is equally comfortable discussing
 **business targets with a leader, solving an employee concern, challenging a hiring manager, analysing people data or getting into the details to make something happen.**
**Job Purpose**
 To partner with business leaders in building a high\-performing organisation by translating business priorities into effective people strategies and ensuring strong execution across the employee lifecycle.
   

  

 The Manager – HRBP will act as a
 **thought partner to the business** 
 , while remaining deeply hands\-on in execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business Partnering
* Partner with business leaders to understand their business plans, organisation structure, workforce requirements and people challenges.
* Act as a trusted HR advisor and thought partner to leaders and managers.
* Translate business priorities into people priorities and actionable HR plans.
* Proactively identify people risks and opportunities rather than only responding to issues.
* Challenge and influence managers where required, while maintaining strong relationships and credibility.
* Understand business metrics and connect people decisions with business outcomes.
* Workforce Planning \& Organisation Effectiveness
* Partner with leaders on annual and periodic workforce planning.
* Assess organisation structures, spans, layers, capability requirements and future talent needs.
* Support manpower planning based on business growth, productivity and cost considerations.
* Identify capability gaps and work with leaders to build the right talent and organisation structure.
* Support organisation design and restructuring initiatives as the business evolves.
* Talent Acquisition
* Partner with Talent Acquisition on critical and leadership hiring requirements.
* Support role calibration, talent benchmarking and hiring strategy for assigned functions.
* Ensure hiring plans are aligned with business priorities, timelines and budgets.
* Bring a business lens to candidate quality, compensation and talent availability.
* Build strong understanding of internal and external talent pipelines.
* Performance \& Talent Management
* Own and strengthen performance management practices for assigned teams.
* Partner with managers on goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement.
* Support talent reviews, succession planning and identification of high\-potential talent.
* Enable managers to have better quality performance and career conversations.
* Identify capability gaps and work with the People Team to create relevant development interventions.
* Employee Engagement \& Culture
* Actively own the employee experience for assigned functions.
* Use employee feedback, engagement data and people insights to identify areas of improvement.
* Partner with managers to strengthen engagement, retention and team effectiveness.
* Drive meaningful employee connects and culture initiatives rather than activity\-led engagement.
* Be a strong custodian of Wholsum’s values and culture as the organisation scales.
* Employee Relations \& Manager Enablement
* Act as a point of support for managers and employees on people\-related matters.
* Handle sensitive employee situations with maturity, empathy and sound judgement.
* Coach managers on employee conversations, conflict resolution, performance concerns and people decisions.
* Ensure consistent and fair application of HR policies and processes.
* Build manager capability to independently handle people matters effectively.
* People Analytics \& Insights
* Use people data to identify trends and support business decisions.
* Track metrics such as attrition, hiring TAT, workforce cost, engagement, performance and retention.
* Convert people data into meaningful insights and recommendations for leadership.
* Build a data\-backed approach to solving recurring people challenges.
* HR Projects \& Organisation Building
* Lead and contribute to strategic People \& Culture projects as the organisation scales.
* Build and improve HR processes, frameworks and systems with a focus on simplicity and effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to use technology and AI to improve HR productivity and employee experience.
* Drive projects from idea to execution, ensuring measurable outcomes.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, success will mean:
   

  

* Business leaders see you as a trusted people partner, not just an HR process owner.
* Workforce plans are aligned with business growth and cost priorities.
* Hiring, retention and talent decisions are increasingly proactive and data\-backed.
* Managers become better at managing, developing and engaging their teams.
* Performance and talent processes are executed with quality and ownership.
* People issues are identified early and resolved thoughtfully.
* Employees have a strong and consistent experience across their lifecycle.
* HR is seen as an enabler of business growth, not a support function sitting on the sidelines.


**Experience Required**
* 9–12 years of relevant experience across HR Business Partnering, HR Generalist, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations or related HR roles.
* Strong experience in business partnering with managers and senior business leaders.
* Experience working in a startup, D2C, FMCG, food, retail, consumer or other high\-growth environment will be preferred.
* Strong exposure to multiple HR areas, with the ability to look at people challenges holistically.
* Demonstrated experience in handling complex people situations and influencing stakeholders.
* Experience in workforce planning, performance management, talent management and employee engagement.
* Strong understanding of HR metrics and people analytics.


**What We Are Looking For**
 Business Acumen
   

  

 You understand that HR decisions ultimately need to support the business. You are curious about revenue, growth, productivity, cost and organisational performance.
   

  

 Ownership
   

  

 You don’t wait for perfect instructions. You identify the problem, figure out what needs to happen and drive it to closure.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management
   

  

 You can build trust with people at different levels while also having the confidence to challenge when required.
   

  

 People Judgement
   

  

 You can balance empathy with business realities and make thoughtful decisions in sensitive situations.
   

  

 Execution Excellence
   

  

 You can think strategically but are equally comfortable getting into the details and making things happen.
   

  

 Growth Mindset
   

  

 You enjoy ambiguity, learn quickly and are excited by the opportunity to build rather than simply maintain existing systems.
   

  

 Data Orientation
   

  

 You are comfortable using data and people insights to understand problems, challenge assumptions and make better decisions.
   

  

**Academic Requirements**
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.
* Candidates with a bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Commerce or a related discipline may also be considered.


 WHAT WILL YOU GET?
   

  

* A front\-row seat to building a high\-growth FMCG business.
* Opportunity to work closely with founders, business leaders and senior People \& Culture leaders.
* The opportunity to shape the people agenda as Wholsum scales.
* Exposure to strategic workforce planning, organisation building and business decision\-making.
* Freedom to experiment, build and improve rather than simply follow established playbooks.
* Mentorship from senior leaders, board members and in\-house experts.
* The opportunity to think strategically while staying close to execution.
* A chance to make a real impact on how people experience and grow with Wholsum Foods.


**STARTING DATE:** 
 Position open immediately
   

  

**LOCATION:** 
 Golf Course Road, Gurugram
   

  

**WORKING MODEL:** 
 5\-day working week \| Wednesday WFH
   

  

 Wholsum Foods is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in its workforce.

title: Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
   

  

**Job Description**
**Are you ready to help build something new?**
 At Philips, meaningful careers are built by stepping into opportunities that challenge you, broaden your perspective, and enable you to make an impact with care.
   

  

 The Central Rewards Services team was established in August 2026 to bring together shared activities across M\&A, analytics, equity, mobility, business travel, and operations. By combining our expertise, we aim to increase agility and strengthen global consistency.
   

  

 As a Rewards Services Partner, you will join us at an important stage in our journey. You will help shape how the team works, contribute across disciplines, and grow your expertise beyond a single Rewards specialization.
   

  

**In this role, you have the opportunity to..**
 Help build the future of Rewards Services at Philips. You will combine ownership of Global Mobility support for the APAC region with broader contributions to global Rewards processes, including annual compensation rounds, market benchmarking, analytics, and cross\-functional improvement initiatives.
   

  

 This is intentionally a diverse and evolving role. The Central Rewards Services team is new, and not every responsibility or way of working has been fully defined. You will have the space to bring ideas, test better approaches, and take ownership where your experience, curiosity, and energy can create value.
   

  

 You will work with specialists across the global Rewards landscape, learn from different disciplines, and help connect activities that have traditionally been managed separately. In doing so, you will strengthen both the employee experience and the consistency and effectiveness of our Rewards services.
   

  

 The role is an opportunity to broaden your career as a Rewards professional while making a visible contribution to the success of a new global team.
   

  

**Your role**
* Own and coordinate Global Mobility activities for the APAC region, providing clear guidance and a consistent experience for employees and stakeholders.
* Contribute to global Rewards cycles, including annual compensation review processes, with a focus on accurate preparation, effective coordination, and high\-quality delivery.
* Support market benchmarking and Rewards analysis, translating data into clear insights that enable informed decisions.
* Work across Central Rewards Services activities, including equity, business travel, M\&A, analytics, operations, and Rewards Excellence, based on business priorities and team needs.
* Help design and embed new ways of working that reduce duplication, improve agility, and strengthen global consistency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, clarify ownership, improve service quality, and create an even better employee and stakeholder experience.
* Build strong partnerships with a multitude of stakeholders from a great variety of functions within the organisation to deliver connected solutions.
* Use data, technology, and AI responsibly to improve insights, efficiency, and service delivery.
* Share knowledge, learn from colleagues across disciplines, and contribute to building capability within the Central Rewards Services team and the wider Rewards community.
* Take ownership beyond established boundaries when new priorities emerge, balancing flexibility with sound judgment and reliable delivery.


**The impact you can make**
 Your Contribution Will Go Beyond Delivering Individual Processes. You Will Help Turn a Newly Established Team Into a Connected And Trusted Global Partner By
   

  

* Ensuring a consistent, employee\-focused Global Mobility experience across the APAC region.
* Helping global Rewards processes run smoothly and deliver reliable outcomes.
* Connecting expertise and activities across Central Rewards Services so that work is performed where it creates the most value.
* Bringing forward practical ideas and turning them into improvements that can be scaled globally.
* Helping build a team culture based on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.


**You're The Right Fit If You Have**
* A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Experience in Global Mobility, Compensation, Rewards, HR Operations, or a related discipline.
* Interest in broadening your expertise across multiple Rewards areas rather than remaining within one specialization.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and complexity into clear insights and practical actions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills in a global, matrixed organization.
* The ability to organize priorities, deliver reliably, and adapt when business needs change.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset and the confidence to question existing approaches constructively.
* Curiosity, creativity, and flexibility, together with a willingness to step outside your comfort zone.
* The judgment and discretion required when working with confidential employee and business information.
* AI literacy and an interest in using technology to improve how Rewards services are delivered.


**You will thrive in this role if you...**
* Are energized by the opportunity to help create, not only to maintain.
* Can bring structure to ambiguity without waiting for every detail to be defined.
* See change as an opportunity to learn, contribute, and improve.
* Enjoy moving between regional delivery, global processes, analysis, and project work.
* Build trust through collaboration, openness, and follow\-through.
* Want to broaden your Rewards expertise and help a new team become a success.


**How We Work Together**
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
   

  

**About Philips**
 Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.
