**Position Summary**
 Nestlé is looking for an experienced Regional Benefits Senior Expert to join our Total Rewards team. This role will provide functional expertise and strategic support for the review, design and implementation of employee benefits programmes across multiple European markets.
   

  

 Working closely with Market Total Rewards teams and regional and global stakeholders, you will help ensure that our benefits programmes remain competitive, cost\-effective, compliant and valued by employees. * Monitor programme costs and financial risks, identifying opportunities related to plan design, investment strategy and benefits utilisation.
* Support clear and engaging employee communications, including web content, videos, brochures and educational materials.
* Translate complex benefits topics into practical and understandable guidance for non\-technical audiences.
* Help maintain compliance with internal controls, benefits guidelines, tax requirements, social security regulations and applicable labour laws.
* Coordinate regional benefits benchmarking and help markets assess competitive positioning, external trends and potential corrective actions.
* Support the selection and optimisation of insurance, consulting and benefits administration partners.

**Key Projects**
* Deployment of a global flexible benefits solution across markets.
* Automation of benefits reviews in partnership with NBS and People Analytics.
* Migration and change management for a new benefits management platform.
* Expansion of benefits communication at key employee moments.
* Financial wellbeing initiatives and global benefits reviews.
* Benefits implications of international medical plans and expatriate policy implementation.
* Continued optimisation of benefits vendors, governance and compliance frameworks.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* At least eight years of experience managing employee benefits processes and programmes.
* Strong in\-market experience within Nestlé or another organisation, with practical functional and operational benefits knowledge.
* Experience designing, reviewing or implementing employee benefits plans.
* Good understanding of local employment laws and labour regulations.
* Experience developing and using KPIs and benefits\-related metrics.
* Strong benchmarking, data analysis and insight\-generation capabilities.
* Advanced Excel skills and the ability to use data to recommend benefits actions and decisions.
* Experience managing and negotiating with benefits, insurance or consulting vendors.
* Finance and tax knowledge would be an advantage.
* Previous experience supporting multiple countries or markets would be highly valuable.


**Skills And Personal Qualities**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong project\-management and time\-management capabilities.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and establish credibility with senior stakeholders.
* Confidence in communicating technical benefits topics to different audiences.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively under demanding deadlines.
* Strong networking and relationship\-building skills.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work within multifunctional and multicultural teams.


**Key Stakeholders**
 You will collaborate with Market and Zone Total Rewards teams, Market HR leaders, Finance, IT, Corporate Total Rewards, Group Risk Services, the Group Pension Unit, procurement teams and other regional and global partners. Externally, you will engage with insurance providers, third\-party administrators, HR consultants and professional Total Rewards networks.
   

  

**Join Us**
 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced benefits professional to influence the future of employee benefits across Europe. You will combine technical expertise, market insight, data analysis and stakeholder partnership to help deliver sustainable and meaningful benefits solutions for our employees.
   

  

 Nestlé is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where people from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives can thrive.

 We are looking for an experienced Learning \& Development (L\&D) Manager to design, implement, and oversee training and development programs that build employee skills, strengthen leadership capability, and support the organization's growth.  \- Design and implement company\-wide learning and development strategies aligned with business goals and workforce needs.

title: Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
description:
### **Job Title**

Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
### **Job Description**

**Are you ready to help build something new?**

At Philips, meaningful careers are built by stepping into opportunities that challenge you, broaden your perspective, and enable you to make an impact with care.


The Central Rewards Services team was established in August 2026 to bring together shared activities across M\&A, analytics, equity, mobility, business travel, and operations. By combining our expertise, we aim to increase agility and strengthen global consistency.


As a Rewards Services Partner, you will join us at an important stage in our journey. You will help shape how the team works, contribute across disciplines, and grow your expertise beyond a single Rewards specialization.


**In this role, you have the opportunity to..**

Help build the future of Rewards Services at Philips. You will combine ownership of Global Mobility support for the APAC region with broader contributions to global Rewards processes, including annual compensation rounds, market benchmarking, analytics, and cross\-functional improvement initiatives.


This is intentionally a diverse and evolving role. The Central Rewards Services team is new, and not every responsibility or way of working has been fully defined. You will have the space to bring ideas, test better approaches, and take ownership where your experience, curiosity, and energy can create value.


You will work with specialists across the global Rewards landscape, learn from different disciplines, and help connect activities that have traditionally been managed separately. In doing so, you will strengthen both the employee experience and the consistency and effectiveness of our Rewards services.


The role is an opportunity to broaden your career as a Rewards professional while making a visible contribution to the success of a new global team.


**Your role**

* Own and coordinate Global Mobility activities for the APAC region, providing clear guidance and a consistent experience for employees and stakeholders.
* Contribute to global Rewards cycles, including annual compensation review processes, with a focus on accurate preparation, effective coordination, and high\-quality delivery.
* Support market benchmarking and Rewards analysis, translating data into clear insights that enable informed decisions.
* Work across Central Rewards Services activities, including equity, business travel, M\&A, analytics, operations, and Rewards Excellence, based on business priorities and team needs.
* Help design and embed new ways of working that reduce duplication, improve agility, and strengthen global consistency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, clarify ownership, improve service quality, and create an even better employee and stakeholder experience.
* Build strong partnerships with a multitude of stakeholders from a great variety of functions within the organisation to deliver connected solutions.
* Use data, technology, and AI responsibly to improve insights, efficiency, and service delivery.
* Share knowledge, learn from colleagues across disciplines, and contribute to building capability within the Central Rewards Services team and the wider Rewards community.
* Take ownership beyond established boundaries when new priorities emerge, balancing flexibility with sound judgment and reliable delivery.

**The impact you can make**

Your contribution will go beyond delivering individual processes. You will help turn a newly established team into a connected and trusted global partner by:


* Ensuring a consistent, employee\-focused Global Mobility experience across the APAC region.
* Helping global Rewards processes run smoothly and deliver reliable outcomes.
* Connecting expertise and activities across Central Rewards Services so that work is performed where it creates the most value.
* Bringing forward practical ideas and turning them into improvements that can be scaled globally.
* Helping build a team culture based on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.

**You're the right fit if you have:**

* A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Experience in Global Mobility, Compensation, Rewards, HR Operations, or a related discipline.
* Interest in broadening your expertise across multiple Rewards areas rather than remaining within one specialization.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and complexity into clear insights and practical actions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills in a global, matrixed organization.
* The ability to organize priorities, deliver reliably, and adapt when business needs change.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset and the confidence to question existing approaches constructively.
* Curiosity, creativity, and flexibility, together with a willingness to step outside your comfort zone.
* The judgment and discretion required when working with confidential employee and business information.
* AI literacy and an interest in using technology to improve how Rewards services are delivered.

**You will thrive in this role if you...**

* Are energized by the opportunity to help create, not only to maintain.
* Can bring structure to ambiguity without waiting for every detail to be defined.
* See change as an opportunity to learn, contribute, and improve.
* Enjoy moving between regional delivery, global processes, analysis, and project work.
* Build trust through collaboration, openness, and follow\-through.
* Want to broaden your Rewards expertise and help a new team become a success.

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.  



  

**About Philips**  

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

title: Office Admin, HR & Digital Operations
description:
**Job Summary**

The Office Admin, HR \& Digital Operations professional will be responsible for ensuring the smooth day\-to\-day functioning of Curio Education’s office, managing HR and administrative processes, preparing management reports and presentations, handling Excel/MIS requirements, coordinating travel, and managing key digital platforms including the **Curio App and iXpress LMS**.

The role requires a highly organised, tech\-comfortable, responsible, and proactive individual who can coordinate effectively with Management, Employees, Sales Team, Academic Team, Schools, Franchisees, Vendors, and Technology Partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Office Administration**

* Manage the day\-to\-day functioning of the Curio Education office.
* Ensure the office remains organised, professional, clean, and functional.
* Maintain stationery, pantry supplies, office consumables, and other requirements.
* Coordinate repair and maintenance of office equipment, internet, computers, printers, ACs, furniture, and facilities.
* Maintain office asset records.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers.
* Maintain visitor records and meeting arrangements.
* Ensure administrative requirements of all departments are completed on time.

**2\. Employee Attendance \& Leave Management**

* Maintain daily employee attendance.
* Track late arrivals, absenteeism, working hours, and leave.
* Maintain monthly leave records.
* Coordinate leave approvals with reporting managers.
* Prepare attendance summaries for payroll.
* Maintain holiday and compensatory\-off records.

**3\. Recruitment Coordination**

* Coordinate hiring requirements with Management and Department Heads.
* Post vacancies on recruitment platforms.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates.
* Conduct preliminary HR screening.
* Schedule interviews.
* Coordinate candidate communication and follow\-ups.
* Maintain recruitment trackers.
* Track selected candidates until joining.
* Maintain manpower and vacancy reports.

**4\. Employee Joining \& Onboarding**

* Collect employee documents.
* Prepare offer and appointment letters.
* Complete employee information forms.
* Create and maintain employee files.
* Coordinate email IDs, systems, attendance access, and resources.
* Explain office policies, timings, leave rules, and reporting structures.
* Coordinate employee induction and onboarding.

**5\. Employee Documentation \& HR Records**

Maintain updated and confidential employee records including:

* Resumes
* Identification documents
* Educational certificates
* Previous employment records
* Offer and appointment letters
* Salary information
* Attendance and leave records
* Performance records
* Increment and promotion letters
* Warning letters
* Resignation and exit documents

**6\. HR Policies \& Processes**

* Support Management in implementing HR policies.
* Communicate policies to employees.
* Monitor compliance with:
* Attendance
* Leave
* Working hours
* Workplace discipline
* Confidentiality
* Performance standards
* Code of conduct
* Maintain proper HR documentation.

**7\. Payroll Coordination**

* Prepare monthly attendance and leave inputs.
* Coordinate salary data with Accounts and Management.
* Maintain records of salary revisions, incentives, deductions, advances, and reimbursements.
* Ensure payroll inputs are timely and accurate.
* Coordinate routine salary\-related queries.

**8\. PowerPoint Presentation Creation**

The candidate should be able to independently prepare professional PowerPoint presentations for Curio Education and iXpress.

Presentations may include:

* Sales presentations
* School proposal presentations
* Management review presentations
* Franchise presentations
* Teacher training presentations
* Parent orientation presentations
* Monthly and quarterly business reviews
* Internal meeting presentations
* Project presentations
* Reports and dashboards

The candidate should be able to convert raw information, data, and Management inputs into structured and professional presentations while maintaining Curio and iXpress branding.

**9\. Excel, MIS \& Data Management**

* Create and maintain Excel trackers.
* Prepare Management MIS reports.
* Maintain employee and recruitment databases.
* Maintain school and franchisee databases.
* Prepare sales and collection trackers.
* Maintain attendance and leave reports.
* Prepare operational trackers.
* Create monthly performance sheets.
* Prepare basic dashboards and summaries.
* Work confidently with formulas, filters, sorting, conditional formatting, pivot tables, and data analysis.
* Verify data before sharing reports.

**10\. Curio App Management**

* Create and manage school accounts.
* Create teacher and user logins.
* Maintain student and school information.
* Coordinate student data uploads.
* Manage access rights.
* Coordinate academic content uploads.
* Monitor app usage.
* Support schools and teachers with basic app\-related queries.
* Maintain user credentials and records.
* Coordinate with the technical team regarding issues.
* Track issues until resolution.
* Test new features where required.
* Prepare usage reports for Management.
* Highlight schools with low app usage or recurring technical issues.

**11\. iXpress LMS Management**

* Create franchisee, centre, teacher, and student accounts.
* Manage user credentials and access.
* Add new centres to the LMS.
* Update centre and student information.
* Upload and organise learning content.
* Assign modules, courses, assessments, and resources.
* Monitor student and centre activity.
* Maintain student enrolment data.
* Coordinate assessment uploads and reports.
* Support franchisees and teachers with LMS queries.
* Coordinate technical issues with the technology team.
* Test system updates.
* Maintain issue\-resolution records.
* Prepare LMS usage reports for Management.

**12\. Digital User Support**

* Respond to basic Curio App and iXpress LMS queries.
* Guide teachers, schools, franchisees, and employees.
* Maintain an issue tracker.
* Categorise issues into user, data, content, or technical issues.
* Resolve basic issues internally.
* Escalate technical problems where required.
* Follow up until closure.

**13\. Travel Planning \& Management**

The candidate will be responsible for **planning, coordinating, and managing official travel requirements** for Management and team members.

Responsibilities include:

* Collecting travel requirements from Management and employees.
* Planning travel based on meetings, school visits, training schedules, events, and business requirements.
* Preparing complete travel itineraries.
* Booking flights, trains, buses, cabs, and other transport.
* Booking hotels and accommodation.
* Comparing travel options to achieve the best balance of cost, convenience, and timing.
* Obtaining required travel approvals before booking.
* Coordinating airport, railway station, and local transfers.
* Sharing tickets, hotel vouchers, contact details, and travel plans with employees.

* Coordinating travel for:
* Sales visits
* School meetings
* Teacher training
* Parent orientations
* Franchise meetings
* Conferences
* Exhibitions
* Management travel

* Coordinating group travel where multiple team members are travelling together.
* Maintaining records of travel bookings and expenses.
* Collecting travel bills and supporting documents.
* Coordinating reimbursement documentation with Accounts.
* Tracking travel advances and settlements.
* Maintaining preferred hotel, airline, cab, and travel\-agent databases.
* Negotiating rates with travel vendors wherever possible.
* Ensuring travel arrangements are completed well in advance.
* Providing support to travelling employees in case of delays, cancellations, or booking\-related issues.

**14\. Meetings \& Management Support**

* Schedule Management meetings.
* Prepare agendas.
* Prepare reports, Excel sheets, and PPTs before meetings.
* Record Minutes of Meetings where required.
* Maintain action\-point trackers.
* Follow up with departments regarding pending tasks.
* Maintain a Management Action Tracker.

**15\. Performance Management Support**

* Maintain employee KRAs and KPIs.
* Coordinate performance reviews.
* Track probation and confirmation dates.
* Follow up with reporting managers for employee reviews.
* Maintain appraisal records.
* Prepare confirmation, increment, promotion, or extension letters after approval.

**16\. Employee Engagement \& Communication**

* Coordinate employee meetings and engagement activities.
* Organise birthdays, festivals, and celebrations.
* Communicate office notices and announcements.
* Address routine employee concerns.
* Support smooth interdepartmental communication.

**17\. Office Discipline**

* Ensure adherence to office timings and company policies.
* Monitor workplace discipline.
* Report repeated attendance or behavioural concerns to Management.
* Maintain appropriate documentation.
* Protect confidential HR and Management information.

**18\. Vendor \& Expense Coordination**

Manage vendors related to:

* Office supplies
* Printing
* Housekeeping
* Internet
* IT support
* Software
* Courier
* Maintenance
* Travel
* Hotels
* Cab services
* Technology platforms

Responsibilities include checking bills, coordinating approvals, maintaining vendor records, tracking expenses, and ensuring service quality.

**19\. Exit \& Full\-and\-Final Coordination**

* Receive and process resignations.
* Track notice periods.
* Coordinate handovers.
* Collect company assets.
* Disable digital access.
* Coordinate relieving and experience letters.

Coordinate documentation, wherever applicable, relating to:

* Employee contracts
* PF
* ESI
* Professional Tax
* POSH
* Shops \& Establishment requirements

**Daily Responsibilities**

A typical day may include:

* Checking Curio App and iXpress LMS requirements.
* Preparing Excel trackers and MIS.

**Key Performance Indicators – KPIs**

Performance will be evaluated on:

**Job Description**

**HavStrategy**

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

**About HavStrategy**

HavStrategy is a data\-driven digital marketing and performance growth agency that helps D2C, eCommerce, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, luxury, and consumer brands achieve sustainable business growth through innovative marketing strategies, performance marketing, branding, data analytics, and business consulting.

As a Founder's Office Executive, you will work directly with the founders and leadership team, driving strategic initiatives, business operations, and cross\-functional execution with a high degree of ownership. This role is ideal for a self\-driven professional who can independently manage projects, translate strategy into execution, and act as a trusted extension of the founders.

title: Global Benefits Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Global Benefits Manager, you will manage and evolve BCG’s employee benefits programs across multiple regions, with a focus on health, life, disability, and business travel coverage. You will bring deep benefits expertise and strong analytical judgment to ensure programs remain competitive, well\-governed, compliant, and responsive to evolving business and employee needs.


As part of the Global Benefits Centre of Expertise, you will manage complex benefits programs and initiatives, turn data and market insights into practical recommendations, and drive improvements across processes and the employee benefits experience. You will work closely with global and regional colleagues and external partners, providing guidance on complex benefits matters and helping shape consistent approaches across markets.

* Manage the delivery, review, and improvement of global benefits programs across multiple regions.
* Lead benchmarking, cost, and claims analyses to shape plan design, renewal, and wellbeing recommendations.
* Assess insurance contracts and plan documentation, identifying opportunities to improve value and manage risk.
* Lead global program renewals, partnering with brokers and insurers to drive high\-quality outcomes.
* Translate benefits data and market developments into practical insights and recommendations for decision\-making.
* Partner with HR and Finance teams to address complex benefits issues, manage costs, and improve program delivery.
* Drive improvements to benefits processes, documentation, governance, and the MyBenefits digital experience.
* Identify and manage program risks while supporting alignment with global standards and local regulatory requirements.

  

What You'll Bring

* You bring 6\- 8\+ years of experience in benefits management, broking, or consulting.
* You have deep knowledge of employee benefits, insured programs, and insurance market practices.
* You use strong analytical skills and judgment to turn complex data into practical recommendations.
* You bring advanced Excel skills and experience developing clear, decision\-focused presentations.
* You confidently manage complex priorities and programs across a global, matrixed environment.
* You communicate effectively with diverse audiences and influence decisions through clear, evidence\-based recommendations.
* You have experience with digital benefits platforms and identifying opportunities to improve employee experience.

  

Who You'll Work With


You will be part of BCG’s Global Benefits Centre of Expertise, working with colleagues across regions to shape and deliver high\-quality benefits programs. You will partner closely with global, regional, and local HR and Finance teams, bringing benefits expertise and practical recommendations to complex program and operational decisions.

  

You will also build productive relationships with benefits brokers, insurers, and other external partners, working together to manage renewals, address emerging issues, and improve program performance. Across these relationships, you will help connect global priorities with local needs and drive greater consistency and effectiveness in how benefits are delivered.

  

Additional info


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.  

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.  

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Talent Aquisition Lead
description:
**We’re Hiring**
================


Talent Acquisition Lead
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
Working Days: 6 Days a Week
Experience: 10–15 Years  

AVI Renewable Energy is looking for an accomplished Talent Acquisition Lead to exclusively manage Senior Management, SBU Head, Functional Head, CXO\-level and other leadership/business\-critical hiring mandates. The role is focused on reducing leadership hiring TAT through proactive executive search, direct headhunting, talent mapping, market intelligence and senior\-level networking.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Manage end\-to\-end hiring for Senior Management, Functional Heads, SBU Heads and CXO\-level roles.
* Partner with Management and Functional Heads to define leadership profiles, priorities and closure timelines.
* Develop role\-specific search strategies covering target industries, companies and candidate pools.
* Directly headhunt and engage high\-quality passive candidates through LinkedIn, networking and professional channels.
* Build and maintain leadership talent maps and succession\-ready candidate pipelines.
* Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks and competitor talent.
* Assess senior candidates on leadership capability, business scale, P\&L exposure, team size, career progression and cultural fit.
* Present high\-quality calibrated shortlists and evidence\-based candidate recommendations to Management.
* Manage senior candidate engagement, compensation discussions, negotiations and joining risks.
* Handle confidential/replacement searches with complete discretion.
* Manage executive search partners where required while strengthening direct sourcing capability.
* Track leadership hiring TAT, vacancy ageing, search progress and joining risks through structured MIS.
* Lead and mentor the Talent Acquisition team.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


* Master’s / PGD in HR preferred. Engineering or Management graduates with strong Leadership Talent Acquisition experience may also be considered.
* Experience in Solar, Renewable Energy, EPC, Engineering, Manufacturing, Infrastructure, Power or related industries will be strongly preferred.
* 10–15 years of Talent Acquisition / Executive Search experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Senior Management, Functional Head, SBU Head and/or CXO hiring.
* Proven expertise in direct headhunting, passive\-candidate engagement and talent mapping.
* Advanced LinkedIn sourcing, networking and market\-mapping capability.
* Demonstrated ability to independently close senior/leadership mandates.
* Strong stakeholder management, assessment, negotiation and communication skills.
* Experience in senior\-level compensation benchmarking and offer closure.
* High professional maturity, judgement, confidentiality and ownership.

description:
**Job Description**

**Primary Responsibilities**



* Reporting to the General Manager and you will be responsible for determining the People \& Culture strategic and programmatic needs of ibis Kochi City Centre and also support effective implementation and evaluation of strategies, policies and procedures.
* Control and monitor the administration of all People \& Culture activities and policies.

	+ Compensations \& Benefits
	+ Performance Management System
	+ Employee Relations

* Any matter which may effect the interests of Ibis Kochi City Centre should be brought to the attention of the Management.



**People \& Culture Planning**



* Develop an annual and long\-term People \& Culture plan that identifies the organizations People \& Culture agenda as a component of the organizations overall Strategic Plan.
* Identify People \& Culture strategies and program requirements needed to maintain a progressive work culture in support of effective recruitment, development, and retention of the employees.



**People Management**



* Establish and maintain seamless co\-ordination \& co\-operation with all departments of Ibis Kochi City Centre to ensure maximum productivity, morale and guest service.
* Develop and maintain effective relationships with all the departments.
* Respond to queries by resolving issues in a timely and efficient manner.

* Ensure that all personnel are kept well informed of department’s objectives and policies.

**Operational Management**



* Develop and implement effective recruitment and screening system, as per the organizations requirement.
* To ensure the smooth and efficient running of the People \& Culture Department, ensuring that all the Policies and Procedures outlined in the Operations Manual are strictly adhered to.
* Establish standard policies and procedures for all the processes in the People \& Culture Management.

* Ensure that all the employees comply with the policies and procedures.

* Prepare and submit periodic personnel reports such as turnover, personnel inventories and recruitment.

	+ Manpower planning.

* To ensure that all practices are complete and abreast with legal practices, policies and procedures.

* Inspect the staff Cafeteria, locker rooms and other facilities on a regular basis to ensure that they are well operated and maintained.

* Master's Degree in Human Resources Management

* Excellent reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
* Proficient in MS Excel, Word, \& PowerPoint



**Competencies**



* Strong leadership, interpersonal and negotiation skills
* Excellent communication and customer contact skills
* Results and service oriented with an eye for details
* A team player \& builder
* A motivator \& self\-starter
* Well\-presented and professionally groomed at all times

title: Employee Relations Associate- Contractual
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description: Associate – Employee Relations (Contract)**
**Role :** 
 Associate – Employee Relations (Contract)
   

  

**Function Description:**
 The Employee Relations (ER) function is a Centre of Excellence within the Talent organisation of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS). This contract role provides day\-to\-day support to the ER Lead and team by assisting with investigations, managing assigned low\-severity cases, keeping case records current and completing routine ER administrative activities. The role works within defined procedures and promptly escalates sensitive, complex or higher\-risk matters to the ER Lead.
   

  

**Job description:**
* Assist the ER Lead and ER team across investigations by supporting case intake, preparing investigation plans and timelines, scheduling interviews and coordinating with relevant stakeholders.
* Gather, organise and review relevant documents and evidence; prepare interview questions; take accurate interview notes; maintain evidence logs; and draft factual case summaries for review by the ER Lead.
* Independently manage assigned low\-severity and routine ER cases in accordance with approved policies, standard operating procedures, service\-level expectations and guidance from the ER Lead.
* Conduct initial fact\-finding, coordinate discussions, document employee and stakeholder inputs, follow up on open actions and prepare closure documentation for low\-severity matters.
* Recognise and promptly escalate matters involving higher severity, legal or reputational exposure, retaliation concerns, safeguarding issues, conflicts of interest or any other complexity beyond the agreed scope.
* Perform ER operations, including opening and updating cases, monitoring ageing and turnaround time, maintaining trackers and dashboards, coordinating documentation and approvals, and supporting timely case closure.
* Maintain complete, accurate and audit\-ready case files, ensuring all records are stored and handled in line with confidentiality, privacy and information\-security requirements.
* Prepare standard correspondence, meeting records, case updates, reports and other ER documentation using approved templates and review protocols.
* Compile routine case data, check trackers for missing or overdue updates and provide regular status information to the ER Lead.
* Maintain standard templates, checklists, investigation files and process documents, and complete other routine ER administrative tasks assigned by the ER Lead.


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, factual and well\-structured case documentation.
* Strong attention to detail, organisation and follow\-through while managing multiple cases and operational tasks.
* Basic understanding of employee relations principles, workplace policies and Indian employment law is desirable.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion, maintain confidentiality and demonstrate professional judgement.
* Ability to remain neutral, listen carefully, ask structured questions and distinguish facts from assumptions.
* Ability to work within defined processes, recognise the limits of delegated authority and escalate risks in a timely manner.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint; experience with HR or case\-management systems is an advantage.
* A collaborative, service\-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively with the ER Lead, Talent teams and business stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Law, or a related field.
* 0\-3 years of experience in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Employee Engagement, or a similar role.
* Basic understanding of employment laws and workplace policies is desirable.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.


**Skills**
* Organization and record management
* Communication and interpersonal skills
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Confidentiality and professionalism
* Stakeholder coordination


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


- 

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: HR Manager – Ecommerce & Appliances
description:
Moonstruck Appliances is hiring an HR Manager to build strong teams and take ownership of recruitment and day\-to\-day people management.
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced HR professional who has worked in ecommerce, D2C, home\-appliance or consumer\-durables companies and understands how to hire, develop and retain people in a fast\-moving business.
 



  





 Location: Bawana, Delhi \| Full\-time \| On\-site
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 • Recruitment from start to finish: work with the founders and department heads on hiring plans, write clear job descriptions, source candidates, screen profiles, coordinate practical assessments and interviews, manage offers and follow through until joining.
 



 • Ecommerce and appliance hiring: recruit marketplace managers and executives, Amazon/Flipkart specialists, advertising and performance\-marketing staff, catalogue teams, designers, customer\-support staff and operations employees. Coordinate warehouse, production and service hiring as business needs require.
 



 • Team building and leadership: lead the recruitment/HR function, establish clear responsibilities and reporting lines with department heads, coach managers and help teams work together effectively.
 



 • Performance management: help managers set measurable goals, run probation and performance reviews, identify training needs and follow up on agreed improvement plans.
 



 • Onboarding and retention: create structured induction and 30/60/90\-day onboarding plans, improve joining and early\-tenure retention, conduct employee check\-ins and exit interviews, and address recurring reasons for attrition.
 



 • People operations: maintain accurate employee records, attendance and leave processes; coordinate payroll inputs with accounts; document HR policies, employee concerns and resolutions with confidentiality and fair treatment.
 



 • Hiring and HR reporting: maintain a weekly dashboard of vacancies, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joiners, time to fill, offer acceptance, early retention, headcount and pending performance reviews.
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 • Proven HR and recruitment experience within ecommerce, D2C, home\-appliance or consumer\-durables companies.
 



 • A record of independently closing specialist and managerial roles, with examples of the roles hired, hiring volume, turnaround time and retention results.
 



 • Experience managing employee relations, onboarding, performance reviews and manager coordination, alongside recruitment.
 



 • Ability to lead recruiters or HR staff, set priorities, follow up consistently and hold teams accountable for agreed actions.
 



 • Familiarity with ecommerce roles and workflows, including Amazon/Flipkart operations, marketplace advertising, catalogue management, customer support and fulfilment.
 



 • Practical sourcing experience using LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and recruitment partners; confidence using Excel/Google Sheets and an applicant or HR tracking system.
 



 • Clear communication, sound judgement and the ability to handle sensitive employee matters professionally.
 



 • Availability for full\-time, on\-site work in Bawana, Delhi.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



  





 Priority roles filled with suitable candidates, stronger offer\-to\-joining conversion and early retention, reliable onboarding, timely performance reviews, and managers who follow clear people\-management processes.
 



  





 TO APPLY
 



  





 Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and a short note covering:
 



 • The ecommerce or appliance companies you have worked with and your responsibilities.
 



 • The main roles you have hired for, approximate hiring volume and measurable outcomes.
 



 • The size of the HR/recruitment team you have led and the employee headcount you have supported.
 



 • Your notice period, expected compensation and availability to work on\-site in Bawana.

title: HR Manager – Ecommerce & Appliances
description:
Moonstruck Appliances is hiring an HR Manager to build strong teams and take ownership of recruitment and day\-to\-day people management.
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced HR professional who has worked in ecommerce, D2C, home\-appliance or consumer\-durables companies and understands how to hire, develop and retain people in a fast\-moving business.
 



  





 Location: Bawana, Delhi \| Full\-time \| On\-site
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 • Recruitment from start to finish: work with the founders and department heads on hiring plans, write clear job descriptions, source candidates, screen profiles, coordinate practical assessments and interviews, manage offers and follow through until joining.
 



 • Ecommerce and appliance hiring: recruit marketplace managers and executives, Amazon/Flipkart specialists, advertising and performance\-marketing staff, catalogue teams, designers, customer\-support staff and operations employees. Coordinate warehouse, production and service hiring as business needs require.
 



 • Team building and leadership: lead the recruitment/HR function, establish clear responsibilities and reporting lines with department heads, coach managers and help teams work together effectively.
 



 • Performance management: help managers set measurable goals, run probation and performance reviews, identify training needs and follow up on agreed improvement plans.
 



 • Onboarding and retention: create structured induction and 30/60/90\-day onboarding plans, improve joining and early\-tenure retention, conduct employee check\-ins and exit interviews, and address recurring reasons for attrition.
 



 • People operations: maintain accurate employee records, attendance and leave processes; coordinate payroll inputs with accounts; document HR policies, employee concerns and resolutions with confidentiality and fair treatment.
 



 • Hiring and HR reporting: maintain a weekly dashboard of vacancies, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joiners, time to fill, offer acceptance, early retention, headcount and pending performance reviews.
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 • Proven HR and recruitment experience within ecommerce, D2C, home\-appliance or consumer\-durables companies.
 



 • A record of independently closing specialist and managerial roles, with examples of the roles hired, hiring volume, turnaround time and retention results.
 



 • Experience managing employee relations, onboarding, performance reviews and manager coordination, alongside recruitment.
 



 • Ability to lead recruiters or HR staff, set priorities, follow up consistently and hold teams accountable for agreed actions.
 



 • Familiarity with ecommerce roles and workflows, including Amazon/Flipkart operations, marketplace advertising, catalogue management, customer support and fulfilment.
 



 • Practical sourcing experience using LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and recruitment partners; confidence using Excel/Google Sheets and an applicant or HR tracking system.
 



 • Clear communication, sound judgement and the ability to handle sensitive employee matters professionally.
 



 • Availability for full\-time, on\-site work in Bawana, Delhi.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



  





 Priority roles filled with suitable candidates, stronger offer\-to\-joining conversion and early retention, reliable onboarding, timely performance reviews, and managers who follow clear people\-management processes.
 



  





 TO APPLY
 



  





 Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and a short note covering:
 



 • The ecommerce or appliance companies you have worked with and your responsibilities.
 



 • The main roles you have hired for, approximate hiring volume and measurable outcomes.
 



 • The size of the HR/recruitment team you have led and the employee headcount you have supported.
 



 • Your notice period, expected compensation and availability to work on\-site in Bawana.

**BeFiSc \| Full\-Time \| Noida Onsite** 




**Job Title :**

 Manager – Human Resources

 Human Resources

**About BeFiSc** 


 BeFiSc is a financial data intelligence and risk technology company helping businesses make safer, faster, and smarter decisions. We work with organizations across FinTech, BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, and Financial Services.
 





 Our core focus is Fraud Prevention, Risk Analysis, and Financial Data Intelligence. Using technology, APIs, data analytics, and large\-scale data processing, we help businesses detect suspicious patterns, assess customer and transaction risks, verify identities and businesses, and turn complex financial data into actionable insights.
 





 Our solutions support critical use cases including customer onboarding, underwriting, fraud detection, identity and employment verification, financial analysis, due diligence, and risk monitoring.
 



**Role Overview** 


 We are looking for an experienced HR Manager to lead and strengthen the Human Resources function at BeFiSc. The candidate must have minimum 5\+ years of HR experience, with prior exposure to the FinTech/BFSI industry and hands\-on experience working in a technology\-driven company.
 





 The HR Manager will be responsible for the complete employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, retention, HR operations, policies, compliance, and organizational development.
 





 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-growing technology environment and partnering closely with Founders, Leadership, Engineering, Product, Sales, Operations, Support, Finance, and Information Security teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
1. Own and manage the end\-to\-end HR function for the organization.
2. Lead recruitment across Engineering, Product, Information Security, Data, Sales, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, and other business functions.
3. Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle including manpower planning, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, salary negotiation, offer rollout, and joining.
4. Build strong hiring pipelines using LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, employee referrals, consultants, recruitment agencies, and other sourcing channels.
5. Work closely with hiring managers to define JDs, technical/non\-technical skills, screening parameters, interview processes, and hiring timelines.
6. Manage the complete employee lifecycle including onboarding, probation, confirmation, performance reviews, promotions, transfers, and exits.
7. Design and manage KRA/KPI\-based performance management and appraisal processes.
8. Drive employee engagement, recognition, retention, and workplace culture initiatives.
9. Identify employee concerns, manage grievances, and resolve workplace issues professionally.
10. Develop and maintain HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks, and internal HR processes.
11. Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour laws, statutory requirements, POSH, and employment regulations.
12. Coordinate payroll, attendance, leave management, employee documentation, HRMS, and employee records.
13. Track HR metrics including Hiring TAT, Offer\-to\-Joining Ratio, Attrition Rate, Retention Rate, Cost per Hire, Employee Turnover, and Recruitment Funnel Performance.
14. Conduct regular HR reviews and provide meaningful HR dashboards and reports to management.
15. Partner directly with leadership on workforce planning, organizational structure, compensation, succession planning, and HR strategy.
16. Build scalable HR processes suitable for a fast\-growing FinTech and technology organization.


**Required Skills** 
* Strong experience in Talent Acquisition and Technical Hiring.
* Understanding of technology roles and technical skill sets.
* Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in performance management and KRA/KPI frameworks.
* Strong employee engagement and retention capabilities.
* Knowledge of HR policies, labour laws, POSH, and statutory compliance.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle employee grievances and sensitive situations professionally.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, Excel, and Google Sheets.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and execution capabilities.


**Required Qualifications and Experience** 
* Minimum 5\+ years of relevant HR experience.
* Prior experience in the FinTech/BFSI industry is required/preferred.
* Must have experience working in a technology/software/SaaS/API/product\-driven company.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in both technical and non\-technical recruitment.
* Experience independently managing multiple HR functions.
* Experience working directly with senior management and business leaders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred or Good to Have** 
* Experience working in a FinTech startup or high\-growth technology company.
* Experience scaling an organization and building HR processes from the ground up.
* Experience hiring Software Engineers, Tech Leads, DevOps, QA, Data Engineers, Product Managers, Information Security, Sales and Operations professionals.
* Understanding of FinTech, Digital Lending, BFSI, APIs, SaaS, financial data, or risk technology.
* Experience implementing or managing HRMS/ATS platforms.
* Experience building HR dashboards and management reports.
* Exposure to employee learning and development programs.
* Experience managing organizational restructuring and change management.
* HR certifications or additional professional qualifications will be an advantage.


**Key Performance Areas** 
* Quality and timely closure of hiring requirements.
* Recruitment TAT and offer\-to\-joining conversion.
* Quality of technical and non\-technical hiring.
* Employee retention and attrition management.
* Effective onboarding and employee lifecycle management.
* Timely execution of performance reviews and appraisal cycles.
* Employee engagement and workplace satisfaction.
* Accuracy and compliance of HR operations and documentation.
* Quality of HR reporting and management dashboards.
* Effective resolution of employee concerns and grievances.
* Development and implementation of scalable HR processes.
* Strong coordination with leadership and department heads.


**Ideal Candidate Profile** 


 The ideal candidate should be proactive, structured, people\-oriented, data\-driven, and result\-oriented, with the ability to balance employee needs with business objectives.
 





 The candidate should understand both the FinTech business environment and technology workforce, and should be capable of recruiting and managing employees across technical and business functions.
 





 We are looking for someone who can go beyond traditional HR administration and take ownership of building teams, improving hiring quality, strengthening employee retention, developing managers, establishing processes, and supporting organizational growth.
 





 The person should be comfortable working directly with founders and senior leadership in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment.
 



**Why Join BeFiSc** 
* Work with a fast\-growing FinTech and financial data intelligence company.
* Build and scale HR processes across technology and business teams.
* Work closely with founders and senior leadership.
* Take ownership of hiring and people strategy.
* Build teams working on fraud prevention, risk assessment, financial intelligence, APIs, and large\-scale data products.
* Opportunity to influence company culture, employee experience, and organizational growth.
* Work in an environment where ideas and improvements can quickly be implemented.




 At BeFiSc, the HR Manager will play a key role in building the people, culture, and processes required to support the company's next stage of growth.

title: Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
   

  

**Job Description**
**Are you ready to help build something new?**
 At Philips, meaningful careers are built by stepping into opportunities that challenge you, broaden your perspective, and enable you to make an impact with care.
   

  

 The Central Rewards Services team was established in August 2026 to bring together shared activities across M\&A, analytics, equity, mobility, business travel, and operations. By combining our expertise, we aim to increase agility and strengthen global consistency.
   

  

 As a Rewards Services Partner, you will join us at an important stage in our journey. You will help shape how the team works, contribute across disciplines, and grow your expertise beyond a single Rewards specialization.
   

  

**In this role, you have the opportunity to..**
 Help build the future of Rewards Services at Philips. You will combine ownership of Global Mobility support for the APAC region with broader contributions to global Rewards processes, including annual compensation rounds, market benchmarking, analytics, and cross\-functional improvement initiatives.
   

  

 This is intentionally a diverse and evolving role. The Central Rewards Services team is new, and not every responsibility or way of working has been fully defined. You will have the space to bring ideas, test better approaches, and take ownership where your experience, curiosity, and energy can create value.
   

  

 You will work with specialists across the global Rewards landscape, learn from different disciplines, and help connect activities that have traditionally been managed separately. In doing so, you will strengthen both the employee experience and the consistency and effectiveness of our Rewards services.
   

  

 The role is an opportunity to broaden your career as a Rewards professional while making a visible contribution to the success of a new global team.
   

  

**Your role**
* Own and coordinate Global Mobility activities for the APAC region, providing clear guidance and a consistent experience for employees and stakeholders.
* Contribute to global Rewards cycles, including annual compensation review processes, with a focus on accurate preparation, effective coordination, and high\-quality delivery.
* Support market benchmarking and Rewards analysis, translating data into clear insights that enable informed decisions.
* Work across Central Rewards Services activities, including equity, business travel, M\&A, analytics, operations, and Rewards Excellence, based on business priorities and team needs.
* Help design and embed new ways of working that reduce duplication, improve agility, and strengthen global consistency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, clarify ownership, improve service quality, and create an even better employee and stakeholder experience.
* Build strong partnerships with a multitude of stakeholders from a great variety of functions within the organisation to deliver connected solutions.
* Use data, technology, and AI responsibly to improve insights, efficiency, and service delivery.
* Share knowledge, learn from colleagues across disciplines, and contribute to building capability within the Central Rewards Services team and the wider Rewards community.
* Take ownership beyond established boundaries when new priorities emerge, balancing flexibility with sound judgment and reliable delivery.


**The impact you can make**
 Your Contribution Will Go Beyond Delivering Individual Processes. You Will Help Turn a Newly Established Team Into a Connected And Trusted Global Partner By
   

  

* Ensuring a consistent, employee\-focused Global Mobility experience across the APAC region.
* Helping global Rewards processes run smoothly and deliver reliable outcomes.
* Connecting expertise and activities across Central Rewards Services so that work is performed where it creates the most value.
* Bringing forward practical ideas and turning them into improvements that can be scaled globally.
* Helping build a team culture based on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.


**You're The Right Fit If You Have**
* A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Experience in Global Mobility, Compensation, Rewards, HR Operations, or a related discipline.
* Interest in broadening your expertise across multiple Rewards areas rather than remaining within one specialization.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and complexity into clear insights and practical actions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills in a global, matrixed organization.
* The ability to organize priorities, deliver reliably, and adapt when business needs change.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset and the confidence to question existing approaches constructively.
* Curiosity, creativity, and flexibility, together with a willingness to step outside your comfort zone.
* The judgment and discretion required when working with confidential employee and business information.
* AI literacy and an interest in using technology to improve how Rewards services are delivered.


**You will thrive in this role if you...**
* Are energized by the opportunity to help create, not only to maintain.
* Can bring structure to ambiguity without waiting for every detail to be defined.
* See change as an opportunity to learn, contribute, and improve.
* Enjoy moving between regional delivery, global processes, analysis, and project work.
* Build trust through collaboration, openness, and follow\-through.
* Want to broaden your Rewards expertise and help a new team become a success.


**How We Work Together**
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
   

  

**About Philips**
 Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

title: Vice President, India Payroll
description:
**About This Role**
**Background**
 BlackRock’s Global Payroll \& Employment Tax function is a critical, high\-impact team responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and compliant payroll services across the organization. The team operates within a robust governance framework, partnering closely with Human Resources, Finance, Tax, and external vendors to ensure adherence to global standards, local regulatory requirements, and a strong control environment.
   

  

 With a focus on operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement, the function plays a key role in enhancing payroll processes, driving automation, and supporting the organization’s evolving business needs. The team fosters a collaborative, service\-oriented culture, ensuring a high\-quality employee experience while maintaining the highest standards of compliance and integrity.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Vice President, Payroll will be responsible for leading and overseeing the end\-to\-end payroll operations for India. This role is accountable for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll execution, while advancing governance, control frameworks, and transformation initiatives. The role requires close collaboration with local HR and global stakeholders across Payroll, Finance, Tax, and HR Operations in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
   

  

 The incumbent will play a key leadership role in vendor management, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and process optimization, while also contributing to broader regional and global payroll initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Lead and oversee the end\-to\-end India payroll function, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and full compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Manage and ensure compliance with all India statutory regulations, including PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, gratuity, and income tax, while staying current with evolving labor laws and regulatory updates.
* Lead and mentor a high\-performing payroll team, driving accountability, capability building, and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Drive automation and process optimization initiatives to enhance payroll systems, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Build and maintain strong cross\-functional partnerships with HR (Benefits, Mobility, HRBPs), Finance (FP\&A, Controllers, Accounting), and Tax teams to ensure seamless data flow, accurate reporting, and alignment of payroll processes
* Manage the payroll vendor relationships to deliver payroll effectively.
* Develop and monitor key payroll metrics and KPIs to track operational performance, compliance adherence, and service delivery effectiveness.
* Oversee audit and compliance activities, including internal audits, employment tax audits, and social security reviews, ensuring timely and accurate response to stakeholders.


**Knowledge/ Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in payroll operations and statutory compliance, preferably within India and broader APAC regions
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
* Knowledge of withholding tax, related tax filings, tax policy and regulations as they relate to India / APAC Countries
* Proven ability to manage payroll vendors effectively, including adherence to contracts, SLAs, and service delivery standards
* Solid understanding of HR processes, payroll dependencies, and cross\-functional integrations
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word (essential); experience with Workday or similar HR/payroll systems preferred
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills
* Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and manage competing priorities
* Flexibility to support global teams across time zones, including extended working hours when required


**Competencies Required**
* A high level of attention to detail
* A positive and ‘can\-do’ attitude
* Risk Management
* Teamwork including collaborating with remote team members
* Problem solving
* Desire and ability to provide outstanding service to internal clients
* Adaptable, resilient and embracing of change.
* Capable of communicating with impact.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities and meet tight deadlines
* Ability to identify, analyse and develop processes and drive continuous improvement
* Discretion in dealing with confidential information


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Platform Engineer Contractor
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join EarnIn's Platform Services team for an internship building AI\-powered solutions that directly impact our Platform Infrastructure. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work across two connected workstreams — reducing platform toil and accelerating delivery for every engineer at EarnIn — under the guidance of senior platform engineers. This position is based in Bengaluru, India, with two days a week in\-office required as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement with a start date in January 2027\.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Build components of the AI First Responder agent — an automated on\-call triage system that integrates Datadog, Incident.io, and Slack — including agent tooling, evaluation harnesses, and integration workflows.
* Contribute to the IaC migration away from Terraform Cloud — refactoring Terraform modules, cleaning up policies, and building migration scaffolding that clears tech debt and accelerates platform delivery.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) throughout both workstreams to develop applied AI skills in a real infrastructure context.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and well\-documented code that lasts beyond the internship.
* Collaborate with engineers across the Bengaluru and Mountain View Platform teams; present your work and learnings to the broader team.
* Shadow incident triage and on\-call workflows to build context on production operations (no on\-call responsibilities).


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university
* Experience with Python, Go, or another backend language — coursework or personal projects count.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), containers (Docker), or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts (Terraform, Kubernetes); classroom or personal\-project experience counts.
* Eagerness to learn and actively use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow — this is a core expectation, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Comfort working in a Linux/CLI environment and with Git\-based version control.
* Ability to communicate progress proactively, ask good questions, and document your work clearly.
* Self\-starter mindset — you take initiative, seek feedback, and iterate quickly; moderate guidance is a plus.
* Prior internship or project experience in platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or site reliability is a plus.
* Familiarity with Datadog, PagerDuty, or similar observability and incident\-management tools is a plus.
* Experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) or building agent\-style workflows in a project context is a plus.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or Helm in any environment (lab, personal cluster, coursework) is a plus.


\#LI\-Hybrid

  

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E\-Verify participant.



EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

title: ServiceNow HRSD Portal Lead
description:

The Knowledge Manager ensures that HR knowledge is accurate, current, consistent, searchable, appropriately governed, and easy for employees and HR teams to use. The role owns knowledge governance, lifecycle management, content standards, quality assurance, knowledge structure, reporting, optimization, technical configuration required for managing knowledge platform and continuous improvement.


This role works closely with HR Knowledge Owners, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Knowledge Authors, HR Service Delivery teams, and HRSD Superusers to manage the complete knowledge lifecycle.


The Knowledge Manager also plays an important role in ensuring that HR knowledge is optimized for Employee Center Pro, HR Case Management, enterprise search, and Now Assist.

* Manage Knowledge Governance: Implement and maintain the HR Knowledge Management governance framework, including clear roles and expectations for knowledge owners, knowledge authors, SMEs, approvers, HRSD superusers, and other contributors.
* Manage Knowledge Structure in ServiceNow: Maintain the functional organization of HR knowledge within ServiceNow HRSD, partner with the ServiceNow platform team on required technical configuration, and ensure content is structured consistently for easy discovery by employees and HR agents.
* Optimize Knowledge for Employee Center Pro: Ensure employee\-facing HR knowledge provides an effective self\-service experience through Employee Center Pro. The objective is to help employees find the right answer without needing to submit an HR case whenever possible.
* Support Now Assist and AI\-Enabled Experiences: Ensure HR knowledge is optimized for Now Assist and other AI\-enabled HR capabilities, and monitor knowledge\-base health and effectiveness to identify improvement opportunities.

* Experience with Knowledge Management, preferably within HR or Shared Services.

* Strong understanding of content lifecycle and knowledge governance.
