title: HCM Analyst, Bengaluru, India
description:
Job Summary
  
The HCM Systems Analyst – Dayforce is a hands\-on configuration role responsible for building, configuring, maintaining, and optimizing the organization’s Dayforce HCM platform across Core HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance/Workforce Management, Recruiting, Performance, Compensation, and Learning.
  
This role serves as a functional and technical Dayforce resource, partnering with HR Operations, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Learning, HR Business Partners, IT, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective and scalable system solutions.
  
The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on Dayforce configuration experience and is comfortable independently researching issues, building solutions, testing changes, troubleshooting complex problems, and continuously improving the platform within a complex, global HCM environment.
  
Primary Duties and Responsibilities
  
* Configure, maintain, and optimize Dayforce modules, including:
* Core HR / People
* Payroll
* Time \& Attendance / Workforce Management
* Recruiting
* Performance Management
* Compensation
* Learning
* Build and modify Dayforce configuration, including workflows, forms, approval processes, eligibility rules, business rules, security roles, notifications, and other system functionality.
* Translate business requirements into effective Dayforce solutions while considering system scalability, usability, data integrity, and downstream impacts.
* Partner with HR and Payroll teams to design and implement system enhancements and process improvements.
* Troubleshoot complex system, configuration, and data issues; identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support configuration and system administration for recurring HR processes, including payroll, performance reviews, compensation cycles, recruiting activities, learning programs, and employee lifecycle events.
* Perform impact analysis, configuration, testing, and validation for system changes, enhancements, releases, and new functionality.
* Develop and execute test scenarios and support user acceptance and regression testing.
* Monitor Dayforce releases and product updates, evaluate potential impact, and recommend opportunities to leverage new functionality.
* Maintain system security and role\-based access in accordance with organizational and data privacy requirements.
* Support Dayforce reporting, data imports and exports, interfaces, integrations, and data validation activities.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity across the HCM platform and assist with identifying and resolving data quality issues.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, simplify workflows, and improve the employee and manager experience.
* Maintain system configuration documentation, process documentation, and change records.
* Provide technical and functional support to HR system users and assist with training and knowledge transfer as needed.
* Partner with Dayforce Support and external vendors to research and resolve product or configuration issues when necessary.
* Participate in HCM projects, implementations, integrations, acquisitions, and other HR technology initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders and team members across multiple countries and time zones.


Education and Certification
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
* Dayforce certifications are preferred.
* Additional HR technology, payroll, project management, or systems certifications are an advantage.
* Equivalent combinations of education and relevant hands\-on Dayforce experience will be considered.


Competencies, Skills and Experience
  
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience configuring, administering, and supporting Dayforce in a complex organizational environment.
* Strong Dayforce configuration experience across multiple modules; experience with Core HR and Workforce Management is strongly preferred, with experience in additional modules such as Payroll, Recruiting, Performance, Compensation, and Learning highly valued.
* Experience supporting a global or multi\-country HCM environment preferred.
* Ability to independently configure and troubleshoot Dayforce rather than relying primarily on vendor or implementation partner resources.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and the employee lifecycle, including organizational management, employee data, payroll, time and attendance, recruiting, performance management, compensation, and learning.
* Strong systems\-thinking skills and the ability to understand upstream and downstream impacts of system, process, and data changes.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
* Experience with system testing, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and change management.
* Knowledge of HCM integrations, data imports and exports, APIs, reporting, and data structures preferred.
* Understanding of HR data security, role\-based access, and data privacy principles.
* Ability to translate business needs into clear functional and system requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and system integrity.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with a high degree of independence.
* Demonstrated curiosity and resourcefulness, with the ability to research unfamiliar functionality and develop solutions independently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within global, cross\-functional teams.
* Flexibility to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple time zones.

title: Lead, Business Continuity Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Lead, Business Continuity Manager (APAC Location)**

**Location**


Bangalore / Pune

**Position Summary**


The Lead, Business Continuity Management (APAC Location) is responsible for the development, implementation, governance, testing, and continuous improvement of Business Continuity Management (BCM).


This role serves as the primary APAC focal point for technology continuity planning while partnering with global technology teams, infrastructure organizations, cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business units, and regional regulators. The incumbent will ensure that critical technology services can withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptive events while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regional regulatory requirements.


The role requires balancing regional execution with global alignment, ensuring APAC\-specific risks, regulatory obligations, and operational requirements are effectively incorporated into the enterprise resilience framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Continuity Strategy \& Governance**

* Lead the APAC Technology Business Continuity Program.
* Develop and maintain regional technology continuity and resilience strategies aligned with global frameworks.
* Ensure regional BCM practices are aligned with enterprise risk management standards and global technology policies.
* Establish governance forums, metrics, reporting, and executive dashboards for continuity and resilience programs.
* Support annual reviews of continuity policies, standards, procedures, and recovery strategies.

**Continuity Planning \& Preparedness**

* Develop, maintain, and govern Technology Business Continuity Plans (BCPs).
* Ensure recovery plans exist for critical platforms, infrastructure services, applications, and technology processes.
* Coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments across APAC technology functions.
* Assess dependencies involving third\-party vendors, cloud service providers, and critical technology partners.
* Maintain inventories of critical services, applications, recovery strategies, and recovery objectives.

**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience Testing**

* Coordinate disaster recovery testing programs across APAC technology teams.
* Manage tabletop exercises, simulation exercises, crisis management drills, and failover testing activities.
* Validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
* Track remediation of gaps identified through testing and post\-incident reviews.
* Produce executive summaries and lessons\-learned reports following exercises.

**Operational Resilience**

* Support identification and mapping of Important Business Services (IBS) and technology dependencies.
* Assess resilience vulnerabilities across people, process, technology, facilities, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Assist in establishing impact tolerances and resilience performance measures.
* Support enterprise operational resilience initiatives and regional regulatory requirements.

**Crisis Management \& Incident Response**

* Support technology crisis management and major incident response activities.
* Participate in regional command centers during significant incidents.
* Coordinate communications, issue escalation, decision tracking, and recovery governance during disruptions.
* Facilitate post\-incident reviews and corrective action plans.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary APAC liaison between global BCM teams and regional technology leadership.
* Partner with:


	+ Infrastructure Engineering
	+ Cyber Security
	+ IT Operations
	+ Technology Risk Management
	+ Enterprise Risk
	+ Corporate Services
	+ Business Units
* Provide guidance and coaching to technology teams regarding continuity planning requirements.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**

* CBCP (Certified Business Continuity Professional)
* MBCI (Member, Business Continuity Institute)

 **50,000\+ employees,** 
 presence across

 **bigbasket, bbnow, bbdaily, bbinstant, Fresho, bbmandi and bbsaathi.**

**Join bigbasket. Build what’s next**

**Reporting To** 
 : CHRO
 



**Location \-** 
 Bangalore (Corporate Office)
 



**Work Model \-** 
 Onsite

 Join us and be part of the team building what’s next at bigbasket.

title: Snr Director of HR (Position located in Bangalore, India)
description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15\-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.
   

  

***Please submit your resume in English.***
 The Senior Director (APAC) will serve as a key strategic HR leader, driving visionary HR strategies across the APAC region in close collaboration and alignment with the CHRO and regional HR peers, while serving as the global HR Business Partner to designated functions. This role will partner directly with C\-level and executive leaders to cultivate organizational excellence and drive business success through innovative people strategies. The Senior Director (APAC) will lead the development and implementation of forward\-thinking HR initiatives, champion change management, ensure compliance, and foster a thriving, high\-performance company culture across both the APAC region and supported global functions. The Senior Director will be instrumental in optimizing talent management, enhancing organizational effectiveness, and empowering a high\-performing HR team while seamlessly collaborating with global HR Directors/Managers and cross\-functional leaders. As the key on\-the\-ground lead for the region, this role will also partner closely with Global Success Hub site leaders to support alignment across core people functions globally. The Senior Director will help drive integrated planning and communication to ensure consistency across locations, while respecting existing departmental ownership of functional workstreams. This position will also be responsible for assisting in the drafting, negotiation and review of a variety of contracts for employment matters in coordination with the KB4 Legal team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with Global Success Hub site leaders to develop and manage a unified success hub framework and execution timeline spanning organizational structure, benefits, compensation, recruitment, and talent branding, ensuring global synchronization
* Facilitate integrated success hub planning for headcount, capacity, and employee communications to ensure cross\-location alignment, while maintaining existing departmental ownership of functional workstreams
* Draft and implement robust HR policies, procedures and processes in line with KnowBe4’s culture and core values, including the development of the employee handbooks for the International entities
* Continuously monitor and review the effectiveness of all existing HR policies and processes, and make recommendations for improvement as appropriate
* Identify and report on HR\-related risks, making recommendations for managing such risks
* Work collaboratively with the CHRO International, local HR teams and Legal to manage complex employee relations matters including dispute resolutions, disciplinaries, grievances, leaves, absences, retirement, and redundancy in a confidential, lawful, and sensitive manner
* Oversee compliance requirements with regards to employee contracts, bonuses, pensions, required filings, and related matters
* Support the local HR teams in all aspects of benefits administration, selection and coordination with vendors
* Provide advice and coaching, supporting the local HR teams on disciplinary, grievance and other people related matters
* Work in coordination with the Expansion team to assist in their recruitment process
* Represent the company at mediation, arbitration, conciliation, and litigation proceedings, as required
* Advise executives, including senior management, within the company
* Oversee a team of HR Directors \& HR Managers to proactively identify opportunities to enhance the employee experience and help develop and implement innovative solutions
* Work alongside and counsel other departments within the company
* Research and anticipate unique legal issues that could impact the company from a People Operations perspective.
* Research and help to develop strategies to avoid litigation and reduce potential areas of risk


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field or experience required
* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field or experience preferred
* Minimum 10 years of human resource leadership experience
* Significant experience in both operational and strategic HR, supporting multiple countries preferably in a fast\-growing environment
* Fluent in English and preferable in at least one other language of the countries under this position
* Excellent knowledge of People Operations/HR processes, tools and practices – performance management, compensation and benefits, employee engagement
* Thorough knowledge of applicable employment\-related laws and regulations in the APAC region
* Proficiency with or the ability to quickly learn KnowBe4's HRIS and talent management systems
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks and delegate them when appropriate
* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
* Proficient with Google Suite.
* Ability to work both independently and as a team
* Ability to work well under pressure
* Ability to handle high volumes of work at a fast pace
* Must be able to travel to various locations with APAC region and the US office on a 1 or 2 yearly basis


**Our Fantastic Benefits**
 We offer company\-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses \- all in a modern, high\-tech, and fun work environment. For more details about our benefits in each office location, please visit www.knowbe4\.com/careers/benefits.
   

  

*Note: An applicant assessment and background check may be part of your hiring procedure.*
**Individuals seeking employment at KnowBe4 are considered without prejudice to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please visit www.knowbe4\.com/careers/request\-accommodation.**
 No recruitment agencies, please.

title: Manager : HR Support Services (People Services)
description:
Nasdaq Technology is looking for a passionate People Services Manager with focus on people management along with day to day HR operations to join the Bangalore technology center in India. If Innovation and effectiveness drive, you forward this is the place for you!
   

  

 When you work at Nasdaq, you’re working for more open and transparent markets so that more people can access opportunities. Connections can be made, jobs can be created, and communities can thrive. We want all our employees to have access to opportunities, too. That means planning for career growth, ensuring you have the tools you need, and promoting an inclusive culture where we’re all valued for our unique perspectives.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with a genuine desire and drive to deliver top technology solutions to today's markets.
   

  

 With this position we offer
   

  

 Here, you will work for a global tech leader committed to breaking down barriers to inclusive prosperity. We see technology as a means to free people up to work together more efficiently and effectively by centralizing data, analytics, and market intelligence.
   

  

 Here, we’re committed to building a more diverse and inclusive workforce. Not only is it our responsibility to do better, but we also need representative voices to power the fresh thinking that is vital for our business and our clients.
   

  

 This is a permanent full\-time role based in Bangalore, following a hybrid work model setup (at least 2 in office days per week).
   

  

 You can expect an autonomous but fast\-paced work environment where you are recognized for your results and ability to drive things forward. Every day brings many opportunities to learn \& grow and rewards with a global impact we build.
   

  

 In return, you will receive HMO coverage for you and your dependents, employee stock purchase plan, equity grant, retirement plan, annual bonus, free counseling sessions, subscription to e\-learning platforms, fitness, wellness, and more.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities \-**
 The People Manager will lead global People Operations across Tier 1 and Tier 2 services, ensuring the timely, accurate, and consistent resolution of routine, specialized, and complex employee cases in accordance with established policies, service standards, and regulatory requirements. This role will oversee day\-to\-day operational performance, proactively manage risks and escalations, and ensure all agreed KPIs, service\-level targets, quality standards, and compliance requirements are consistently achieved. Operating with minimal supervision, the People Manager will maintain operational stability, drive continuous improvement, optimize team capacity and service delivery, and build a high\-performing, accountable, and positive team culture.
   

  

* Lead global People Operations across Tier 1 and Tier 2 services, ensuring reliable and consistent support across regions, business units, and employee populations.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end management of routine, specialized, and complex employee cases, ensuring timely resolution and an excellent employee experience.
* Manage daily operations with minimal supervision, maintaining service continuity and ensuring the function operates effectively and as expected.
* Monitor team performance against established KPIs, service\-level agreements, quality standards, productivity targets, and compliance requirements.
* Analyze operational trends, performance gaps, and recurring issues, implementing corrective actions and sustainable process improvements.
* Manage escalations and operational risks proactively, ensuring issues are resolved promptly and communicated to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Drive workforce planning, workload distribution, prioritization, and capacity management to maintain balanced and efficient service delivery.
* Coach and develop team members through regular feedback, performance discussions, skills development, and clear accountability for results.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing team culture built on trust, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Strengthen collaboration and synergy across Tier 1, Tier 2, Centers of Excellence, People Partners, Technology, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Ensure People Operations processes, policies, procedures, and knowledge materials are accurate, consistently applied, and regularly updated.
* Support global operational changes, system enhancements, process transitions, and transformation initiatives to improve scalability and service effectiveness.
* Provide clear performance updates, operational insights, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.


**We expect you to have: (Minimum Qualifications)**
* Total experience between 6\-10 years.
* Strong experience in day\-to\-day HR operations, including case management, employee administration, and related HR processes.
* Minimum 3 years of people management experience, with demonstrated leadership capabilities.
* Willingness to work in the 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM shift supporting EMEA and US regions.
* Exposure to employee data management and experience in Workday is a must.
* Experience in Zendesk or other similar tools.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to think outside of the box!


**It would be great If you have :**
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration/HR or another similar field.
* Good understanding and awareness of AI\-related concepts and applications.


**Does it sound like you?**
 As the selection process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. We will get back to you in 2\-3 weeks.
   

  

**Come as you are**
 Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Nasdaq is a leading global provider of trading, clearing, exchange technology, listing, information, and public company services. As the creator of the world's first electronic stock market, its technology powers more than 100 marketplaces in 50 countries. Nasdaq is home to over 4,000 total listings with a market value of approximately $12 trillion.
   

  

* To learn more, about our business visit business.nasdaq.com. Check out more about our Life at Nasdaq.


**Come as You Are**

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.
   

  

 We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

title: Manager– Finance, HR & Administration

 Full\-Time

The role requires someone who can take ownership of day\-to\-day operations, manage the existing team, ensure timely accounting and compliance, drive HR processes and policies, oversee administration, and prepare monthly MIS and management reports for leadership review. title: Assistant Manager -Employee Data Management
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting embraces long\-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI\-powered workflows.
   

  

 You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.
   

  

 Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long\-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.

 Master's Degree

* Good verbal and written English language skills.
* Ability to communicate and resolve difficult customer service issues Expertise and knowledge in Core HR\-related processes (excluding Recruitment).

* Ambitious individual who can work under their direction towards agreed targets/goals.

* Enhance technical skills by attending educational workshops, reviewing publications etc.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced operational environment.

* Experience analyzing trends and operational metrics to drive business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to drive employee engagement, knowledge\-sharing, and team development initiatives.

title: Human Capital Management - Employee Relations - Vice President - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**OUR IMPACT**
 As a division, Human Capital Management (HCM) is at the forefront of supporting business growth and change at Goldman Sachs by recruiting, developing, and rewarding the people of Goldman Sachs. Our teams advise, design, and implement strategies, processes, and technologies that help our people advance professionally, drive productivity, and help the firm and our clients achieve superior results. We look for individuals with strong problem solving and analytical skills, innovative thinking and intellectual curiosity who want to make an impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset, our people.
   

  

**THE EMPLOYEE RELATIONS (ER) TEAM**
 The Employee Relations team, which is part of the Human Capital Management division, is dedicated to advising and coaching managers and employees on all aspects of the employment relationship. Working with managers and employees to prevent, advise and resolve challenging and complex workplace situations, the ER Advisor will work to protect and support the firm's culture in accordance with firm policies, our business principles, and applicable legal standards. The work is invariably of a sensitive nature and requires a unique combination of skills to deliver workable solutions on a diverse range of issues.
   

  

**YOUR IMPACT**
 Are you looking for a new opportunity to showcase your employment relationship, performance management, disciplinary actions, and business restructurings skills? Do you have excellent communication, problem solving and leadership skills? We have an excellent position in the Human Capital Management (HCM) division’s Employee Relations function, located in the firms’ Bengaluru or Hyderabad Office.
   

  

 You will be valued for your intellectual curiosity and your innovative approach to problem\-solving. You will have direct impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset: Our people.
   

  

**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**
* Handle HR investigations to confirm issues are solved in adherence to policies.
* Senior contact for disciplinary actions, escalations \& issue remediation.
* Provide advice to managers regarding all aspects of the employment relationship, including performance management, disciplinary actions, terminations, and business restructurings.
* Investigate allegations of unfair or unlawful treatment and/or inappropriate behavior.
* Counsel individual employees regarding problems in the office and advising on health and personal issues that may impact work.
* Oversee adherence to firm policies regarding, among others, use of firm resources including e\-mail and Internet access, protection of confidential information, etc.
* Oversee all terminations and implementation of severance policy.
* Assist in formulating, interpreting, and communicating policies that pertain to employee relations issues.
* Conduct training programs to educate employees about firm policies regarding employee relations issues.
* Liaise with internal and external legal counsel as necessary to resolve employee issues.
* Stabilize, motivate, bind teams create and uphold strong Goldman Sachs culture.


**Skills \& Experience We’re Looking For**
 Highly motivated HR professional or Employment Lawyer, with a solid understanding of employment issues and a proven track record of the following:
   

  

* 9\+ years of relevant work experience in HR and Employee Relations
* Managing complex issues, identifying potential risk, and driving resolution
* Leveraging analytical, teamwork and project management skills to undertake thorough investigations.
* Ability to develop and build relationships at all levels, with a proven track record of acting in an advisory capacity.
* Developing and building effective relationships at all levels to advise and influence effectively.
* Bringing groups with diverse views/priorities to a common resolution through use of strong negotiation and facilitation skills
* Approaching issues strategically; anticipating consequences and navigating around unforeseen obstacles
* Listening actively and thinking creatively to deliver commercially pragmatic solutions and resolve conflicts.
* Ability to demonstrate approachability and empathy so that employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Well\-developed organizational and multi\-tasking skills, with strong attention to detail


**About Goldman Sachs**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
   

  

 We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability\-statement.html

title: Senior Associate - HR Implementation

title: Human Resources Director
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Domestic HR Leadership \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner directly with business heads and executive leaders to align headcount planning with national growth objectives.
* Lead organizational restructuring, team integration, and change management initiatives across regional business units.
* Manage Pan\-India HR budgets, workforce analytics, productivity metrics, and regional attrition control programs.



**2\. Domestic \& Tech Talent Acquisition** 



* Lead talent acquisition drives to hire tech (engineering, product, AI), corporate (sales, marketing, finance), and regional field teams across major metro hubs (Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi NCR).
* Direct executive hiring, campus recruitment programs, and succession planning for business\-critical roles.
* Strengthen the company's employer brand across domestic talent networks, tech communities, and top Indian universities.



**3\. Performance Management \& Total Rewards** 



* Execute continuous performance management frameworks (OKRs/KRAs) to drive accountability across tech and GTM divisions.
* Design competitive domestic compensation benchmarks, annual increment structures, variable pay schemes, and ESOP programs.
* Oversee annual appraisal cycles, performance calibrations, and employee development programs.



**4\. Domestic HR Operations \& HRIS Management** 



* Oversee the deployment and optimization of enterprise HRIS platforms (e.g., Darwinbox, greytHR) for seamless attendance, leave, and payroll processing.
* Streamline employee onboarding, pre\-employment screening (BGV), documentation, and offboarding workflows.
* Lead nationwide employee engagement, internal communication, and workplace culture initiatives.



**5\. Indian Labor Laws \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Ensure strict adherence to Indian labor regulations, Factory Acts, Shops \& Establishment Acts, PF, ESIC, Gratuity, and POSH guidelines across all regional offices.
* Oversee industrial relations, contract labor management, statutory audits, and legal/disciplinary proceedings.
* Manage employee grievance redressal mechanisms and maintain corporate workplace governance.

 We are looking for an experienced People Advisor to help establish and grow our new Technology \& Innovation hub based in Hyderabad.
 



  





 You will help play a key role in shaping the people environment of our Innovation Hub. Partnering closely with business leads and cross\-functional teams to establish people policies and processes, support operational readiness and build an engaging, inclusive and high\-performing workplace.
 



 You will bring strong HR business partnering and employee relations experience, together with practical knowledge of Indian statutory requirements, shift\-based workforce management and the establishment or scaling of a GCC, GBS, captive centre or shared services operation.
 



  





**Key Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**People partnering and stakeholder management** 



* Act as the primary People Advisor for leaders and employees at the Hyderabad hub.
* Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness and people priorities.
* Coach managers on performance management, employee relations and day\-to\-day people matters.
* Build strong relationships with regional and global stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into practical and sustainable people solutions.



**Site establishment and HR operations** 



* Support the setup and operations for the Hyderabad Technology \& Innovation hub site
* Work with Legal, Finance, Compliance, Facilities, Payroll, Talent Acquisition and other teams to support site readiness.
* Develop and implement site\-level people policies, processes and governance.
* Act as the key HR contact for people\-related matters affecting the Hyderabad site.
* Support workforce administration and ensure an effective employee experience as the site grows.



**Statutory compliance and risk management** 



* Ensure site\-level compliance with applicable Indian employment laws and statutory requirements.
* Support the statutory requirements associated with establishing and operating a global business services or technology centre in Hyderabad.
* Manage statutory documentation, reporting, audits and inspections.
* Maintain accurate and audit\-ready employee and compliance records.
* Partner with Legal, Finance and Compliance teams to identify and manage people\-related risks.



**Employee relations and lifecycle management** 



* Independently manage employee relations matters, including grievances, performance concerns, disciplinary processes and workplace investigations.
* Coach managers through sensitive or complex employee situations.
* Oversee onboarding, employee movements, policy implementation and offboarding activities.
* Maintain accurate employee information and HR documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve employee lifecycle processes and service delivery.



**Shift and workforce management** 



* Support teams working across global time zones, including shift\-based or extended\-hours operations.
* Help develop and implement practical shift\-related policies and workforce processes.
* Advise leaders on shift management, employee wellbeing and workforce continuity.
* Monitor workforce trends and identify potential operational or employee risks.
* Support contractor onboarding, compliance and offboarding.



**Culture, engagement and inclusion** 



* Help create the culture and employee experience for a new and growing site.
* Lead engagement, wellbeing, inclusion, recognition and retention initiatives.
* Support communication and change\-management activities as the hub develops.
* Build connections between Hyderabad employees and the wider global organization.
* Use employee feedback and workforce insights to recommend practical improvements.

* Partner with external vendors supporting staffing, facilities, transportation, employee services and site operations.

* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational issues affecting employees.

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
   

  

 The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling \& Staffing Support**
* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.


**Capacity, Utilization \& Workforce Analytics**
* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision\-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity\-related information as requested by management.


**Coordination \& Stakeholder Communication**
* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.


**Process \& Administrative Support**
* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2\-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

 Resource Coordination
   

  

 Relationship Management
   

  

 Schedule Management
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

 Capacity Planning \& Tracking
   

  

 Business Acumen
   

  

 Workforce Analytics
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Operational Support
   

  

 Attention to Detail
   

  

 Data Accuracy \& Reporting
   

  

 Adaptability

* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.

* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.

title: Contingent Workforce Analyst II
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Contingent Workforce Approvals Analyst administers the approval workflow for temporary staff requests. The role monitors the intake form daily, checks each submission for completeness and accuracy, chases the requester for whatever is missing, puts the record into the format the approvers need, routes it to the right director and vendor manager, and tracks it through to final sign\-off and notification.
   

  

 This is a pivotal governance role, balancing administrative diligence with rigorous policy enforcement. Each verification step is essential: validating hiring manager hierarchies ensures proper authorization, location codes dictate cost and compliance protocols, budget confirmations prevent unapproved spending, and length\-of\-service tracking maintains policy adherence. Serving as the primary control point, you will mitigate risk by ensuring all requests are accurate and complete before processing, proactively preventing potential downstream compliance or operational exposure.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Request Intake \& Completeness Review
* Monitor submissions from the internal approval form daily, so no request waits on the analyst to notice it.
* Review each submission for completeness and accuracy, including hiring manager hierarchy, location codes and budget confirmation.
* Verify the requester has the standing to raise the request and that the approving hierarchy is correctly identified.
* Hold back incomplete or non\-compliant requests rather than routing them onward, and record why.
* Log every request so volume, ageing and approval cycle time can be reported.
* Clarification \& Data Finalisation
* Follow up with requesters using the established templates to resolve missing information, incorrect data formats and insufficient justification.
* Update request records into the required format, ensuring the scope of work detail and the objectives the role supports are captured.
* For extensions, include the previous request identifiers and length\-of\-service detail, since these determine whether the extension is permissible.
* Confirm budget and cost\-centre detail is present and consistent before the request moves to approval.
* Keep the requester informed, since these requests usually have a start date depending on them.
* Approval Routing \& Tracking
* Assign the appropriate director and vendor manager to each request based on the confirmed hierarchy.
* Loop in the assigned vendor manager for review and track the request through to final sign\-off.
* Chase approvals that stall, and escalate where a delay puts a start date or a compliance position at risk.
* Maintain accurate approval status throughout, so anyone can see where a request stands without asking.
* Handle rejections and rework cleanly, returning the request with a clear reason.
* Notification, Documentation \& Reporting
* Send approval notifications to hiring managers and requesters once a decision is reached.
* Record the final decision date and maintain the complete record of the approval chain.
* Provide the documentation required for extensions to the requester.
* Report on request volumes, approval cycle times, rejection reasons and ageing.
* Maintain the templates, procedures and knowledge base for the workflow, and propose improvements where the same clarification is needed repeatedly.


 PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS
   

  

 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per service line.
   

  

* Daily Monitoring: intake reviewed every business day, with no submission left unactioned overnight.
* Completeness Check: 100% of requests validated against the mandatory field set before routing; zero incomplete requests routed to approvers.
* Clarification Turnaround: requester follow\-up issued within the agreed window of identifying a gap.
* Approval Tracking: 100% of in\-flight requests carrying an accurate current status, with stalled approvals chased.
* Notification: decisions communicated and decision dates recorded for 100% of closed requests.
* Policy Compliance: extensions processed only with previous request identifiers and length\-of\-service detail present.
* First Meaningful Response: provide a meaningful technical update on 90% of requests within 2 business hours.
* Ticket Quality: sustain ≥95% against the weighted quality scorecard, which is weighted toward technical accuracy, then completeness, timeliness and communication.
* Customer Satisfaction: sustain ≥95% of responses rated Excellent or Good.


 TOOLS \& SYSTEMS
   

  

* Intake and workflow: the internal approval form and request tracker for submissions and status.
* Communication: shared mailbox, email templates and enterprise chat for requester and approver follow\-up.
* Records and reporting: spreadsheet trackers and BI tooling for cycle time, ageing and rejection analysis.
* Directory and organisational data: hierarchy and cost\-centre reference data used to identify the correct approvers.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory
   

  

* 2–5\+ years in workflow administration, contingent workforce or vendor management support, HR operations, or a comparable approvals and compliance coordination role.
* Demonstrated discipline validating submissions against a mandatory field set and holding back non\-compliant requests.
* Comfort navigating organisational hierarchies and identifying the correct approving authority.
* Accurate handling of cost\-centre, budget and location reference data.
* Excellent written English, since the role runs largely on templated follow\-up with senior stakeholders.
* Confidentiality judgement, as requests contain personal and commercial information.
* Willing and able to work a shift\-based roster, including night shifts, from the Hyderabad delivery centre.


**Preferred**
* Contingent workforce or vendor management systems experience.
* Exposure to length\-of\-service, tenure or co\-employment policy controls.
* Workflow or approvals automation experience.
* Reporting and dashboard building on cycle time and approval throughput.
* Procurement or HR operations certification, or working towards one.

* Support SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, end\-user training, deployment, and post\-implementation activities.

**Your Skillset** 



* 5\+ years of experience in functional consulting and solution delivery, with strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources.
* Strong hands\-on experience in configuring and implementing Dynamics 365 Human Resources functionalities based on business requirements.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes and employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in requirement gathering, business process analysis, fit\-gap analysis, and functional solution design.
* Ability to work directly with HR and business stakeholders to understand requirements and recommend appropriate Dynamics 365 HR solutions.
* Experience in preparing functional documentation, including BRD, FDD, process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
* Hands\-on experience with HR system migration, data mapping, data validation, and transitioning functionality from legacy or third\-party applications.
* Understanding of system integrations and collaboration with technical teams to support HR application integrations.
* Experience in SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, user training, and deployment activities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, collaborate with distributed teams, and drive activities from requirements through implementation.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with Dynamics 365, Power Platform, AI, and Microsoft ecosystem innovations.



  





**Why LevelShift?** 



* Accelerate your career growth by working on impactful HR digital transformation and enterprise application initiatives.
* Gain hands\-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources, Power Platform, AI, and modern business application technologies.
* Learn from experienced consultants, architects, and technology leaders in a collaborative environment.
* Work alongside cross\-functional teams that value innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

 With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
   

  

 Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
   

  

 We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024\-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.
   

  

 Note\*: All applications will be subject to potential background checks. You will be informed if this will be the case. Further information about the processing of your personal data will be made available during the application process. We'll seek your explicit consent prior to processing the data.

* Experience in managing day\-to\-day payroll activities for a large employee population, preferably across blue\-collar and white\-collar workforce.
* Good understanding of Indian payroll practices, income tax, PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Experience working with HRMS or payroll systems, preferably Keka.
* Good knowledge of Excel and experience working with payroll reports and reconciliations.

* Good coordination and communication skills with the ability to work closely with HR and Finance teams.

title: GM/AVP- Employee Relations and Retention
description:
Role Summary
 
 ICCS is looking for a General Manager / AVP – Employee Relations \& Retention to own attrition as a business number across ICCS's approximately 5,000\-employee, 10\+ site PAN India footprint, and to run the compliance\-first ER case function that supports it. In a domestic BPO, attrition is the single largest controllable cost driver — this role exists to move that number, not merely to administer grievance and disciplinary process around it. It is for a seasoned ER / attrition leader who has run a high\-volume ER function inside a BPO / ITES / contact\-centre environment — grievance handling, disciplinary process and domestic enquiries, POSH compliance — and has personally owned and moved an attrition number at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Attrition Ownership \& Retention Strategy** 




 •    Own the PAN India attrition target; publish and defend attrition performance to the CEO's office monthly.
 



 •    Design and run retention programmes targeted at the 0–90 day window, where most frontline attrition occurs.
 



 •    Build exit analytics — reason codes, tenure cohorts, site and process\-level patterns — and convert them into operational interventions, not just engagement activity.
 



 •    Partner with Operations leadership so retention actions land with team leaders, not only with HR.
 



**2\. PAN India ER Strategy \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER framework end\-to\-end for all ICCS centres (Noida, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai and any new sites), ensuring consistent grievance redressal, disciplinary process and investigation protocols.
 



 •    Own ER case TAT and SLA commitments against every open case, and personally intervene on high\-risk or aging matters.
 



 •    Build and standardise ER policies, SOPs and escalation matrices consistently across all sites and processes.
 



**3\. Grievance Handling \& Investigations** 




 •    Lead or oversee investigations into employee complaints — misconduct, harassment, policy violations — ensuring principles of natural justice are followed throughout.
 



 •    Conduct or supervise disciplinary hearings and domestic enquiries, working closely with site HR and Operations.
 



 •    Ensure fair, prompt and confidential handling of every case, with documentation that stands up to audit and legal scrutiny.
 



**4\. Statutory Compliance \& POSH** 




 •    Own POSH compliance PAN India — constitution and functioning of Internal Committees (IC) at every location, awareness sessions, and timely closure of complaints within statutory timelines.
 



 •    Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Contract Labour Act, and other state\-specific regulations across all centres.
 



 •    Liaise with legal counsel on ER matters that carry litigation or regulatory risk.
 



**5\. Employee Engagement \& Listening** 




 •    Run skip\-level connects, engagement surveys and floor\-level listening mechanisms, particularly at frontline/production level.
 



 •    Analyse exit interview and case data to identify ER\-linked attrition drivers and recommend systemic fixes to Operations and HR leadership.
 



**6\. Stakeholder \& Team Management** 




 •    Manage works/grievance committees as required under Standing Orders, and act as the primary liaison between employees, Operations leadership and HR on sensitive matters.
 



 •    Partner closely with Operations, Legal and Compliance teams on high\-risk or reputationally sensitive cases.
 



 •    Build, mentor and manage a PAN India ER team of 8–10 across locations — setting case\-quality, TAT and attrition\-outcome standards.
 



**7\. Reporting \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER and attrition dashboard and report monthly on attrition performance, case volumes, TAT, closure rates and POSH compliance status to the CEO's office and Head – HR.
 



 •    Maintain complete case documentation and ensure audit\-readiness across all centres at all times.
 



  




 Desired Candidate Profile
 
**Experience \& Background** 




 •    15\+ years in Employee Relations / Industrial Relations, with direct ownership of an attrition number — not case management alone.
 



 •    Has owned an attrition number across a workforce of 3,000 or more in a BPO or similar high\-churn environment, with a measurable, personally\-driven reduction backed by before\-and\-after figures.
 



 •    Mandatory: current or recent experience within the BPO / ITES / Contact Centre / Shared Services industry, with direct ER exposure in a high\-volume, frontline environment.
 



 •    Managed a PAN India, multi\-location ER team of 8 or more (minimum 3–4 locations), ideally including Noida/Delhi\-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai.
 



 •    Hands\-on experience conducting domestic enquiries and POSH investigations, from complaint intake through to closure.
 



 •    Working knowledge of applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, POSH Act, Contract Labour Act and related state regulations, including contract labour compliance.
 



 •    Experience partnering with Legal and Operations leadership on high\-risk or litigation\-prone cases.
 



**Preferred** 




 •    Experience in a unionised or union\-attempt environment.
 



 •    Exposure to predictive attrition analytics.
 



**Not a Fit** 




 •    Generalist HRBPs who have supported attrition initiatives without owning the number.
 



 •    Corporate or white\-collar ER backgrounds with no frontline, high\-churn exposure.
 



 •    Candidates who describe retention purely as engagement activity — events, celebrations, rewards — with no analytical basis.
 



**Education** 




 •    Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Ownership of an attrition number as a business metric, backed by data.
 



 •    Strong working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance.
 



 •    Excellent investigation, case\-management and documentation skills.
 



 •    Stakeholder management across Operations, Legal and employees at all levels.
 



 •    High emotional intelligence, discretion and conflict\-resolution ability.
 



 •    Team building and people leadership across a distributed, PAN India team.
 



 •    Data orientation — comfortable building and defending an attrition / case\-management dashboard/MIS.
 



 •    Ability to operate calmly and objectively in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, sensitive\-case environment.

 Role Overview We are looking for an HR professional with strong hands-on experience in Employee Relations, Labour Laws and HR Legal matters . The role will be responsible for managing employee-related cases, disciplinary matters, separation-related disputes and labour/legal matters in coordination with the HR and Legal teams. The ideal candidate should have practical experience in handling cases such as absconding, notice-period violations, employee misconduct, termination disputes, recovery matters and labour complaints/cases . Manage cases related to absconding, absenteeism, misconduct, policy violations and disciplinary issues . Investigate employee complaints and disputes and recommend appropriate action. Coordinate with HRBPs, business teams and managers on sensitive employee matters. Maintain proper documentation and case records. Draft/review show-cause notices, warning letters, charge sheets, termination letters and other legal/HR communications . Provide guidance to HR teams on appropriate and legally compliant actions. Prepare case summaries, employee history, supporting documents and factual briefs for external lawyers. Track ongoing employee/labour cases and ensure timely follow-up. Maintain a tracker of legal notices, disputes, cases and their status. Labour Law Compliance Keep abreast of applicable labour and employment laws. Support HR in identifying and mitigating legal risks in employee-related processes. Review HR processes and documentation from a labour-law perspective. Support implementation of changes arising from amendments to labour laws. Candidate Profile Must-have experience: 4–8 years of experience in HR Employee Relations / HR Legal / Labour Relations / Industrial Relations . Hands-on experience handling employee disputes and disciplinary cases . Experience dealing with absconding, notice-period recovery, termination and separation-related cases . Exposure to Labour Courts / Labour Commissioner / labour authorities and coordination with external lawyers. Good understanding of Indian Labour & Employment Laws. Strong drafting, documentation and communication skills. Preferred: LLB / LLM qualification. Experience in a large employee-base organisation, preferably Retail, F&B, Hospitality, FMCG, Manufacturing or other multi-location businesses . Key Competencies Employee Relations Labour Law Disciplinary Proceedings Legal Notice Management Labour Litigation Coordination Investigation & Case Handling Legal Drafting Stakeholder Management Strong documentation and follow-through Practical understanding of HR risk Success Measures Timely closure of employee cases and disputes. Effective handling of disciplinary and separation-related matters. Reduction of avoidable legal/labour disputes. Timely response to legal notices and labour authority matters. Strong documentation and compliance in employee actions.

description:
Job Summary 
 Senior Design Verification Engineer - Silicon Engineering / 3-10 Years Job Description 
 Job Description Senior Design Verification Engineer Experience: 310 Years Location: Bangalore / Ahmedabad / Pune / Hyderabad Job Overview 
 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior Design Verification Engineer with 310 years of hands-on experience in Design Verification. As a key member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the robustness and correctness of our cutting-edge System-on-Chip designs. Responsibilities 
 Lead and manage Design Verification efforts for complex projects, ensuring the successful execution of verification plans. Develop and implement comprehensive verification strategies, test plans, and test benches for high-speed SoCs, including low-speed peripherals like I2c/i3c, SPI, UART, GPIO, QSPI , and high-speed protocols like PCIe, Ethernet, CXL, MIPI, DDR, and HBM . Conduct Gate-level simulations and power-aware verification using Xprop and UPF . Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, architects, designers, and pre/post-silicon verification teams. Analyze and implement SystemVerilog assertions and coverage ( code, toggle, functional ). Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior verification engineers. Manage and lead a dynamic team of verification engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. Ensure verification signoff criteria are met and documentation is comprehensive. Demonstrate dedication, hard work, and commitment to achieving project goals and deadlines. Adhere to quality standards, implement good test practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of verification methodologies. Experience with verification tools from Synopsys and Cadence , including VCS and Xsim . Integration of third-party VIPs (Verification IP) from Synopsys and Cadence. 

 Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related field. OR Masters degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related field. OR PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 310 years of hands-on experience in SoC Design Verification. Expertise in UVM (Universal Verification Methodology) and SystemVerilog . Prior experience working on IP-level and SoC-level verification projects. Proficient in verification tools such as VCS, Xsim, waveform analyzers , and third-party VIP integration (e.g., Synopsys VIPs and Cadence VIPs). Hands-on experience with UFS (Universal Flash Storage), Ethernet, PCIe, CXL, and MIPI protocols. Solid understanding of low-speed peripherals ( I2c/i3c, SPI, UART, GPIO, QSPI ) and high-speed protocols. Experience in DDR, HBM, Gate-level simulations , and power-aware verification using Xprop and UPF . Proficiency in scripting languages such as Shell, Makefile, and Perl . Strong understanding of processor-based SoC verification, including Native, Verilog, SystemVerilog, and UVM mixed environments . Experience with C-SystemVerilog handshake and writing C test cases for boot-up verification . Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.

Job Title: HR-People & Organization Manager Company: Sage Healthy Global Location: Avadi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India(Work from office) Position Type: Full-time; based in the Avadi office 
 Build a workplace where strong people join, grow, and stay. 
 Sage Healthy provides medical billing and revenue cycle management services to healthcare practices across the United States. Our Avadi team works with colleagues in North America to improve billing accuracy, reimbursement, and service delivery. Our people and technology underpin the quality and continuity of that work. 
 Position Summary: 
 The People & Organization Manager leads the full HR function for Sage Healthy Global, with accountability for recruitment, retention, rewards, recognition, employee relations, policies, and reliable HR administration. This is a hands-on management role that turns business needs into practical people initiatives and measurable improvements in hiring, employee experience, and team stability. 
 The manager partners with India operations, department leaders, Business Operations & Finance, and corporate leadership to build capable teams and support fair, consistent management. The role owns HR service quality and coaches or supervises assigned HR support staff, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and approval controls. 
 Responsibilities: 
 1. Recruitment and Onboarding Agree staffing priorities, job profiles, selection criteria, and hiring timelines with department managers within approved headcount and budgets. Build candidate pipelines through local networks, referrals, institutions, and relevant recruitment channels; lead structured screening, interviews, and offer coordination. Own joining readiness and onboarding, including documentation, induction, manager handoffs, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day check-ins; track early performance and retention. 
 2. Retention and Employee Engagement Identify preventable turnover through employee feedback, stay conversations, departure feedback, and analysis by team and tenure; agree corrective actions with managers. Run a practical engagement calendar and short employee surveys; communicate findings and follow through on agreed improvements. Support career conversations, internal mobility, and a positive employee experience for office-based and remote India staff. 
 3. Rewards and Recognition Review market information and internal pay consistency; recommend salary ranges, increments, benefits, and incentives with Finance and leadership approval. Administer approved compensation review and reward processes with documented criteria, budget checks, and clear employee communication. Build timely, fair recognition for individual and team contributions, service milestones, and company values; monitor participation across teams and work locations. 
 4. Performance and Development Coordinate goal setting, probation reviews, performance discussions, and development plans with clear deadlines and completion tracking. Coach managers on feedback, performance concerns, documentation, and fair treatment; support appropriate improvement plans and escalation. Identify training needs with department heads, coordinate delivery, and assess whether learning improves job performance and readiness for greater responsibility. 
 5. Employee Relations and Policies Provide an accessible, confidential channel for employee concerns; handle matters promptly, document outcomes, and escalate sensitive cases to designated leadership or advisers. Maintain clear people policies and support consistent application across hiring, attendance, leave, conduct, performance, and separation. Coordinate applicable employment compliance, workplace dignity and harassment-prevention processes, required training, and records with qualified local advisers. Promote respectful conduct and embed Sages values: One Team, Excellence, See It Through, Courage, and Growth. 
 6. HR Administration and Payroll Coordination Own accurate employee records, employment documentation, attendance and leave data, benefits administration, and timely updates in the HR system. Validate and submit payroll inputs, including joiners, leavers, attendance, and approved salary changes; resolve discrepancies with Business Operations & Finance. Coordinate employee benefit and statutory administration with Finance and advisers, maintaining clear owners and calendars for required actions. Manage separations, handovers, employee communications, and final-settlement inputs; coordinate access removal and asset return with Infrastructure & Support. 
 7. People Planning and Process Improvement Maintain a practical people plan aligned with staffing demand, organizational changes, and management priorities; flag capacity and succession risks early. Standardize HR workflows and service expectations, delegate routine tasks where resources permit, and improve HR system use and data quality. Coordinate confidentiality and security training with relevant teams; restrict employee information to authorized users and maintain appropriate records. 
 8. Reporting and Accountability Provide a concise monthly dashboard covering time to fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, voluntary turnover, engagement feedback, and recognition participation. Track timely onboarding, probation and performance reviews, payroll-input accuracy, and closure of employee concerns and agreed actions. Establish baselines and agree realistic targets with leadership within the first 60 days; review results monthly and own corrective actions with department managers. Operate within delegated authority. Obtain approval for headcount, compensation changes, incentive budgets, policy changes, and significant employment decisions. 
 Requirements: Ability to combine hands-on HR delivery with ownership of recruitment, retention, and employee engagement outcomes. Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through when handling sensitive employee and management matters. Ability to coach managers, resolve problems constructively, and collaborate across functions and locations. Clear written and spoken English and effective Tamil communication for the local workforce. Availability to work from Avadi and coordinate with international colleagues as required. 
 Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in human resources, business administration, psychology, or a related discipline; a postgraduate HR qualification is preferred. Experience: Typically 58 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years leading HR initiatives or a team, with evidence of improved hiring, retention, or engagement. Functional knowledge: Practical experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, compensation reviews, and HR administration. Local knowledge: Working knowledge of employment requirements and HR practices relevant to Tamil Nadu, with the judgment to seek specialist advice. Systems and analytics: Proficiency in an HR platform such as Keka, Microsoft Excel, and concise management reporting; ability to turn data into action. Industry exposure: Experience in medical billing, healthcare services, BPO, IT-enabled services, or a comparable service organization is preferred. 
 Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and role scope, paid monthly on the last working day. Annual vacation and personal time off follow company policy and applicable requirements. Bonus eligibility after the first year is subject to the approved scheme and employment terms. The role offers opportunities for professional growth. 
 Note: This profile outlines the principal responsibilities of the People & Organization Manager and may evolve with business needs. Management will confirm reporting arrangements, delegated authority, and individual performance targets.
