 About the Role 
A 10-year-old health tech company is building a new managed IT Services delivery centre in India to support mid-sized companies and nonprofit organisations in the US.
We are looking for a senior leader who can build this operation from the ground up, hire the team, set up processes, launch the first client, and then manage the business as it grows.
This is not a traditional IT operations manager role. The person will be responsible for building a high-quality service organisation that US clients can trust with their day-to-day IT operations.
 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 1. Build the India IT Services Centre 
 Design the overall operating model for the India delivery centre. Decide the team structure, responsibilities, working shifts and staffing requirements. Select and implement the required IT service management and monitoring tools. Set up the required office infrastructure, security controls and business continuity arrangements. Establish relationships with local IT service partners who can provide on-site support for US clients. Create clear service processes, escalation procedures and operating guidelines. 2. Build and Lead the Team 
The initial team is expected to include:
 Service Desk Lead IT Support Engineers Level 1 and Level 2 Network / Infrastructure Engineer Microsoft 365 / Intune specialist NOC / Monitoring Engineer Cloud / Backup support Service Delivery Manager HR / Recruitment support Key responsibilities include:
 Hire the initial team. Define job descriptions and selection criteria. Create practical technical assessments and interview processes. Develop an onboarding and training programme. Ensure adequate backup resources for critical skills. Manage employee retention, especially for US-shift roles. Build a talent pipeline for future growth. 3. Launch and Transition the First Client 
The successful candidate will lead the transition of the first US client into companys managed IT services.
This includes:
 Understanding the client's existing IT environment and processes. Planning the transition from the current service provider/team to the company. Creating documentation, operating procedures and knowledge-transfer plans. Conducting testing before taking responsibility for live IT operations. Ensuring the team is ready before the client goes live. Managing major incidents and escalations during the transition. Clearly defining what Aigilx will and will not support. Important: The candidate must be comfortable managing a client transition from the beginning through to stable day-to-day operations.
 4. Manage Service Quality 
Once the centre is operational, the Head will be responsible for service quality and client satisfaction.
Key measures include:
 SLA performance meeting agreed response and resolution times. Customer satisfaction (CSAT). First-contact resolution. Ticket resolution time. Reopened tickets. Successful IT changes. Backup and recovery testing. Major incident management. The leader will regularly review performance with US clients and take corrective action where required.
 5. Manage Security and Compliance 
The candidate must ensure that employees follow strong IT security practices, including:
 Appropriate access controls. Limited administrative access. Secure handling of client information. Regular review of employee access. No use of personal devices for sensitive client information. Compliance with applicable Indian employment and data-protection requirements. Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, healthcare or HIPAA-related environments will be an advantage.
 6. Manage the Business and P&L 
This is also a business leadership role.
The candidate will:
 Own the financial performance of the India delivery unit. Manage staffing costs and utilisation. Monitor profitability. Help develop pricing for IT services. Support proposals and presentations for US clients. Work with the sales team to win new business. Grow the operation after the first client is stable. Ensure the business does not hire significantly ahead of confirmed client demand. What We Are Looking For 
 Must-Have Experience 
The ideal candidate should have:
 Experience 
 12+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, IT service management or managed IT services. At least 6 years of experience managing an IT delivery operation serving US or UK clients from India. Experience working in an MSP, GCC, captive centre or similar IT services organisation. Experience building or significantly expanding an IT delivery team. Experience taking at least one client from transition/implementation to stable operations. Experience managing US-shift/night-shift teams. Experience managing service delivery, client escalations and operational performance. Technical Understanding 
The person does not necessarily need to be the strongest hands-on engineer but must understand the major IT areas being delivered.
They should have good working knowledge of:
 Microsoft 365 Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory Microsoft Intune End-user IT support Networks and firewalls VPN IT monitoring / NOC operations Backup and disaster recovery Azure or AWS IT service management / ITIL Experience with technologies such as Fortinet and Veeam is useful.
 Leadership & Business Skills 
Look for candidates who can demonstrate:
 Strong people leadership. Client management skills. Excellent spoken and written English. Experience dealing directly with US senior IT leaders. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to manage high-pressure incidents. Experience managing budgets and operational costs. Understanding of utilisation, profitability and pricing. Ability to build processes and operating discipline. Strong documentation and governance mindset. Preferred Experience 
These are good-to-have, not mandatory :
 Healthcare or nonprofit IT services experience. HIPAA-aware environments. SOC 2 or ISO 27001 implementation experience. Experience managing third-party IT vendors/specialists. P&L ownership. Existing professional network/talent pool in Chennai or Hyderabad. Education 
 Minimum: Bachelors degree in engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
 Preferred certifications: 
 ITIL Microsoft certifications Fortinet Veeam PMP/PRINCE2 is an advantage, particularly for transition/project management.
An MBA is an advantage but is not a substitute for relevant IT delivery experience.
 Ideal Candidate will be Someone who: 
 Has built and operated an IT services centre , rather than only managed an existing team. Is comfortable working with US clients and US working hours. Can communicate confidently with senior US stakeholders. Takes ownership when there is a major client issue. Builds strong processes and documentation. Can say No when a client asks for work outside the agreed scope. Understands both technology and business. Can build a team that eventually operates without depending on the Head for every decision. Is comfortable being hands-on during the initial setup but can gradually move into a leadership role. First-Year Success Measures 
The successful candidate is expected to achieve the following:
 First 30 days 
 Finalise operating model and team structure. Identify required tools. Create hiring plan. Prepare first-client transition plan. First 60 days 
 Key leadership positions hired. IT service management system ready. Shift structure established. Local service partners identified. First 90 days 
 Core team in place. Team training completed. Major incident simulation completed. Ready for first client launch. By Month 6 
 First client operating successfully. SLA and service-quality targets achieved. Customer satisfaction of approximately 4.2/5 or higher. Annualised attrition below 18%. By Month 12 
 India unit has clear P&L visibility. SOC 2 preparation underway. Second client contracted or close to signing. Delivery centre can operate effectively without depending on the Head every day. 
 
 Compensation 
Best in the Industry

title: Senior Human Resource Executive
description:
Job description 
 About Antraweb Technologies 
 Antraweb Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a growing technology and service-based organization with a strong presence across multiple locations. We provide business solutions that help organizations simplify their processes and improve operational efficiency. As we continue to expand our teams and operations, we are looking for passionate professionals who want to grow along with the organization. At Antraweb, employees receive the opportunity to work closely with business leaders, handle meaningful responsibilities and gain exposure across multiple areas. 
 Company Website - Best Tally Software Support Customization & Solutions Provider 
 Role Overview We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior HR Executive to join our growing HR team. The primary responsibility of this role will be managing end-to-end recruitment, particularly for senior, leadership and specialized positions. The selected candidate will also gain exposure to various HR operations and employee lifecycle activities. This role is ideal for someone who wants to move beyond routine recruitment and develop into a well-rounded HR professional with greater responsibilities and future growth opportunities. 
 Key Responsibilities Talent Acquisition Manage end-to-end recruitment for senior, mid-level and specialized positions. Work closely with department heads and management to understand manpower requirements. Develop effective sourcing strategies for different roles. Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and recruitment agencies. Screen profiles and conduct initial HR interviews. Coordinate interviews with department heads and senior management. Handle salary discussions, offer negotiations and candidate follow-ups. Build and maintain a strong recruitment pipeline. Ensure positions are closed within the defined timelines. Conduct reference checks and coordinate background verification. Manage offer rollout, candidate engagement and joining formalities. Maintain recruitment trackers and prepare regular hiring reports. 
 HR Operations Coordinate employee onboarding, induction and documentation. Maintain employee records and ensure accurate HRMS updates. Support attendance, leave and payroll-related processes. Assist in employee engagement and grievance handling. Coordinate employee confirmations, transfers and performance reviews. Support the implementation and communication of HR policies. Assist with ISO documentation, internal audits and compliance requirements. Coordinate resignations, handovers, exit formalities and full-and-final settlements. Prepare HR reports and management updates whenever required. 
 What Makes This Role Exciting? Opportunity to recruit for senior, leadership and specialized positions. Direct interaction and coordination with department heads and management. Exposure to both talent acquisition and complete HR operations. Opportunity to take ownership of important HR projects and processes. Scope to grow into a team-handling or broader HR leadership role based on performance. A fast-paced working environment where new ideas and initiatives are encouraged. Continuous learning and professional development as the organization expands. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Graduate or postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Management or a related field. Minimum 2-3 years of relevant HR experience. Strong experience in end-to-end recruitment, including senior-level hiring. Good understanding of HR operations and the employee lifecycle. Excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills. Confidence in coordinating with candidates, employees, department heads and senior management. Proficiency in MS Excel, recruitment portals and HRMS platforms. Strong follow-up, documentation and reporting abilities. Ability to manage multiple vacancies and HR responsibilities simultaneously. A proactive, process-oriented and ownership-driven approach. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Experience in the IT, software, technology or service industry. Exposure to hiring for technical, sales, operational and leadership positions. Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of assigned responsibilities. Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period will be preferred. 
 Grow With Us At Antraweb, this will not be just another recruitment role. You will have the opportunity to understand the business, work on different aspects of HR and gradually take on larger responsibilities. If you are ambitious, eager to learn and looking for a workplace where your contribution can make a visible difference, we would be happy to meet you.

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Position : Human Resource Executive Experience : 12 Years Reporting To : Founder / CEO or Designated Manager Employment Type : Full-time Salary: Up to 20K /Month 
 About the Role : 
 We are looking for an HR Executive who can take care of the regular HR work in the office and keep things properly organized. The person will mainly handle recruitment, employee joining, attendance, leave, documentation, employee coordination and other day-to-day HR activities. This role is suitable for someone who is comfortable talking to people, follows up on work regularly and does not wait for someone to remind them about every task. 
 What You Will Be Doing : 
 You will be responsible for handling recruitment activities, starting from finding candidates and checking CVs to arranging interviews, speaking with candidates, following up with them and coordinating their joining. You will keep track of open positions and make sure candidates are followed up properly. If there is a delay in hiring, you should be able to identify it and bring it to the manager's attention. You will also take care of the joining process for new employees, including collecting documents, KYC, induction, access, KRAs and initial training coordination. Attendance and leave records need to be maintained properly. Employee documents and other HR records should also be kept updated and confidential. You will coordinate with managers regarding employee KRAs and performance reviews and make sure the required information and follow-ups are completed on time. Employees may come to you with regular questions or concerns. You should be able to understand the issue, handle it where possible and involve management when the matter needs a decision. You will also help organize employee activities such as training, birthdays, small team events and other engagement activities. When an employee leaves the company, you will coordinate the exit process, including notice period follow-up, handover, company asset return, exit interview and documentation. A weekly HR update will also need to be prepared covering recruitment status, attendance, new joining's, employee issues, pending documentation and other important HR matters. If you notice repeated issues with attendance, employee behavior or any other HR matter, you should bring them to the management's attention instead of ignoring them. 
 What We Are Looking For : 
 Good communication skills (English) and the confidence to speak with employees and candidates. Someone who is comfortable making regular follow-up calls and messages. Good knowledge of basic HR and recruitment activities. Ability to conduct initial candidate discussions and understand whether a candidate is suitable for the position. Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with HRMS or other HR software will be an advantage. Good documentation and record-keeping habits. Ability to handle employee information with confidentiality. Someone who can remain calm while dealing with employee issues or difficult conversations. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes responsibility for their work and gets things done without needing constant supervision. 
 The Right Person For This Role : 
 The right person will be friendly and approachable with employees but will also know when to be firm. You should be comfortable working independently, following up with people and keeping track of several things at the same time. We do not expect you to make management-level decisions. We do expect you to identify problems, keep the management informed and make sure routine HR work does not get stuck. 
 Please Note : 
 Final decisions related to hiring, salary, increments, promotions, termination and major disciplinary matters will be taken by the Founder, CEO or the authorized manager.

 Department: Human Resources
 Experience: 812 Years
 Location: Ahmedabad
 Industry: Pharmaceutical / Healthcare 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and people-oriented HR Manager to lead and manage key HR functions including employee lifecycle management, onboarding, compliance, payroll, performance management, employee engagement, talent management, grievance handling, and separation processes. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of HR policies, labour laws, statutory compliance, employee relations, and performance management, along with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Onboarding & Induction Design and implement structured onboarding and induction programs for new employees. Coordinate offer formalities, joining documentation, background verification, and employee records. Ensure cross-functional coordination with IT, Administration, Finance, and other departments for Day 1 readiness. Conduct employee orientation covering company policies, culture, processes, and role expectations. Monitor onboarding effectiveness and support faster time-to-productivity for new hires. 2. HR Compliance & Statutory Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, Gratuity, POSH, Shops & Establishments, and other applicable regulations . Review and update HR policies in accordance with changes in legislation and organisational requirements. Coordinate statutory audits, inspections, filings, and documentation. Maintain accurate employee records and statutory documentation. Coordinate with legal advisors and labour-law consultants on compliance-related matters. 3. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Oversee accurate and timely monthly payroll processing. Manage compensation structures, employee benefits, reimbursements, and allowances. Coordinate salary revisions and maintain compensation records. Support salary benchmarking and compensation analysis against relevant market standards. Ensure proper statutory deductions, payroll compliance, and payroll audits. Resolve employee queries related to salary, deductions, benefits, and reimbursements. 4. Performance Management & Appraisals Develop and administer the organization's performance management process. Coordinate KRA/KPI setting, goal setting, mid-year reviews, and annual performance appraisals . Facilitate performance discussions between employees and managers. Support managers in providing structured and constructive feedback. Identify performance gaps and coordinate Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs). Support recognition and reward initiatives for high-performing employees. 5. Employee Reviews & Increment Management Manage annual and periodic performance review cycles. Coordinate increment and promotion recommendations with functional and departmental heads. Ensure consistency and proper documentation of performance ratings and salary revisions. Maintain records of employee performance, increments, promotions, and related decisions. 6. Employee Separations & Full & Final Settlement Manage the complete employee separation process, including resignation acceptance, notice-period tracking, and exit formalities. Coordinate knowledge transfer and proper handover processes. Ensure timely processing of Full & Final Settlement (F&F) . Coordinate issuance of relieving letters, experience certificates, and other separation documents. Manage involuntary separations in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements. 7. Exit Interviews & Attrition Analysis Conduct structured exit interviews with separating employees. Capture and analyse reasons for employee attrition. Identify recurring trends, retention risks, and areas requiring management intervention. Share actionable insights and recommendations with senior management. Maintain confidentiality and objectivity while handling exit feedback. 8. Talent Management & Learning & Development Support succession planning and internal talent mapping. Identify critical roles and potential internal talent. Conduct skill-gap analysis and coordinate training and development initiatives. Support employee career development and internal mobility programs. Assist in developing employee engagement and retention initiatives. 9. Employee Grievance & Employee Relations Establish effective channels for employee grievance redressal. Address employee concerns and complaints fairly, professionally, and within defined timelines. Conduct appropriate investigations while maintaining confidentiality. Ensure resolutions are aligned with company policies and applicable laws. Escalate sensitive matters, including harassment, ethical concerns, and serious employee-relations issues, through the appropriate channels. Track grievance trends and recommend corrective actions to improve employee relations. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management . Good understanding of labour laws and statutory compliance . Strong payroll and compensation management knowledge. Experience in performance management, KRA/KPI frameworks, and appraisal processes. Strong employee relations and grievance-handling skills. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee matters. Strong stakeholder-management and team-management skills. Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS/HRIS platforms . Preferred Candidate Profile MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification. 8–12 years of relevant experience in HR, preferably in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, manufacturing, or related industry . Hands-on experience managing end-to-end HR operations. Strong exposure to statutory compliance, payroll, employee relations, performance management, and HR policies. Experience in managing HR processes independently and working closely with senior management.

title: Senior HR Executive (Operations & Keka HRMS Specialist)
description:
About the Role We are looking for a dynamic and highly experienced Senior HR Executive to take complete ownership of our core HR operations. This role is built for a true HR technologist and operations expert who possesses a flawless, inside-out understanding of Keka HRMS. 
 As a Senior HR Executive, you will act as the backbone of our employee lifecycle, managing everything from seamless onboarding to graceful exits. You will ensure our payroll runs without a hitch, our workplace culture remains vibrant, and our organization remains 100% compliant with Indian labor laws and IT industry standards. If you are a process-driven HR professional who knows how to leverage technology to automate and streamline HR functions, we want you on our team.
 Who You Are Personality & Interpersonal: You have a chirpy and bubbly personality that naturally connects with people. Highly emotionally intelligent, you can easily read the mood of the workforce and are deeply passionate about fostering a positive work environment. Drive & Ownership: You are driven, ambitious, and actively looking to transform into an HR Manager role. You take full ownership of the HR function, working closely with leadership to proactively identify improvement areas and close those gaps. Functional Expertise: You possess strong operational HR skills, are deeply knowledgeable about payroll and statutory compliance, and are skilled in compensation planning. Crucially, you have a strong willingness to grow from operational tasks into strategic HR leadership. Systems & Efficiency Mindset: You are comfortable leveraging AI to drive efficiency and productivity. You focus heavily on building resilient systems and processes that teams can learn from, effectively reducing the organization's dependency on any single individual. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Keka HRMS Mastery & Data Insights Act as the absolute Subject Matter Expert (SME) and primary administrator for our Keka HRMS platform. Flawlessly configure, update, and manage all Keka modules, including Leave & Attendance, Payroll, Performance Management, and Expense flows. Create and automate backend workflows and customized reports. Prepare weekly and monthly HR reports that surface workforce-related challenges in alignment with business priorities. Troubleshoot system glitches, adapt the platform to evolving company policies, and train staff on using the portal effectively. 
 2. End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management Onboarding: Handle pre-joining and onboarding formalities. Generate offer letters, conduct thorough background verifications (BGV), set up IT assets, and execute engaging induction programs. Offboarding/Exits: Manage seamless exit formalities, conduct empathetic exit interviews, manage departmental clearances, and ensure accurate Full & Final (FnF) settlements. 
 3. Payroll, Compensation & Budgeting Manage end-to-end pre-payroll activities, ensuring 100% accuracy in leave, attendance, and loss of pay (LOP) data within Keka. Oversee salary structuring, tax declarations, and take charge of compensation planning. Propose and manage the overall HR budget, working closely with the founders to allocate sufficient budget for high-impact employee welfare and engagement activities. Coordinate with the Finance/Accounts team to process monthly payroll on time, resolving grievances promptly. 
 4. Performance Management & Team Leadership Oversee and manage a 360 performance appraisal system that drives high performance and continuous growth across the company. Mentor junior HR team members , conducting regular 1:1s and empowering the team to achieve more. Promote a results-driven culture while actively maintaining high team morale. 
 5. Employee Experience & Relations Interact with remote and in-office employees, maintaining a healthy balance and cohesive culture between the remote and in-person experience. Design and execute high-impact employee engagement initiatives, team-building activities, and workplace wellness programs tailored to IT professionals. Act as the first point of contact for employee grievances, resolving conflicts professionally, empathetically, and in strict adherence to company policies. 
 6. Statutory Compliance & IT Industry Standards Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of Indian labor laws applicable to the IT sector (e.g., Shops and Establishments Act, Maternity Benefit Act, POSH). Ensure strict compliance and timely remittance of all statutory deductions (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, and Gratuity). Stay updated on changing labor regulations and minimum wage revisions to advise management on risk mitigation. 
 7. Core HR Administration Draft, update, and enforce HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs), ensuring these processes are well-documented for the team. Maintain highly confidential employee records, organizational charts, and digital files securely. 
 Qualifications & Requirements Experience: 6 to 7 years of proven experience in HR Operations, preferably within the IT/Software Services industry. Keka Proficiency (Mandatory): Must have advanced, hands-on administrative experience with Keka HRMS. You should know how to configure policies from scratch and troubleshoot backend settings. Compliance Knowledge: Deep, practical understanding of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, PT), and payroll processing. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of drafting professional internal communications, policies, and managing vendor relations. Problem-Solving: High emotional intelligence, discretion with confidential information, and a proactive approach to conflict resolution. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 What Sets You Apart Previous experience independently implementing or migrating an organization to Keka HRMS. Strong data analysis skills using Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, Pivot tables) in conjunction with Keka data exports.

title: People & Culture Director
description:
SmartBear delivers application integrity for modern tech stacks, ensuring continuous, measurable assurance that software just works as intended with governance to operate at AI speed and scale. SmartBear offers deep test automation, API lifecycle management, and observability capabilities. With integrations across the SDLC, it sets a new quality standard for application delivery teams.
   

  

 SmartBear is trusted by developers, testers, and software engineers across 32,000 organizations, including 75% of the largest financial institutions and industry leaders such as Adobe, JetBlue, and Microsoft. SmartBear’s open source tools are downloaded more than 100 million times a month and have earned over 30,000 GitHub stars from the developer community. With its best\-loved brands, including Swagger, TestComplete, Reflect, QMetry, Zephyr, and more, SmartBear meets customers where they are to make our technology\-driven world a better place. Learn more at
 
 www.smartbear.com
 
 , or follow us on
 
 LinkedIn
 
 ,
 
 X
 
 , and
 
 Reddit
 
 . 
   

  

 At SmartBear, you will be part of a dynamic team solving one of the most critical challenges facing modern businesses: ensuring the integrity of software in an AI\-driven world. Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.
 



**People \& Culture Director** 




 This is a pivotal role for SmartBear's India operations, combining hands\-on HRBP partnership with company\-wide accountability for statutory compliance. As HRBP to your assigned function, you'll partner with senior business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with business priorities, coach leaders on talent, performance, and organizational effectiveness, and drive strategic people initiatives that build high\-performing, engaged, and inclusive teams. You'll also serve as India's statutory compliance expert, owning alignment with Indian labor law across all India\-based SmartBear employees including those outside your HRBP client group, regardless of function or reporting line, in partnership with our Director of Global People Operations. 
 



**About the Role:** 



* Partner with business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with organizational goals and translate business priorities into actionable people plans.
* Coach and advise managers on performance management, employee development, organizational design, compensation, and employee relations.
* Analyze employee engagement survey results and develop action plans with leaders.
* Develop and implement talent retention strategies that enhance employee experience.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, influencing leaders through data, business insight, and People \& Culture expertise.
* Collaborate across the People \& Culture organization to deliver consistent, scalable, and impactful people programs.
* Partner with global People \& Culture teams to adapt enterprise\-wide programs to local legal and cultural context.
* The successful candidate will work from our Bengaluru, India office in hybrid model.



**India Statutory Compliance (all India employees):** 



* Own compliance with Indian labor law — including the Industrial Relations Code, Shops \& Establishments Act, and related regulations — for every India\-based employee, regardless of which function or HRBP they are otherwise supported by, serving as SmartBear's go\-to expert on India employment regulation.
* Partner with the Director of Global People Operations, Legal, and other HRBPs to maintain visibility into employment actions (hiring, compensation changes, terminations) across functions, so compliance risk is caught even outside your direct client group.
* Serve as the single point of accountability and escalation for India regulatory questions raised by other HRBPs or business leaders.



**We are looking for you if you have:** 



* 8\+ years of experience in a senior People Partner or HR Business Partner role, ideally within a high\-growth technology environment.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to develop and implement strategic People \& Culture initiatives.
* Strong expertise in performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience analyzing employee engagement data and translating insights into measurable action plans.
* Excellent communication, coaching, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* A passion for building inclusive, high\-performing teams and creating exceptional employee experiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and HR regulatory requirements is required, given this role's company\-wide compliance ownership.
* Experience working as part of a global, distributed People \& Culture team is a plus.
* A background in people operations — including HR systems, processes, and policy administration — is a plus.



**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:** 
  
 


* You can grow your career at every level.
* We invest in your success as well as the spaces where our teams come together to work, collaborate, and have fun.
* We love celebrating our SmartBears; we even encourage our crew to take their birthdays off.
* We are guided by a People and Culture organization \- an important distinction for us. We think about our team holistically – the whole person.
* We celebrate our differences in experiences, viewpoints, and identities because we know it leads to better outcomes.



**Did you know?** 



* Our main goal at SmartBear is to make our technology\-driven world a better place.
* SmartBear is committed to ethical corporate practices and social responsibility, promoting good in all the communities we serve.
* SmartBear is headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices across the world including Galway Ireland, Bath, UK, Wroclaw, Poland and Bangalore, India.
* We’ve won major industry (product and company) awards including B2B Innovators Award, Content Marketing Association, IntellyX Digital Innovator and BuiltIn Best Places to Work.



*SmartBear is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for employees where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that reflects a diversity of thought and experience as well as our values of being smart, open, driven, accountable, and curious.*

title: Associate Manager HR
description:
**About the Organization** 




  





 At
 **eGov** 
 , we start with citizens and the everyday public services that shape their lives. A parent is bringing a child to a clinic. A family waiting for water . A streetlight that finally gets fixed. In those moments, government is not policy or process—it is lived experience. We believe everyone deserves public services that are
 **accessible, responsive, and transparent** 
 —services that work consistently, reach everyone, and respect people’s time and dignity.
 



  





 To make this possible, we partner closely with governments to strengthen the foundations on which public services run. Our core approach is offering the
 **DIGIT platform** 
 \- a Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI
 **)** 
 \- that helps create shared, reusable digital systems that enable governments to plan, deliver, and monitor public services at scale. DPI is not about a single application or program; it is about creating
 **common rails** 
 that many services, departments, and partners can use over time.
 



  





 But public services do not improve solely through technology. We work with governments on
 **strategy, institutional design, and implementation** 
 , and we help build
 **ecosystems of partners** 
 that can deliver together. By aligning policy, processes, people, financing, and digital systems, we support the state to turn intent into services that work on the ground.
 



  





 Across India, Africa, and other emerging economies, we help governments move from fragmented, project\-led digitisation to
 **durable public infrastructure** 
 that belongs to the state and quietly improves public services day after day. When this works well, citizens may never see the systems behind it—but they feel the difference in how services show up in their lives.
 



  





 We currently work in 10 countries, and more than 1 billion people and hundreds of sectoral public services systems have been built on DIGIT.
 



  





 You’ll thrive here if you:
 


* Care deeply about citizens and the quality of public services
* Believe strong state capacity is essential to inclusive development
* Enjoy working across strategy, partnerships, and execution
* Want to build systems that endure beyond individual projects



  





 We are strategists, technologists, momentum builders, and partners—but above all, people committed to
 **making public services work better for everyone** 
 .
 



  





**Why Work With Us?** 




**Make Large\-Scale Impact:** 
 Contribute to initiatives that drive significant societal change at national and global levels.
 



**Learn from Experts:** 
 Gain mentorship from experienced professionals across our ecosystem.
 



**Use Technology for Good:** 
 Be part of a team dedicated to solving real\-world problems through digital innovation.
 



**Grow and Lead:** 
 Take on high\-ownership roles in a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
 



  





**Role Summary:** 




 The HR Associate Manager will play a dual role spanning
 **Employee Experience, HR Operations, and HR Partnering (HRBP)** 
 . This role is responsible for enhancing employee engagement, ensuring seamless HR operations, and partnering with organizational leaders to drive people strategies aligned with organizational goals.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Employee Experience** 



* Drive initiatives to enhance overall employee engagement and satisfaction across the employee lifecycle
* Design and implement employee listening mechanisms (surveys, feedback forums, skip\-level meetings)
* Lead engagement programs and culture\-building activities
* Partner with leadership to strengthen organizational culture and employee value proposition (EVP)
* Analyze employee feedback and recommend actionable insights



  





**2\. HR Operations** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end HR operations including onboarding, offboarding, documentation, and HR compliance
* Ensure accuracy and efficiency in HR systems (HRMS), data management, and reporting
* Manage payroll inputs, benefits administration, and statutory compliance (PF, Gratuity, etc.)
* Drive process improvements and automation initiatives in HR operations
* Ensure adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements



  





**3\. HR Partnering (HRBP)** 



* Act as a strategic partner to organizational leaders on workforce planning and organizational design
* Support performance management processes, including goal setting, reviews, and calibration
* Partner with managers on talent development, succession planning, and retention strategies
* Provide guidance on employee relations, conflict resolution, and disciplinary actions
* Enable leadership with data\-driven insights on people metrics



  





**4\. Talent \& Capability Development** 



* Identify skill gaps and support learning \& development initiatives
* Facilitate leadership development and capability\-building programs
* Support internal mobility and career progression frameworks



  





**5\. HR Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Track and analyze key HR metrics (attrition, engagement, performance, diversity, etc.)
* Prepare dashboards and reports for leadership reviews
* Use data insights to drive strategic HR interventions



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or related field
* More than 6 years of HR experience with exposure to
 **HRBP roles \+ HR Operations**
* Strong understanding of HR best practices and application of technology in HR
* Experience in managing employee engagement and culture initiatives



  





**Key Skills \& Competencies:** 



* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution skills
* Data\-driven mindset with strong analytical capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Experience:** 



* Exposure to HRMS tools (Zoho, Success Factor, Darwinbox, SAP, etc.)
* Certification in HR (e.g., SHRM\-CP, SHRM\-SCP) is a plus



  





**Success Metrics:** 



* Improvement of OHI (Organizational Health Index) scores
* Improvement in employee engagement scores
* Efficiency in HR operations and process turnaround time
* Stakeholder satisfaction and leadership alignment



  





**Application Process** 




 Interested candidates may upload their updated CV and details in the link: https://forms.gle/dV3HmTJ9DQrxDPLe8
 



  





 Please note that the applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the position may be closed once suitable candidates are identified. Only short\-listed candidates will receive an acknowledgment and will be called for personal interactions.

title: HR Commercial Pilot Partner — Retention Risk Investigation & Intervention
description:
**You don't know they're going to leave.** 

  




**You just know something isn't right.** 

  






 You have an employee you really don't want to lose.
 




  






 They're valuable. They're still delivering. There hasn't been a resignation. There may not even be an obvious problem.
 




  






 But something has changed.
 




  






 Maybe their behaviour is different.
 





 Maybe their workload has become unsustainable.
 





 Maybe their engagement is slipping.
 





 Maybe they've been waiting too long for a promotion.
 





 Maybe something has changed with their manager.
 





 Maybe compensation has started bothering them.
 




  






 You don't know yet.
 




  





**And that's where the work begins.** 




  






 You start looking.
 




  






 You pull information from the HRIS. You look at performance history. You check engagement or pulse data. You look at compensation. You speak to the manager. You look at previous conversations. You search for other signals that might explain what you're seeing.
 




  






 One piece points in one direction. Another piece points somewhere else.
 




  






 So you investigate further.
 




  






 You speak to the manager again.
 




  






 You try to understand whether this is temporary or structural. Whether it's workload, compensation, career progression, management, recognition, something personal, or something you haven't even considered yet.
 




  






 Eventually, you have to speak with the employee.
 




  






 So you prepare.
 




  






 What should you ask?
 




  






 How should you approach the conversation?
 




  






 What should you avoid saying?
 




  






 How do you make sure you don't turn a sensitive retention conversation into something that actually accelerates disengagement?
 




  






 You have the conversation.
 




  






 And now you have even more information.
 




  






 But you're still left with the hardest part:
 




  





**What do I actually do about this?** 




  






 Which signal matters most?
 




  






 What is the real underlying problem?
 




  






 How serious is the risk?
 




  






 What intervention has the best chance of working?
 




  






 Do you change the workload?
 




  






 Redesign the role?
 




  






 Address compensation?
 




  






 Change something in the manager\-employee relationship?
 




  






 Accelerate a career conversation?
 




  






 Do something else entirely?
 




  






 And what happens if you get the decision wrong?
 




  






 Do nothing, and you may lose someone you could have retained.
 




  






 Act incorrectly, and you may make the situation worse.
 




  






 Meanwhile, there are other employees, other managers, other business problems and other HR priorities waiting for you.
 




  






 And then another employee needs investigating.
 




  






 And another.
 




  






 And another.
 




  






 This is the retention job HR is already being paid to do.
 




  






 The problem isn't that HR doesn't know how to retain people.
 




  





**The problem is how much manual intelligence work sits between noticing a problem and knowing what to do about it.** 




  






 Today, getting this job done can mean moving between multiple systems, gathering fragmented information, speaking with multiple people, connecting weak signals, interpreting incomplete evidence, preparing conversations, documenting what happened, deciding what action to take and then following up to see whether that action actually worked.
 




  






 The HRBP is doing the job.
 




  





**But the intelligence required to do the job is fragmented around them.**

title: HRIS Senior Associate -  Data, Reporting & Testing
description:
**Summary:** 




 The Indus HRIS Senior Associate – Techno\-Functional Data, Reporting \& Testing plays a critical role in enabling scalable, compliant, and audit\-ready HR data operations within Oracle HCM as the organization expands across countries, legal entities, and integrated systems. This role combines
 



 functional HR process understanding with technical HRIS execution, owning expanded responsibilities across HR reporting rationalization, country\-specific regulatory and audit reporting (including ISQM\-equivalent requirements), and complex testing efforts supporting entity onboarding and integrations.
 



 The Senior Associate operates with a high degree of independence may serve as a bridge between HR, Compliance, and IT by translating business and regulatory requirements into technical reporting logic, data validations, and testing outcomes.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Techno\-Functional Reporting \& Data Ownership** 



* Own and enhance HR reporting solutions within Oracle HCM (OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts), translating functional HR and regulatory requirements into technical report logic.
* Collaboration on the rationalization, standardization, and streamlining of existing HR reports by assessing business usage, aligning data definitions, and eliminating duplication across countries and entities.
* Design and support country\-specific regulatory, compliance, and audit reporting, including requirements aligned to ISQM\-equivalent control frameworks.
* Perform advanced data analysis and reconciliation, validating report outputs against Oracle HCM source data and downstream integrations.
* Define and maintain functional and technical documentation, including data definitions, report logic, transformation rules, and checkpoints.



**Testing \& Integration Validation** 




 Participate and/or lead end\-to\-end testing efforts for new country/entity onboarding, configuration changes, and HR system integrations.
 



 Develop and execute detailed test scenarios and scripts that reflect real HR business processes (hire, transfer, termination, organizational changes) and country\-specific variations.
 



 Validate integrations through source\-to\-target testing, ensuring accuracy of employee, assignment, organizational, and regulatory data.
 



 Own defect triage, root cause analysis, and retesting, partnering with HRIS, IT, and vendors through resolution.
 



 Coordinate and execute regression testing for reporting, extracts, and integrations following releases or configuration changes.
 



**Controls, Audit \& Risk Management** 



* Support HRIS control frameworks by ensuring reporting and testing processes meet documented control standards and audit expectations.
* Prepare and maintain audit\-ready evidence, including reconciliations, test results, report logic, and approvals.
* Proactively identify data and control risks introduced by new countries, entities, or integrations and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR systems, reporting accuracy, and data controls.



**Stakeholder Partnership \& Functional Leadership** 



* Act as a techno\-functional SME for HR reporting and testing within the HRIS team.
* Collaborate with IT and integration teams to align functional requirements with technical solutions (APIs, extracts, downstream feeds).
* Mentor Associate\-level team members and contribute to continuous improvement of HRIS reporting and testing standards.



  





**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications:** 



* 4–7\+ years of experience in HRIS, HR technology, or HR data roles with both functional and technical responsibilities.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle HCM data structures and reporting tools.
* Demonstrated experience owning testing activities for HR processes, integrations, or multi\-entity implementations.
* Ability to translate business, regulatory, and audit requirements into technical reporting and testing solutions.
* Proven experience working in audit\-sensitive, controlled environments.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**The Vacancy** 




  





 GB Global is the UK’s leading independent logistics and global trade management provider, employing over 1,000 colleagues across a diverse network of operational, logistics, warehousing and commercial locations.
 



  





 As our Chennai business continues to grow, we are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded HR professional to join the team and help strengthen local people support.
 



  





 This is a strong opportunity for an experienced HR Business Partner, Senior HR Adviser or aspiring HR Manager who is ready to take the next step. The successful candidate will lead day\-to\-day employee relations activity, support wider ER initiatives, and contribute to organisational change projects across the business.
 



  





 The role will be based predominantly in Chennai, with regular travel to other business locations as required. This will give the successful candidate the opportunity to build strong working relationships, understand GB Global operations first\-hand, and provide practical HR support across the business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Lead complex employee relations casework, including disciplinary, grievance, capability, absence management and appeal matters.
* Provide practical, commercially focused HR advice to senior operational leaders, balancing business needs with fair, consistent and compliant people practices.
* Coach and support managers to build confidence in handling people matters and improving day\-to\-day management capability.
* Support Organisational change, restructuring and consultation processes, ensuring clear communication, appropriate documentation and effective risk management.
* Identify, assess and mitigate employment risks while ensuring compliance with employment legislation, company policies and internal procedures.
* Keep HR policies, procedures and templates up to date, ensuring they remain legally compliant, operationally relevant and clearly understood by managers and employees.
* Use HR data, trends and management information to support decision\-making, identify recurring issues and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with managers on recruitment activity, including understanding resourcing requirements, supporting selection processes and helping to deliver a positive candidate experience.
* Work closely with outsourced payroll providers to maintain accurate employee data, support timely payroll processing and resolve payroll queries efficiently.
* Contribute to the development of the wider Employee Relations function by improving processes, sharing best practice and supporting consistent standards across the business.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




  




* Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, Senior HR Adviser or HR Manager role.
* Strong employee relations knowledge, with the confidence to manage complex and sensitive people matters.
* Good working knowledge of employment law and HR best practice, with the judgement to know when to escalate risk.
* Experience supporting operational, logistics, warehousing or other fast\-paced environments would be advantageous.
* Commercially aware, pragmatic and confident working with managers to find practical solutions.
* Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable using HR data and systems to support accurate records, reporting and decision\-making.
* Relevant HR qualification, such as CIPD Level 5 or equivalent, or able to demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
* Flexible and willing to travel to other business locations when required.



  





**What We Offer:** 




  




* A genuine opportunity to shape the HR support model for a growing Chennai operation.
* Exposure to a varied employee relations workload, Organisational change activity and operational leadership teams.
* The chance to work in a commercially focused environment where HR has a clear role in supporting business performance.



  





 This is a hands\-on HR Manager role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, providing practical employee relations support and helping managers make confident people decisions. The successful candidate will play an important part in supporting the continued growth of the Chennai operation, while contributing to a consistent, commercially focused HR approach across GB Global.

* Certification in Labor laws, compliance regulations, ER and IR is preferred



**Desired Experience** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in ER.
* Working experience in manufacturing organization (Plant Location).
* Experience in electronic manufacturing or related industries is preferred.
* Experience in green field assignments or setting up of processes, systems, policies and implementation of rollouts is an added advantage
* Experience of working with a unionized workforce is preferred



**Desired Certifications** 



* Additional certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, HR Systems, Employee Relations, and POSH will be considered an added advantage.



  





**Job Description:** 
 Shift ER
 








**Role Purpose:** 
 Shit ER is a pivotal individual contributor responsible for fostering a harmonious, compliant, and high\-performing workplace by strengthening relationships between employees, contractors, leadership, and the organization. Operating in a fast\-paced, precision\-driven electronics manufacturing environment, this role closely partners with cross\- functional departments to drive employee engagement, grievance resolution, workforce discipline, and industrial harmony. Operating at the intersection of business continuity and employee experience, ER ensures a fair, compliant and inclusive workplace by strengthening trust across the shop floor. The role champions a positive work culture through proactive employee connect initiatives, conflict resolution, welfare interventions, grievance management, and stakeholder collaboration. By fostering strong employee relationships and promoting compliance, workplace safety, and continuous improvement, ER plays a critical role in maintaining a stable, engaged, and productive workforce that supports operational excellence and sustainable business growth.
 



  





**Who is it for?** 
 This is not your typical HR role. This is for professionals who believe that strong employee relationships build stronger businesses. If you enjoy being on the shop floor, solving real workplace challenges, building trust, and creating a culture where people feel heard and respected, this role is for you. You will be the bridge between employees and the business—driving employee experience, workplace harmony, and operational excellence. If you thrive in dynamic manufacturing environments and want to make a meaningful impact on people and business every day, this is Employee Relations with
 **Heart, Hustle** 
 and
 **Heritage.** 




  





**What we Expect you to Bring:** 



* A people\-first mindset with strong shop\-floor presence and hands\-on execution.
* Ability to build trust, credibility, and meaningful relationships across all workforce segments.
* Curiosity and learning agility to understand manufacturing operations and translate business needs into people solutions.
* Strong conflict resolution, grievance handling, and problem\-solving skills with fairness and empathy.
* Sound understanding of labor laws, statutory compliance, and workplace discipline.
* Data\-driven thinking with the ability to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills across and leadership teams.
* Ownership, resilience, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with confidence.



  





**What you will get:** 



* Be a part of a TATA enterprise that’s reshaping India’s Global Electronics Manufacturing story
* A seat at the table in shaping a future\-ready manufacturing powerhouse
* Build a plant, a culture and legacy, not just a function
* The chance to build a culture of trust, fairness, and inclusion while making a measurable business impact.
* Work alongside experienced business leaders and HR professionals on transformational initiatives.
* Freedom to experiment, build and grow
* An environment that values initiative, ownership, and people\-impact



  





**Important Considerations:** 



1. This role is based at the plant (factory). It follows a six\-day workweek and will be a 100% work from office role.
2. As the plant operates 24X7, flexibility
 **to work in A, B and C shifts** 
 on a daily basis is required
3. Prior experience of managing plant / shop floor workforce is preferred
4. Ability to communicate in English and Tamil is essential



  





**Contribution areas\- Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Culture and Engagement:** 



* Instill a values\-driven, high\-ownership culture. Create and drive programs that amplify the right intent and right behavior
* Craft engagement programs that connect head, heart and hands – whether on the shop floor or in the control room
* Organize participative employee platforms and communication vehicles that foster transparency, teamwork, and empowerment
* Act as a coach for the supervisory and managerial population to ensure people are lead with the right value system



  





**Employee Relations and Shopfloor presence:** 



* Build a key influencing presence among the shopfloor workers, supervisors, and representatives from different committees.
* Proactively flag any possible future IR issues early and work on proactive measures to fix them and maintain a harmonious climate
* Ensure high shop floor visibility and provide daily ER support to Operations Leaders
* Ensure complete compliance with labor laws, safety regulations and Tata Code of Conduct.



  





**Compliance and Statutory Readiness** 



* Support in the implementation of all labor law requirements (Factories act, CLRA, ESI, PF etc.)
* Prepare the necessary data, metrics and insights for client audits and represent the organization with the auditors
* Design and conduct vendor audits, ad\-hoc and planned inspections related to labor compliance, employee wellbeing as well as employee experience on all facilities provided (Like Canteen, transport, OHS, creche)
* Be in an anytime audit ready state by Creating and maintaining up to date all statutory registers, notices and reports



  





**HR Operations** 



* Track regular absenteeism, attrition, and engagement trends to generate real\-time insights and deploy proactive interventions
* Provide manpower planning support in alignment with planned incoming volumes
* Support the roll\-out of different HRMs systems for biometric attendance management, payroll integration, policies administration, manpower reports and daily dashboards
* Create, own and maintain cognitive dashboards for real\-time insights and tracking of trends proactively

**Change Management** 



* Design and execute structured change interventions – awareness campaigns, townhalls, pulse checks and feedback loops to reduce resistance and build readiness
* Partner with leadership to communicate change clearly and consistently ensuring psychological safety and clarity to the workforce
* Support mindset shifts among shopfloor and supervisory teams to embrace digital tools, lean practices, and performance ownership

 Conduct periodic policy\-awareness programmes.

 Ensure the HRMS contains complete and accurate employee information.
 



 Lead HR process automation and digitisation initiatives.

 Control access to confidential employee information.
 



 Conduct regular HRMS and employee\-file audits.
 



 Generate reliable HR data and reports for management decisions.
 



**Regional and Showroom HR Operations** 




 Guide Regional HR Managers and showroom HR representatives.
 



 Ensure HR policies and processes are followed consistently across all locations.
 



 Conduct periodic HR operational audits of regions and showrooms.
 



 Resolve escalated employee and manager queries.
 



 Support new\-showroom openings, employee transfers and workforce deployment.
 



**Employee Relations and Grievances** 




 Establish a structured employee grievance\-resolution process.
 



 Ensure employee complaints are acknowledged, investigated and closed within defined timelines.
 



 Support disciplinary enquiries and corrective\-action processes.
 



 Guide regional and functional managers in handling employee issues.
 



 Maintain confidentiality and fairness in all employee\-related matters.
 



 Coordinate with the Employee Relations or Legal team when necessary.
 



**Statutory Compliance and Audit Support** 




 Coordinate compliance relating to employment records, working hours, leave, notices and statutory registers.
 



 Work with the Compliance, Payroll and Legal teams on labour\-law requirements.
 



 Ensure timely closure of HR audit observations.
 



 Provide employee documents and records during internal, statutory and management audits.
 



 Monitor compliance requirements across different states.
 



**Separation and Full\-and\-Final Settlement** 




 Ensure resignations and terminations follow the approved process and delegation of authority.
 



 Monitor notice periods, handover, clearances and recovery of company assets.
 



 Coordinate timely full\-and\-final settlements with Payroll and Finance.

 Conduct exit interviews and analyse reasons for attrition.
 



 Recommend corrective action to improve employee retention.

 Analyse HR trends and highlight risks requiring management attention.
 



 Maintain a single, reliable source of employee data.

 Review team productivity and quality of work.

**Qualification and Experience** 




 MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification.
 



 Approximately 15–20 years of HR experience, including at least 5 years in a senior HR operations role.
 



 Experience in large retail, jewellery, FMCG or other multi\-location organisations is preferred.
 



 Strong knowledge of HR operations, HRMS, labour compliance, payroll coordination and employee relations.

description:

**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self\-expression, and human connection.** 
 Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one\-of\-a\-kind vintage and luxury.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and analytically driven
 **Senior Specialist II, HR Technology** 
 (Workday Techno\-functional consultant) to join our People team. In this role, you will serve as a senior subject matter expert at the intersection of HR systems and people analytics, helping to optimize our HR technology ecosystem while enabling data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
   

  

 While you will bring deep expertise in Workday HCM—our current HR platform—your value extends beyond any single tool. You are an HR technology and people analytics professional who can build scalable reporting and analytics solutions, support workforce planning through data\-driven insights, and translate complex workforce data into actionable recommendations for HR and business leaders. You contribute to the development of analytics frameworks and predictive analyses while helping ensure that our people data ecosystem remains scalable, reliable, and adaptable as technology evolves.
   

  

 You will partner closely with HR, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to enhance system capabilities, improve data quality, streamline processes, and deliver meaningful workforce insights that support organizational goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* People Analytics \& Workforce Insights
* Develop and maintain workforce dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports that support HR and business decision\-making.
* Analyze workforce trends across headcount, attrition, recruiting, diversity, performance, engagement, and employee lifecycle metrics.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and business leaders to understand reporting needs and provide actionable insights.
* Build and maintain data visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism Analytics, or equivalent platforms.
* Support workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives through data analysis and reporting.
* Contribute to the development of people analytics frameworks and predictive analyses that support talent and workforce decisions.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of workforce metrics by adhering to established reporting standards and governance practices.
* HR Systems Administration (Workday)
* Administer, configure, and maintain Workday HCM modules including Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Benefits, Time \& Absence, and Helpdesk.
* Configure and support business processes, workflows, notifications, security roles, and system controls in alignment with HR policies and operational requirements.
* Develop and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and composite reports.
* Support Workday biannual releases by assessing impacts, testing enhancements, and coordinating deployment activities.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues while ensuring timely communication and resolution for stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Operations and IT teams to continuously optimize system functionality, user experience, and process efficiency.
* HR Data Governance \& Quality
* Maintain high standards of HR data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across HR systems.
* Conduct regular audits and validation activities to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
* Support compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and applicable data privacy regulations.
* Document reporting definitions, system configurations, business processes, and operating procedures.
* Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of HR data governance standards and data quality processes.
* Support efforts to improve trust, transparency, and accessibility of people data across the organization.
* Systems Integration \& Technical Support
* Support integrations between Workday and connected systems including payroll, benefits, talent, learning, and finance platforms.
* Assist with data imports, exports, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) processes, and interface monitoring activities.
* Partner with IT teams and external vendors to troubleshoot integration issues and implement system enhancements.
* Participate in testing activities for integrations, system upgrades, new functionality, and process changes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, and knowledge base materials to support operational continuity.
* Process Optimization \& Stakeholder Enablement
* Identify opportunities to automate manual HR processes and improve operational efficiency through technology solutions.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable system configurations, reports, and process improvements.
* Serve as a trusted resource for HR technology questions, providing guidance and support to stakeholders across the organization.
* Deliver training, user documentation, and knowledge\-sharing sessions to improve system adoption and proficiency.
* Participate in HR technology projects, implementations, and continuous improvement initiatives from planning through execution.
* Build strong partnerships with HR, IT, Finance, and business teams to ensure technology solutions align with organizational needs.


**Qualifications**
**Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in HR Technology, HRIS, People Analytics, or related functions within complex and growing organizations.
* Hands\-on experience administering and configuring Workday HCM, including Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Benefits, Time \& Absence, and related modules.
* Proven experience developing HR reporting, dashboards, workforce analytics, and data\-driven insights that support business and talent decisions.
* Experience supporting HR system implementations, enhancements, testing, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience working with HR system integrations, data management processes, and vendor\-supported technology solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex projects and deliver technical solutions while effectively partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Analytics \& Technical Skills**
* Strong proficiency in Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and reporting capabilities.
* Experience with data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism Analytics, or equivalent tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret workforce data and communicate findings effectively.
* Working knowledge of SQL and data querying concepts; familiarity with Python or R is a plus.
* Understanding of system integration concepts including APIs, EIBs, SFTP, and data transformation processes.
* Knowledge of HR data structures, reporting methodologies, and data governance best practices.


**Domain \& Compliance Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of core HR processes and employee lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of compensation, recruiting, talent management, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness concepts.
* Understanding of HR data privacy, security, and compliance requirements including GDPR, CCPA, and applicable local regulations.
* Familiarity with global HR operations and governance practices is preferred.


**Soft Skills \& Ways Of Working**
* Strong customer\-service orientation with a commitment to delivering high\-quality stakeholder support.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language.
* Detail\-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy, data quality, and process discipline.
* Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative team player who builds productive partnerships across functions and levels.
* Demonstrates initiative, ownership, continuous learning, and a passion for process improvement.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In your first year, you will establish yourself as a trusted HR technology and people analytics partner across the organization. Stakeholders will rely on your expertise to deliver accurate workforce insights, maintain reliable HR systems, and identify opportunities for process improvement. Reporting capabilities will become more efficient and scalable, data quality will improve, and HR teams will have greater confidence in leveraging technology and analytics to make informed decisions. Through your contributions, the HR technology ecosystem will be better optimized, more user\-friendly, and well\-positioned to support the organization's growth and evolving business needs.
   

  

**A Note on Tooling**
 We currently use Workday as our primary HRIS, and deep Workday expertise is required for this role. However, we value professionals whose strengths extend beyond any single platform. Success in this role requires strong capabilities in HR technology, people analytics, workforce reporting, and process optimization that can adapt as systems and business needs evolve over time.

title: HR Partner - Oakridge International School - Gachibowli
description:
Oakridge Gachibowli is a premium international day school in India. We have the proud privilege of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. We have 150\+ IB\-trained teachers with years of experience, helping us consistently achieve outstanding results and seeing our students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is a leading premium day school in India, with more than 2800 students in full time enrollment. The school has a proud legacy of 22 years educational excellence and of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. The school has 150\+ IB\-trained teachers, enabling consistent outstanding results and inspire students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. The school serves Nursery through to high school (Grade 12\) students. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 The Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is partnered with the Nord Anglia Education family, the world’s leading premium international school organisation. They currently have 81 schools in India, China, Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and North, Central and South America. NAE are a fast growing, successful education company with over 50 years’ experience. The schools are amongst the most respected premium schools in their markets and are a very popular choice for parents.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a strategic role responsible for aligning HR practices with the school’s goals and educational mission. Acting as a trusted advisor to school leadership and faculty, the HRBP supports workforce planning, employee relations, talent management, performance development, and change management. The role ensures that HR initiatives promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing school culture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic HR Partnership:** 
 Collaborate with school leadership to understand staffing needs and workforce planning.Align HR strategies with academic and operational goals.Provide data\-driven insights to support decision\-making and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:** 
 Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and lead recruitment for teaching, administrative, and support staff.Ensure timely onboarding and orientation of new hires.Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring practices.
   

  

**Employee Relations \& Engagement:** 
 Foster a positive work environment through proactive engagement and support.Handle employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution in a fair and consistent manner.Develop and implement initiatives that support staff well\-being and retention.
   

  

**Performance Management \& Development:** 
 Support performance appraisal processes and goal\-setting practices.Collaborate with department heads to identify professional development needs.Guide leadership and staff on career development opportunities and succession planning.
   

  

**Compliance \& Policy Implementation:** 
 Ensure compliance with labor laws, school policies, and relevant educational regulations.Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date HR documentation and records.Lead internal audits and HR reporting as needed.
