title: People Director
description:
**About the Team**
 The India People team is establishing the people practices and employee experience that will support the launch and growth of our Hyderabad site. We partner closely with site leaders and employees to create effective teams, consistent leadership practices, and a healthy, sustainable workplace as the operation scales.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As the India People Business Partner, you will be a highly visible, hands\-on presence at the Hyderabad site, staying close to daily operations, leaders, and employees throughout the site's launch, growth, and stabilization. You will support employee engagement, manager effectiveness, organizational effectiveness, talent management, employee relations, workforce planning, and change management. You will coordinate two Human Resources Generalists and use people data to identify risks, improve day\-to\-day execution, and help shape the site's future people practices. You will report to the People Director on our EE People Ops \- HR Business Partner HRBP team in our HR organization.
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Night Shift —
 **5:00 PM–2:00 AM or 6:00 PM–3:00 AM**
**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
* Partner daily with site and functional leaders on team effectiveness, manager support, performance concerns, role clarity, workforce needs, and other people topics that emerge as the site scales.
* Support employee engagement, workplace culture, team health, and manager consistency while helping leaders and employees navigate new processes, changing structures, and operating model changes.
* Support team design, workforce planning, succession planning, talent cycles, and role clarity while identifying opportunities to improve the site's organizational effectiveness.
* Manage sensitive employee relations matters, support investigations and escalations, and promote consistent application of company policies and local labor requirements.
* Coordinate and prioritize the work of two Human Resources Generalists while partnering with the Senior Manager or Director on organizational decisions, talent priorities, escalations, and site\-level people risks.


**We're excited about you because…**
* You have 6\+ years of progressive experience in a People Business Partner, Human Resources Business Partner, or comparable role supporting business leaders and employees.
* You have experience providing hands\-on people support in a high\-growth, site\-based, operations\-focused, or multi\-shift environment.
* You have applied knowledge of employee relations, sensitive investigations, policy administration, and employment compliance in India.
* You have experience coaching managers and supporting organizational effectiveness, succession planning, talent processes, workforce planning, employee engagement, and organizational change.
* You are able to work fully onsite in Hyderabad during a night shift of either 5:00 p.m.–2:00 a.m. or 6:00 p.m.–3:00 a.m.


**About DoorDash**
 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
   

  

 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: People & Culture Lead
description:
**People \& Culture Lead** 




**Hyderabad, India · Reports to Strategy ·** 
**India operations with US entity coordination** 




  





 Own the People function as a true Global HRBP for a 500\+ person India operation supporting a US\-headquartered entity. This is a strategic business\-partnering role first, and an operational ownership role second: you'll sit close to Founders and Function Leads as their HR counterpart across two geographies, shaping org design, talent strategy and workforce decisions in real time — while also owning the full employee lifecycle end to end.
 **Prior experience operating as an HRBP across multiple countries (ideally India \+ US) is required** 
 — this is not a single\-market generalist role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Global HR Business Partnering (core of the role)** 




 Act as the primary HR partner to Founders and Function Leads across both the India and US contexts — understanding each business unit's goals and translating them into people strategy, org design, and workforce decisions. Advise on organisational design, role architecture, reporting structure and the levelling framework across two regulatory regimes and two talent markets. Bring a comparative lens: know how HR practices, employment norms and talent expectations differ between India and the US, and design policies/programmes that work coherently across both without defaulting to a single\-market template. Be the escalation point Founders and leaders turn to for judgment calls on people issues, not just process execution.
 



  





**Function ownership** 




 Own the P\&C agenda, roadmap and operating model globally. Own the organisational knowledge architecture \- SOPs, handbooks, lifecycle documentation and the knowledge directory \- and keep the documented record current and continuity\-proof across both entities.
 



  





**Talent acquisition** 




 Own hiring across technical and non\-technical roles in India, partnering with US\-side stakeholders on cross\-border hiring needs: requisition governance, pipeline health, interview frameworks and hiring manager enablement. Lead offer construction and closure for senior hires, with awareness of US compensation norms where relevant. Manage recruiting capacity including agency relationships.
 



  





**Compensation and equity** 




 Run the compensation cycle end to end \- benchmarking, band construction, moderation, approval and communication \- with fluency in both India and US market benchmarks. Administer the ESOP programme: grant recommendations, board cadence, documentation and employee communication.
 



  





**Benefits and people operations** 




 Design and roll out benefits including retirement schemes and insurance for the India population, while coordinating with US\-side HR/legal on benefits parity and obligations where applicable. Own payroll governance and vendor performance across employee and contractor populations, onboarding, leave and holiday framework, and HRIS data integrity and access governance.
 



  





**Performance and development** 




 Own the performance and goal\-setting cycle and its alignment to company objectives and board reporting, across both geographies. Design and facilitate manager and leadership development. Run recognition programmes tied to company values.
 



  





**Compliance and employee relations** 




 Hold accountability for statutory compliance across the India entity, including the Labour Codes and POSH, while coordinating closely with legal counsel and US HR/legal on US\-side employment obligations. Own worker classification policy and risk assessment across engagement models in both countries. Manage grievances and investigations, and operate separation processes for voluntary and business\-reason exits across both entities.
 



  





**Data and reporting** 




 Maintain headcount tracking, org charts and workforce data as the single source of truth across India and US populations. Prepare people data for board, investor and diligence requirements, and the analysis behind global headcount planning.
 



  





**Corporate transactions** 




 Support mergers, acquisitions and structural changes: people\-side due diligence, workforce mapping, retention planning, harmonisation of terms across jurisdictions, and post\-transaction integration. Prior M\&A experience is preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Required:** 
 Demonstrated HRBP experience, with direct exposure to managing HR across at least two countries — India and US experience specifically preferred.
* Strong grasp of comparative employment law/practice basics between India and the US (this role owns statutory compliance in India and coordinates US obligations, not the reverse).
* Comfort operating as a strategic partner to founders/leadership, not just a process owner.
* Prior M\&A / corporate transaction exposure preferred.

Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016\. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life\-till\-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android\-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
   

  

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Job Description**

* To ensure workforce requirements are in sync with annual operating plan and organization \& operating structure from a perspective of layers, spans, etc.

**Business Partnering:**
* Maintain strong individual connect and regular touch points with all employees from the assigned business groups
* Solve for front\-line attrition by doing attrition analysis and taking corrective action
* Regular visit to sales offices in the regions and interact with the employees.
* Attend sales review meetings and market visits
* Own and interpret HR policy for the organization and resolve issues quickly and effectively.


 Address all employee queries and provide help/ support within decided timelines
   

  

**Qualifications**
* MBA \- HR from Tier 1 campus with proven working experience of 1\-3 years
* Exposure to start up environment is an added advantage
* Understanding of HR concepts and evolving HR practices
* Strong on execution rigour for completing tasks with high ownership


**Additional Information**

We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. title: HR Operations Partner
description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait** 
 .
   

  





 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
   

  





 For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  





 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job summary**
  

 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic HR professional who can be a part of Vendor Operations Team Your responsibilities encompass strategic collaboration with stakeholders, overseeing HR metrics, and providing valuable insights for informed decision\-making. Additionally, you will drive talent actions, manage requisitions, and ensure accurate data management for HR processes.
   

  

  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**




 Experience in HR operations within shared services/similar GCC setup, with strong exposure to:
   

  





 End\-to\-end HR lifecycle processes (hire\-to\-retire)
   

  





 HR metrics, SLA governance, and reporting
   

  





 Stakeholder management across geographies
   

  





 Data accuracy, audit readiness, and compliance (GDPR/local regulations)
   

  





 Process standardization and continuous improvement.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification:** 
 Post Graduation in Management
   

  

  

  

**Minimum work Experience:** 
 7\-10 years of experience
   

  

  

  

  

  

**Technical Skills**



* Vendor Onboarding \& Lifecycle Management
* Contract Management \& Compliance
* Invoice Processing, Validation \& Reconciliation
* Vendor Performance Monitoring (SLA/KPI Management)
* Stakeholder Management, Reporting \& Governance
* Ability to create minimal and meaningful presentation to communicate your findings
* Good Experience of data crunching in Excel



  

  

**Behavioural Skills**
  

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 • Collaborative Skill sets and result oriented.
   

  

 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
   

  

 • Excellent Time Management and organisation skills

title: Workforce Management Lead
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 The WFM Team Lead – Scheduling \& Intraday leads the end\-to\-end tactical execution layer of Workforce Management, integrating schedule optimisation, weekly workforce steering, real\-time operational control, and incident response under a single, cohesive leadership structure.
   

  

 This role ensures that approved capacity strategies are translated into structurally sound, compliant schedules (0–30 day horizon), proactively adjusted through weekly tactical steering, and actively protected through disciplined intraday performance management.
   

  

 Beyond operational oversight, the role operates as the Workforce Command Center lead — providing governance, decision control, and service protection during both stable and volatile operating conditions. It ensures workforce decisions are data\-informed, risk\-quantified, and aligned to service, productivity, and cost objectives.
   

  

 As part of the WFM Centre of Excellence (CoE), the role is accountable for embedding standardised workforce governance, decision frameworks, incident protocols, and execution discipline across Scheduling and Intraday functions. It drives the transition from reactive workforce administration to structured, analytics\-driven workforce control at scale.
   

  

 This position closes the loop between Forecast → Capacity → Schedule → Intraday → Continuous Improvement, ensuring execution learnings systematically improve tactical and structural planning quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Capability Development
* Lead and develop Scheduling and Intraday WFM Specialists.
* Define clear accountability boundaries across tactical and real\-time scopes.
* Elevate analytical maturity beyond administrative execution.
* Coach team members in Scenario modelling, Workforce risk quantification, Structured incident response
* Build succession strength and capability depth.
* Foster a culture of data\-driven decision\-making and ownership.
* Tactical Planning \& Schedule Governance (0–30 Day Horizon)
* Own end\-to\-end schedule publication governance.
* Ensure schedules reflect approved capacity plans, are interval\-accurate and structurally optimised, comply with labour and contractual obligations
* Oversee scenario testing and trade\-off validation prior to release.
* Balance service protection with cost efficiency and schedule stability.
* Approve short\-term workforce interventions (OT, VTO, temporary uplift).
* Identify systemic schedule weaknesses before operational impact.
* Weekly Workforce Steering
* Lead weekly tactical workforce performance reviews.
* Identify structural and emerging risks across 1–3 week horizon.
* Drive proactive adjustments to reduce intraday volatility.
* Align closely with Forecasting and Capacity Planning on emerging shifts.
* Ensure continuous feedback loop from execution into planning assumptions.
* Intraday Performance \& Operational Control
* Oversee real\-time service level, occupancy, and productivity monitoring.
* Ensure structured and rapid deviation diagnosis.
* Guide stabilisation interventions to prevent performance oscillation.
* Maintain disciplined escalation protocols with Operations leadership.
* Safeguard service performance during peak volatility.
* Incident Management \& Command Center Leadership
* Act as the Workforce Command Center lead during operational disruption.
* Own structured workforce response to demand surges, high absenteeism events, system/tool outages, service\-level degradation
* Quantify operational risk exposure and recovery timelines.
* Coordinate cross\-functional workforce interventions.
* Ensure incidents are managed through defined protocols, not reactive decisions.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and embed systemic improvements.
* WFM CoE Governance \& Standardisation
* Enforce WFM execution standards across Scheduling and Intraday.
* Drive adoption of workforce governance frameworks, incident playbooks, tactical review cadences, decision documentation standards
* Reduce dependency on ad hoc, spreadsheet\-driven processes.
* Strengthen system\-based optimisation and automation.
* Ensure auditability, reproducibility, and structural integrity of workforce decisions.
* Contribute to maturity uplift of the WFM operating model.
* Continuous Improvement \& Execution Excellence
* Identify recurring volatility drivers.
* Improve shrinkage modelling and break optimisation logic.
* Increase automation and reporting maturity.
* Reduce emergency interventions and reactive staffing.
* Improve alignment between planning accuracy and operational execution.


**Qualifications**
 You are passionate about leading people, building teams, and making a difference in your work, while also having a strong understanding of operational teams and processes. You have experience working across global teams, across different functions and you understand how to communicate cross\-culturally. You get it done. You can identify and resolve issues independently, taking initiative even under unfamiliar or ambiguous circumstances. You’ve worked with BI tools before like Looker etc. and your Excel/Spreadsheets skills are advanced! SQL and Python skills are a plus.
   

  

* Experience as a people lead: At least 3 years of experience leading teams and 2 years in a Workforce Management role.
* Independent problem solver: Ability to identify and resolve issues independently, even in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations.
* Self\-starter: Proven track record of taking ownership and creatively solving problems, while improving efficiency.
* Strong understanding of WFM: Knowledgeable in forecasting and different forecasting models, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time management.
* Strong relationships with stakeholders: Ability to connect and maintain relationships with various internal teams.
* Strategic and data\-driven: Ability to think strategically, translate strategy into operational plans, and analyse and interpret data.
* Process Expert: Lean Six Sigma experience to green\-belt level, understanding how to formally document processes, automate, improve efficiency, and reduce waste and cycle times across WFM practices


 Additional Information

This is a high\-impact leadership role for a culture\-first people leader who embodies Insight Global’s Shared Values and can build a high performing team. At Insight Global, we don’t recruit like everyone else, and we don’t want to. The right person for this role will think creatively, challenge traditional campus hiring approaches, and help redefine what great recruiting looks like at scale.
 



  





 RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across priority hiring needs for the Hyderabad delivery center as well as campus hiring strategy. Ensure strong alignment to business demand, hiring quality, and speed across technical, delivery, solutions, and fresh graduates across sales/recruiting.

Provide market insights, talent trends, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.

Experience hiring across technical (IT), Solutions, or Delivery\-based roles, non\-IT with an emphasis Sales/Recruiting roles preferred.

* Creative, solutions\-oriented mindset with a history of bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches

title: Director of People & Culture – Fairmont Mumbai & Roswyn, A Morgans Originals Hotel
description:
**Company Description**
**Fairmont Mumbai**
 Fairmont Hotels \& Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. Famous for its engaging service, awe\-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. Fairmont is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group counting over 5,400 properties throughout more than 110 countries, and a participating brand in ALL \- Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences.
   

  

**Roswyn, a Morgans Originals Hotel**
 Morgans Originals are original hotels with original stories. We stand for vibrancy, intrigue and iconic details, celebrating the feeling of an infinite Friday night, when anything can happen, no matter what day of the week it is. By balancing a refined outlook with the best lifestyle programming, we capture the excitement of being in\-the\-know \-\- connecting people to the city, the culture and the moment.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Director of People \& Culture is responsible for the overall leadership and management of the People \& Culture function across both properties. The role ensures effective implementation of HR strategies, policies, and procedures in line with
 **Accor standards** 
 , while supporting business objectives and fostering a high\-performance culture.
   

  

 The incumbent will act as a strategic partner to the General Manager and Executive Committee, driving employee engagement, talent development, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Management
* Develop and implement the People \& Culture strategy in alignment with business objectives and Accor guidelines.
* Provide strategic HR support to the Executive Committee.
* Drive organizational development, workforce planning, and change management initiatives.
* Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
* Oversee recruitment and selection processes to ensure timely hiring of qualified candidates.
* Ensure adherence to approved manning budgets and organizational structure.
* Promote employer branding initiatives in line with Accor standards.
* Learning \& Development
* Implement training plans and development programs in line with Accor learning frameworks.
* Monitor training effectiveness and ensure compliance with mandatory training requirements.
* Identify high\-potential employees and support succession planning.
* Performance Management
* Ensure effective implementation of the performance management system.
* Support department heads in goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning.
* Promote a performance\-driven culture with clear accountability.
* Employee Engagement \& Welfare
* Drive employee engagement initiatives to enhance satisfaction and retention.
* Ensure effective communication channels across all levels of the organization.
* Oversee employee welfare activities in line with company policies.
* Compensation \& Benefits
* Ensure proper administration of payroll, benefits, and statutory compliance.
* Maintain internal equity and external competitiveness of compensation structures.
* Monitor labor costs in line with budget guidelines.
* Employee Relations \& Compliance
* Manage employee relations issues, including grievances and disciplinary matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and Accor policies.
* Maintain positive relations with external authorities and stakeholders where required.
* HR Operations \& Administration
* Oversee HR administration, documentation, and record management.
* Ensure compliance with internal audits and corporate reporting requirements.
* Maintain HR systems and ensure data accuracy.
* Culture \& Brand Alignment
* Ensure implementation of Accor values and Heartist® culture across both properties.
* Support the integration of brand standards for Fairmont and Morgans Originals into daily operations.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, respect, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Hospitality Management, or related field.
* Minimum 10–15 years of experience in Human Resources, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role.
* Experience in hospitality, preferably within luxury or lifestyle segments.
* Knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory requirements is essential.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Competencies**
* Leadership and Team Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Communication and Interpersonal Skills
* Problem Solving and Decision Making
* Knowledge of HR Practices and Labor Laws
* Change Management

**Experience \-** 
 5\-6\+ Years

**Role Overview**
 The Client Servicing professional will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day relationships with clients, ensuring smooth manpower deployment and operations, and coordinating with internal recruitment, HR, payroll and compliance teams to deliver agreed staffing services effectively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage day\-to\-day communication and relationship with assigned clients.
* Understand client manpower requirements and coordinate with recruitment teams for timely deployment.
* Ensure joining, onboarding, documentation and induction of deployed manpower.
* Monitor attendance, absenteeism, attrition and manpower productivity.
* Coordinate with clients for attendance validation, overtime, incentives and other payroll inputs.

* Track replacements, new manpower requirements and employee exits.

* Follow up on client approvals, work orders/POs, invoices and payment\-related issues wherever required.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend corrective actions to improve service quality.
* Maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders and identify opportunities for business expansion.
* Ensure adherence to agreed SLA/KPI and service\-level commitments.
* Escalate critical operational issues to senior management with a proposed action plan.
* Manage and collect client payments.
* Agreement renewal \& negotiations

* Excellent client communication and relationship\-management skills
* Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities
* Good understanding of staffing/manpower operations
* Knowledge of payroll and statutory compliance
* MIS and Excel proficiency
* Problem\-solving and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage multiple clients and priorities
* Willingness to travel for client visits

title: Fleet Personnel Officer
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Fleet Personnel Officer provides comprehensive communication, project coordination, executive and administrative support to the Head of Fleet Personnel. The role is responsible for managing high\-volume correspondence, coordinating departmental projects, monitoring actions and deliverables, and supporting the effective functioning of the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
   

  

 The position also supports departmental reporting, governance, seafarer welfare initiatives, union and CBA administration, forums, travel and selected operational matters. It requires a high degree of discretion, sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to remain responsive while coordinating with senior leaders, Fleet Personnel teams, vessels, seafarers, manning partners, unions, vendors and other stakeholders across different time zones.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Email, Communication and Correspondence Management: 20%
* Manage and organise the Head of Fleet Personnel’s high\-volume email correspondence, ensuring messages are reviewed, prioritised and directed appropriately.
* Identify matters requiring immediate attention, follow\-up, delegation or escalation, and maintain visibility of pending responses and commitments.
* Draft, proofread and coordinate emails, letters, memos, presentations and other communications on behalf of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Prepare standard departmental letters, invitation letters, confirmations and authorisation documents, and maintain appropriate records.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain timely inputs and ensure correspondence is closed out accurately and professionally.
* Handle confidential, sensitive and privileged information with discretion.
* Project Coordination and Action Management: 20%
* Coordinate Fleet Personnel projects and improvement initiatives by maintaining project plans, milestones, actions, risks, decisions and deliverables.
* Proactively follow up with responsible stakeholders, identify potential delays and provide concise progress updates to the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Coordinate user inputs, testing, communications and implementation follow\-up for Fleet Personnel systems and digitalisation initiatives, including COMPAS and related crew\-management processes.
* Support the preparation of project briefs, presentations, status reports, process guidance, memos and rollout communications.
* Liaise with IT, Finance, HR, Training, regional teams and other functions to resolve dependencies and support timely delivery.
* Remain responsive to urgent project requirements and changing priorities arising from Seaspan’s global operations.
* Meetings, Minutes and Follow\-up Coordination: 10%
* Coordinate meeting logistics and prepare agendas, briefing notes and supporting materials for departmental, management and external stakeholder meetings.
* Record and circulate clear minutes of meetings and maintain action trackers with owners and target dates.
* Follow up on overdue actions and provide the Head of Fleet Personnel with timely updates on progress and outstanding matters.
* Coordinate the Fleet Personnel weekly meeting agenda and consolidate inputs from departmental and regional teams.
* Support meetings across time zones when operationally required.
* Reporting, Dashboards and Management Information: 10%
* Prepare and maintain periodic reports, dashboards, management information and KPI trackers for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Gather and consolidate information from Fleet Personnel teams and company systems into structured summaries for leadership review.
* Support monthly management reporting, budget coordination, variance commentary and ad hoc analysis.
* Maintain accurate records of departmental actions, incidents, recognition, policy exceptions and other agreed metrics.
* Work accurately under tight timelines while managing multiple reporting requirements concurrently.
* CBA, Wage Scale, Vessel Data and Union Coordination: 10%
* Maintain trackers for Collective Bargaining Agreement renewals, vessel enrolments, correspondence and supporting documentation.
* Maintain controlled vessel and CBA data, including business unit, shipowner, flag, complement and applicable wage arrangements.
* Support the preparation, issue and recordkeeping of approved wage scales and related Fleet Personnel memoranda.
* Coordinate routine documentation and follow\-up with unions, manning partners and internal stakeholders under the guidance of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Compliance, Audit and Document Control: 8%
* Support ISO, RPSL and other Fleet Personnel audit preparations, including document collection, tracker maintenance and closure of agreed actions.
* Assist with updates to departmental manuals, procedures, records and controlled documents.
* Maintain organised and secure digital and physical filing systems for the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
* Ensure records are complete, current, readily retrievable and handled in accordance with company confidentiality and data\-protection requirements.
* Seafarer Welfare, Insurance and Recognition Programmes: 7%
* Coordinate administrative aspects of seafarer medical and life\-insurance programmes, including data updates, supporting documentation and follow\-up with service providers.
* Support humanitarian\-aid and other urgent seafarer welfare arrangements as directed.
* Administer long\-service and loyalty\-recognition programmes, including eligibility records, approved awards, procurement coordination and event logistics.
* Maintain accurate records of recognition items and ensure expenditure remains within approved budgets and processes.
* Forums, Town Halls and Stakeholder Events: 5%
* Support the planning and execution of seafarer forums, vessel town halls, leadership visits, conferences, seminars, roadshows and sponsorship activities.
* Coordinate participant lists, invitations, venues, suppliers, presentation materials, awards and event budgets.
* Liaise with regional offices, vessels, manning partners and internal functions to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
* Maintain event plans, cost trackers, records and post\-event actions.
* Calendar and Travel Coordination: 5%
* Manage the Head of Fleet Personnel’s calendar, including scheduling, prioritising and resolving conflicts across internal and external meetings.
* Anticipate scheduling requirements and ensure adequate preparation time for leadership meetings, operational reviews and external engagements.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodation, visas, invitation and coverage letters, ground transport and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and reconcile travel and business expenses through the applicable company expense\-management system.
* Provide timely support when travel arrangements or meeting schedules change outside standard office hours.
* General Departmental and Administrative Support: 5%
* Support vendor onboarding, invoice documentation, purchase coordination and routine departmental administration in accordance with approved processes.
* Coordinate office, equipment and logistical requirements for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Respond to routine stakeholder enquiries or direct them to the appropriate responsible person.
* Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Head of Fleet Personnel in support of departmental priorities.


**Technical Skills**
**Key Skills and Capabilities**
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Strong email organisation, correspondence tracking and action\-management capability.
* Ability to prepare professional correspondence, presentations, reports, dashboards, project plans and structured trackers.
* Strong digital and physical document\-management skills.
* Experience with enterprise systems such as COMPAS or other crew\-management systems, NetSuite, Certify, Concur, SharePoint or similar platforms would be an advantage.
* Ability to work accurately with operational, financial and personnel data.


**Professional Skills**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, integrity and professional judgement.
* Strong project coordination, planning, organisation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate requirements and manage a high volume of competing priorities.
* Strong attention to detail, responsiveness and consistent follow\-through.
* Ability to engage confidently and respectfully with senior executives, seafarers, vessel teams, unions, manning partners, vendors and colleagues across cultures and time zones.
* Calm, dependable and solution\-oriented approach, particularly when handling urgent or sensitive matters.
* Resilience and the ability to maintain accuracy and professionalism in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity environment.


**Professional Experience And Education**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Human Resources, Maritime Studies or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* At least five years of relevant experience in Fleet Personnel coordination, project coordination, executive support or senior administration, preferably supporting senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-volume email correspondence, multiple projects and concurrent deadlines in a demanding work environment.
* Experience in the maritime, ship\-management, crewing or logistics sector is preferred.
* Prior exposure to seafarer administration, CBA or union coordination, audit support, management reporting, travel, insurance, employee events or welfare programmes would be an advantage.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to commit to a high\-intensity and high\-volume work environment, supported by prior experience in a role requiring sustained responsiveness and effective prioritisation.
* Availability on a 24/7 basis, when operationally necessary, to support meetings or urgent matters outside standard office hours due to Seaspan’s global operations.
* Flexibility to coordinate with stakeholders across international time zones and respond promptly to changing operational priorities.
* Ability to travel occasionally when required for Fleet Personnel forums, events or leadership support.
* Demonstrated commitment to Seaspan’s values, safety culture, confidentiality requirements and standards of professional conduct.


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

title: Talent Development Adviser
description:
**Mott MacDonald** 
 is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
   

  

 We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
   

  

 We are proud to be part of an ever\-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee\-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
   

  

 Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
 **brilliant** 
 .
   

  

**Role**
 The role is responsible for independently managing end‑to‑end Talent Development processes across India. This includes training coordination, stakeholder engagement, content support, performance management cycles (Connected Conversations), talent review processes, learning systems administration, reporting and communication management.
   

  

 This position ensures seamless delivery of all talent development initiatives across the business, working closely with stakeholders, SMEs, global teams and external partners.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning Needs \& Stakeholder Engagement** 
  

* 
+ Engage with business stakeholders to understand functional needs and recommend Unit/Function‑specific training and development plans.
+ Support the identification of skill gaps, learning needs and interventions required at an operational level.


**Learning Program Management** 
  

* 
+ Independently plan, schedule and coordinate all learning events and capability‑building programmes.
+ Work with internal SMEs and external partners to scope, design, create and adapt training content.
+ Manage end‑to\-end logistics, communication, attendance, and completion follow‑ups for all training initiatives.


**Learning Systems \& Content Administration** 
  

* 
+ Act as the single point of contact for learning systems including Connected Learning, LinkedIn Learning, other LMS platforms, induction/training resources, and course catalogues.
+ Upload, maintain and monitor training content, learner assignments, completions, and reporting accuracy.
+ Maintain and periodically update induction material, learning pathways, and guidance resources.


**Learning Communication \& Knowledge Management** 
  

* 
+ Independently manage all L\&D communication channels including SharePoint pages, Compass pages, newsletters and learning campaign messaging.
+ Ensure content is updated, user‑friendly, and promotes high employee engagement.


**Performance Management (Connected Conversations)** 
  

* 
+ Manage the entire Connected Conversations cycle including communication rollout, training and awareness sessions, query resolution, monitoring completion and facilitating escalations.
+ Track progress and ensure timely closure of the performance management process across India.


**Talent Review \& Calibration Support** 
  

* 
+ Drive the annual Talent Review and Calibration process by coordinating schedules, collecting data, maintaining templates, and supporting facilitation.
+ Partner with the Talent Development Business Partner to ensure smooth execution and documentation.


**Global \& Group Development Programmes** 
  

* 
+ Facilitate the nomination and selection process for Group/Global development programmes for India.
+ Support implementation and communication of Group programmes and contribute inputs as required.


**Data, Reporting \& Insights** 
  

* 
+ Prepare periodic and on‑demand reports on training effectiveness, feedback, training hours, nominations, and completion metrics.
+ Analyse L\&D budget utilisation vs spend and highlight variances.
+ Provide insights to continuously improve the learning experience.


**Continuous Improvement** 
  

* 
+ Contribute to the development and updating of L\&D processes, policies, frameworks, and resources.
+ Recommend innovative tools, methodologies, and technologies to enhance learning delivery and impact.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong coordination and project management
* Excellent communication (written and verbal)
* Stakeholder management
* Learning system/LMS administration (SAP Success Factors and Articulate Rise is preferred)
* Content curation and basic design capability
* Data analysis and reporting
* High attention to detail and ownership
* Ability to manage multiple tasks independently
* Digital mindset and tech savviness


**Educational \& Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in HR; certification in L\&D or OD is an advantage.
* 5–7 years of experience in Learning \& Development
* Hands‑on exposure to LMS, performance management systems, or content coordination preferred.


**Flexible working**
 At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work\-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
   

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**
* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long\-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing


**Employment Compliance Requirement**
 As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
   

  

**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
 By applying, you
 **confirm** 
 that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.
   

  

 Location(s):
   

  

 Mumbai, MH, IN Noida, UP, IN
   

  

 Contract Type: Permanent
   

  

 Work Pattern: Full Time
   

  

 Market: Various
   

  

 Discipline: Human resources and talent acquisition
   

  

 Job Ref: 16446
   

  

 Recruiter Contact: Ravi Naagar

title: HR Associate
description:
**1\) Job Purpose:** 




 To support the design, governance, and execution of Organizational Effectiveness (OE) and Employee Relations initiatives across the organization. * Support preparation of annual reports, MIS, and compliance submissions.
* Ensure confidentiality and integrity of all case\-related information.



**Employee Relations Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Develop and maintain dashboards for Value Violation and POSH cases.
* Prepare periodic governance reports for leadership review.
* Track case closure TAT and adherence to established protocols.



**Organizational Effectiveness Projects** 



* Support execution of OE initiatives across businesses and functions.



**Employee Engagement \& Culture Initiatives** 



* Support administration of engagement surveys and diagnostic studies.



**Stakeholder Management \& Project Coordination** 



* Coordinate with HRBPs, Corporate HR, business leaders, legal teams, and external partners.
* Facilitate meetings, reviews, and governance forums.
* Ensure timely completion of deliverables and action items.
* Build collaborative relationships across businesses and functions.

**Business \& Personal Effectiveness** 



* Accountability and Ownership

* Result Orientation

* Execution Excellence
* Learning Agility
* Composure under Pressure



**Interpersonal Effectiveness** 



* Stakeholder Management
* Conflict Management

* Professional Communication



**Thinking Effectiveness** 



* Process Orientation
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

title: Vice President - HR Technology Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Vice President \- HR Technology Specialist
   

  

**Department** 
 : Human Resources
   

  

**Position Purpose**
**HR Technology Specialist** 
 evangelizes digital HR across hire to retire lifecycle. This role bridges HR processes with technology, focusing on data integrity, reporting, and integrations. This specialist drives process optimization, onboard and enhance platforms to support seamless operations. Perfect for professional with a passion for AI and tech driven HR solutions and user\-centric design.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Create process maps and experience maps across employee and manager hire to retire lifecycle
* Collaborate with CoEs, delivery teams and key stakeholders to identify opportunities and solve for user experience gaps, aligned with business goals.
* Map business requirements to technical solutions and automate workflows (e.g., onboarding, performance reviews)
* Create and maintain a roadmap, prioritize development, define requirements and finalize design, working with engineering and other relevant stakeholders
* Partner with technology on product selection, configuration, troubleshooting, and user support.
* Manage system integrations, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with applicable regulations (e.g., EPF, ESI).
* Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) for system upgrades, patches, and new features.
* Analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend enhancements for scalability and security.


 Provide training and documentation to end\-users, fostering self\-service adoption.
   

  

**Specific Qualifications**
* 
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or at least 10 years of experience in HR technology or IT support within HR contexts.
* Proficiency in HR systems such as Oracle HCM, Avature etc.
* Knowledge of HR processes, data privacy (GDPR/DPDP Act), and agile methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with excellent communication for cross\-functional teams.


**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**Job description:** 




**Job Description: HR Executive** 




**Location: Andheri East** 




  





**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Website Link: https://realatte.com / https://logicloop.io/** 




  





**Position Summary:** 




  





 The HR Executive at Realatte Ventures will play a critical role in building the company’s talent pool by managing the full recruitment life cycle. You will be responsible for identifying and attracting top talent, managing candidate relationships, and working closely with hiring managers to meet the company’s staffing needs. This role requires a strategic mindset, excellent communication skills, and a passion for finding the best fit for every role.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Full\-Cycle Recruitment: Manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes for various roles within the company, from entry\-level to senior positions.



  




* Talent Sourcing: Use diverse channels such as job boards, social media, networking events, and recruitment agencies to identify potential candidates.



  




* Screening and Interviewing: Conduct initial screening calls, schedule interviews, and coordinate assessments to evaluate candidates’ skills, experience, and cultural fit.



  




* Collaboration with Hiring Managers: Work closely with department heads and hiring managers to understand staffing needs and ensure alignment with business goals.



  




* Candidate Experience: Ensure a smooth and positive experience for all candidates throughout the recruitment process, maintaining timely communication and providing feedback.



  




* Offer Management: Extend job offers, negotiate salaries, and finalize terms of employment with selected candidates.



  




* Recruitment Metrics: Track and report on recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, and quality of hire to evaluate recruitment effectiveness.



  




* Employer Branding: Assist in developing strategies for promoting the company's employer brand and enhancing the candidate pipeline.



  




* Onboarding: Collaborate with HR and other departments to ensure successful onboarding of new hires.



  




* Recruitment Strategies: Stay updated on industry trends and continuously improve recruitment processes and strategies to attract top talent.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment strategies, techniques, and best practices.
* Experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple recruitment projects simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge of employment laws and regulations related to hiring and recruitment.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR INTERN
 



  





 \*Company:\* Trance Interiors LLP
 



 \*Department:\* Human Resources
 



 \*Position:\* HR Intern
 



 \*Location:\* Thane West, Mumbai
 



 \*Employment Type:\* Internship
 



 \*Reporting To:\* HR Executive / HR Manager
 



  





  





  





  1\. JOB PURPOSE
 



  





 The HR Intern will support the HR Department in day\-to\-day HR operations, recruitment, employee coordination, documentation, attendance management, onboarding, employee engagement, and HR process development.
 



  





 The intern will gain practical exposure to various HR functions while assisting the HR team in maintaining an organized, professional, and employee\-friendly workplace.
 



  





  





  





  2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





  A. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 



  





 \* Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, social media, references, and other recruitment channels.
 



 \* Screen CVs and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate with candidates regarding interview schedules.
 



 \* Conduct initial communication with candidates.
 



 \* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Follow up with candidates regarding interview attendance and joining status.
 



 \* Coordinate interview schedules with the concerned department heads.
 



 \* Maintain records of shortlisted, rejected, selected, and joined candidates.
 



 \* Assist in preparing offer letters, appointment letters, internship letters, and other HR documents.
 



  





 B. Employee Onboarding
 



  





 \* Coordinate the joining process for new employees.
 



 \* Collect and verify required employee documents.
 



 \* Maintain employee personal and employment records.
 



 \* Assist in preparing joining forms and onboarding checklists.
 



 \* Coordinate introduction of new employees to the team.
 



 \* Assist in induction and orientation programs.
 



 \* Ensure new employees are added to relevant communication groups and HR systems.
 



 \* Maintain proper onboarding documentation.
 



  





  C. Attendance \& Leave Management
 



  





 \* Maintain daily employee attendance records.
 



 \* Monitor late coming, absenteeism, leave, and early departures.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining leave records.
 



 \* Follow up with employees regarding attendance irregularities.
 



 \* Prepare attendance reports for HR review.
 



 \* Assist in monthly attendance reconciliation.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees and reporting managers regarding attendance\-related queries.
 



  





  D. Employee Records \& HR Documentation
 



  





 \* Maintain updated employee master data.
 



 \* Organize employee files and documentation.
 



 \* Maintain records of Aadhaar, PAN, educational documents, experience letters, bank details, photographs, and other required documents.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining employee joining and exit records.
 



 \* Ensure HR documents are properly filed and updated.
 



 \* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
 



  





  E. HR Operations
 



  





 \* Assist with daily HR administrative activities.
 



 \* Prepare HR reports, trackers, and MIS.
 



 \* Maintain recruitment and employee databases.
 



 \* Assist in preparing HR communications and notices.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees and department heads for HR\-related requirements.
 



 \* Support implementation of HR policies and procedures.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining HR calendars and employee\-related schedules.
 



  





  F. Employee Engagement
 



  





 \* Assist in organizing employee engagement activities.
 



 \* Coordinate birthday celebrations, employee events, festivals, and team activities.
 



 \* Support Employee of the Month initiatives.
 



 \* Collect employee feedback where required.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining employee engagement records.
 



 \* Support initiatives to improve employee communication and workplace culture.
 



  





  G. Performance Management \& HRIS
 



  





 \* Assist in maintaining employee performance records.
 



 \* Support the HR team in collecting performance feedback from reporting managers.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining KPI and performance assessment records.
 



 \* Support the implementation of the company's HRIS / Performance Management System.
 



 \* Assist in updating employee information and HR data in the company application.
 



 \* Help maintain performance review trackers and reports.
 



 \* Support Employee of the Month evaluation processes.
 



  





  H. Learning \& Development
 



  





 \* Assist in identifying employee training requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate training sessions and workshops.
 



 \* Maintain training attendance and participation records.
 



 \* Collect employee feedback after training programs.
 



 \* Assist in preparing training calendars.
 



 \* Maintain Learning \& Development documentation.
 



  





  I. Employee Communication
 



  





 \* Draft and circulate HR\-related communications.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees through email and WhatsApp groups when required.
 



 \* Communicate interview schedules, joining instructions, HR notices, and internal announcements.
 



 \* Maintain professional communication with candidates and employees.
 



 \* Assist in resolving basic employee queries and escalate complex matters to the HR Manager.
 



  





  J. Exit \& Separation Support
 



  





 \* Assist in the employee resignation and exit process.
 



 \* Maintain resignation and exit documentation.
 



 \* Coordinate exit formalities and clearance requirements.
 



 \* Assist in collecting exit feedback.
 



 \* Update employee records after separation.
 



 \* Coordinate with relevant departments for exit\-related documentation.
 



  





  





  





  3\. DAILY HR ACTIVITIES
 



  





 The HR Intern may be responsible for:
 



  





 \* Checking attendance and leave records.
 



 \* Following up with candidates.
 



 \* Scheduling interviews.
 



 \* Updating recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Maintaining employee records.
 



 \* Coordinating with employees and reporting managers.
 



 \* Updating HRIS / HR application data.
 



 \* Preparing HR reports and documents.
 



 \* Supporting ongoing HR activities.
 



 \* Handling routine HR coordination and administrative work.
 



  





  





  





  4\. SKILLS REQUIRED
 



  





  Technical Skills
 



  





 \* Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets.
 



 \* Basic knowledge of MS Word.
 



 \* Good email drafting skills.
 



 \* Basic understanding of recruitment processes.
 



 \* Ability to maintain trackers and databases.
 



 \* Basic understanding of HR functions.
 



 \* Willingness to learn HRIS and HR technology.
 



  





  Soft Skills
 



  





 \* Good verbal and written communication.
 



 \* Professional attitude.
 



 \* Good interpersonal skills.
 



 \* Ability to coordinate with multiple people.
 



 \* Attention to detail.
 



 \* Good organizational skills.
 



 \* Time management.
 



 \* Follow\-up skills.
 



 \* Positive and learning\-oriented attitude.
 



 \* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
 



  





  





  5\. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION
 



  





 \* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Commerce, or a related field.
 



 \* Students pursuing BBA / BMS / MBA / PGDM in HR may also be considered.
 



 \* Freshers are welcome to apply.
 



  





  





  6\. EXPERIENCE
 



  





 \*Experience:\* 0–1 year
 



  





 Freshers and candidates looking to gain practical exposure in Human Resources are encouraged to apply.
 



  





  





  7\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)
 



  





 The HR Intern's performance may be evaluated on:
 



  





 1\. Recruitment coordination and follow\-up.
 



 2\. Interview scheduling accuracy.
 



 3\. Candidate database maintenance.
 



 4\. Employee documentation accuracy.
 



 5\. Attendance and leave record accuracy.
 



 6\. Timely completion of HR tasks.
 



 7\. Employee communication and coordination.
 



 8\. HRIS data accuracy and updates.
 



 9\. Support provided for onboarding and induction.
 



 10\. Support for employee engagement activities.
 



 11\. Report and tracker maintenance.
 



 12\. Discipline, punctuality, and attendance.
 



 13\. Confidentiality and professionalism.
 



 14\. Ability to meet assigned deadlines.
 



 15\. Learning ability and initiative.
 



  





  





  8\. CAREER DEVELOPMENT / LEARNING AREAS
 



  





 During the internship, the HR Intern will receive practical exposure to:
 



  





 \* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 



 \* Interview Coordination
 



 \* Employee Onboarding
 



 \* HR Documentation
 



 \* Attendance \& Leave Management
 



 \* Employee Engagement
 



 \* HR Operations
 



 \* HRIS
 



 \* Performance Management
 



 \* KPI Management
 



 \* Learning \& Development
 



 \* Employee Relations
 



 \* HR Policies \& Procedures
 



 \* HR MIS \& Reporting
 



 \* Exit \& Separation Process
 



  





  





  9\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
 



  





 The candidate should demonstrate:
 



  





 \* Professionalism
 



 \* Discipline
 



 \* Punctuality
 



 \* Ownership of assigned responsibilities
 



 \* Confidentiality
 



 \* Positive attitude
 



 \* Willingness to learn
 



 \* Accountability
 



 \* Good follow\-up
 



 \* Teamwork
 



 \* Adaptability
 



  





  





 10\. WORKING HOURS
 



  





 \*Working Hours:\* 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM
 



 \*Working Days:\* Monday to Saturday
 



  





 The employee/intern may be required to support urgent HR activities or business requirements outside normal working hours when reasonably required.
 



  





  





  11\. REPORTING \& COORDINATION
 



  





 The HR Intern will report to the \*HR Executive / HR Manager\* and will coordinate with:
 



  





 \* Management
 



 \* Department Heads
 



 \* Project Managers
 



 \* Site Supervisors
 



 \* Finance \& Accounts
 



 \* Administration
 



 \* Employees
 



 \* Job Candidates

 Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. title: Senior HR Generalist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 The Human Resources function partners with business leaders to align people strategies with business priorities across Medtronic operations in India and subcontinents. This role supports multiple business units and collaborates closely with commercial and leadership teams to drive organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership development, succession planning, and change initiatives that enable sustainable business growth.
   

  

 This position is based in Gurgaon, India, with Mumbai as an alternate location. The role operates under a Flex work arrangement.
   

  

 The Senior HR Generalist serves as a strategic Human Resources partner to business leaders across India and subcontinent region. The role focuses on translating business priorities into people strategies, advising leaders on talent and organisational matters, and supporting business transformation, growth initiatives, and workforce effectiveness. The successful candidate will work closely with leadership teams to enhance organisational performance and leadership capability while fostering a high\-performing and agile workforce.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
* Partner with business leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business objectives and growth priorities.
* Advise leaders on organisational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent management initiatives.
* Coach leaders on employee engagement, performance management, change management, and leadership effectiveness.
* Analyse business performance indicators and workforce trends to inform strategic people decisions.
* Collaborate with Human Resources Centres of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and Learning and Development, to deliver integrated talent solutions.
* Support organisational transformation initiatives and guide leaders through periods of change and ambiguity.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influence decision\-making through business insight and human resources expertise.
* Ensure consistent application of people practices and policies across multiple countries and business units.


**Required Knowledge and Experience:**
* 5\+ years of HR Business Partnering / Generalist experience, partnering with business leaders in a fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Candidates from premier institutes may be considered with 3\+ years of relevant experience.
