title: Head - People Success
description:
**Head \- People Success** 




**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Bhopal (Remote today; office\-based once our India office opens)
 



**Experience:** 
 15\+ YOE in human resources, including proven global team building
 



**Reports to:** 
 President, India
 



**Manages:** 
 People Success function across India and the United States
 



  





**About Sutra.AI** 




 Sutra.AI is a complete 'Data to Value' AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose\-built for mid\-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent\-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Head \- People Success is the single point of accountability for talent acquisition, org design, performance, total rewards, engagement, culture, people operations and statutory compliance across all geographies in which Sutra.AI operates.
 



 The role partners directly with the President (India), the founder and functional heads on structure, hiring sequence and workforce spend. It is expected to challenge those decisions with evidence, not to implement them unquestioned.
 



**Base Location should be Delhi NCR / Bhopal.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 




 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Employer Brand
 


* Build the hiring engine end to end: role scorecards, structured interview loops, calibration standards and interviewer training.
* Own sourcing strategy and channel economics across inbound, referral, outbound, agency and partner channels; know the cost per hire and quality per channel.
* Own how Sutra.AI is perceived by the candidates we most want to attract, including careers presence, candidate experience and offer\-stage conversion.
* Establish a house standard for job descriptions, levelling language and hiring collateral across all functions.
* Close the loop between scorecard and hire quality, and let that evidence reshape how future roles are scoped.



 2\. Global Team Building \& Employment Structure
 


* Design and run hiring, onboarding and people operations across India and the United States.
* Own contractor\-versus\-employee decisions, own\-entity versus EOR calls, and regional employment contract structures; defend each call commercially.
* Build compensation benchmarking that holds across every market we hire in.
* Establish onboarding that produces productive contributors, not oriented ones, within a defined window.



 3\. Org Design \& Workforce Planning
 


* Partner with leadership on structure, spans, layers and hiring sequence, anchored to the operating plan rather than to demand.
* Build and maintain a rolling headcount plan tied to revenue and runway.
* Resolve reporting\-line and title inconsistencies across the existing organisation and establish a single levelling taxonomy.
* Tell leadership when we are hiring the wrong role at the wrong time, and specify what to hire instead.



 4\. Performance, Career Frameworks \& Total Rewards
 


* Design career frameworks and competency ladders per function, defining what good looks like at each level.
* Build a performance cycle from first principles that managers and employees find useful, and that makes promotion decisions defensible.
* Own levelling, banding and the annual compensation cycle across both markets, including internal equity management.
* Own ESOP administration and the employee education that makes equity comprehensible.
* Build a recognition programme that rewards behaviour and outcomes rather than tenure.



 5\. Engagement, Retention \& Wellbeing
 


* Own team health as a measured number: eNPS, pulse surveys, skip\-levels and stay interviews.
* Act on what listening mechanisms surface and close the loop visibly.
* Keep regretted attrition low, and diagnose the true cause behind every exit.
* Make working at Sutra.AI feel connected for people who may never share an office.



 6\. Culture \& Internal Communication
 


* Build the rituals, communication rhythms and feedback loops that make two time zones operate as one company.
* Establish written and verbal communication norms appropriate to a distributed, senior team.
* Keep culture deliberate rather than accidental as headcount grows.



 7\. People Operations \& Compliance
 


* Own HRIS selection and implementation, policy, payroll coordination and the people data layer.
* Own statutory compliance in India (PF, ESI, POSH, gratuity, S\&E, labour codes) and equivalent obligations in the United States and any subsequent geography.
* Build documentation and audit readiness ahead of customer, investor and certification requirements. Our customers operate in healthcare, financial services, aviation and defence\-adjacent sectors and will audit our controls.
* Partner with Engineering and Platform on people\-side controls relevant to ISO 27001, SOC 2 and equivalent frameworks.



 8\. Leadership Coaching
 


* Act as a thought partner to the founders and functional heads on structure, talent and organisational decisions.
* Coach first\-time managers into competent ones.
* Have the hard conversations that nobody else in the company is positioned to have, including with leadership.



  





**Focus Areas (Outcomes)** 



* **Hiring:** 
 Predictable, forecastable hiring with a defensible quality bar.
* **Structure:** 
 A levelled, coherent organisation with clear reporting lines and no duplicated accountability.
* **Rewards:** 
 Compensation that is benchmarked, internally equitable and explainable by managers.
* **Retention:** 
 Measured team health, low regretted attrition and diagnosed causes.
* **Governance:** 
 Clean statutory compliance and audit\-ready people operations in every geography.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 



* **Experience:** 
 15\+ years in human resources, including 5\+ years owning the function as Head of HR, VP People or CHRO.
* **Global Team Building:** 
 Demonstrated hiring and people operations across at least two countries; India and the United States preferred.
* **Compensation Architecture:** 
 Built levelling and compensation frameworks from scratch, not inherited and maintained them.
* **Compliance Depth:** 
 Fluent in Indian statutory and payroll obligations, with practical working knowledge of US employment requirements.
* **Environment:** 
 Direct experience in startups or fast\-growth technology environments; comfortable operating as the entire function before building a team.
* **Talent Market Knowledge:** 
 Has hired engineering, data and GTM talent under pressure and understands those markets specifically.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Proven credibility as a coach and challenger to founders and senior leaders.



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience scaling an organisation from approximately 50 to 300\+ people.
* ESOP design, administration and employee education experience.
* Experience establishing a US entity or EOR arrangement operated from India.
* Exposure to SaaS or AI technology landscapes.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2 or comparable certification from the people\-controls side.



  





**This role is NOT for you if** 



* You need an existing process to run rather than a blank page.
* You view people as downstream of business decisions rather than shaping them.
* You are uncomfortable disagreeing with founders in the room.
* You require permanently remote work. The base location requirement is firm.



  





**Core Competencies** 




 Technical \& Functional Competencies
 


* **Talent Acquisition Systems:** 
 Scorecard design, structured interviewing, calibration, funnel forecasting and channel economics.
* **Organisation Design:** 
 Structure, spans and layers, levelling taxonomy, decision rights and workforce planning against an operating plan.
* **Total Rewards:** 
 Multi\-market benchmarking, banding, internal equity, annual cycle design and equity administration.
* **Performance Systems:** 
 Competency frameworks, review philosophy, promotion governance and manager enablement.
* **People Analytics:** 
 Attrition, engagement and hiring data used diagnostically, not descriptively.
* **Employment Law \& Compliance:** 
 India statutory obligations, US employment requirements, cross\-border employment structures.
* **Distributed Team Leadership:** 
 Culture, ritual and communication design across time zones.



  





**Behavioural Competencies** 



* **Structural Thinking:** 
 Sees duplicated or absent accountability in a messy org and can articulate the fix.
* **Candour:** 
 Disagrees in the room rather than afterwards, with evidence, and commits fully once decided.
* **Data Fluency:** 
 Substantiates claims with cohort, manager and period\-level evidence.
* **Ownership:** 
 Operates without oversight and closes problems rather than reporting them.
* **Written Clarity:** 
 Writes precisely, recognising that in a distributed company unclear writing is unclear thinking at scale.

description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**L\&D Trainer**
 The L\&D team is responsible for facilitating learning experiences in a job\-specific area and for on\-the\-job capabilities needed for TPSP’s global footprint. We manage the activities involved in the preparation, delivery and assessment of training and development solutions for Expedia Group TPSP. The team collaborates with Instructional Designers, Operations and Quality Assurance representatives to improve performance. The ideal candidate will be a self\-starter with a passion for talent development, a high level of flexibility, commitment, and the ability to train and coach within a high paced customer centric contact centre environment.
   

  

 Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Our customer\-first mindset focuses on developing products that encourage loyalty and repeat business from our travelers and partners. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to achieve growth and results for our customers and company.
   

  

 TPSP provides the platform and services to handle the service requests from travellers across the multiple brands of Expedia Group, in all locations. This role will partner with the global team, supporting team members, interacting with internal customers (employees) of all levels and external vendors in delivering our products and services.

* Facilitate training to support global TPSP initiatives for different Line of Businesses
* Manage the learning environment: in person and virtual learning and create a positive learning environment in which participants feel safe to try new skills
* Prepare for training delivery by reviewing materials and participant needs
* Facilitate training using various learning methods to meet the needs of learners and the curriculum. Encourage participation and builds learner motivation
* Deliver constructive feedback to encourage self\-discovery and continuous learning
* Ensure learning outcomes by checking for understanding and skill acquisition and report findings and make recommendations to aid decisions making
* Manage projects as assigned by the Learning Team leadership
* Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with agents, peers, management, corporate, and partners
* Report performance of training classes, conduct training needs analysis and plan interventions for performance improvement

* Training: Facilitating adult learning solutions in a contact centre environment preferably within the travel industry
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communications skills; ensures the intended message is communicated clearly and in ways that meet the learner’s needs
* Strong organization skills: The ability to develop plans and set priorities; manage multiple priorities at one time
* Problem solving: Analytical problem\-solving skills; linear and logical troubleshooting skills
* Business judgment: Ability to demonstrate good judgment and proactive problem\-solving methods
* Learning theory: Can apply principles of adult learning theory to learning experiences
* Trust Each Other: We are all Expedians. We are accountable to each other to deliver on our commitments, and we will trust our team members to help get it done
* Traveller Focus: Promote a strong disposition to Traveller advocacy. Convey to the trainees how to passionately meet or exceed traveller expectations
* Embodies Expedia Inc. values and beliefs and shares these both internally and externally
* 2 years \+ experience in contact centre
* Travel knowledge: Minimum 1 year experience in the travel industry
* Good knowledge of Data dashboards, LMS, MS\-Excel and PowerPoint
* Willing to work in rotational shifts and weekends as required by the business

 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

 The
 **Senior ER Partner – HR Compliance, People Practices \& Governance** 
 is responsible for leading and governing the organization's HR regulatory compliance framework across India while driving consistent, legally compliant, and business\-aligned people practices. The role serves as the central point of coordination for HR compliance, policy governance, workplace accommodations, and employment\-related regulatory initiatives, ensuring adherence to applicable Central and State labour laws and organizational standards.
   

  

 The position partners extensively with HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal, Global Compliance, HR Centres of Excellence, Internal Audit, Payroll, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, and external compliance partners to strengthen governance, mitigate employment risks, and implement sustainable compliance practices across all India operations.
   

  

 Ultimately, this role enables the organization to maintain a strong culture of compliance, governance, fairness, and operational excellence while supporting business growth, protecting the organization from employment\-related risks, and enhancing the employee experience through consistent and legally compliant people practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**HR Regulatory Compliance \& Governance**
* Lead and govern the organization's HR regulatory compliance framework across all India operations, ensuring adherence to applicable Central and State labour laws.
* Establish and continuously improve governance frameworks, compliance controls, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure sustainable compliance.
* Develop and maintain annual compliance calendars, statutory obligation trackers, governance dashboards, and compliance scorecards.
* Monitor legislative developments and evaluate their impact on HR policies, processes, and business operations.
* Drive implementation of regulatory changes through cross\-functional collaboration and change management.
* Conduct periodic compliance health checks, gap assessments, and risk reviews, and oversee timely closure of corrective actions.


**People Practices \& Policy Governance**
* Own the end\-to\-end governance of HR and Employee Relations policies, guidelines, standards, and procedures.
* Draft, review, update, and implement HR / ER policies to ensure compliance with applicable laws and alignment with global standards and business objectives.
* Lead periodic policy reviews and governance processes, including stakeholder consultation, legal review, approvals, communication, and implementation.
* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of people practice across the organization.
* Develop policy toolkits, guidance documents, FAQs, and manager resources to promote consistent and compliant decision\-making.


**Employee Relations Support**
* Lead governance of workplace accommodation programs, ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements relating to disability, pregnancy, religion, gender identity, and other protected characteristics.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Employee Relations Leads, Legal, Facilities, Occupational Health, and business leaders to evaluate accommodation requests and recommend appropriate workplace solutions.
* Develop and maintain accommodation frameworks, guidelines, approval processes, and documentation standards.
* Review and advise on Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), disciplinary actions, grievance handling, misconduct matters, and separation processes to ensure legal compliance and consistency.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Communication**
* Serve as the central point of coordination for HR compliance and governance initiatives across HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Payroll, HR Operations, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, Security, Internal Audit, and Legal.
* Facilitate cross\-functional governance meetings, working groups, and steering committees to drive accountability and execution of compliance initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external statutory compliance vendors, consultants, and regulatory service providers.
* Coordinate statutory compliance audits, inspections, regulatory filings, and documentation with external partners.
* Develop executive dashboards and reports providing visibility into HR compliance health, regulatory risks, policy governance, audit findings, accommodation trends, and Employee Relations risks.
* Prepare and deliver presentations and compliance updates for HR Leadership, Executive Leadership, Legal, and Governance Committees.
* Partner with Global Legal, Global Compliance, Global HR, and Centres of Excellence to ensure India\-specific legal and regulatory requirements are incorporated into global people practices.
* Represent India in global governance forums, policy reviews, and compliance initiatives.


**Required Skills**
**Compliance**
* Employment \& Labor Law Compliance
* Regulatory Compliance \& Internal Controls


**Risk Management**
* Risk Assessment \& Compliance Audits
* Documentation Management \& Corrective Actions


**Communication \& Stakeholder Management**
* Stakeholder \& Executive Communication
* Negotiation, Coaching \& Presentation Skills


**Analytical Skills**
* Data Analysis \& Trend Identification
* Reporting, Problem Solving \& Decision Making


**Why Join Us**
 This role offers the opportunity to lead and strengthen the organization's Employee Relations and Compliance function by driving regulatory excellence, enhancing governance practices, and fostering a fair, ethical, and compliant workplace. The Employee Relations Compliance Lead will work closely with HR, Legal, Compliance, and business leaders to influence strategic decisions, mitigate organizational risk, and contribute to a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail\-oriented professional with strong expertise in employee relations, employment law, compliance governance, and workplace investigations, who thrives in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment and is passionate about delivering compliant and employee\-centric solutions.

* Guide the team on advanced Boolean search, Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, vendors, and other sourcing channels.

* Drive targeted hiring campaigns for niche and difficult\-to\-fill requirements.
* Ensure a balance between hiring speed, candidate quality, and cost efficiency.



**F. Recruitment MIS, analytics \& performance management** 



* Own recruitment dashboards and daily / weekly / monthly hiring reports.
* Track recruitment performance against agreed targets.
* Analyze the recruitment funnel and identify bottlenecks.



  





**G. Process improvement \& recruitment technology** 



* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment workflows and reduce manual effort.

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA HR is preferred.

* Proven experience in team handling and recruitment delivery.
* Strong experience in bulk hiring, high\-volume recruitment, or project\-based hiring.
* Experience in AI/LLM training, AI data operations, data annotation, BPO/KPO, or similar organizations is preferred.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders and business\-critical hiring requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, HRMS, and Excel\-based MIS.

* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and target\-oriented environment.

description:

system and process improvement, and sectoral strengthening. Our work is across seven states—Karnataka, Tamil

growth from a team of about 70 people today to approximately 200 people over the next five years.

the programs / state teams, functional skill\-building and leadership development programs for staff across
  

locations

HR documentation and employee records across all program locations

Leadership Team
  

Build and implement a performance management framework, including goal setting, periodic reviews and appraisal
  

processes
  

Design and administer compensation \& benefits structures, including salary benchmarking, increments and
  

employee insurance, appropriate for a nonprofit/social sector budget
  

Drive employee engagement initiatives to strengthen culture, retention and a sense of purpose aligned with
  

Dhwani's mission
  

Ensure adherence to all statutory and labour law requirements applicable across the states Dhwani operates in
  

Put in place HR policies, employee handbook and grievance redressal mechanisms, and ensure consistent
  

application across all locations
  

Partner with program and functional heads to anticipate people needs as the organisation scales over the next five
  

years

  


**Position Senior Manager Human Resources (Full time)**

Ensure weekly and monthly HR reviews are in place for smooth functioning of the function

Strong leadership skills

Sound working knowledge of PAN India HR Operations, statutory compliance and labour law
  

Experience developing and implementing HR strategy, policies and business plans aligned to organisational goals
  

Proven ability to build, manage and develop relationships with employees, leadership and external stakeholders
  

Track record of bringing innovative, creative thinking and fresh ideas to organisation\-building
  

Effective dissemination of information to large and diverse groups across locations
  

Exceptionally convincing and persuasive written and oral skills, with the ability to present and convey complex
  

ideas clearly and coherently
  

Highly self\-motivated and able to work autonomously, take initiative and make decisions. Commitment to
  

Dhwani's core values and strategic direction


**Experience**  

At least 15 years overall HR experience, with a minimum of 3 years in a similar HR leadership role, preferably with
  

exposure to the social/development sector

To apply for this position, share your CV with a covering letter to **careers@dhwanifoundation.org** with **“Head of**

**Description**


Manager, People Operations – APAC  

  

We’re looking for a dynamic People Operations Manager for our APAC region (Japan, China, Hong Kong, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, India) to drive operational excellence and lead our People Ops team across the APAC region. This is a people manager role that combines strategic thinking with hands\-on execution. You’ll be responsible for delivering exceptional employee experiences, leading regional HR initiatives, managing day\-to\-day People Operations tasks, ensuring operational excellence and leading a high\-performing APAC People Operations team.
  

  

As a trusted leader, you’ll work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders, regional managers, and global HR colleagues to bring consistent, high\-quality People Operations support throughout the employee lifecycle and focussing on operational excellence. This role will be reporting directly to the Senior Director, People Operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage the APAC People Operations team, providing coaching, guidance, and career development.
* Oversee the execution of core HR processes across the region — onboarding, offboarding, HRIS transactions, employee job changes, benefits, and immigration.
* Ensure compliance with local labor laws and internal policies across APAC locations.

* Lead training initiatives and enablement programs for employees and managers in maintaining operational efficiency and self\-serve initiatives.
* Lead global and APAC internal audits and also manage people systems audit ensuring data integrity and compliance.

* Generate and analyze HR metrics and reports to inform decision\-making, support the rest of the People Team with reporting and data insights.

description:
**Job Title: VP\- Business Manager**


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.


The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas.As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C CoE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function.Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.


The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.

**In this role, you will:**


The role holder will share good practice globally, lead a team and build trusted relationships across the function. Key responsibilities include:

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions.Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes, connecting information across teams to generate ideas for improved performance, effectiveness and service delivery.Challenge assumptions and test whether plans, resources and investments remain aligned to business priorities.
* Use scenario analysis to explore choices, trade\-offs and potential outcomes for the relevant Sub\-function or Line of Business.
* Support decisions on consultancy, third\-party spend, hiring and out\-of\-plan requirements by assessing business need, value and alignment to priorities.Track agreed actions and outcomes, helping leaders understand whether interventions are delivering the intended impact.
* Support senior leaders across Lines of Business and Sub\-functions with integrated business management covering performance, people, priorities, governance and organisational effectiveness.Create clear leadership narratives from centrally produced Management Information, focusing discussion on decisions, actions and opportunities rather than reporting alone.
* Coordinate business planning and governance rhythms, ensuring priorities, dependencies and actions remain visible and connected.Coordinate and execute the business change and organisational design activity required to deliver the agreed financial resource plan, across both cost and FTE
* Build trusted relationships with R\&C leadership and partners across the Global Businesses, Global Functions, Finance and HR.Facilitate constructive, evidence\-based conversations that help stakeholders align on priorities and make timely decisions.
* Bring together perspectives from global and regional stakeholders to spot themes, share learning and scale effective ideas.Provide constructive challenge to existing practices and proposed initiatives, developing practical solutions to complex issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, simplify activity and redirect resources to the areas of greatest strategic importance.
* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery.Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team

**To be successful you will:**

**Knowledge \& Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions.Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making.Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes.Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation.Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans.Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities.Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.
* Ability to spot patterns, risks and opportunities and develop practical ideas in response.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders.Strong leadership, collaboration and facilitation skills.
* Comfort interpreting data and scenarios without needing to own the underlying financial production processes.
* Proactive, resilient and effective in a fast\-moving international environment.Outstanding organisational and problem management skills, and extensive project and programme management exposure

Data and Analytics, HR Process Improvement; Process management; HR Process improvement, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Strategic mindset, Digital literacy, HR Data Analsyis; Data management; Employee data management, Commercial accumen, Solutioning.**What we offer**

As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.

**Position Summary**

  



The Fleet Personnel Officer provides comprehensive communication, project coordination, executive and administrative support to the Head of Fleet Personnel. The role is responsible for managing high\-volume correspondence, coordinating departmental projects, monitoring actions and deliverables, and supporting the effective functioning of the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.



The position also supports departmental reporting, governance, seafarer welfare initiatives, union and CBA administration, forums, travel and selected operational matters. It requires a high degree of discretion, sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to remain responsive while coordinating with senior leaders, Fleet Personnel teams, vessels, seafarers, manning partners, unions, vendors and other stakeholders across different time zones.


**Key Responsibilities**

  


**1\. Email, Communication and Correspondence Management: 20%**


* Manage and organise the Head of Fleet Personnel’s high\-volume email correspondence, ensuring messages are reviewed, prioritised and directed appropriately.
* Identify matters requiring immediate attention, follow\-up, delegation or escalation, and maintain visibility of pending responses and commitments.
* Draft, proofread and coordinate emails, letters, memos, presentations and other communications on behalf of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Prepare standard departmental letters, invitation letters, confirmations and authorisation documents, and maintain appropriate records.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain timely inputs and ensure correspondence is closed out accurately and professionally.
* Handle confidential, sensitive and privileged information with discretion.


**2\. Project Coordination and Action Management: 20%**


* Coordinate Fleet Personnel projects and improvement initiatives by maintaining project plans, milestones, actions, risks, decisions and deliverables.
* Proactively follow up with responsible stakeholders, identify potential delays and provide concise progress updates to the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Coordinate user inputs, testing, communications and implementation follow\-up for Fleet Personnel systems and digitalisation initiatives, including COMPAS and related crew\-management processes.
* Support the preparation of project briefs, presentations, status reports, process guidance, memos and rollout communications.
* Liaise with IT, Finance, HR, Training, regional teams and other functions to resolve dependencies and support timely delivery.
* Remain responsive to urgent project requirements and changing priorities arising from Seaspan’s global operations.


**3\. Meetings, Minutes and Follow\-up Coordination: 10%**


* Coordinate meeting logistics and prepare agendas, briefing notes and supporting materials for departmental, management and external stakeholder meetings.
* Record and circulate clear minutes of meetings and maintain action trackers with owners and target dates.
* Follow up on overdue actions and provide the Head of Fleet Personnel with timely updates on progress and outstanding matters.
* Coordinate the Fleet Personnel weekly meeting agenda and consolidate inputs from departmental and regional teams.
* Support meetings across time zones when operationally required.


**4\. Reporting, Dashboards and Management Information: 10%**


* Prepare and maintain periodic reports, dashboards, management information and KPI trackers for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Gather and consolidate information from Fleet Personnel teams and company systems into structured summaries for leadership review.
* Support monthly management reporting, budget coordination, variance commentary and ad hoc analysis.
* Maintain accurate records of departmental actions, incidents, recognition, policy exceptions and other agreed metrics.
* Work accurately under tight timelines while managing multiple reporting requirements concurrently.


**5\. CBA, Wage Scale, Vessel Data and Union Coordination: 10%**


* Maintain trackers for Collective Bargaining Agreement renewals, vessel enrolments, correspondence and supporting documentation.
* Maintain controlled vessel and CBA data, including business unit, shipowner, flag, complement and applicable wage arrangements.
* Support the preparation, issue and recordkeeping of approved wage scales and related Fleet Personnel memoranda.
* Coordinate routine documentation and follow\-up with unions, manning partners and internal stakeholders under the guidance of the Head of Fleet Personnel.


**6\. Compliance, Audit and Document Control: 8%**


* Support ISO, RPSL and other Fleet Personnel audit preparations, including document collection, tracker maintenance and closure of agreed actions.
* Assist with updates to departmental manuals, procedures, records and controlled documents.
* Maintain organised and secure digital and physical filing systems for the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
* Ensure records are complete, current, readily retrievable and handled in accordance with company confidentiality and data\-protection requirements.


**7\. Seafarer Welfare, Insurance and Recognition Programmes: 7%**


* Coordinate administrative aspects of seafarer medical and life\-insurance programmes, including data updates, supporting documentation and follow\-up with service providers.
* Support humanitarian\-aid and other urgent seafarer welfare arrangements as directed.
* Administer long\-service and loyalty\-recognition programmes, including eligibility records, approved awards, procurement coordination and event logistics.
* Maintain accurate records of recognition items and ensure expenditure remains within approved budgets and processes.


**8\. Forums, Town Halls and Stakeholder Events: 5%**


* Support the planning and execution of seafarer forums, vessel town halls, leadership visits, conferences, seminars, roadshows and sponsorship activities.
* Coordinate participant lists, invitations, venues, suppliers, presentation materials, awards and event budgets.
* Liaise with regional offices, vessels, manning partners and internal functions to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
* Maintain event plans, cost trackers, records and post\-event actions.


**9\. Calendar and Travel Coordination: 5%**


* Manage the Head of Fleet Personnel’s calendar, including scheduling, prioritising and resolving conflicts across internal and external meetings.
* Anticipate scheduling requirements and ensure adequate preparation time for leadership meetings, operational reviews and external engagements.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodation, visas, invitation and coverage letters, ground transport and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and reconcile travel and business expenses through the applicable company expense\-management system.
* Provide timely support when travel arrangements or meeting schedules change outside standard office hours.


**10\. General Departmental and Administrative Support: 5%**


* Support vendor onboarding, invoice documentation, purchase coordination and routine departmental administration in accordance with approved processes.
* Coordinate office, equipment and logistical requirements for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Respond to routine stakeholder enquiries or direct them to the appropriate responsible person.
* Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Head of Fleet Personnel in support of departmental priorities.

  


**Key Skills and Capabilities**

  


**Technical Skills**


* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Strong email organisation, correspondence tracking and action\-management capability.
* Ability to prepare professional correspondence, presentations, reports, dashboards, project plans and structured trackers.
* Strong digital and physical document\-management skills.
* Experience with enterprise systems such as COMPAS or other crew\-management systems, NetSuite, Certify, Concur, SharePoint or similar platforms would be an advantage.
* Ability to work accurately with operational, financial and personnel data.


**Professional Skills**


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, integrity and professional judgement.
* Strong project coordination, planning, organisation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate requirements and manage a high volume of competing priorities.
* Strong attention to detail, responsiveness and consistent follow\-through.
* Ability to engage confidently and respectfully with senior executives, seafarers, vessel teams, unions, manning partners, vendors and colleagues across cultures and time zones.
* Calm, dependable and solution\-oriented approach, particularly when handling urgent or sensitive matters.
* Resilience and the ability to maintain accuracy and professionalism in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity environment.

  


**Professional Experience and Education**


**Education**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Human Resources, Maritime Studies or a related discipline.


**Experience**


* At least five years of relevant experience in Fleet Personnel coordination, project coordination, executive support or senior administration, preferably supporting senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-volume email correspondence, multiple projects and concurrent deadlines in a demanding work environment.
* Experience in the maritime, ship\-management, crewing or logistics sector is preferred.
* Prior exposure to seafarer administration, CBA or union coordination, audit support, management reporting, travel, insurance, employee events or welfare programmes would be an advantage.


**Additional Requirements**


* Willingness to commit to a high\-intensity and high\-volume work environment, supported by prior experience in a role requiring sustained responsiveness and effective prioritisation.
* Availability on a 24/7 basis, when operationally necessary, to support meetings or urgent matters outside standard office hours due to Seaspan’s global operations.
* Flexibility to coordinate with stakeholders across international time zones and respond promptly to changing operational priorities.
* Ability to travel occasionally when required for Fleet Personnel forums, events or leadership support.
* Demonstrated commitment to Seaspan’s values, safety culture, confidentiality requirements and standards of professional conduct.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

Job Description
**Job Title:** Manager \- HR Operations
**Experience:** 6\+ years
**Location:** Mumbai
**Work Arrangement:** 5 days in the office  

  

**About Upstox**
At Upstox, we're building the future of investing—simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India's fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys.  

  

  

**About the Role**
We are looking for an experienced HR Operations Manager to lead and manage day\-to\-day HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, HR policies, compliance, HR systems, and employee support. The role will work closely with employees, managers, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and business leadership to ensure efficient, compliant, and employee\-friendly HR operations.  

  

**What you'll own:**
**1\. HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle**

  

* Own end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes from onboarding to exit.
  
* Manage employee documentation, HR records, transfers, promotions, confirmations, and exits.
  
* Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of employee data and HR documentation.
  
* Establish and improve HR processes, SOPs, and service standards.
  
* Manage employee queries and ensure timely resolution through HR helpdesk/ticketing mechanisms.
  

**2\. HR Policies \& Processes**

  

* Develop, implement, and periodically review HR policies and processes.
  
* Ensure consistent application of HR policies across teams and locations.
  
* Identify process gaps and drive automation and continuous improvement.
  
* Create HR dashboards, MIS, and periodic reports for management.
  

**3\. Payroll \& Benefits**

  

* Coordinate with payroll/Finance teams for accurate and timely payroll processing.
  
* Validate payroll inputs including attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, and employee changes.
  
* Manage employee benefits such as insurance, leave, gratuity, and other company\-sponsored programs.
  
* Resolve payroll and benefits\-related employee queries.
  

**4\. Statutory Compliance**

  

* Ensure compliance with applicable employment and labour laws.
  
* Coordinate statutory requirements including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, gratuity, Shops \& Establishments, and other applicable regulations.
  
* Maintain required HR records and documentation.
  
* Coordinate internal and external audits related to HR operations and compliance.
  

**5\. HRMS \& Data Management**

  

* Own HRMS administration and ensure accurate employee master data.
  
* Drive automation of HR processes wherever possible.
  
* Monitor data accuracy, access controls, and HR reporting.
  
* Work with HR technology vendors for system enhancements and issue resolution.
  

**6\. Employee Experience**

  

* Act as a point of contact for employee HR\-related queries and concerns.
  
* Improve employee experience across onboarding, lifecycle events, and exits.
  
* Develop employee communication processes and HR service standards.
  
* Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders on employee\-related operational matters.
  

**7\. HR Governance \& Reporting**

  

* Prepare monthly/quarterly HR MIS and dashboards.
  
* Track key HR metrics such as headcount, attrition, absenteeism, hiring, onboarding, exits, payroll accuracy, and employee queries.
  
* Identify trends and provide actionable insights to HR leadership. Maintain HR SOPs, process documentation, and audit records.
  
  

**Who you are:**  

* 6–10 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Generalist, or a similar role.
  
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle management and HR processes.
  
* Good knowledge of Indian labour and statutory compliance.
  
* Experience managing HRMS and HR process automation.
  
* Strong exposure to payroll, benefits, HR MIS, and employee documentation.
  
* Experience working with Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external vendors.
  
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
  
* Ability to independently manage HR operations in a fast\-growing organization.
  
  

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ('PI'). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.


Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

title: Head of IT and Business Operations
description:
**Head of IT \& Business Operations**

**Solutionara Private Limited**  
**Location:** Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-Site  
**Experience:** 12–18\+ Years

**About Solutionara**

Solutionara is an **AI\-led IT Consulting and Technology Services organization** delivering enterprise transformation, cloud modernization, integration solutions, data platforms, and digital engineering services to global clients.

Headquartered in the United States with a Global Delivery Center (GDC) in Noida, we are building an automation\-first, AI\-enabled operating and delivery model where cloud infrastructure, operational excellence, and intelligent workflows support both client delivery and organizational growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Head of IT \& Business Operations** to lead technology operations, cloud and DevOps practices, internal IT infrastructure, workplace technology, and business operations for our Noida Global Delivery Center.

This is a **hands\-on leadership role** for someone who can combine technology strategy with execution. You will be expected to strengthen AWS and DevOps operations, improve infrastructure reliability and security, drive automation, manage internal IT services, and ensure the GDC operates efficiently as Solutionara continues to scale.

The ideal candidate has strong experience across **AWS, DevOps, infrastructure/platform operations and enterprise IT**, while also being comfortable owning vendors, procurement, facilities, operational governance, and cross\-functional business operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Cloud, DevOps \& Infrastructure**

* Lead AWS cloud operations and DevOps practices across internal and client\-facing environments.
* Establish scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure standards.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform** and related technologies.
* Establish CI/CD, deployment, release, and environment\-management practices.
* Lead containerized environments using **Docker and Kubernetes**.
* Strengthen monitoring, observability, incident management, backup, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
* Drive cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps practices.
* Support enterprise cloud transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Advance **AI\-assisted DevOps, AIOps, and automation\-first operations**.

**IT Operations \& Security**

* Own internal IT operations for the Noida GDC.
* Oversee endpoint management, devices, software licensing, IT assets, networking, Wi\-Fi, and workplace technology.
* Manage employee technology onboarding and offboarding.
* Strengthen IAM, cloud security, vulnerability management, access controls, and technology governance.
* Establish effective IT support processes and service standards.

**Business Operations**

* Oversee day\-to\-day operational readiness of the Noida Global Delivery Center.
* Coordinate facilities, workplace services, administration, and business continuity.
* Develop scalable operational processes, controls, and governance.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through automation and process improvement.
* Build operational dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting.

**Vendor Management \& Procurement**

* Manage technology, cloud, facilities, and operational vendors.
* Oversee contracts, renewals, procurement, assets, and inventory.
* Monitor vendor performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization and consolidation.

**Leadership**

* Partner directly with executive leadership on technology and operational priorities.
* Collaborate across Engineering, Delivery, Integration, HR, Finance, and Client Services.
* Lead and mentor technology and operations team members.
* Build accountability, operational discipline, and a strong ownership culture.

These responsibilities reflect the broad technology, operations, vendor, automation and leadership ownership defined for the position.

**What We're Looking For**

* **12–18\+ years** of experience across Cloud Operations, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, IT Operations, Technology Management, or related areas.
* **5\+ years in a technology leadership role** involving cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform operations, or enterprise IT.
* Strong hands\-on understanding of **AWS** and enterprise cloud environments.
* Strong experience with **Terraform / Infrastructure as Code**.
* Experience with **CI/CD** technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab.
* Experience with **Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized environments**.
* Knowledge of cloud networking, IAM, security, monitoring, observability, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Experience managing internal IT operations, infrastructure, endpoints, assets, or workplace technology.
* Experience with vendors, procurement, operational governance, and cost management.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a **fast\-paced, growing technology consulting environment**.
* Willingness to remain close to execution and step in hands\-on when required.

The underlying role specification similarly requires substantial AWS/DevOps technical depth alongside operational leadership rather than executive management alone.

**Preferred**

* AWS Professional or Specialty certification.
* Consulting, managed services, or technology services experience.
* Experience supporting U.S.\-based clients or global delivery teams.
* Exposure to **AIOps, AI\-assisted operations, and intelligent automation**.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar security/governance frameworks.
* Experience supporting enterprise cloud transformation programs.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means building a secure and scalable technology and operational foundation for Solutionara—reliable AWS environments, mature DevOps and IaC practices, effective internal IT operations, stronger automation, disciplined governance, and a GDC operating model capable of supporting continued growth.

**Work Location**

This is a **full\-time, on\-site leadership position based at Solutionara's Global Delivery Center in Sector 62, Noida**.

This is **not a remote position**. Candidates should apply only if they are comfortable working regularly from our Noida office.

Pay: ₹1,200,000\.00 \- ₹2,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Noida, Uttar Pradesh: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice Period, If Serving then last day of work?
* Have you been responsible for internal IT and business operations in addition to cloud/DevOps—for example endpoints, IT assets, networking, vendors, procurement, workplace technology, or operational governance?

HR Specialist
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Responsibilities:

* Manage end\-to\-end HR processes related to onboarding, offboarding, promotions, transfers, employee lifecycle events, and benefits setup.
* Prepare, validate, and facilitate the issuance of HR letters and employment\-related documentation, including offer letters, promotion letters, transfer letters, experience letters, and other employee correspondence, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
* Coordinate and provide timely inputs to payroll, benefits, compensation, and other stakeholder teams to support employee transactions and lifecycle changes.
* Maintain employee records and ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance within HRIS systems.
* Respond to employee and manager inquiries regarding HR policies, pay, benefits, leave management, performance processes, and company guidelines through Workday Help; independently resolve queries or appropriately escalate complex issues.
* Support internal audits and ensure compliance with employment legislation, company policies, and data privacy requirements.
* Create, maintain, and update process documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to enhance operational efficiency within a tiered service delivery model.
* Collaborate closely with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Payroll, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, and other HR functions to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Handle sensitive and confidential employee information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.
* Participate in projects, process improvement initiatives, and system enhancements, providing operational insights and recommendations.
* Effectively manage workload, prioritize activities based on business needs and service level commitments, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.


Requirements:

* Minimum 3 \- 5 years of experience
* Experience in exposure of HR operations \& knowledge of HR operations processes.
* Analytical \& customer service oriented
* Workday knowledge \- mandatory
* Ticketing tool experience \- mandatory
* Proficient in Microsoft Office
* English level \- advanced

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager on BCG’s IT HR Systems Group, you will serve as a hands\-on configuration expert across Workday, with deep focus on Advanced Compensation—designing, building, and maintaining salary, bonus, eligibility rules, and cycle frameworks—while also supporting configuration across Core HCM, Security, and other modules as needed to ensure cohesive, scalable system design aligned with business strategy. You will work with Global Comp Stakeholders and Product Team to translate BCG’s compensation strategy into scalable Workday solutions, combining technical configuration and functional expertise to ensure accurate execution of compensation cycles, data integrity, and continuous platform improvement

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources or information systems with 7\+ years of deep, hands\-on configuration experience with Workday Advanced Compensation and Core Compensation is a must
* Strong Understanding of merit pools, compensation review statements, proration rules, complex scorecards, grade setups, eligibility rules, etc. and integration points with Core HCM, Talent modules and third\-party payroll systems is a must
* Certification, such as Workday Pro \- Advanced Compensation, is strongly preferred.
* Prior Consulting experience as a Workday Comp Lead or an architect role on end\-to\-end implementation projects is strongly preferred
* Prior experience with large, global companies with complex enterprise\-scale comp implementations in Workday is strongly preferred
* Experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans to ensure high quality before deployment is preferred
* Familiarity with Workday Docs and BIRT to build templates and control dynamic field visibility, and with Workday Security Configuration, is preferred
* Technical troubleshooting skills, including debugging and analysis of performance issues, are preferred
* Skilled in stakeholder management, offering training and support to end\-users during annual compensation cycles while delivering exceptional customer service year\-round for L3 support items is preferred

  

Who You'll Work With


The Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager will join a team of:

* Other members of the HR IT team, including the Workday Delivery Team, the Comp squad, and other squads under the People Portfolio
* Global Comp stakeholders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions
* QA Teams for testing on specific enhancements and software releases

  

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

  

Plan and Execute Comp Configuration: Design and build intricate variable pay, merit, bonus, allowances, including compensation review statements, and the overall coordination of events within Workday.  

Cycle Management: Own the end\-to\-end execution of Annual Salary Reviews, mass operation management, and merit grid setups.  

Business Processes: Configure Business Process Frameworks (BPF), condition rules, validations, and complex calculated fields.

title: Executive IT
description:
**Job Title:** Executive IT

**Function:** Information Technology

**Reports to:** Manager – IT

**Location:** Kolkata

**Travel Required**:**25%** **þ** **50%** **75%**


**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – IT is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability and day\-to\-day support of IT infrastructure and end\-user systems across operational and administrative locations within the assigned region. The role coordinates IT support activities, manages vendor service delivery, resolves infrastructure issues and ensures minimal disruption to business operations.


Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, HR and Corporate IT teams, the role provides first and second\-level support for IT infrastructure, end\-user computing, hardware, software and network\-related issues while ensuring adherence to service levels, IT standards and information security requirements.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To provide reliable, responsive and efficient IT support across the assigned region by ensuring timely resolution of technology issues, effective vendor coordination, high system availability and uninterrupted business operations through proactive infrastructure support and adherence to IT governance standards.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Regional IT Operations Support**

* Provide day\-to\-day IT support across all operational and administrative locations within the assigned region, ensuring high system availability and minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate resolution of hardware, software, network and system\-related issues impacting business operations.
* Ensure operational locations receive timely IT support in accordance with defined service levels.
* Provide on\-site support for critical IT issues where remote resolution is not feasible.
* Support regional IT readiness for new branch openings, relocations, expansions and operational infrastructure changes.

**Incident \& Service Request Management**

* Manage IT incidents and service requests from logging through resolution, ensuring adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Prioritise and coordinate resolution of business\-critical incidents impacting operational continuity.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting and coordinate with specialised support teams for second and third\-level issues.
* Track recurring incidents, identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, escalation records and service request updates.

**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**

* Support end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, handheld devices, scanners and other operational IT equipment.
* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.

**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**

* Coordinate and monitor regional IT support vendors to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.
* Build effective working relationships with vendor partners to ensure uninterrupted IT support across the region.

**IT Asset \& Inventory Management**

* Maintain accurate records of regional IT assets including desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handheld devices and networking equipment.
* Coordinate asset allocation, movement, replacement and disposal in accordance with organisational policies.
* Support periodic IT asset verification and inventory audits.
* Ensure software licensing, asset tagging and documentation remain accurate and up to date.
* Monitor asset lifecycle and recommend timely replacement of ageing or obsolete equipment.

**Business Continuity \& Operational Readiness**

* Support business continuity by ensuring IT systems remain operational across all regional locations.
* Coordinate IT readiness for new operational sites, office relocations and infrastructure expansion projects.
* Participate in disaster recovery activities, system recovery testing and operational contingency planning where applicable.
* Ensure critical operational systems supporting logistics and customer service remain available with minimal downtime.
* Provide IT support during peak business periods and critical operational events to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

**Information Security \& IT Governance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies, information security standards and regulatory requirements across all regional locations.
* Support implementation of IT security controls, endpoint protection, user access management and system compliance initiatives.
* Coordinate timely installation of software updates, security patches and antivirus definitions in collaboration with Corporate IT and support vendors.
* Report IT security incidents, system vulnerabilities and policy deviations, ensuring timely corrective actions.
* Promote awareness of information security best practices among regional users.

**Cross\-functional Stakeholder Support**

* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance, HR and other business functions to understand IT support requirements and ensure timely service delivery.
* Coordinate with Corporate IT teams for system upgrades, application deployments, infrastructure enhancements and enterprise\-wide IT initiatives.
* Provide IT support for new branch openings, relocations, office expansions and operational infrastructure changes.
* Assist business users during rollout of new applications, hardware and technology solutions.
* Maintain effective communication with stakeholders regarding incident status, planned maintenance and system availability.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify recurring IT issues and recommend process improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of new technologies, automation initiatives and digital solutions that improve business productivity.
* Recommend improvements to IT support processes, knowledge documentation and service delivery standards.
* Contribute to regional IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of customer service, collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.

  



**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Computer Engineering or a related discipline is mandatory.
* Relevant technical certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, CompTIA or equivalent will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* **3–6 years** of experience in IT Infrastructure Support, End User Computing, Desktop Support or Regional IT Operations.
* Experience supporting multi\-location business operations within a regional environment.
* Strong experience in hardware troubleshooting, operating systems, user support and IT infrastructure coordination.
* Experience coordinating with outsourced IT support vendors and monitoring service delivery against agreed SLAs.
* Exposure to IT asset management, incident management, user access administration and IT support processes.
* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, warehousing, manufacturing, retail or other multi\-site organisations will be preferred.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* IT Infrastructure \& End User Support
* Hardware \& Peripheral Device Support
* Windows Operating Systems \& Microsoft Office
* Basic Network Troubleshooting
* IT Incident \& Service Request Management
* IT Asset \& Inventory Management
* Vendor \& SLA Management
* Active Directory \& User Access Management (preferred)
* IT Security \& Endpoint Compliance
* Microsoft Office Suite and IT Service Management (ITSM) tools

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Centricity
* Service Orientation
* Communication Skills
* Problem Solving \& Analytical Thinking
* Planning \& Coordination
* Stakeholder Management
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Accountability \& Ownership
* Adaptability \& Learning Agility
* Integrity \& Professionalism
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

IT Service Delivery

  

Incident resolution within SLA, Service Request Closure TAT, System Availability

  

  

End User Support

  

User Satisfaction, First\-Time Resolution Rate, Reduction in Repeat Incidents

  

  

Vendor Performance

  

Vendor SLA Compliance, Timely Escalation \& Resolution, Quality of Service Delivery

  

  

IT Asset Management

  

Asset Accuracy, Inventory Compliance, Timely Asset Deployment \& Recovery

  

  

Infrastructure Support

  

Hardware Uptime, Preventive Maintenance Completion, Regional IT Readiness

  

  

Information Security

  

Compliance with IT Policies, Patch \& Antivirus Compliance, Security Incident Resolution

  

  

Business Support

  

IT Readiness for New Sites, Business Continuity Support, Stakeholder Satisfaction

  

  

Continuous Improvement

  

Process Improvements Implemented, Reduction in Recurring Incidents, Contribution to IT Projects


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.
