With its best\-loved brands, including Swagger, TestComplete, Reflect, QMetry, Zephyr, and more, SmartBear meets customers where they are to make our technology\-driven world a better place. Learn more at
 
 www.smartbear.com
 
 , or follow us on
 
 LinkedIn
 
 ,
 
 X
 
 , and
 
 Reddit
 
 . 
   

  

 At SmartBear, you will be part of a dynamic team solving one of the most critical challenges facing modern businesses: ensuring the integrity of software in an AI\-driven world. Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.
 



**Senior People Partner (HRBP)** 




 This is a pivotal role for SmartBear's India operations, combining hands\-on HRBP partnership with company\-wide accountability for statutory compliance. As HRBP to your assigned function, you'll partner with senior business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with business priorities, coach leaders on talent, performance, and organizational effectiveness, and drive strategic people initiatives that build high\-performing, engaged, and inclusive teams. You'll also serve as India's statutory compliance expert, owning alignment with Indian labor law across all India\-based SmartBear employees including those outside your HRBP client group, regardless of function or reporting line, in partnership with our Sr. Director of Global People Operations. 
 



**About the Role:** 



* Partner with business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with organizational goals and translate business priorities into actionable people plans.
* Coach and advise managers on performance management, employee development, organizational design, compensation, and employee relations.
* Analyze employee engagement survey results and develop action plans with leaders.
* Develop and implement talent retention strategies that enhance employee experience.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, influencing leaders through data, business insight, and People \& Culture expertise.
* Collaborate across the People \& Culture organization to deliver consistent, scalable, and impactful people programs.
* Partner with global People \& Culture teams to adapt enterprise\-wide programs to local legal and cultural context.
* The successful candidate will work from our Ahmedabad, India office in hybrid model.



**India Statutory Compliance (all India employees):** 



* Own compliance with Indian labor law — including the Industrial Relations Code, Shops \& Establishments Act, and related regulations — for every India\-based employee, regardless of which function or HRBP they are otherwise supported by, serving as SmartBear's go\-to expert on India employment regulation.
* Partner with the Director of Global People Operations, Legal, and other HRBPs to maintain visibility into employment actions (hiring, compensation changes, terminations) across functions, so compliance risk is caught even outside your direct client group.
* Serve as the single point of accountability and escalation for India regulatory questions raised by other HRBPs or business leaders.



**We are looking for you if you have:** 



* 8\+ years of experience in a senior People Partner or HR Business Partner role, ideally within a high\-growth technology environment.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to develop and implement strategic People \& Culture initiatives.
* Strong expertise in performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience analyzing employee engagement data and translating insights into measurable action plans.
* Excellent communication, coaching, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* A passion for building inclusive, high\-performing teams and creating exceptional employee experiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and HR regulatory requirements is required, given this role's company\-wide compliance ownership.
* Experience working as part of a global, distributed People \& Culture team is a plus.
* A background in people operations — including HR systems, processes, and policy administration — is a plus.



**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:** 
  
 


* You can grow your career at every level.
* We invest in your success as well as the spaces where our teams come together to work, collaborate, and have fun.
* We love celebrating our SmartBears; we even encourage our crew to take their birthdays off.
* We are guided by a People and Culture organization \- an important distinction for us. We think about our team holistically – the whole person.
* We celebrate our differences in experiences, viewpoints, and identities because we know it leads to better outcomes.



**Did you know?** 



* Our main goal at SmartBear is to make our technology\-driven world a better place.
* SmartBear is committed to ethical corporate practices and social responsibility, promoting good in all the communities we serve.
* SmartBear is headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices across the world including Galway Ireland, Bath, UK, Wroclaw, Poland and Bangalore, India.
* We’ve won major industry (product and company) awards including B2B Innovators Award, Content Marketing Association, IntellyX Digital Innovator and BuiltIn Best Places to Work.



*SmartBear is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for employees where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that reflects a diversity of thought and experience as well as our values of being smart, open, driven, accountable, and curious.*

title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.

description:
**What You Will Do**
**Talent Acquisition**
* Own end\-to\-end hiring for tech, AI, product, and leadership roles \- sourcing strategy, JD design, pipeline management, and offer closure
* Build and manage high\-quality hiring pipelines for hard\-to\-fill roles in a competitive talent market
* Set and track hiring metrics \- time to fill, quality of hire, funnel conversion, offer acceptance rates
* Introduce AI and automation into hiring workflows to improve speed and candidate experience
* Serve as a talent partner to engineering and product leadership \- not just a hiring executor


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Own the full HR operations stack, onboarding, performance management, compensation cycles, exit processes
* Ensure HR compliance across domestic and international entities, employment law, statutory requirements, overseas HR obligations
* Design and manage compensation and benefits structures that are competitive for a product\-first organisation
* Lead payroll coordination and ensure HR systems are fit for scale


**Organisation Design \& Culture**
* Partner with the CEO on org structure decisions, reporting lines, spans of control, team design
* Build a culture of performance and ownership, not just process compliance
* Drive employee engagement and retention programmes, with a focus on engineering and product talent
* Lead leadership development and succession planning for senior roles


**HR Strategy**
* Define the people strategy for the next 2–3 years in alignment with business growth plans
* Build an HR function that scales, the right team, the right tools, the right processes
* Be a trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team on all people\-related decisions


**Non\-negotiable Requirements**
**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
* MBA with HR specialisation from a Tier 1\-2 B\-school
* 20 years of progressive HR experience;
* Background in product\-based technology organisations, IT services experience alone will not be considered
* Prior experience in companies with 1000\+ employees at minimum
* Full\-function ownership, must have led both talent acquisition and HR operations, not TA alone
* Personally owned tech and AI/product hiring, not just managed a team that did it
* Willingness to be based in Kochi, this is an onsite role and location is non\-negotiable


**What We're Really Hiring For**
 We are looking for a senior leader who still builds, who brings energy and curiosity to the role, who has introduced new ways of working in the last 12 \- 18 months, and who is excited by the scope of what this role offers rather than intimidated by it.
   

  

 The best fit for this role is someone who has come through a strong product organisation and still has the drive and initiative of someone in their growth years.
   

  

**Good To Have**
* Experience managing HR for overseas entities or geographically distributed teams
* Exposure to AI/ML talent hiring or AI\-augmented HR workflows
* Background in B2B product companies (SaaS, enterprise software, maritime tech, logistics tech, fintech)
* Prior experience with international HR compliance, employment laws across multiple geographies


**WHY THIS ROLE**
 Direct report to CEO, you will be in every strategic conversation that touches people, not presenting to an HR committee.
   

  

 Full\-function ownership from day one, no handoffs, no matrix, no waiting for sign\-off from a global HR head.
   

  

 A product organisation that is growing, you are not maintaining a steady state; you are building for the next phase.
   

  

**LOCATION**
 Kochi, Kerala. This is an onsite role. The location is non\-negotiable. Candidates who are not based in Kochi or not open to relocating to Kochi will not be considered.

title: Learning and Change Transformation - Senior Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \| PEOPLE CONSULTING \| LEARNING \& CHANGE**
**Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation \& Change**
 Own the workstream. Shape the solution. Accelerate client adoption.
   

  

**ROLE SNAPSHOT**
**Role:** 
 Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation \& Change
   

  

**Portfolio:** 
 Learning \& Development, People Consulting MENA
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7–9 years, including substantial client\-facing L\&D consulting experience
   

  

**Capability profile** 
 Learning consulting with deployable organisational change management capability
   

  

**Engagement model** 
 Workstream ownership; proposal solutioning; client\-facing delivery
   

  

**Travel:** 
 India\-based with willingness for short\- or long\-term deployment across KSA, UAE and Qatar
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 The Senior Consultant is a founding delivery and pursuit hire for the growing MENA Learning \& Change capability. The role translates complex client and RFP requirements into practical learning, adoption and capability\-building solutions, then owns key workstreams through delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine Learning \& Development consulting, organisational change management, proposal development, facilitation and responsible AI usage. The role supports MENA priorities, with KSA as the primary growth market and government, energy and financial services as sector priorities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client delivery and workstream ownership**
* Own one or more learning and change workstreams across scope, quality, schedule, effort, dependencies, risks and client communication.
* Lead discovery interviews, focus groups, learning needs analyses, skills\-gap assessments, stakeholder workshops and design sessions.
* Translate business outcomes into capability frameworks, curriculum architectures, blended learning journeys, facilitator\-led experiences and measurement plans.
* Produce and quality\-review client\-ready strategies, roadmaps, workshop packs, recommendations, dashboards and implementation plans.
* Facilitate stakeholder and learner sessions and present workstream recommendations to client managers and senior stakeholders.
* Coach Staff Consultants and coordinate specialists, designers, facilitators and technology contributors across the workstream.


**Learning transformation and change management**
* Design integrated learning and adoption approaches covering audience analysis, impacts, readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, reinforcement and sustainment.
* Apply instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM to learning journeys, curricula, academies, leadership programmes and capability\-building interventions.
* Develop learning operating model, managed learning services, governance, intake, content operations and performance\-measurement components where relevant.
* Support leadership assessment\-led development assignments, including administration and interpretation when appropriately accredited, and convert insights into development pathways.
* Use evaluation and analytics approaches to measure participation, learning transfer, adoption and business impact.


**Pursuits, proposals and business development**
* Independently draft solution approaches, proposal narratives, methodologies, workplans, staffing models, delivery plans, assumptions, risks and effort estimates.
* Analyse RFP requirements, develop compliance matrices and help create differentiated win themes and client\-specific solution stories under tight turnaround times.
* Create proposal slides, capability showcases, credentials, case studies, benchmarks and sector research for MENA partner and account teams.
* Participate in partner reviews, solution workshops and oral presentation preparation; present assigned sections confidently when required.
* Identify follow\-on opportunities during delivery and shape them into a clear problem statement, proposed response and indicative scope.


**AI\-enabled learning and technology**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal development, learning design and content acceleration in line with firm policies.
* Design AI\-enabled learning use cases, with particular emphasis on a learning content generation accelerator, personalised journeys and analytics\-assisted decisions.
* Apply human review, factual verification, accessibility, privacy, confidentiality, intellectual property and quality controls to AI\-assisted output.
* Bring working knowledge of LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces, LMS ecosystems and learning analytics to solution design.
* Guide Staff Consultants in effective prompt design, AI\-assisted production and responsible review practices.


**Capability building and internal contribution**
* Build and maintain reusable proposal content, credentials, case studies, research, methods, templates and delivery assets.
* Convert project learning into portfolio intellectual property and support capability demonstrations and internal roadshows.
* Contribute to recruitment assessments, onboarding, coaching, certification pathways and community\-of\-practice activity.
* Balance client delivery with pursuit and capability commitments in a lean, growth\-stage team.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting judgement: structures ambiguous problems, forms hypotheses, makes evidence\-based recommendations and knows when to escalate.
* Dual capability: can lead both a learning design conversation and a change/adoption conversation without treating them as separate disciplines.
* Proposal craft: writes clear, persuasive and executable solutions rather than generic capability statements.
* Facilitation and design thinking: designs productive workshops and moves diverse stakeholders towards decisions.
* Client communication: produces director\-ready documents and communicates confidently in virtual and in\-person settings.
* AI fluency: uses AI to increase speed and quality while retaining human accountability and professional scepticism.
* Builder mindset: creates reusable capability while meeting immediate delivery requirements.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 7–9 years of relevant experience across L\&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management.
* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting experience and independent ownership of learning or change workstreams.
* Evidence of contribution to RFPs, solution approaches, proposal writing, effort estimation and presentation development.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Practical experience in change impacts, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals or learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline. PREFERRED
* GCC or MENA delivery or proposal experience, especially in government, energy or financial services.
* Big Four or global consulting experience.
* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating models, leadership development or leadership assessment\-led development.
* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.
* Experience with SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, EdCast or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Camtasia, Captivate or comparable content tools.
* Experience on digital transformation, ERP, AI adoption or workforce transformation programmes.


**CERTIFICATIONS**
**Required At Joining Or Within Agreed Development Plan**
* PROSCI or an equivalent recognised change management certification.
* Design thinking / human\-centred design / workshop facilitation credential or demonstrable equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI credential.
* One recognised learning credential or structured pathway towards APTD, CPTD or equivalent.


**Preferred / Differentiating**
* CCMP.
* Kirkpatrick learning evaluation credential.
* Hogan, SHL or Korn Ferry practitioner accreditation.
* Agile, Scrum or SAFe certification.
* Learning analytics, LMS, LXP or talent\-platform certification.


**WAYS OF WORKING**
**INITIAL RAMP\-UP**
* 50% client delivery.
* 30% pursuits and proposal support.
* 10% capability building.
* 10% internal initiatives.


**ONCE STAFFED ON A BILLABLE ENGAGEMENT**
* 70% client delivery.
* 30% pursuits, proposal support and agreed capability contribution.
* Allocation remains subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.


**INDICATIVE SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Dimension**
* Delivery
* Pursuits
* Billable deployment
* Capability assets
* AI and innovation
* People


**Indicative measure**
* Own at least one significant learning or change workstream and achieve agreed scope, quality, schedule and client\-feedback expectations.
* Make material contributions to priority MENA proposals, including independent ownership of assigned solution and delivery sections.
* Transition into billable client delivery as demand permits, targeted within the first 2–3 months of joining.
* Create or materially improve reusable credentials, case studies, methods, proposal content or delivery assets.
* Demonstrate responsible AI use in proposals and delivery and contribute to the learning content generation accelerator or another client\-facing use case.
* Coach assigned Staff Consultants and provide timely, documented review and development feedback.


**Evidence**
* Workplan, quality reviews and client feedback.
* Pursuit tracker and proposal records.
* Staffing and utilisation records.
* Controlled repository and reuse evidence.
* Demo, use\-case record or client deliverable.
* Coaching records and work\-product improvement.


**What Ey Offers**
* Exposure to live MENA learning, change and workforce transformation programmes.
* A role combining workstream delivery, solution shaping, proposal support and capability building.
* A development path across learning consulting, organisational change, facilitation, AI and emerging learning technology.
* The opportunity to shape a growing MENA Learning \& Change capability rather than inherit a fixed operating model.


**Recruitment note:** 
 This JD is intentionally designed to filter for consulting capability, not training administration alone. Selection must be based on role\-relevant skills and experience.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Training & Development Manager
description:
TRAINING \& DEVELOPMENT MANAGER
   

  

 Foundry Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Position:** 
 Training \& Development Manager
   

  

**Department:** 
 Human Resources / Training \& Development
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–12 Years, preferably in Foundry / Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Qualification:** 
 MBA / PGDM – HR / Training \& Development / MSW / Relevant Engineering Qualification
   

  

**Location:** 
 Wai Dist\-Satara Maharashtra
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and implement the annual Training \& Development plan based on organizational and departmental requirements.
* Identify Training Needs (TNI/TNA) based on competency gaps, performance, KRA and skill requirements.
* Develop and maintain skill matrix and competency matrices for employees, operators and technicians.
* Design training programs for new employees, existing employees, contract workers and temporary workers.
* Develop skill\-based training modules for Foundry operations such as:
+ Melting \& Furnace Operations
+ Moulding
+ Core Shop
+ Sand Plant
+ Fettling \& Shot Blasting
+ Quality \& Laboratory
+ Maintenance
+ Crane \& Material Handling
+ Gatecutting/Patternshop
+ Safety and Emergency Response

* Establish and monitor OJT, classroom and practical training programs.
* Develop training materials, SOP\-based training modules, work instructions and evaluation questionnaires.
* Conduct skill\-level assessments and competency evaluations for employees.
* Monitor effectiveness of training through post\-training evaluation, skill improvement and workplace performance.
* Maintain complete training records, attendance, assessment results and competency certification.
* Develop and implement L1/L2/L3/L4 skill certification systems as applicable.
* Coordinate with HODs and Section In\-Charges to identify critical skill gaps and improvement areas.
* Promote Kaizen, suggestion schemes, cross\-functional learning and continuous improvement.
* Monitor training KPIs and prepare monthly / quarterly Training MIS reports.
* Support new employee induction and job\-specific orientation programs.
* Ensure training compliance related to quality, safety, environment and customer requirements.
* Support internal / customer audits related to competency and training records.
* Develop internal trainers through a Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) program.


**Required Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Training Need Identification, Competency Development and Skill Matrix Management.
* Experience in shop\-floor training and operator skill development.
* Good understanding of foundry manufacturing processes will be preferred.
* Knowledge of KRA, KPI, competency assessment and performance management.
* Good presentation and communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical, leadership and people\-management skills.
* Knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, Quality and Safety systems will be an advantage.


 Key Performance Areas
   

  

**Training Effectiveness \| Competency Development \| Skill Matrix \| Training Compliance \| Employee Development \| New Employee Training \| OJT Effectiveness \| Skill Certification \| Training MIS \| Continuous Improvement**
**Preferred Candidate**
 Candidates with experience in
 **Foundry / Automotive / Engineering / Manufacturing Industries** 
 , particularly in
 **shop\-floor skill development and technical training** 
 , will be preferred.
   

  

**Additional Benefits:** 
 PF / Mediclaim / Leave Payment
   

  

**Facility:** 
 Accommodation provided free of cost
   

  

 subsidiary Canteen /Transport facility

**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing organization focused on connecting businesses with the right talent across diverse industries. With more than a decade of experience, the company has built a strong global client and candidate base and maintains a high customer retention rate. Its team of trained professionals uses advanced tools and methods to bridge gaps between employers and job seekers. V Engineering LLC emphasizes a values\-driven work culture and strong ethics, striving to deliver long\-term, successful placements.

* Minimum educational qualification: bachelor’s degree or equivalent; relevant certifications in counseling or HR are beneficial.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
HR Business Partner — People \& Culture
 



 Panigrahana Weddings \| Bengaluru \| Full\-time, on\-site
 



  





 Build the HR function of a growing wedding planning and design business. We are looking for a hands\-on HR Business Partner who can turn people needs into practical systems, earn employees’ trust and hold managers accountable. You will own the employee lifecycle and help shape how the company hires, works, develops people and handles difficult conversations.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 • End\-to\-end recruitment: understand hiring needs, define roles, source talent, run structured interviews, coordinate offers and improve quality of hire.
 



 • Joining and onboarding: documentation, induction, role clarity, probation reviews and a consistent new\-joiner experience.
 



 • HR foundations: organisation structure, job descriptions, policies, employee records, attendance and leave processes, and reliable HR reporting.
 



 • Performance and development: clear expectations, review cycles, manager coaching, feedback and practical learning plans.
 



 • Employee relations: listen carefully, handle concerns confidentially, resolve conflict fairly and follow through on commitments.
 



 • Culture and retention: build everyday practices that support trust, accountability, recognition and effective collaboration across sales, design, planning and execution teams.
 



 • Exits: thoughtful exit interviews, handovers, documentation and coordination of final settlements; use the feedback to improve the workplace.
 



 • People operations: coordinate payroll inputs, benefits and applicable compliance with finance and specialist advisers.
 



  





 WHO WILL DO WELL HERE
 



 • You have independently handled both recruitment and broader HR operations, with examples of systems you built or improved.
 



 • You can work in a startup environment: create the process, implement it yourself and keep it usable as the business grows.
 



 • You combine emotional intelligence with sound judgment. You can be empathetic without avoiding difficult decisions, and direct without losing respect for people.
 



 • You are organised, discreet and comfortable working closely with founders and functional leaders.
 



 • Experience in hospitality, events, creative services or another people\-intensive business is helpful.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



 A dependable hiring pipeline, clear roles and onboarding, accurate people records, useful review routines, and employees who know where to raise concerns and receive follow\-through.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



 Apply with your CV. Please include a short example of an HR process you built from scratch and a people challenge you handled, without sharing confidential employee information. Tell us your current location and notice period.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who wants responsibility for the whole HR function and enjoys doing the work as well as setting direction.

description:
**Product \& Engineering Expert – PowerPoint Review \& Reconstruction** 




  





**Position:** 
**Product \& Engineering Expert – PowerPoint Review \& Reconstruction** 




  





**Type:** 
**Contractor** 




  





**Compensation:** 
**$150–$350/hour** 




  





**Location:** 
**Remote** 




  





**About the Opportunity** 




 micro1 is engaging experienced Product \& Engineering Experts to contribute to a customer project focused on improving the quality, clarity, and effectiveness of executive\-level business presentations.
 



 In this role, you will combine your product and engineering expertise with advanced PowerPoint, presentation design, data visualization, content editing, and visual storytelling skills. You will reconstruct product and engineering presentations from images while preserving factual accuracy, technical context, domain definitions, and important caveats.
 



 Your work will help train next\-generation AI systems by providing high\-quality, real\-world product and engineering judgment. No prior AI experience is required — your domain expertise is what matters most.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Analyze images of product and engineering business slides, including roadmaps, architectural overviews, program updates, and technical presentations.
* Accurately reconstruct source slides using
 **Microsoft PowerPoint** 
 .
* Preserve technical accuracy, domain\-specific definitions, critical caveats, and the original business intent.
* Improve slide clarity, structure, visual hierarchy, and overall executive communication.
* Apply effective data visualization and visual storytelling principles.
* Develop clear message hierarchies and evidence\-supported slide titles.
* Edit and improve slide content, layouts, diagrams, charts, and supporting visuals while maintaining fidelity to the original context.
* Create a detailed change log for each slide explaining improvements made and decisions to preserve or reject specific elements.
* Defend both existing design choices and proposed improvements using clear, logical reasoning.
* Communicate technical concepts in plain language for audiences ranging from engineering leaders to senior executives.
* Ensure presentations effectively communicate complex product and engineering information to business stakeholders.
* Participate in project\-based sprints, with individual assignments typically requiring
 **1–2 hours** 
 .



**Required Qualifications** 



* Strong professional experience in
 **product management, engineering, engineering leadership, or technical program management** 
 .
* Deep understanding of product development and engineering environments.
* Proven experience creating or refining
 **executive\-level PowerPoint presentations** 
 for senior stakeholders or client audiences.
* Advanced proficiency in
 **Microsoft PowerPoint** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of presentation design, content editing, and data visualization.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into clear executive\-level communication.
* Strong critical\-thinking and analytical skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written communication skills.
* Ability to clearly explain message hierarchy, evidence\-supported titles, visual selections, and content decisions.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* **3\+ years of experience** 
 in product management, engineering leadership, or technical program management.
* Experience building presentations for executives, technical leaders, clients, or cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong experience with product roadmaps, engineering programs, technical architectures, and program updates.
* Experience reconstructing or redesigning existing presentation materials.
* Strong ability to evaluate whether visual and content choices accurately communicate technical information.
* Background as an industry practitioner or consultant with deep product or engineering expertise.
* Experience explaining complex engineering concepts to non\-technical or executive audiences.
* Prior experience with AI model training, AI evaluation, or rubric development is a plus but not required.



**Key Areas of Expertise** 



* Product Management
* Engineering
* Engineering Leadership
* Technical Program Management
* Product Development
* Product Roadmaps
* Engineering Roadmaps
* Technical Architecture
* Program Updates
* Microsoft PowerPoint
* Slide Reconstruction
* Executive Presentations
* Presentation Design
* Data Visualization
* Visual Storytelling
* Content Editing
* Technical Communication
* Message Hierarchy
* Evidence\-Supported Titles
* Technical Accuracy
* Executive Communication
* Critical Thinking
* Product \& Engineering Strategy



**Compensation \& Engagement** 



* Compensation is
 **$150–$350/hour** 
 .
* This is a
 **remote contractor opportunity** 
 .
* Work is structured around individual PowerPoint review, reconstruction, and enhancement assignments.
* Each slide engagement is expected to require approximately
 **1–2 hours** 
 , depending on complexity.
* Projects operate through task\-based, sprint\-driven workflows with flexible timing.
* Experts are expected to provide both high\-quality presentation work and detailed documentation explaining their decisions.



**Application Process** 



1. Apply to the role and complete the required screening questions.
2. Complete an
 **AI Interview** 
 , if required.
3. Complete a

 , if applicable.
4. Participate in
 **Hiring Manager Review** 
 .

title: Head of HR Operations & Recruitment
description:
ABOUT ARIVUPRO ACADEMY
   

 ArivuPro Academy is South India's leading commerce and professional\-certification academy, coaching students for CA, CS, CMA India, ACCA, CMA USA, CFA, CIA, CPA US, EA, FRM, CFP and CIMA UK, alongside its
   

 integrated ArivuPro One degree\-plus\-certification programme. With centers across Karnataka (Bangalore — Koramangala, Malleshwaram) and Tamil Nadu (Chennai — Tambaram, Nungambakkam; and Coimbatore), over 100,000 students trained, 5,000\+ daily learners and 25\+ institutional partnerships (including RV University and GSSS Institute of Engineering and Technology for Women), ArivuPro operates at a B2B/institutional scale — and is now expanding into new certification tracks including US CPA. That growth has outpaced ad hoc HR support.
   

  

 We're hiring a Head of HR Operations \& Recruitment to build
   

 the function properly — owning everything from faculty and staff hiring to onboarding, policy, compliance and people operations across all five centres.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

 This is a build\-and\-own mandate, not a maintenance role. You will design ArivuPro's HR operations function from the ground up — processes, policies and systems — while personally driving recruitment for a business with two distinct hiring tracks: subject\-matter faculty (CA/CS/CMA/ACCA/CPA and other qualified experts) and corporate/support staff (academic coordinators, business development, operations, admin) across centres in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. You'll report to the Director and Vertical Head, and have real latitude to
   

 shape how the function runs.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
   

 •Recruitment strategy \& delivery — Run full\-cycle hiring for both faculty (qualified CA/CS/CMA/ACCA/CPA professionals and subject experts) and corporate roles across Bangalore, Chennai (Thambaram, Nungambakkam) and Coimbatore, including sourcing channels specific to each (professional networks and alumni for faculty; standard job boards and referrals for staff).
   

 •Faculty pipeline — Build a repeatable pipeline for scarce, high\-demand faculty talent ahead of new batch launches and new certification tracks (e.g., the upcoming US CPA rollout), so hiring never becomes the bottleneck on batch scheduling.
   

 •HR operations infrastructure — Stand up onboarding, attendance, leave, performance and offboarding processes across all five centres; select and implement an HRMS/ATS suited to a multi\-location, dual\-workforce (faculty \+ staff) academy.
   

 •Policy \& documentation — Own and maintain HR policy documentation, including compensation and incentive structures for revenue\-facing roles (e.g., business development), employment contracts, and faculty engagement terms; ensure consistency across centres.
   

 •Compliance — Ensure statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, shops \& establishments, and other applicable labour law) across both states of operation — Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
   

 •Institutional coordination — Work closely with academic operations on faculty deployment and batch scheduling, and support HR aspects of institutional partnership agreements (e.g., staffing commitments tied to
   

 university/college tie\-ups).
   

 •Team building — Recruit and lead a small HR ops/recruitment team as hiring volume grows across centres.
   

 •Culture \& retention — Own engagement and retention initiatives for a workforce split between full\-time staff and part\-time/visiting faculty — a materially different retention problem from a typical corporate team.
   

  

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
   

 •8\+ years in HR with at least 3 years owning recruitment and HR operations end\-to\-end, ideally with P\&L or function\-building accountability.
   

 •Proven experience recruiting specialist/credentialed talent, not just generalist corporate hiring — ed\-tech, professional training, higher education, EdTech, or a similarly expertise\-driven hiring environment is a strong plus.
   

 •Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH); multi\-state/multilocation HR experience preferred given ArivuPro's five\-centre footprint across Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
   

 •Track record of building HR processes and policy from scratch, not just operating within an existing system.
   

 •Comfortable in a fast\-scaling, founder\-led environment — able to move between strategic policy work and hands\-on interview scheduling in the same week.
   

 •Strong stakeholder management — this role sits close to the Director and Vertical Head and coordinates constantly with academic operations.
   

 •Familiarity with the CA/CS/CMA/ACCA coaching or broader professional\-certification education space is a strong advantage, though not mandatory.
   

  

 WHAT ARIVUPRO OFFERS
   

 •A genuine build mandate — shape the HR function for a scaling, multi\-location institution rather than inherit someone else's system.
   

 •Direct access to and mentorship from the Director and Vertical Head.
   

 •A fast\-growing organization with 25\+ institutional partnerships and an expanding certification portfolio (ACCA, and now US CPA).
   

 •Competitive compensation, benchmarked to experience and scope of ownership.
   

  

 TO APPLY
   

 Send your resume and a short note on the most complex HR function you've built or scaled to hr@arivupro.com
   

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

 Health Insurance

title: Lead - People and Culture
description:
**About Atomgrid** 




  






 Atomgrid is building the next\-generation specialty chemicals company — from India, for the world. 
 




  






 Today we operate in more than 10 countries, with a global team of 100\+ people and sales presence across key global markets. 
 





 Founded by IIT and IIM alumni and backed by two rounds of institutional capital, we're driven by one large ambition: to redefine what "Made in India" means in specialty chemicals.
 




  






 Recent Coverage :
 




  






 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/news\-inc42\-funding\-share\-7417098107236134912\-Jj\_u/
 




  





**Role Overview** 





 The Lead – People \& Culture will be Atomgrid’s first people person and will play a foundational role in shaping our people function. The individual will set up HR policies, performance management frameworks, employee engagement practices, and ensure compliance with labour laws and regulations. The role will also focus on talent acquisition ensuring that we hire the best talent across R\&D, manufacturing, supply chain, and business teams. This is a rare 0 → 1 role with direct impact on Atomgrid’s growth and culture.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**​​1\. People \& Culture** 



* Build and define Atomgrid’s culture from the ground up.
* Act as the cultural ambassador across teams.



  






 2\.
 
**Talent Acquisition \& Employer Branding** 



* Lead end\-to\-end hiring across business, R\&D, operations and manufacturing roles with speed and quality.
* Build a strong talent pipeline through direct sourcing, networks, and partnerships.
* Design and implement structured hiring processes, assessment frameworks, and strong candidate experience.
* Partner with founders and BU heads to close senior/critical roles within aggressive timelines.
* Build Atomgrid’s employer brand in chemicals and manufacturing talent markets.



  





**2\. HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Set up HR policies. Implement and run the HRMS system ( Keka )

**Qualifications** 



* 5–8 years of HR / people / culture  experience, ideally in a startup / growth\-stage company.

title: Director, Human Resources
description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
 Kobie, a 35\-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi\-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data\-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
   

  

**About The Team And What We'll Build Together**
 Kobie's Human Resources function in India is being built from the ground up as a strategic hub that will drive the teammate experience, culture, and operational excellence of our India Tech Hub. As Director, Human Resources, you are joining at a pivotal moment where you will establish the foundation for building a Top Workplace in India, one that mirrors Kobie's award\-winning culture in the US while honoring the unique needs and context of the Indian talent market and regulatory environment.
   

  

 You will report directly to the AVP, Human Resources (US\-based) and will own all people operations, compliance, and talent strategy for the India site. While you will work closely with the India Site Lead to operationalize their vision and priorities, your primary accountability is ensuring the India team experiences world\-class HR practices, clear career pathways, and a culture of belonging. You will partner with the India leadership team to bring forward their talent and organizational health concerns, and you will translate Kobie's US HR strategy into India\-specific initiatives that drive retention, engagement, and employer brand strength.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that requires strategic thinking paired with operational rigor. You will build HR policies and processes from the ground up, navigate Indian labor law and compliance, design competitive compensation and benefits, execute talent acquisition in the India market, and create the teammate experiences that make Kobie a destination employer. You will have one direct report, a Manager, Human Resources, and the opportunity to grow this team as India expands.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Lead design and launch of compliant, scalable HR policies, processes, and systems aligned with Kobie's global standards. Oversee implementation and ongoing refinement
* Own the complete teammate experience from recruitment through offboarding, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Kobie's values across onboarding, performance management, development, relations, and engagement
* Establish and drive India's talent strategy and recruitment roadmap in partnership with the India Site Lead and US HR leadership. Design a world\-class candidate experience that drives measurable satisfaction. Build and maintain strong pipeline and make final\-round hiring decisions
* Design and oversee India's compensation and benefits strategy, including market benchmarking, salary bands, incentives, and benefits packages that attract and retain top talent competitively and compliantly
* Build a cohesive organizational culture that instills purpose and belonging. Drive engagement initiatives, win celebrations, and recognition programs aligned with Kobie's core values
* Partner with the India Site Lead to operationalize strategic priorities: employer branding and communications, office operations and teammate programs, culture and organizational health, talent development, and cross\-functional collaboration
* Collaborate with India's leadership team to identify and address organizational health concerns (morale, retention, engagement, conflict). Provide guidance, coaching, and resources to help leaders develop their teams and navigate people challenges
* Establish and maintain HR compliance across all India operations: payroll, benefits, statutory requirements, leave management, and labor relations in adherence with Indian employment law and company policies
* Develop direct reports and build HR team capability. Identify learning and development opportunities, provide feedback and coaching, and foster a growth culture as India expands
* Partner with US HR functions to align India initiatives with global strategy while reflecting local needs. Collaborate on tools and processes implementation. Escalate decisions to the AVP, Human Resources
* Track HR metrics including headcount growth, retention rate, time\-to\-fill, quality of hire, offer acceptance rate, offer\-to\-join conversion rate, engagement survey results, and compliance status. Provide regular updates to US leadership and use data to inform continuous improvement
* Anticipate India site needs as the team grows and organization evolves. Identify gaps in processes, tools, or resources and propose solutions proactively. Demonstrate agility in response to changing business priorities
* Serve as the primary HR voice in US\-India leadership forums, communicating site health, opportunities, and challenges while maintaining global HR alignment


**Required**
**What You Need to Be Successful**
* 10\-12 years of HR experience, with a minimum of 5\-6 years in an HR leadership or senior management role overseeing multiple functions (HR Operations, Talent, Compliance, or equivalent scope)
* Deep expertise in Indian labor law, employment regulations, statutory compliance, and payroll/benefits administration. Demonstrated ability to navigate India's complex and evolving regulatory environment
* Proven track record designing and implementing HR policies, processes, and systems. Experience building HR infrastructure from the ground up in a scaling organization preferred
* Demonstrated expertise in compensation and benefits strategy, including market research, salary benchmarking, benefits design, and total rewards planning
* Strong talent acquisition and talent strategy expertise. Experience sourcing, recruiting, and retaining talent in competitive markets. Familiarity with India's tech and talent landscape a strong plus
* Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills. Ability to influence leaders at multiple levels, manage up effectively, and build cross\-functional alignment. Comfort with frequent check\-ins and asynchronous communication across time zones
* Strong people leadership and coaching skills. Ability to attract, develop, and retain HR talent. Experience building high\-performing teams in early\-stage or rapidly scaling environments
* Forward\-thinking and AI\-savvy. Comfort with emerging HR technologies and AI\-enabled tools. Ability to drive AI\-informed thinking and innovation in people practices


**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience in a startup or scale\-up environment where HR infrastructure was built or significantly expanded. Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities
* Experience with US reporting relationship and global HR alignment. Experience supporting international operations or managing cultural bridges between regions
* Proficiency with ADP and Lever
* Strong spreadsheet and data analysis skills


**About Kobie**
 Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth\-focused culture.
   

  

 As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy\-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award\-winning culture to a new region \- creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
   

  

 We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
   

  

 Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
   

  

 To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well\-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work \- recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work\-life balance.
   

  

 As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
   

  

 Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 Effective PMS framework implemented and continuously improved

 Clear, measurable and role\-specific Goal Sheets across departments

 management

description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Content Trainer role is part of a global training team that will develop, instruct, and inspire capability that leads to high performance across new associate's careers at Gracenote Operations. The role is hybrid, so you must live near a Nielsen office. Hybrid Workers are employees who work partially from home which is in the same city as the Nielsen office they are employed with and partially from a Nielsen office / site. Training will support trainees across global timezones including India, Mexico, US, and Europe.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Facilitate virtual training plans through exceptional communication and time management skills to ensure learners are well\-prepared for the role.
* Establish training alignment with managers through confident coaching and clear expectations.
* This is a time\-adjusted role, and you must be available to work in alignment with the US Eastern timezone. Ready to work in a 24/7 operation, including morning and evening shifts.
* Utilizes multiple and blended training modalities including (but not limited to) coaching, virtual classroom training/ facilitation, 1\-on\-1 sessions, action learning \& e\-learning to create the requisite learning impact.
* Actively involved in supporting employees throughout the employee lifecycle.
* Responsible for staying current on policies \& procedures, knowledge \& skills relative to Nielsen strategy, values \& direction.
* Quickly assess the strengths and needs of their trainees and adjust the training to accommodate the learner’s needs while staying true to the learning design \& objectives.
* Model positive behaviors and set clear expectations for training, while motivating, providing counsel, and following up with trainees.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts to ensure training content is current, accurate, and consistent.
* Openly and respectfully engage in all discussions about training issues; provide solution\-based input and make logical recommendations.
* Positively identify learning comprehension and relay information to the hiring manager to create awareness and ongoing training plans


**Qualifications**
* 2\-5 years of relevant training or coaching experience
* 2\+ years of experience developing/mentoring others
* Highly proficient in speaking and writing English
* Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technology within a learning environment
* Demonstrated ability to, anticipate and address risks, and consistently meet deadlines
* Demonstrated rapport\-building, relationship, and collaboration skills
* Proven ability to work effectively with diverse individuals of all levels
* Strong project management experience, must be able to self\-manage and prioritize projects with little supervision
* Instructional Design or Rich Media experience a plus


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

 We are excited to be recruiting on behalf of Intralink, an international business development and innovation consultancy that specializes in helping companies expand into global markets. **Finance \& HR Manager, Intralink India** 




**Background** 




 Are you someone who enjoys bringing structure, clarity and financial discipline to a fast\-moving, international work environment?
 



  





 Do you thrive at the intersection of finance and people operations?
 



  





 And, do you want to play a pivotal role in supporting a globally connected consulting firm as it grows its footprint in India?
 



  





 If that’s yes, yes and yes, you may be who we are looking for to join our team.
 



  





 Intralink is a global business development consultancy specialising in international markets. With over 25 offices worldwide and more than 200 multilingual professionals, we support companies across technology, industrial, consumer and sustainability\-driven sectors to expand internationally.
 



  





 As we continue to grow our India presence, we are looking for a Finance \& HR Manager to take ownership of the India office’s financial operations, HR administration and broader office management. You’ll report directly to the India Managing Director and work closely with our UK headquarters, playing a trusted role in ensuring smooth, compliant and efficient operations on the ground.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing** 




 You’ll be responsible for managing the financial health and HR operations of Intralink’s India office.
 



 Acting as a key point of contact between local operations and UK headquarters, you’ll ensure robust financial controls, accurate reporting, and seamless coordination with external partners.
 



  





**Accounting \& Finance** 




 In your day\-to\-day, you’ll manage daily bank operations, oversee staff expense claims and reimbursements, and monitor expenditure against approved budgets. You’ll prepare and report monthly management accounts to headquarters, support annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting, and provide sound financial advice to the India Managing Director.
 



  





 You’ll coordinate closely with vendors, external accountants and auditors on GST, manage corporate income tax filings and statutory audits, assist in implementing standard accounting policies, and ensure all financial records are properly maintained. You’ll also manage locally issued client invoices, credit control processes, and staff severance and pension arrangements where applicable.
 



  





**HR \& Payroll Support** 




 You’ll support core HR operations including payroll processing, withholding tax filings and year\-end tax settlements. This will include assisting with staff onboarding and offboarding, benefits enrolment, annual health insurance renewals and responding to employee queries related to salaries and administrative matters.
 



  





 You’ll maintain accurate personnel and leave records, support recruitment\-related logistics such as interviews or job fairs when required, provide documentation for staff visas, and organise mandatory annual training or health check\-ups. Ensuring HR compliance and supporting ad\-hoc people\-related initiatives will also form part of your role.
 



  





 You’ll also stay aware of changes to Indian labour laws to ensure ongoing compliance and help organise board meetings on a quarterly basis.
 



  





**What you’ll be getting** 




 ● Competitive and negotiable salary, depending on experience
 



 ● 20 days of paid annual leave per year
 



 ● Health insurance coverage
 



 ● A multinational working environment with close collaboration across global offices
 



 ● Exposure to international business operations and senior stakeholders
 



 ● A trusted, high\-impact role supporting leadership and business growth in India
 



  





**What you’ll need** 




 • 5\+ years of relevant work experience in accounting or finance, strongly preferred
 



 • Hands\-on experience with accounting systems (NetSuite experience highly desirable)
 



 • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls and administrative procedures
 



 • Solid understanding of office management systems and HR administration
 



 • Excellent organisational, planning and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail
 



 • Ability to prioritise effectively and work independently in a fast\-paced environment
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
 



 • Advanced spoken and written English skills
 



 • Native or fluent Hindi
 



  





 This position is based in India and will require regular interaction with Intralink’s UK headquarters and local stakeholders.
 



 Please submit a CV and Cover Letter detailing your experience and motivations for applying to this role.

**Company:** 

 DIYguru Mobility Pvt. Ltd.
 




**Industry:** 

 Electric Vehicles (EV), Mobility \& Skill Development
 




**Department:** 

 Corporate Relations \& Placements
 




**Location:** 

 Delhi – Sultanpur / Noida
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Internship
 




**Education:** 

 MBA/PGDM preferred; graduates from Operations, Marketing, HR, Engineering or related backgrounds may apply.
 




**Duration:** 

 6 Months internship for fresher /Full time for experienced candidates 
 




  





**About DIYguru** 




  






 DIYguru is India’s leading platform for
 
**upskilling students and professionals in Electric Vehicles (EV) and future mobility** 

 . We are focused on bridging the industry skill gap through
 
**hands\-on, industry\-relevant learning experiences** 

 that prepare individuals for emerging career opportunities across EV, battery technology, automotive electronics, connected mobility and sustainable transportation.
 





 Through our industry\-focused programs, corporate partnerships, placement initiatives and practical learning ecosystem, DIYguru connects
 
**education, industry and employment** 

 to build a future\-ready workforce for the rapidly evolving mobility sector.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




  






 We are looking for an energetic, organized and communication\-focused Corporate Relations Intern to support our corporate relations, placement and industry partnership activities.
 





 This role is ideal for a fresher who wants practical exposure to Corporate Relations, HR, Business Development, Industry Partnerships and Placement Management. You will work directly on company research, lead generation, corporate outreach, hiring coordination, candidate mapping and relationship management.
 





 The role involves regular communication with HR professionals, recruiters, hiring managers, colleges and candidates, making it a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys networking, research, follow\-ups and building professional relationships.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Corporate Research \& Lead Generation** 



* Research companies hiring across EV, automotive, manufacturing, engineering, software, electronics, battery, mobility and related sectors.
* Identify HR, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment and relevant business POCs.
* Build and maintain a structured corporate database.
* Identify companies suitable for DIYguru's placement and hiring ecosystem.
* Research company hiring patterns, locations, job roles and manpower requirements.
* Generate new corporate leads through LinkedIn, company career pages, industry networks and referrals



  





**2\. Corporate Outreach \& Follow\-ups** 



* Contact HRs, recruiters and hiring managers through email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and calls.
* Introduce DIYguru's training, placement and industry ecosystem.
* Understand corporate manpower requirements and hiring needs.
* Schedule meetings with relevant corporate stakeholders.
* Conduct timely and professional follow\-ups with prospects.
* Maintain an updated status for every corporate lead.



  





**3\. Placement \& Hiring Coordination** 



* Collect and understand Job Descriptions received from companies.
* Support candidate mapping against company requirements.
* Coordinate resume/profile sharing with corporate partners.
* Support interviews, assessments and hiring drives.
* Maintain interview schedules and candidate status.
* Follow up with candidates and companies until the hiring process is completed.
* Support OJT, internship, placement drives and Recruitathons.



  





**4\. Employer \& Industry Relationship Support** 



* Maintain professional relationships with HRs and recruiters.
* Capture and communicate company feedback to the internal team.
* Track repeat hiring opportunities from existing corporate relationships.
* Identify opportunities for long\-term corporate partnerships and MoUs.
* Support the Corporate Relations team in building a strong employer network.



  





**5\. College \& Placement Cell Outreach** 



* Research colleges, universities, ITIs, diploma institutions and engineering institutes.
* Identify TPOs, placement officers, HODs and relevant institutional contacts.
* Support outreach for placement collaborations, hiring drives, Recruitathons and industry programs.
* Build and maintain college databases and communication records.



  





**6\. MIS, CRM \& Documentation** 



* Maintain corporate, candidate and college databases.
* Update lead status, follow\-up dates, requirements and outcomes.
* Prepare daily and weekly MIS reports.
* Track pending follow\-ups and ensure leads are not missed.
* Maintain accurate records of corporate requirements, candidate mapping and hiring activities.



  





**7\. Required Qualifications** 



* Graduate in HR, Marketing, Management, Engineering or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM is preferred.
* Freshers and candidates seeking internship experience are encouraged to apply.
* **Strong interest in Corporate Relations, HR, Recruitment or the EV industry.**



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Confidence in speaking with HRs and professionals
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building ability
* Research and lead\-generation skills
* Good LinkedIn usage and professional networking ability
* Professional email and WhatsApp communication
* Basic Excel/Google Sheets knowledge
* Strong organization and time\-management skills
* Willingness to make professional calls
* Ability to handle rejection positively



  





**Good\-to\-Have Skills** 



* Prior internship in HR, Sales or Corporate Relations
* Experience with CRM or lead\-management tools
* Understanding of recruitment and placement processes
* Knowledge of the EV, automotive or mobility industry
* Basic understanding of LinkedIn prospecting



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  






 The ideal candidate is proactive, confident, curious and comfortable communicating with new people. You should be willing to pick up the phone, conduct research, send professional messages, follow up consistently and take ownership of assigned leads.
 





 You should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change and results depend on consistent execution. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with a learning mindset, professional attitude, accountability and genuine interest in building an industry network.
 




  





**Key Performance Expectations** 



* Build and continuously update a high\-quality corporate prospect database.
* Generate and qualify relevant corporate leads on a regular basis.
* Maintain consistent follow\-ups and accurate lead\-status tracking.
* Support timely candidate mapping and hiring coordination against company JDs.
* Maintain professional communication with corporate and institutional stakeholders.
* Contribute to developing new corporate and institutional relationships for DIYguru.



  





**Why Join DIYguru?** 



* EV \& Future Mobility Exposure: Work closely with companies and professionals across the growing EV and mobility ecosystem.
* Industry\-Focused Learning: Gain practical exposure to corporate hiring, placements and industry partnerships.
* Real Corporate Projects: Work on live company requirements, hiring drives, Recruitathons and partnership initiatives.
* Cross\-Functional Exposure: Learn how HR, Business Development, Corporate Relations and Placement functions work together.
* Career Growth: Build practical skills and professional networks that can support a long\-term career in Corporate Relations, HR, Recruitment or Business Development.



  





**Application Process** 





 Interested candidates can apply by sharing their updated resume at
 
 hr@diyguru.org
 






 Candidates should highlight relevant internships, projects, communication experience, activities, HR exposure or professional networking experience.
 





 Join DIYguru and gain hands\-on experience at the intersection of EV, industry, education and employment.
