 CTC - 3 -3.5 LPA About Aptara Aptara is a global provider of digital content, learning, publishing, content transformation, and technology-enabled solutions, with more than three decades of experience and a corporate history dating back to 1988. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, USA, Aptara has a global presence across four continents with 6,000+ professionals, serving leading organizations including Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies and major global publishers. Aptara offers end-to-end solutions across Digital Learning, Corporate Learning & Performance, K-20 Education, Publishing & Content Conversion, Data Management, Compliance & Regulatory Reporting, and Global Support Services. With a strong focus on innovation, technology, quality, information security, and continuous improvement, Aptara helps global organizations transform their content, learning, and digital experiences at scale. About the Role Aptara is looking for an experienced HR Generalist with 2+ years of relevant experience who has strong hands-on exposure to HR Operations, Payroll, Statutory Compliance, Labour Laws, Employee Relations, and HR Processes . The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day HR activities across the employee lifecycle while independently handling key aspects of monthly payroll, statutory compliances, employee documentation, attendance and leave administration, HR MIS, and employee queries . The role requires a well-rounded HR professional who can effectively manage both people-oriented HR operations and process-driven payroll and compliance activities . The candidate should have practical knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory requirements, payroll processes, employee lifecycle management, and HR policies. The candidate should also be capable of coordinating with Finance, Administration, business stakeholders, employees, and external statutory consultants/agencies to ensure smooth and compliant HR operations. Key Responsibilities 1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Manage day-to-day HR operations and employee lifecycle activities. Handle employee onboarding, documentation, induction, transfers, promotions, salary revisions, and exit formalities. Ensure timely completion of joining and exit documentation. Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, HR databases, and employee master data. Manage attendance, leave, regularization, and related employee records. Address employee queries related to HR policies, attendance, leave, payroll, benefits, and statutory deductions. Coordinate with employees, managers, Finance, Administration, and other internal stakeholders for HR-related requirements. Ensure HR processes and policies are implemented consistently across the organization. Support employee engagement initiatives and other HR activities as required. Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information. 2. Payroll Management Coordinate and manage the end-to-end monthly payroll process in coordination with Finance/payroll partners. Collect, validate, and consolidate payroll inputs including: Attendance and leave LOP New joiners Exits and full & final settlements Salary revisions Incentives and variable pay Overtime Arrears Reimbursements Deductions Validate payroll data and identify discrepancies before payroll processing. Ensure accurate calculation of salary components, deductions, statutory contributions, and net salary. Coordinate with Finance/Accounts for timely salary processing. Ensure timely submission and processing of payroll inputs within defined timelines. Handle employee queries related to salary, deductions, attendance, leave, and statutory contributions. Support payroll reconciliation and resolution of payroll discrepancies. Maintain payroll-related records and documentation. Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of employee compensation information. 3. Statutory Compliance Manage and monitor applicable HR and payroll statutory compliances . Ensure timely calculation, payment, reconciliation, and filing of statutory contributions and returns. Coordinate and maintain compliance related to: Provident Fund (PF/EPF) Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Professional Tax (PT) Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) Gratuity Bonus TDS on Salary Minimum Wages Working Hours and Overtime Leave and Holidays Maintain statutory challans, returns, registers, declarations, and supporting documents. Maintain statutory compliance calendars and trackers. Coordinate with external consultants/agencies wherever applicable. Support internal and external audits and provide required HR/statutory documentation. Identify compliance gaps and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure statutory records and employee documentation are maintained accurately and are readily available when required. 4. Labour Laws & Wage Compliance Possess practical knowledge of applicable Indian labour laws and employment regulations . Ensure HR processes and payroll practices are aligned with applicable statutory requirements. Monitor applicable minimum wage rates based on location, employee category, and employment type. Ensure compliance related to: Minimum wages Payment of wages Deductions from wages Working hours Overtime Leave and holidays Bonus Gratuity Social security Employee welfare Review salary structures and payroll components from a statutory-compliance perspective. Monitor regulatory notifications, amendments, and circulars relevant to HR and payroll. Support implementation of changes arising from applicable labour-law requirements. 5. Employee Relations & HR Support Act as a point of contact for employees regarding HR policies, processes, benefits, attendance, leave, payroll, and general HR queries. Support managers in addressing employee-related matters and HR processes. Assist in resolving employee grievances in a timely and professional manner. Maintain proper documentation of employee-related cases and actions. Support disciplinary and employee relations processes in coordination with HR management. Promote consistent application of HR policies and processes. Maintain professional and confidential communication while handling sensitive employee matters. 6. HR Policies & Process Management Support the development, implementation, and periodic review of HR policies and processes. Ensure HR policies are communicated effectively to employees. Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to enhance HR efficiency. Ensure HR processes are aligned with organizational requirements and applicable statutory regulations. Maintain HR process documentation and standard operating procedures. 7. HR MIS, Reporting & Documentation Prepare and maintain HR MIS, reports, trackers, and dashboards as required. Maintain accurate records related to: Headcount Attrition Attendance Leave Payroll Employee movements Compliance Recruitment and joining data Generate periodic HR reports for management review. Maintain employee documentation and ensure data accuracy across HR systems. Support audits, management reviews, and other reporting requirements. 8. Labour Codes & Regulatory Updates Stay updated on relevant developments in Indian labour laws and employment regulations. Maintain awareness of applicable provisions under: Code on Wages Code on Social Security Industrial Relations Code Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code Monitor applicable Central and State-level rules, notifications, amendments, and regulatory updates. Assess the potential impact of relevant regulatory changes on HR processes, payroll, and employee policies. Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders and consultants for implementation of applicable changes. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in HR Generalist / HR Operations roles. Strong hands-on experience in HR Operations, Payroll, Statutory Compliance, and Labour Laws . Practical knowledge of PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Gratuity, Bonus, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements. Good understanding of Indian labour laws and wage-related compliance. Hands-on exposure to monthly payroll processing and payroll validation. Strong knowledge of attendance, leave, employee lifecycle, and HR documentation processes. Experience in handling employee queries and employee relations. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong MS Excel skills and experience working with HRMS/payroll systems. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to handle confidential employee information with discretion. Ability to manage multiple HR activities and meet statutory and payroll deadlines. Preferred Experience Experience in a corporate / IT / ITES / BPO / eLearning / publishing / services environment . Experience handling payroll for a mid-to-large employee population. Experience coordinating with payroll/statutory consultants and Finance teams. Exposure to HR audits and statutory inspections. Experience in preparing HR MIS and management reports. Exposure to HRMS and payroll platforms. Ability to independently manage HR operations while working closely with HR leadership.

title: Head - HR , Dredging & Harbour Businesses
description:
Purpose/Objective 
 
End to end responsibility of building a world-class organization & be accountable for building a dynamic work culture and ensure best-in-class people systems and processes that builds a highly competent organization for all its stakeholders.
 Plan, lead, direct, develop, and coordinate the policies, activities, ensuring legal compliance and implementation of the organization's mission and talent strategy.
 Champion company’s values through strong leadership and inspirational behaviour.
 Key Responsibilities of Role 
 
Key Accountabilities HR Strategy, Systems and Processes- Design and implement the HR strategy of the organization structure to support the CEO to successfully set up and scale the organization.
 - Collaborates with CEO to understand the organization's goals and strategy related to staffing, recruiting, and retention.
 - Partner with the CEO and leadership to foster a culture of openness and performance conducive for a workforce from multiple geographies in India & overseas.
 - Develop & monitor departmental Budget.
 Talent Acquisition and Compensation & Benefits- Lead the buildout of the organization through the onboarding of quality talent across levels in line with the business plan - Own responsibility of recruitment, assessment, onboarding, and assimilation of candidates across levels - Partner with Business HR and external consultants to ensure a fair and competitive compensation and benefits policy for employees.
 - Manage pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
 - Ensuring no stoppage of work on account of non-availability of critical manpower, especially under contractual obligation.
 Talent Management and Learning & Organization Development- Design framework for learning & development, organization development, talent management and employee engagement.
 - Design and institutionalize HR effectiveness measures across people development and organization development.
 - Drive employee engagement measures given the nature of workforce and the difference in base location between several employees and their managers.
 - Work on managing expectations of key talent and driving development through customized interventions as well as through existing group level interventions.
 - Maintain work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
 - Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counseling employees and supervisor.
 - Drive Performance Management process by way of sharper Goal setting - Continuous Feedback - fair assessment of achievements and bring meritocracy in promotions/career growth - Drive Strive of employees & performance of organization at Overall as well as at Individual, team & Business Unit levels linking rewards to Performance - Strong Succession Planning is in place ensuring no work stoppage.
 People development- Provide leadership and support to the team and ensure adequate development opportunities for team members to enhance technical skills and behavioral competencies - Participate in the recruitment process to identify the right talent for key leadership position in the company - Establish individual performance expectations and regularly review individual performance of the team Industrial Relations- Collaborate with BU HR and assist in formulation of labour relations, specific IR tactical plans and strategic matters - Oversee mechanisms to closely monitor IR health and ensure adherence to statutory compliances - Keep track of all the labour related legal compliances [changes/amendments] in the field of marine services and appraise concerned stakeholder and take required action.
 Administration - Lead, oversee, and direct the staff responsible for administrative services - Management of office properties – Offices, Guest House & other fixed assets - Budget, Monitoring & Control of Admin services General- Conduct research and analysis of organizational trends including review of reports and metrics from the organization's human resource information system - Maintain knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and new technologies in human resources, talent management, and employment law; apply this knowledge to communicate changes in policy, practice, and resources to upper management.
 - Cultivate professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies Technical Competencies 
 
Organizational Design ,Talent Acquisition, Performance & Talent Management, Capability Building ,Employee Relations & IR,HR Operations and Technology Qualifications and Experience 
 
Role-holder Requirements Qualification MBA/PG in HR – Full Time Experience 15+ years of experience across all areas of HR is required Expertise in manufacturing organizations or marine services organisation is preferred Strong stakeholder management experience with a multicultural context in a manufacturing or marine services organization Technical Competencies Organizational Design Talent Acquisition, Performance & Talent Management, Capability Building Culture & Change Management, Total Rewards Employee Relations & IR HR Operations and Technology Behavioural / Managerial / Leadership Competencies Strategic Orientation Entrepreneurial Mindset Stakeholder Partnering Transformational Mindset Outcome Orientation

title: HR Executive
description:
HR Executive – Jewellery Industry

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 3–6 years  
**Salary:** ₹80,000 – ₹90,000 per month  
**Industry:** Jewellery / Retail / Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **HR Executive** with a strong background in the **jewellery industry** to manage and support HR operations for our Mumbai\-based organization. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in recruitment, employee relations, attendance \& payroll coordination, HR policies, and general HR administration.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations and employee lifecycle activities.
* Handle **end\-to\-end recruitment** for retail, corporate, sales, manufacturing, and support functions.
* Source and screen candidates through job portals, references, consultants, and other channels.
* Coordinate interviews, selection, offer letters, joining formalities, and onboarding.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, leave, and personnel documentation.
* Coordinate with the accounts/payroll team for **salary processing, payroll inputs, incentives, and deductions**.
* Handle employee grievances and maintain positive employee relations.
* Implement and communicate HR policies, procedures, and company guidelines.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, leave, and employee discipline.
* Support performance appraisal and employee engagement activities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory HR requirements.
* Prepare HR reports, MIS, and management updates.
* Coordinate with department heads regarding manpower requirements and HR\-related matters.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in **HR, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* **3–6 years of HR experience**, preferably in the jewellery industry.
* Strong knowledge of **jewellery retail/manufacturing HR practices** will be preferred.
* Experience in recruitment, payroll coordination, employee relations, attendance, and HR administration.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Excel and HRMS.
* Should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced business environment.
* Candidates currently based in **Mumbai or nearby areas** will be preferred.

What We Offer

* **Salary: ₹80,000 – ₹90,000 per month**, depending on experience and suitability.
* Opportunity to work with an established jewellery business.
* Professional growth and career development opportunities.
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

**To Apply:** Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and total years of experience.

Pay: ₹80,000\.00 \- ₹90,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Manager/ Manager - HR Recruitment
description:
**Company Description** 
 Royaloak is India’s premier furniture brand, recognized as a market leader with an extensive range of products at competitive prices. Founded by brothers Vijai and Mathan Subramaniam, who bring over 25 years of industry experience, the company focuses on “International furniture, Elevating Lifestyles.” Its signature Country Collections feature designs inspired by America, Italy, Turkey, Malaysia, India, and other global influences, curated by in\-house designers. Royaloak combines affordable international luxury with an expansive network of 200\+ stores across India and offers a one\-year warranty on manufacturing defects on most items. Applicants can learn more about the brand and its products at royaloakindia.com or by visiting one of the many retail locations.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru for an Assistant Manager/Manager – HR Recruitment. The role involves managing end\-to\-end recruitment processes, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding talent for various functions and levels. The person in this position will collaborate closely with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements, develop job descriptions, and ensure timely closure of open positions. Daily responsibilities include maintaining and updating recruitment metrics, managing candidate databases and HRIS records, coordinating interview schedules, and supporting employer branding initiatives. The role may also involve assisting with HR operations, benefits coordination, and training\-related activities to support overall HR effectiveness.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong experience in recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) and related HR tools for managing candidate and employee data.
* Candidates should possess knowledge on various sourcing mechanism to develop future pipelines.
* Candidates should have experience in campus hiring, other hiring platforms, and must have the ability to develop leads on his/her own.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in retail, FMCG, QSR, Food sectors is beneficial.
* Ability to handle multiple requisitions, work with tight timelines, and maintain a high level of accuracy and integrity in HR processes.

description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being India's most successful D2C food\-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de\-licious fresh meat and seafood! Think you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious? Read on...
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Director HRBP (Tech) will own the people agenda for Licious' Product, Analytics, Engineering and Data teams, a span of roughly 200 people building the technology that powers India's most loved meat and seafood brand. You will own the full HRBP charter for Tech: raising the talent bar, lifting talent density, shaping how people experience Licious every day and building the leadership ecosystem this company will need as it scales. Alongside the HRBP mandate you will own a critical COE charter for the wider organisation, with Performance Management being a strong possibility, giving you the chance to shape practice well beyond your own business unit.
 



  





 This role demands someone who is equally at home in a leadership review and in a 1:1 with an engineer two weeks into the job. Tech at Licious is growing fast, the environment moves quickly and the answers are rarely sitting in a playbook. You will need to think like a business leader, build credibility quickly with a sharp and analytical set of stakeholders, use data as your default language and be comfortable building things from scratch, iterating in the open and holding your point of view when it matters.
 



  





**Have you got an awesome appetite for?** 




  





**Talent Bar and Talent Density** 



* Raising the talent bar across Product, Analytics, Engineering and Data by partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition on role design, calibration and interview rigour.
* Building a clear and honest view of talent density across the function: knowing where the strength sits, where the gaps are and what it will take to close them.
* Driving internal development, mobility and succession so critical roles have credible internal successors and not only external pipelines.
* Owning workforce planning for Tech, keeping headcount, skills and structure aligned to the product and engineering roadmap.



**Employee Experience and Org Connectedness** 



* Shaping how people experience Licious through continuous listening: surveys, skip levels, focus groups and the informal channels that surface the real signal.
* Building belonging across product and engineering pods so people feel part of one org and one mission rather than a set of separate teams.
* Translating listening data into action plans with named owners, clear timelines and follow through people can actually see.
* Partnering on rituals, forums and communication that keep Tech connected to the business, the consumer and the food.



**Leadership Ecosystem and Capability Building** 



* Building the leadership ecosystem Licious needs to execute and scale: identifying, developing and coaching managers and senior leaders across Tech.
* Coaching leaders through team design, difficult conversations, performance calls and their own growth.
* Partnering with L\&D to build manager capability, so first time managers and experienced leaders both get what they need.
* Keeping the organisation transformation ready by anticipating structure, capability and culture needs ahead of time rather than reacting to them.



**COE Ownership** 



* Owning a company wide COE mandate alongside the HRBP charter, with Performance Management being a strong possibility.
* Building or reshaping the performance philosophy, cycle design, calibration approach and the manager enablement that has to go with it.
* Driving adoption across business units, holding a consistent bar and making the process something managers find genuinely useful.
* Measuring the impact of the COE charter through data and improving it every cycle.



**Business Partnership and Culture** 



* Partnering with Tech leadership as a real thought partner on org design, capability, culture and business priorities.
* Driving culture as an outcome rather than a slogan: making Licious values visible in how decisions get made, how feedback travels and how people are recognised.
* Using people data to spot attrition risk, engagement dips and structural issues early, and bringing solutions rather than dashboards.
* Handling employee relations and sensitive matters with fairness, speed and discretion.



  





**We hope that you have..** 



* Bring 10 to 14 years of HR experience with strong HRBP depth, including meaningful time partnering Product, Engineering, Analytics or Data teams.
* Have owned an HRBP charter for a span of 150 people or more, ideally in a high growth consumer tech, ecommerce or product led environment.
* Bring real COE experience, ideally Performance Management, whether that meant building a framework from scratch or fixing one that had stopped working.
* Have a clear point of view on talent density and can talk specifically about how you raised the bar, what changed as a result and what it cost you to get there.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and leadership transitions, and can hold a team steady while the org around it is still taking shape.
* Have used listening mechanisms seriously: you know how to run them, how to read what they are really saying and how to convert them into visible action.
* Are data fluent and can build a case with numbers in a room full of analytical people who will ask you exactly where the number came from.
* Are a credible coach to senior leaders and can push back on a founder or a function head without damaging the relationship.
* Bring a strong bias for execution: you build, ship, measure and improve instead of waiting for the perfect plan.
* Are excited about building the people engine for a brand that is changing how India eats, and are ready to be hands on to do it.

title: Assistant Manager – HR / Executive PS
company: Electronics Corporation of Tamil Nadu Limited (ELCOT)
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Electronics Corporation of Tamil Nadu Limited (ELCOT) is a Government of Tamil Nadu undertaking under the Information Technology and Digital Services Department. ELCOT promotes IT investment in the state, builds technology infrastructure such as IT Parks and data centres, leads large\-scale IT procurement for Government, and supports emerging technology sectors including AI and AVGC\-XR.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





**Assistant Manager – HR:** 




 The role involves handling HR, establishment, and service\-related matters in accordance with ELCOT's HR policies, Government Orders, applicable Service Rules, and organisational procedures. Responsibilities include supporting recruitment, engagement, deployment, transfer, promotion, probation, leave, attendance, deputation, retirement, and employee separation processes; coordinating staff welfare activities; processing employee representations; preparing official correspondence and HR documentation; and coordinating with Government Departments, PSUs, and other agencies on HR and administrative matters.
 



  





**Executive PS:** 




 The role provides effective personal secretary and executive support to senior management officials. Responsibilities include managing official correspondence, scheduling appointments and meetings, coordinating official engagements and visits, maintaining confidential records and documents, preparing agenda and briefing materials, recording meeting minutes where required, communicating decisions, and monitoring follow\-up actions.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution; and
* MBA / Post Graduate Degree / Post Graduate Diploma in Human Resources / Personnel Management / Human Resource Management or equivalent qualification from a recognized University/Institution.
* Proficiency in computer applications, particularly MS Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and office productivity/digital communication tools.
* Additional qualification/certification in Human Resource Management, Labour Laws, Personnel Administration, Office Administration or Secretarial Practice.
* Knowledge of Government/PSU establishment and personnel procedures, Service Rules, Government Orders and administrative practices.
* Knowledge of Tamil and English with good drafting and communication ability in English.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Preferably 3–8 years of relevant post\-qualification experience in Human Resources, personnel/establishment administration, executive assistance or related areas.
* Experience in Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings, statutory bodies, Government organizations or reputed corporate organizations would be desirable.
* Preference may be given to candidates having experience in a combined HR and Personal Secretary / Executive Assistant role, including independent handling of official correspondence, meeting coordination and personnel matters.



  





**Skils** 




  




* Strong official drafting, noting and communication skills.
* Sound understanding of HR, personnel and establishment administration.
* Strong executive assistance and secretarial coordination skills.
* Ability to organize meetings, maintain schedules and ensure timely follow\-up of decisions/action points.
* Ability to prepare official notes, proceedings, correspondence, reports, MIS and presentations.
* Good analytical, organizational and documentation skills.
* High level of integrity, discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive personnel and management matters.
* Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and work within prescribed timelines.
* Good interpersonal and coordination skills for dealing with employees, senior officials, Government Departments and other stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office, digital office applications and HR/administrative information systems.
* Ability to work independently and provide timely support to Senior Management.

title: Assistant Manager - HR (PMS & Digitalization)
description:
**Primary Purpose:** 




 To design and drive holistic Total Rewards, Performance Management, HR Digitalisation, and Employee Engagement strategies that align people performance with organisational goals.
 



 The role exists to build a high\-performance and digitally enabled culture by integrating rewards, recognition, and engagement initiatives that attract, motivate, and retain talent while supporting Brakes India’s growth and capability\-building objectives.
 



  





**Essential Job Functions:** 



* End\-to\-End Performance Management
* HR Digitalisation (SAP SuccessFactors Implementation \& Governance)
* Rewards \& Recognition Framework and Execution
* Special HR Initiatives
* Job Evaluation
* Employee Wellbeing \& Workplace Experience



  





**Job Functions:** 




  





**End\-to\-End Performance Management:** 




**Planning and Execution** 



* Lead the full Performance Development and Appraisal process, from goal sheet rollout to increment communication.



**Operations Excellence** 




 Coordinate review cycles, data validation, and cross\-check increments and promotion lists
 



  





**HR Digitalisation (SAP SuccessFactors Implementation \& Governance):** 




**Operations Excellence, People Enabling \& Collaboration** 



* Drive the implementation of SAP SuccessFactors modules \- PMS and Employee core.
* Coordinate with IT and implementation partners for AS\-IS documentation, data migration, and testing.
* Conduct UAT cycles and training for end users.



  





**Rewards \& Recognition Framework and Execution** 




**Planning, Resource Allocation and Execution** 



* Plan, schedule, and oversee the periodic roll\-out of all organisation\-wide awards as per the annual recognition calendar.
* Coordinate the end\-to\-end execution of awards, including nominations, validation, approvals, and announcement.
* Design and introduce new award categories to recognise emerging priorities such as innovation, collaboration, and customer excellence.
* Define eligibility criteria, nomination guidelines, and selection frameworks for each award category, ensuring transparency and fairness.
* Maintain dashboard of participation and recognition coverage.



  





**Special Initiatives** 




**Innovation, People Enabling \& Collaboration** 



* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to conceptualise, plan, and execute HR and organisation\-wide special initiatives that strengthen employee experience and process efficiency.
* Monitor and review initiatives such as the Buddy System and HR Council to ensure continued implementation and participation
* Consistently engage with external facilitators, trainers, and partners to organise Knowledge\-Sharing Sessions (KSS) that enhance learning and employee engagement outcomes.
* Design and administer employee satisfaction and perception surveys, analysing responses to identify key trends, improvement areas, and actionable insights in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Measure effectiveness and impact of engagement and special initiatives through defined KPIs and feedback mechanisms, presenting findings to leadership for continuous improvement.



  





**Job Evaluation** 




**Operations Excellence** 



* Conduct systematic job evaluations across all functions and levels using established frameworks.
* Partner with functional heads and HR teams to review job descriptions and role grading for internal equity and external competitiveness.
* Maintain and update the organisation’s job catalogue, ensuring consistency between job levels, titles, and compensation bands.
* Provide inputs to Total Rewards for pay structure design and benchmarking.
* Support periodic audits and role rationalisation exercises for alignment with business changes.



  





**Employee Wellbeing \& Workplace Experience** 




**People Enabling \& Collaboration** 



* Design and oversee wellbeing initiatives that support physical, emotional, and financial health of employees.
* Coordinate health and wellness programs (medical check\-ups, mental wellbeing workshops, insurance renewals, ergonomic drives).
* Develop communication plans to promote awareness and participation in wellbeing initiatives.
* Track participation, feedback, and impact metrics for continuous improvement.

title: Senior HRBP
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an HR Business Partner for India, you'll work closely with the Director of People – APAC to support our Bangalore based teams through a period of rapid growth. You will enable leaders to achieve their business goals through their people \- building the capacity of the organization to attract, develop, and retain talent while ensuring every decision holds up against India's statutory and regulatory framework.
   

  

 This role combines strategic HRBP partnership with hands\-on ownership of India\-specific compliance, employee relations, and operational rigor. You'll be a trusted advisor to business leaders and a steady, empathetic presence for employees, while working closely with Payroll \& Compliance, Talent Acquisition, and Total Rewards to deliver a consistent employee experience.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Business Partnership
   

  

* Conduct regular cadence meetings with your assigned business unit(s), acting as the primary People point of contact for leaders and employees.
* Provide compensation and leveling guidance to business unit leaders, in partnership with Total Rewards, anchored to India market benchmarks and internal equity.
* Analyze workforce trends and metrics \- attrition, hiring, promotions, engagement \- in partnership with the People Operations team to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
* Drive business unit organizational design and talent strategy to achieve business objectives, including headcount planning and role scoping.


 Employee Relations \& Compliance
   

  

* Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues; conduct thorough, objective, and well\-documented investigations.
* Maintain in\-depth, current knowledge of Indian labor law \- including the Shops and Establishments Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, POSH Act, and the New Labour Codes as they come into force \- to reduce legal risk and ensure regulatory compliance across Karnataka and any other state of operation.
* Partner with Payroll \& HR Compliance and external legal counsel as needed on statutory matters, notices, and filings.
* Own or contribute to background verification (BGV) exception handling and RAG\-based risk assessment for your business unit, in line with company policy.
* Provide day\-to\-day performance management guidance to managers \- coaching, counseling, career development, and disciplinary action \- consistent with Indian employment norms and documentation standards.
* Work closely with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Provide HR policy guidance and interpretation, flagging gaps between global policy and India\-specific legal requirements.


 Talent, Training \& Culture
   

  

* Identify training needs for business units and individual coaching needs for people managers; monitor and follow up on training and upskilling objectives.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for your business unit, partnering with Onboarding \& Ops on a smooth, compliant employee lifecycle.
* Gather and report on metrics related to retention, promotion, hiring, and diversity for your client group.
* Help build and refine India People Ops systems and processes \- you'll help write a policy when one doesn't yet exist.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience as an HRBP, with a strong point of view on how HRBPs move a business forward; experience at a fast\-growing technology or insurance company is a plus.
* In\-depth working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance \- PF, ESI, gratuity, statutory bonus, Karnataka Shops \& Establishments Act, and the New Labour Codes. Prior exposure to a multi\-state India compliance footprint is a strong plus.
* Experience managing complex employee relations cases, including conducting investigations and resolving disputes; experience partnering with Underwriting, Engineering, or another regulated business function is a plus.
* Working knowledge of multiple HR disciplines \- organizational design, learning and development, compensation, HR technology, and data management.
* Exposure to a matrixed or multi\-country People team structure (e.g., partnering across India, Singapore, or the US) is a plus.
* You are an empathetic listener who can build trust quickly and hold it, even in difficult conversations.
* You are data\-driven \- able to back up your recommendations to client groups with solid data and clear reasoning.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced, first\-principles environment and see the ambiguity of a scaling company as an exciting challenge rather than a blocker.
* You are a strong communicator, comfortable representing the People function to senior stakeholders.
* You have a genuine passion for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Bachelor's degree required; a postgraduate qualification in HR or a related field is preferred.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
   

  

 To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
   

  

***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Human Resources Director
description:
**About Flipkart** 




  





 Flipkart is India's leading e\-commerce marketplace, serving 500 million\+ registered customers and enabling millions of sellers, logistics partners, and brands. We are building the commerce infrastructure of India — powered by technology, data, and an unrelenting focus on the customer. Our people are the engine behind this mission.
 



  





**Role Context** 




 The Director – HRBP for OneTech is a strategic leadership role at the intersection of people, technology, and organizational effectiveness. This leader will serve as the primary HR partner to senior Engineering and Product leadership — shaping the talent and culture agenda for the teams building Flipkart's core technology platforms.
 



 This is not a traditional HR role. It demands a strategic, execution\-oriented, and data\-fluent HR leader who can influence at the CXO level, navigate organizational complexity at scale, and drive people agendas that directly accelerate engineering velocity and product outcomes.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Business Partnership** 



* Serve as a trusted thought partner to Engineering VPs, Product heads, and their leadership teams — present in business reviews, roadmap planning, and leadership forums.
* Translate business and technology strategy into people priorities: talent, structure, culture, and capability roadmaps aligned to 1–3 year engineering and product goals.
* Understand how product orgs operate — squads, platforms, roadmaps, — and bring HR interventions that map to how engineering actually works.



  





  





**Organizational Design \& Effectiveness** 



* Lead org design across engineering and product functions: platform team structures, squad models, span of control, layer optimization, and role architecture that scales with growth.
* Drive workforce planning in partnership with Finance and TA — headcount modelling, skills gap analysis, and build\-buy\-borrow decisions across technology stacks and domains.
* Facilitate restructuring, team integrations (post\-M\&A), and transformation programs within the vertical.



**Talent Strategy \& Leadership Development** 



* Own the talent agenda for engineering and product: succession planning, high\-potential identification, critical role coverage, and retention of senior engineers and PMs.
* Partner with L\&D to design leadership development pathways for tech leads, senior ICs, engineering managers, and directors.
* Drive a differentiated EVP narrative tailored to attract senior engineering and product talent in a competitive market.



**Culture, Engagement \& DEI** 



* Champion a high\-performance, inclusive engineering culture — using engagement data to diagnose friction and design targeted interventions.
* Lead DEI action planning within client groups, with measurable outcomes on representation across engineering levels and product leadership.
* Act as a culture anchor during periods of change — leadership transitions, org restructures, M\&A integration.



**Performance \& Total Rewards** 



* Anchor the annual performance cycle for the function — calibration, differentiation, and quality of feedback, including IC vs. management tracks.
* Partner with Compensation to design benchmarking, off\-cycle corrections, and incentive structuring for specialized roles (Staff/Principal engineers, Distinguished architects, senior PMs).



**Employee Relations** 



* Handle complex ER matters within the function — investigations, disciplinary actions, and sensitive people issues — with discretion and sound judgment.
* Ensure HR practices comply with applicable labour laws and internal governance frameworks.



**People Analytics \& HR Operating Model** 



* Use workforce and engagement data to generate insights and drive evidence\-based decisions — attrition risk, org health signals, span/layer diagnostics.
* Continuously sharpen HR operating rhythms: governance cadences, HRBP\-to\-business touchpoints, and HR service delivery for the function.
* Represent OneTech HR requirements in cross\-functional CoE forums (policy design, HRIS improvements, comp frameworks).



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Experience** 



* 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 10\+ years as a senior HRBP directly supporting large Engineering or Product organizations.
* Demonstrated success partnering with CXOs and senior technical leaders in a fast\-paced, high\-growth technology or e\-commerce environment.
* Experience managing HR for organizations with significant engineering headcount (500\+) and product\-led business models.
* Prior exposure to M\&A integration, org transformation, or post\-restructuring stabilization in a tech context is strongly preferred.



**Functional Capabilities** 



* Deep HRBP expertise: org design, talent management, performance, compensation, ER, and culture — with specific fluency in how these apply to engineering orgs.
* Ability to speak the language of engineering and product: understands agile ways of working, platform thinking, IC career ladders, and tech hiring dynamics.
* Strong proficiency in workforce analytics and HR metrics; comfortable with data\-driven storytelling to senior technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and HR compliance relevant to large technology organizations.



**Leadership \& Personal Attributes** 



* Executive presence: capable of holding a room with senior engineering leaders, pushing back constructively, and influencing without authority.
* High learning agility — able to quickly absorb context across diverse technology domains and connect dots across business units.
* Operates with discretion, confidentiality, and sound judgment.
* Collaborative but decisive; brings clarity and calm during periods of ambiguity and change.
* Resilient, self\-aware, and genuinely invested in the growth of the teams they support.



  





  





**Why Flipkart** 



* Shape the people agenda for the engineering teams building India's commerce, payments, and supply chain infrastructure.
* Partner with leaders solving problems at a scale few technology organizations in India operate at.
* Work in an HR function with CoE depth, real data maturity, and a genuine seat at the business table.
* Competitive compensation, ESOP participation, and a high\-velocity growth environment.
* A culture that values directness, intellectual curiosity, and impact over hierarchy.

description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

**About the Role:**
 This role ( Specialist \- HR Operations) is the operational backbone of our employee experience across multiple entities. You will play a crucial role in managing our HR operations, Vendor management, Benefit administratement, payroll, compliance, audits and general HR functions and You will solve complex compliance and lifecycle challenges, ensuring our internal HR engine runs flawlessly as we scale. It's an exciting opportunity to build scalable workflows, bridge the gap between HR and other cross functional teams.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Payroll Management : Oversee and manage the end\-to\-end in house payroll process, ensuring timely and accurate salary payments, deductions, and tax saving benefits administration. Maintain accurate and confidential payroll records and documentation.
* Tax Reporting : Prepare and file all required tax documents and reports, including quarterly and annual tax filings, 24Q to generate form 16 and other related forms.
* Payroll Reporting : Generate and share payroll reports in prescribed formats, including payroll summaries, tax reports, and compliance reports etc with the finance team.
* Audits and Reviews : Conduct regular payroll audits to ensure accuracy and compliance. Prepare for internal and external audits as required.
* Statutory compliance : Ensure timely preparation and payment of Statutory dues (PF, ESIC, LWF etc) and filling of paid challans.
* Compliance : Ensure adherence to all relevant employment laws and regulations. Conduct regular audits to maintain compliance and address any discrepancies or issues.
* Benefits Administration : Ensure accurate payroll deductions of employee benefits and timely process the payment to respective partners to record in employees wallets/accounts. Support Wellness benefits including health insurance, wellness benefits etc.
* Vendor Management: You’ll be the go\-to person for all things related to our HR vendors and consultants. From the moment we decide to partner with someone new, you’ll take the reins—guiding them through onboarding, sorting out NDAs and InfoSec approvals, and getting their agreements finalized. You’ll also keep track of when contracts are up for renewal and handle them smoothly via Spotdraft. But your impact doesn't stop at contracts; you’ll be deeply involved in the financial side of things, too. You’ll run the PR\-PO workflows on NetSuite, process invoices, reconcile accounts, and keep our HR Expense Tracker perfectly organized so we always know exactly where things stand.
* HR Operations : Support daily HR operations, including employee onboarding, records management, and HRIS maintenance. Act as a point of contact for HR\-related inquiries. Work closely with other HR team members and departments to ensure seamless integration of HR processes and support organizational goals.
* HR System Management : Administrate and update HRMS as per the requirement. Implement and test system upgrades and changes to ensure continued accuracy and efficiency.
* Dashboard and Reporting : Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to track key metrics, identify trends, and provide insights.
* Project Management : Lead and participate in HR projects aimed at improving operational efficiency and employee satisfaction. Manage project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
* Attention to Detail : Maintain high levels of accuracy in all aspects of payroll processing, compliance, and reporting. Identify and resolve issues proactively. Ensure compliance with data protection regulations.


**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**
* Think in first principles and act like an owner, taking absolute accountability for sensitive data and compliance deadlines.
* Possess a sharp eye for numerical accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
* Communicate with precision and empathy, effectively resolving employee queries and collaborating with external vendors.
* Thrive in a fast\-paced environment, seamlessly balancing the operational needs of multiple entities.
* Have a strong bias for action and efficient problem\-solving, turning operational bottlenecks into streamlined processes.
* Navigate ambiguity with ease, staying proactively updated on evolving state gazettes and labor laws.


 ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿
   

  

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**
* You’re delivering 100% error\-free and on\-time monthly payroll and statutory filings with zero compliance defaults or penalties.
* You’ve established a frictionless benefits administration process, consistently resolving employee queries and enrollments within targeted SLAs.
* You’ve successfully streamlined the PR\-PO and vendor onboarding workflows, resulting in fully reconciled and up\-to\-date HR expense trackers.
* You’ve elevated the new joiner orientation experience, ensuring all statutory forms, COCs, and compliance declarations are seamlessly executed on day one.


**Why This Role Matters \& What’s In It For You**
 As the anchor of our HR team, Your work directly ensures that the people building CoinDCX feel genuinely supported, cared for, and paid on time, all while keeping our company safe and compliant. Along the way, you’ll get incredible hands\-on experience managing HR and finance workflows across multiple entities. This is a special chance to shape how we care for our team from the ground up, doing meaningful work in an industry that's changing the world.
   

  

**Hiring Process:**

**Where We Work:**

 **Bangalore** 
 office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You:**

title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Learning \& Development (L\&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results\-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L\&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world\-class talent at scale.
   

  

 The role will own end\-to\-end program management of high\-impact initiatives spanning the full L\&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single\-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.
   

  

 This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L\&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L\&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Hiring Strategy: Own the end\-to\-end L\&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role\-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.
   

  

 ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism\-based interventions.
   

  

 Capability Building (GB \& BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.
   

  

 Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross\-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.
   

  

 QBR \& OP1: Prepare and present L\&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.
   

  

 Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high\-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.
   

  

 Content Development: Own the end\-to\-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.
   

  

 Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.
   

  

 Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.
   

  

 L\&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L\&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs

title: Trainer - India
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
 Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000\-year data gap” — the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments — kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes — to capture the high\-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more \[here]
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and deliver on a learning curriculum for the Operations team that aligns with Instawork’s business objectives and scales with a growing organization; coordinate and administer training
* Develop a comprehensive onboarding program that encourages new team members to provide premier support for Instawork’s customers and internal stakeholders, as well as prepare them for an intensive operational role managing high volume and nuanced customer requests
* Collaborate with management to create training plans, develop training modules, and facilitate real\-time training for Operations new hires and continuing education for tenured specialists
* Manage the efficacy of new hire onboarding through continuous process planning, execution, and identifying metrics for the Operations learning curriculum
* Establish methods for measuring and reporting on learner engagement, comprehension, and practical application
* Provide consistent visibility through written status and ongoing reporting, summarizing learner developmen
* Develop learning exercises with specific examples of interactions that promote empathy and obsession with the customer experience
* Create and assist with managing content for the Operations for the internal customer Knowledge Base and external customer Help Center


**Who You Are**
* 6\+ months of experience leading and creating support training programs
* 6\+ months leading remote or diverse teams, preferably in the technology services industry
* Experience creating content for and publishing within a Content or Learning Management System
* Proven ability to utilize different strategies to engage learners through presentation, facilitation and mentorship, as well as use of online and offline training concepts
* Demonstrated success managing long\-term projects and ongoing reporting for deliverables
* Proven ability to motivate, influence and work effectively at all organizational levels using different methods of communication
* Experience collaborating with distributed teams across multiple time zones and languages and cultures strongly preferred Learning Management System (LMS) administration experience preferred


**Preferred Languages**
* Fluent in English and at least one of the following regional languages: Marathi, Telugu, or Kannada.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Company Description**  

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description** **Strategic Mandate**


As the Engineering Manager, you will lead and grow the engineering organization behind Nielsen's Databricks\-based data and AI ecosystem — directly managing the Data Platform team and the AI/Data Engineering team. You are accountable for translating executive strategy into a single, unified roadmap that spans GenAI/data engineering and platform governance, ensuring these two disciplines operate in lockstep to drive shared business value. Beyond technical direction, you own people leadership, delivery accountability, and budget/FinOps stewardship for the combined Databricks program, and you are the primary point of escalation and executive stakeholder engagement when priorities, risks, or trade\-offs span both teams

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**

* Org \& People Leadership: Directly manage the AI/Data Engineering and Data Platform teams; own hiring, mentoring, performance management, career development, and career planning.
* Unified Technical Strategy: Shape a single, prioritized engineering plan that brings together GenAI and data\-engineering priorities with platform, governance, and FinOps commitments.
* Delivery \& Execution Accountability: Set OKRs, manage program/sprint cadences, and own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for the combined engineering organization — resolving cross\-team dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and delivery risks.
* Governance \& Risk Oversight: Provide senior oversight of Unity Catalog governance, data security, and platform reliability commitments (99\.99%), ensuring org\-wide compliance, audit readiness, and consistent governed AI enablement (e.g., Databricks Genie, AI/BI, etc).
* Emerging Technology Strategy: Partner with Strategy and Architecture to define standards and governance frameworks for emerging Databricks/AI capabilities, and run a structured evaluation process (POCs, security/architecture review, phased adoption) before they graduate into standard practice.
* Technology Trend Championing: Stay technologically upfront — track industry and Databricks/AI trends, personally trial promising capabilities, and champion adoption of what fits, balanced against a prioritized backlog and delivery commitments.
* FinOps \& Budget Ownership: Own the Databricks budget planning \& tracking, finops governance, headcount planning, and vendor/licensing decisions, bringing in cost\-efficiency accountability and "Strategic Foresight" targets on cloud spend.
* Executive \& Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary interface between the engineering organization and senior leadership, Finance, HR, and Product stakeholders — translating business priorities into technical direction and reporting progress upward.
* Culture \& Community: Champion a unified community of practice across data engineering and platform engineering, ensuring consistent engineering standards, mentorship, and knowledge sharing across both teams.

  

**Qualifications** **Expertise \& Technology Stack**

* Leadership Experience: 10\+ years in data/software engineering, including 3\+ years directly managing engineering leads, managers, or senior ICs across distributed teams.
* Databricks \& Data Platform Fluency: Strong working knowledge of the Databricks ecosystem (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Databricks Workflows, Databricks SQL) sufficient to evaluate architecture trade\-offs and coach technical leads, without requiring day\-to\-day hands\-on coding.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Working understanding of GenAI application patterns (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie, etc) to guide governed AI enablement decisions across both teams.
* People \& Org Development: Proven track record of hiring, performance calibration, career pathing, and building high\-performing, retention\-focused engineering teams.
* Program \& Delivery Management: Experience running OKRs/roadmaps, capacity planning, and cross\-team dependency management across multiple engineering disciplines.
* FinOps \& Budget Management: Experience owning cloud/platform budgets and driving cost\-efficiency accountability across teams.
* Analytical \& Influencing Skills: Ability to synthesize technical trade\-offs surfaced by multiple leads into a single executive narrative, and to influence decisions without dictating implementation details.
* Technology Curiosity: A demonstrated habit of tracking industry and Databricks/AI trends, hands\-on experimentation to validate fit, and driving pragmatic adoption rather than chasing hype.

  

**Additional Information** **Requirements \& Qualifications**

* Experience: 10\+ years in data/software engineering, with 3\+ years in an Engineering Manager or People Manager role overseeing senior/lead engineers delivering large\-scale data or AI platforms.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Proven track record of managing engineering leads responsible for large\-scale, governed data and AI platform delivery.
* Preferred: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional / Platform Architect, or a formal people\-leadership/management certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be able to represent the combined engineering organization to executive leadership and translate confidently across both technical domains and non\-technical stakeholders


Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

This position has been created as part of 2026 SheBuilds Mentorship Program, in preparation for mentees' resume and interview workshop.
  

  

If you are a participant in this program, please apply with your most recent and updated resume for the coaching session, as the interviewer will need to review it prior to the interview.  

  

A day in the life  

Diverse Experiences
  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS
  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance
  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  

  

Inclusive Team Culture

title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's Learning \& Development (L\&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results\-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L\&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world\-class talent at scale.  

  

The role will own end\-to\-end program management of high\-impact initiatives spanning the full L\&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single\-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.  

  

This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L\&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L\&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.  

  

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Hiring Strategy: Own the end\-to\-end L\&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role\-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.  

ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism\-based interventions.  

Capability Building (GB \& BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.  

Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross\-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.  

QBR \& OP1: Prepare and present L\&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.  

Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high\-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.  

Content Development: Own the end\-to\-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.  

Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.  

Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.  

Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.  

L\&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L\&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System
