title: Senior Workplace Coordinator
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Senior Workplace Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring our office operates smoothly, efficiently, and safely while fostering a welcoming and engaging workplace experience. This is a hands\-on, service\-oriented role which will involve working in **rotational shifts in our Bangalore office** and requires adaptability, problem\-solving, and strong communication skills. You will serve as a primary point of contact for employees, vendors, and building management, addressing day\-to\-day office needs, supporting events, and maintaining a high standard of operational excellence.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Conduct a daily walkthrough to ensure office spaces are clean, functional, and free of hazards.
* Manage **employee transport and cab operations** to support seamless daily commuting.
* Coordinate with transport vendors to ensure high service quality, route optimization, and timely schedules.
* Oversee compliance and safety protocols for all commute solutions and transport partners.
* Manage and respond to employee requests and grievances submitted through Jira, Slack, email, or other channels.
* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations, including F\&B and transport/commute programs, shipping and receiving (employee and business mail), office supply management, security, M\&E, and janitorial.
* Act as a liaison with building management to coordinate vendor access, maintenance requests, and other facility needs, ensuring safety, compliance, and engaging employee experience
* Support event planning and execution in collaboration with Workplace Managers, Event Coordinators, and Marketing. Plan, source, and execute events like month\-end happy hours and engagement pop\-ups.
* Assist in managing workplace projects, including office moves, adds, and changes, occupancy planning, design \& build turnkey projects, rennovation, ensuring seamless transitions for employees.
* Maintain emergency preparedness by holding an emergency warden role and being First Aid and CPR certified.
* Ensure vendors and service providers meet performance expectations, including day porters, janitorial teams, and F\&B vendors, via a centrally coordinated FM model.
* Independently execute employee engagement initiatives, such as themed happy hours or other workplace experience programs.
* Develop and document workplace procedures, operational guides, and training materials to enhance efficiency and self\-sufficiency.
* Cross\-train to provide coverage for the Workplace Manager, ensuring seamless operations when they are out of office.
* Build workplace reports with Data \& Analytics insight. Hands on expertise in Workplace Analytics \& PropTech Enablement and content creation to manage employee facing confluence/source pages.
* Maintains logs, trackers \& occurrences register. Funnels all information as per escalation matrix to vendor \& all internal stakeholders.
* Manage and coordinate vendor payments, ensuring timely processing of invoices and accurate record\-keeping.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Graduate with working knowledge of Electricals, Diesel Generators \& HVAC (Heating, Ventilation \& Air Conditioning), FAS (Fire Automation System), PAS (Public Address System) \& ACS (Access Control Systems).
* 5\+ years of experience in Transport operations, Workplace Operations, Facilities, Real Estate, or a fast\-paced service industry such as retail, hospitality, or restaurants.
* Proven track record in **transport management, vendor coordination, and commute operations**.
* Ability to handle a high volume of requests while maintaining a calm, professional, and solution\-oriented approach.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, demonstrating initiative in identifying and implementing workplace improvements.
* Highly organized with grit, tenacity, and resilience, understanding that workplace operations may require non\-traditional hours.
* Experience working in Jira, Slack, or similar ticketing/communication platforms is a plus.
* Comfortable managing multiple vendors, coordinating maintenance requests, and working closely with building management.
* Passion for creating a positive and engaging office environment that enhances employee productivity and connection.
* Willing to work in the office Monday–Friday, on rotational shifts involving nights and occasionally during weekends for events or critical vendor work.
* Understanding of global real estate operations and cross\-cultural collaboration.
* Additional language skills relevant to region/area (if preferable)

 **Note**:

* This is a full\-time, in\-office role (Monday to Friday)
* This role requires you to work in rotational shifts.

**Additional Information**

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. **Talent Product Specialist, AI Enablement**

We have an opportunity for a **Talent Product Specialist, AI Enablement** to join our **Talent Development \& Organizational Effectiveness** team in **Bangalore** , reporting to the **Senior Manager, Talent Systems** . In this pivotal role, you will own assigned workstreams within Infoblox’s AI Enablement roadmap and translate them into practical, engaging experiences that help Bloxers apply AI to real work. Although AI Enablement will be your primary product line, you may also facilitate or support experiences across other Talent Product lines, including Leadership, Performance, Growth, and broader Talent initiatives, as business priorities require. * Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to engage diverse audiences in virtual and in\-person settings
* Hands\-on experience using generative AI tools, copilots, agents, enterprise search, workflow automation, or related technologies
* Ability to translate complex or emerging concepts into clear, practical, audience\-appropriate experiences
* Strong project and program management skills across multiple priorities, timelines, and stakeholders
* Comfort working in ambiguity and adapting as technology and business priorities evolve
* Ability to partner effectively with senior leaders, subject\-matter experts, HR Business Partners, IT, and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Experience using data, feedback, or evaluation methods to improve programs and demonstrate impact
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including facilitator and participant materials
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, learning and development, organizational psychology, education, business, communications, technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered

**Six Months:**

**One Year:**

* Contribute meaningfully to the quarterly AI Enablement roadmap and measurement cycle
* Strengthen global coverage and regional adaptation without fragmenting the enterprise product experience
* Expand practical AI enablement patterns across other Talent Product experiences
* Establish repeatable methods for capturing use cases, productivity improvements, lessons learned, and responsible\-use practices

**Belong —** **Your Community**

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

 Head, Talent Management

 MENA, India, SEA
 



  





**ABOUT DARWINBOX** 




  





 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 900\+ global enterprises to manage their 2\.5 million\+ employees across 116\+ countries.
 



  





 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday. The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, Swiggy, DLF, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
 



  





 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced and strategic professional to join our Human Resources team as Manager, Talent Management. This is an international HRBP role, partnering with business teams across MENA, India, and Southeast Asia, and shall naturally involve travel to these geographies.
 



  





 The role involves both advisory and delivery responsibilities, and the person will work closely with Directors and VPs as a thought partner on people strategy while also owning the design and execution of talent programs.
 



  





 The scope of work spans talent development, careers, performance management, and org design. The expectation is that programs and interventions will be designed keeping the overall organizational strategy in mind, and not as standalone HR initiatives.
 



  





 The person in this role is expected to identify what needs to be built, think through how it connects to where the organization is headed, and then deliver it. Prior experience in product or technology companies is preferred given the nature of the environment. Having worked in client\-facing or product roles is an added advantage, as it brings a useful perspective on how people, processes, and business outcomes interconnect.
 



  





 Because Darwinbox is an HCM solutions company, the broader HR community here, both within the People team and across the business, carries a high level of HR functional knowledge. The expectation for HR expertise in this role is accordingly high.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**International HR Business Partnering** 



* Partner with Directors and VPs across MENA, India, and SEA on people priorities, providing advisory support on talent, org structure, and workforce planning.
* Understand and navigate the business and cultural context across geographies to ensure that HR interventions are relevant and effective.
* Build credible working relationships with senior stakeholders that allow for ongoing, substantive dialogue on people matters.



**Talent Strategy and Program Design** 



* Develop and implement talent management strategies that are aligned to the organization's overall direction and business objectives.
* Design programs across the talent lifecycle including development, careers, performance, engagement, and succession.
* Ensure that programs are built for scale and sustainability, not just for immediate needs, and that they can evolve as the organization grows.



**Performance Management** 



* Design and manage the performance management process, including goal setting, evaluation frameworks, calibration, and career development planning.
* Work with business leaders to strengthen performance culture and improve individual and team productivity.
* Use data to track effectiveness of performance interventions and make informed recommendations.



**Learning and Development** 



* Identify learning needs across the organization and build development programs that address capability gaps at individual and team levels.
* Design career development frameworks and learning pathways that are connected to organizational growth and employee progression.
* Create an environment where continuous learning is treated as an integral part of how work gets done.



**Succession Planning** 



* Build and maintain a succession planning process to identify and develop internal talent for critical and leadership roles.
* Work with business leaders to map high\-potential employees and create structured development paths for them.



**Employee Engagement and Retention** 



* Develop and execute engagement programs that are relevant across international markets and contribute to a positive and inclusive workplace.
* Implement approaches to improve retention, employee well\-being, and overall job satisfaction.
* Use engagement data to have meaningful conversations with business leaders and drive action.



**Org Design** 



* Support organizational design conversations including structure, spans, roles, and team effectiveness.
* Partner with leadership to assess org health and recommend changes that improve performance and agility.



**Data and Reporting** 



* Use HR data and analytics to measure the impact of talent programs and make evidence\-based decisions.
* Provide regular reporting to senior management on key HR metrics and the outcomes of ongoing initiatives.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** 




  





**Education and Background** 



* Master's degree in Human Resources or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of HR experience, with meaningful exposure to talent management and HR business partnering.
* Prior experience in product or technology companies is strongly preferred.
* Having worked in client\-facing or product\-facing capacities is an advantage, as it brings applied understanding of how business and people outcomes are connected.
* International HR or cross\-geography business partnering experience is preferred. Exposure to MENA, India, or SEA markets is a plus.



**Skills and Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of talent management practices including performance, learning and development, succession, org design, and engagement.
* Ability to work effectively with senior leaders, provide well\-reasoned advice, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Good working knowledge of HR practices, employment frameworks, and regulatory considerations across multiple geographies.
* Clear and effective communicator, both in writing and in conversation.

We are Reckitt

 Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Global Business Services
   

  

 Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).
   

  

 Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co\-creativity \- while learning together \- OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast\-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting\-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back\-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Global Process Owner (GPO) – Hire to Retire (H2R) you will be accountable for shaping and governing the end\-to\-end design, and continuous improvement of the global H2R process landscape. The role ensures standardisation, simplification, scalability, and business\-alignment across the employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition through onboarding, performance, development, mobility, and offboarding.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of enabling an exceptional employee experience while ensuring operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with Reckitt’s talent strategy. You will collaborate with HR Centers of Expertise (COEs), Global People Services (Shared Services), IT\&D, and other Global Process Owners in Global business services to drive process design, technology enablement, and continuous improvement across the full hire\-to\-retire value chain.
   

  

 Note: This role is not responsible for running day\-to\-day HR Shared Services operations. Instead, the GPO partners with Global People Services to deliver process improvements, automation, and simplification across all markets, ensuring operational execution aligns with process design and governance standards.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the global end\-to\-end H2R process strategy, standards, and governance framework
* Lead global design authority for H2R processes including hiring, onboarding, core HR operations, payroll, time \& attendance, and offboarding
* Champion process harmonization and digitization across markets, in partnership with HR, IT, and GBS
* Identify and deliver transformation opportunities that improve employee experience and operational performance
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, policy, and data privacy requirements across the H2R process landscape
* Drive adoption and optimization of H2R platforms (e.g., Workday, ServiceNow, payroll solutions)
* Monitor process performance and drive continuous improvement through KPIs and feedback loops


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Deep understanding of the HR function and full employee lifecycle, with extensive experience designing and leading global H2R processes in a multinational company
* Demonstrated success in process transformation, automation, and employee experience enhancement. Proven experience as a H2R GPO or Head of HR Shared Services operations preferred
* Hands\-on experience with global HR technologies (Workday, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ATS, payroll systems)
* Experience working in or closely with a Global Business Services or Shared Services model
* Demonstrated expertise in process ownership, transformation, and governance
* Proven ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders across functions and regions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven mindset
* Strong exposure to GBS ramp\-up and mature environments, with a track record of scaling operations and evolving processes
* FMCG or other high\-volume, fast\-paced industry background preferred


 The skills for success
   

  

* Global Process Design
* Hire to Retire
* HR Operations
* HRIS Platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Payroll \& Time Management
* Employee Experience Design
* Process Transformation
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* GBS Collaboration


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Benefits & Leave Coordinator
description:
**Job Title:** Benefits \& Leave Coordinator


**Location:** Hyderabad, India


**Employment Type:** Full\-time


**About NationsBenefits:**


At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back\-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high\-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on platform modernization — transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloudnative architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core Backoffice functions in the insurance domain.


**Position Summary**


The Benefits \& Leave Coordinator is responsible for the day\-to\-day administration of the Company's leave of absence and employee benefits programs. This role serves as the primary operational resource for leave administration while supporting benefit billing, payroll deductions, benefit arrears, and routine employee benefit administration. Working closely with the Benefits Director, the Coordinator partners with employees, Payroll, HR, carriers, and third\-party administrators to ensure timely and accurate administration of leave and benefits.


**Essential Responsibilities**


**Leave Administration**


* Serve as the primary contact for employee leave of absence questions.


* Administer FMLA, ADA accommodations, Personal Leave of Absence (PLOA), Military Leave, ShortTerm Disability (STD), Long\-Term Disability (LTD), and applicable state leave programs.


* Coordinate leave administration with Lincoln Financial and other leave administrators.


* Track leave requests, certification deadlines, approvals, return\-to\-work dates, and required documentation.


* Prepare leave correspondence and maintain confidential leave records.


* Coordinate return\-to\-work documentation and communicate leave updates with employees, managers, HR, Payroll, and third\-party administrators.


* Monitor benefit continuation while employees are on leave and escalate complex issues to the Benefits Director.


**Benefits Billing, Payroll \& Arrears Administration**


* Reconcile monthly carrier invoices with enrollment records.


* Audit payroll benefit deductions for accuracy.


* Research and resolve billing discrepancies.


* Track employee benefit arrears and prepare repayment schedules.


* Coordinate arrears repayments and retroactive premium adjustments with Payroll.


* Monitor employee premium payments while on leave.


**Employee Benefits Support**


* Respond to routine employee benefit inquiries.


* Process new hire enrollments, qualifying life events, benefit changes, and terminations.


* Assist employees with medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA, FSA, COBRA, EAP, and 401(k) questions.


* Assist with carrier website registrations, ID card requests, and maintain benefit records in the HRIS.


* Support annual Open Enrollment and monitor the Benefits inbox.


**Workers' Compensation Support**


* Serve as a backup resource to HR Business Partners for Workers' Compensation administration.


* Assist with coordinating Workers' Compensation leaves concurrently with FMLA, ADA, Personal Leave of Absence, or other applicable leave programs when appropriate.


* Monitor leave coordination, benefit continuation, and payroll impacts for Workers' Compensation cases.


**Required Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of experience administering leave of absence and employee benefit programs.


* Strong working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, COBRA, disability, and leave administration.


* Experience working with third\-party leave administrators (Lincoln Financial or similar preferred).


* Experience with benefit billing reconciliation, payroll deductions, and employee benefit arrears.


* Experience using HRIS and benefits administration systems (UKG preferred; other HRIS experience accepted).


* Strong organizational, communication, and customer service skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience supporting a multi\-state workforce.


* Professional HR or Benefits certification (SHRM\-CP, PHR, CEBS) is a plus.

title: Senior Engineer– Digital Risk Management
description:
**Position Title:** Senior Engineer– Digital Risk Management (P3\)

 **Location:** Bangalore / Hyderabad

 **Reports To:** Associate Manager, Digital Risk Management \- Carrier Global Capability Center (GCC), Digital Team

 **Position Summary:** To lead the identification, assessment, management, and governance of IT risks across Carrier’s enterprise environment. This role is critical to ensuring the resilience of IT services and the integrity of Carrier's information assets by embedding a robust IT risk management framework aligned with global standards and Carrier's strategic goals. This role acts as the strategic owner of risk governance while working closely with IT Risk Analysts who are responsible for day\-to\-day execution and operationalization of controls, assessments, and reporting, with close coordination and frequent interaction across internal subject\-matter\-expert (SME) teams and Risk owners to ensure risk management process is followed.

 **Key Responsibilities:**


1\. IT Risk Governance \& Framework Management

* Design, implement, and maintain the IT Risk Management Framework aligned with Carrier based Digital Risk Framework which is derived from NIST CSF and ISO 27001\.
* Define IT risk taxonomy, thresholds, and escalation protocols for consistent enterprise\-wide adoption.
* Serve as the primary liaison for IT risk matters across Carrier's global business units, infrastructure, and application teams.
* Serve as the primary record creator for risks in ServiceNow GRC application.


 Key person contributing to the design, configuration, and rollout of the ServiceNow GRC framework, covering the Policy, Risk, Issue, Compliance and Exception Management modules end\-to\-end.2\. Risk Identification, Assessment \& Prioritization

* Conduct and oversee IT risk assessments (inherent and residual) across critical applications, infrastructure, and projects.
* Guide IT Risk Analysts in executing risk analysis, evidence collection, and scoring processes.
* Facilitate scenario\-based and targeted risk assessments for high\-impact areas including cloud migrations, system upgrades, and M\&A.
* Maintain and update risk registers, scoring models, and risk heatmaps using GRC tools \- ServiceNow IRM


3\. Control Management \& Monitoring

* Define and implement key risk indicators (KRIs) and key control indicators (KCIs) for ongoing risk monitoring.
* Supervise IT Risk Analysts in evaluating control effectiveness and documenting evidence.
* Develop action plans for control deficiencies, monitor remediation, and report control maturity metrics.


4\. Exception \& Deviation Handling

* Lead the end\-to\-end management of risk exceptions, waivers, and deviations from IT policy.
* Oversee the workflows managed by analysts and ensure that exceptions are timely reviewed and approved by appropriate stakeholders.
* Automate exception workflows and integrate them with CMDB and audit logs for traceability.


5\. Stakeholder Engagement \& Risk Reporting

* Prepare and present monthly/quarterly risk dashboards to senior leadership, Risk Council, and DCC.
* Conduct regular stakeholder sessions to capture risk concerns, share insights, and promote risk ownership.
* Provide risk insights to inform IT strategic decisions, budget allocations, and project prioritization.


6\. Awareness, Training \& Culture Building

* Develop and deliver IT risk training modules to application owners, support teams, and project managers.
* Promote a risk\-aware culture through playbooks, campaigns, and collaborative learning sessions.
* Partner with HR and L\&D to integrate IT risk content into employee training journeys.
* Mentor and coach IT Risk Analysts to build operational maturity and grow internal expertise.

 **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related field.
* Minimum 8\-10 years in IT risk management, audit, or cyber governance.
* Strong knowledge of risk frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), internal controls, and security policies.
* Hands\-on experience with GRC platforms, specifically ServiceNow IRM / GRC (Risk, Issue, and Exception Management modules), RSA Archer or any other platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate and interact frequently with internal SME teams and external stakeholders to drive risk topics and strengthen the risk management portfolio.
* Working knowledge of AI risk frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001\) and hands\-on ability to leverage AI tools — including building lightweight risk\-reporting apps, dashboards, or chatbots — to automate risk triage, scoring, monitoring and stakeholder queries.

 **Certifications (Preferred):**

* CRISC.

 **Key Attributes:**

* Strategic thinking with tactical execution.
* Strong interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to simplify complex risk narratives for business audiences.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and manage multi\-country risk engagements.
* Strong coordination skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across internal SME teams and external stakeholders for effective risk management outcomes.

 **Why Join Us?** At Carrier, you will be part of a world\-class, diverse workforce that is driving innovation and creating solutions that matter. This role provides an exciting opportunity to **shape the future of communications at Carrier Digital**, offering high visibility and strategic influence within the organization.

title: Chief of Staff - Human Potential
description:
**About the Company** 




 Who we are At The Whole Truth, our mission is to ‘re\-build the world’s trust in its food’. We believe consumers have lost trust in big\-food companies because they’ve been selling half\-truths for ages. We believe the only way to remedy this, is for someone to stand up and speak the whole truth. What we do We are India’s first (and perhaps only) 100% Clean Label food company. What that means is we make food so clean, (only) we can declare each ingredient proudly upfront. \#nothing to hide.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 The HP function at TWT has a broad mandate \- build the organisation and leadership capability required for our next phase of scale, while continuing to deliver reliably on the fundamentals.
 



 As the agenda grows, the challenge is not a shortage of ideas or initiatives. It is ensuring that we are working on the few things that matter most, that ownership is clear, that decisions get made and stay made, and that commitments translate into execution on the ground.
 



 The Chief of Staff exists to make the CHPO and the HP leadership team more effective.
 



 The role will create the operating system through which the function runs: translating priorities into plans, creating the right forums and information flows, identifying where execution is getting stuck, driving decisions and follow\-through, and taking on a small number of strategic problems that cut across the function or organisation.
 



 This is not an EA role, nor is it a shadow HRBP or programme\-management role. The Chief of Staff does not take accountability away from functional owners. The role makes ownership clearer and execution stronger.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 The HP operating system
 


* Translate the HP strategy and OKRs into a small number of clearly owned priorities, milestones and outcomes.
* Design and continuously improve the operating cadence of the function \- leadership reviews, HRBP/TA/Ops forums, monthly operating reviews and quarterly and annual planning.
* Ensure every forum has a clear purpose: information, discussion or decision, with the right people in the room.
* Build one integrated view of HP priorities, decisions, dependencies and commitments.
* Ensure actions and decisions close; surface slippage and unresolved dependencies early rather than after deadlines are missed.
* Run the quarterly OKR/planning rhythm and ensure learning from one cycle informs the next.



  





**CHPO effectiveness and decision support** 




  




* Help the CHPO determine where to spend time and organisational attention.
* Bring structure to ambiguous issues before they become meetings or projects.
* Ensure important conversations arrive with the right context, data, options and trade\-offs.
* Synthesise employee signals, people data, business context and external perspectives into clear points of view.
* Track important decisions made by the CHPO/HP leadership team and ensure they translate into action.
* Act as a trusted thought partner who can challenge assumptions and bring an independent perspective.



  





**Cross\-functional execution** 




 Many important people priorities sit across HRBP, TA, Ops, Finance and functional leadership rather than neatly within one team
 



  





**The Chief of Staff will:** 



* Establish clear ownership and interfaces for these priorities;
* bring the relevant teams together when dependencies need resolving;
* identify open loops and escalate where necessary;
* hold owners to commitments without becoming the owner of their work;
* step in more deeply where an initiative is particularly critical, ambiguous or stuck.



  





**Strategic and OD priorities** 




 Alongside running the HP operating system, the Chief of Staff will personally lead a small number of high\-priority initiatives where there is no obvious natural owner or where the CHPO needs additional problem\-solving capacity.
 



  





**These could include:** 



* Leadership and top\-team effectiveness interventions;
* culture and ways\-of\-working initiatives;
* manager effectiveness;
* employee listening and organisational\-health interventions;
* AI and technology leverage within HP;
* compensation/rewards research and benchmarking alongside specialist partners;
* strategic talent or people\-process redesign;
* emerging organisational questions created by TWT's growth.



  





 The portfolio will change as the organisation changes.
 



  





 HRBPs remain accountable for understanding their organisations and developing the first point of view on talent and organisation design. The Chief of Staff can bring methodology, analysis and execution support where a problem cuts across the organisation.
 



 AI and productivity
 



  





**AI and productivity** 




  




* Identify where AI can fundamentally improve the way the HP function works rather than simply automate existing processes.
* Experiment with practical use cases across recruiting, employee listening, analytics, knowledge management, manager enablement and HP operations.
* Build solutions with the relevant functional owner and help successful experiments become part of normal ways of working.
* Continually ask where HP can deliver the same or better outcomes with less manual effort.



  





**What we are looking for** 




**Essential** 



* **6–10 years of experience** 
 in consulting, strategy, business operations, Chief of Staff roles, transformation/programme leadership or people/organisation strategy.
* Evidence of having taken complex, cross\-functional priorities from ambiguity through to execution.
* Exceptional structured problem\-solving and ability to separate what matters from what doesn't.
* High execution discipline and attention to detail without becoming process\-heavy.
* Ability to influence and hold senior stakeholders accountable without formal authority.
* Strong analytical ability and comfort using data to form a point of view.
* Excellent written communication \- able to turn complexity into a sharp one\-page note rather than a 30\-page presentation.
* Judgement and discretion appropriate to operating close to sensitive organisation and talent issues.



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* Experience in a high\-growth, founder\-led or rapidly changing organisation.
* Exposure to organisation effectiveness, leadership development or people strategy.
* Experience designing management cadences, OKRs or operating systems.
* Strong curiosity about technology and AI and its implications for how organisations and functions operate.



  





**The person we are looking for** 



* Someone who can operate at 30,000 feet and 30 feet in the same day.
* Someone who can help shape an important organisation question in the morning, challenge an unclear OKR in the afternoon, and later ask why something we committed to three weeks ago is still open.
* Someone who is low on ego, high on judgement and comfortable operating through influence rather than authority.
* And, most importantly, someone who understands that their job is not to do everyone else's work.
* Their job is to create enough clarity, discipline and momentum that the organisation gets the work done.

title: Personnel Officer
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 The Personnel Officer manages communications between management offices and sea staff, and coordinates with global port agents to ensure that crew on\-boarding and off\-boarding arrangements are performed efficiently in cost\-effective ports.
   

  

 This position works with the assistant personnel officer and crewing assistants to ensure that ‘fit to travel’ requirements are achieved and completed before sea staff is dispatched to company\-managed vessels.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Is familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) either directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines
* Ensures timely completion of required activities outlined before sea staff are dispatched, schedules sea staff pre\-joining briefings, and advises all parties with follow\-up reports
* Ensures logistics of sea staff and supernumeraries joining and offsigning are carried out promptly and communicated to agents, vessel, and others as required Works with the assistant personnel officer and crewing assistant to ensure that all crew relief nominations have valid documentation and met all visa requirements; also escalates pertinent concerns and issues onboard to relevant senior manager as required.
* Communicates with vessels and provides timely responses where possible;
* Arranges and reviews flag state documentation status of sea staff, ensuring compliance at all times; also applies for flag state dispensation where required
* Approves travel expenses and other vendor bills as applicable for officers joining or signing\-off and their supernumeraries (escalates exceptions to policy or costs which exceed signing authority)
* Prepares management reports where required
* Performs other duties as required.


**Requirements:**
* Graduate in any stream (three years university or equivalent)
* Minimum of three years of working experience in a shipping company,


 at least two of those years as an assistant personnel officer
   

  

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and good writing style
* Able to prioritize and multi\-task
* Attention to detail
* Good interpersonal skills with a customer focus


**Additional Desired Qualifications:**
* Previous sailing experience
* Experience in a multinational company


**Job Demands and/or Physical Requirements:**
* Availability via a mobile phoneoutside of office hours
* Periodic overtime to meet deadlines or accommodate time zone


 differences

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

title: Benefits Analyst
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 You will own Avalara's India benefits portfolio — ensuring programs are compliant, competitive, and felt positively by the \~2,400 employees who rely on them. As a seasoned member of the Global Benefits team, you'll navigate the complexity of India's evolving Labour Code landscape, drive the annual benefits renewal cycle, build smarter ways of working through AI and automation, and serve as a trusted partner to Payroll, Finance, and People teams. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who combines regulatory depth with the initiative to improve how benefits are delivered, not just administered.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Come and be part of the Global Benefits Team! We are a truly global team working together to design and deliver benefits programs that are competitive, compliant, and people\-first. In India, we are navigating an exciting period of change with the Labour Codes transformation, and this role sits at the heart of that work
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 What Your Responsibilities Will Be
   

  

**Annual Renewals**
* Own the end\-to\-end India benefits renewal cycle — timelines, carrier negotiations, plan design reviews and Workday testing etc.
* Evaluate plan performance using utilization data and prepare management summaries with clear recommendations.


**Payroll Inputs \& Vendor Management**
* Serve as the primary Benefits\-to\-Payroll interface, ensuring accurate and timely submission of all India benefits inputs
* Reconcile deductions against vendor invoices, manage payroll cut\-off calendars
* Own the full vendor lifecycle for India benefits partners, onboarding, SLA monitoring, invoice processing, budget tracking, and renewals.
* Lead RFP and evaluation processes; prepare commercial comparisons to support data\-driven decisions.


**Employee Engagement \& wellbeing**
* Act as the first point of contact for India employee benefits and absence queries; resolve or route to the appropriate TPA, broker, or team.
* Drive proactive communications and events (open enrollment, office hours, new hire sessions) across all India entities.


**Absence Management**
* Administer all absence programs i.e. Privilege leave, Casual/Sick Leave, Maternity/Paternity, statutory leaves and holidays in Workday for India; manage escalations, encashment processing, and statutory accruals.
* Ensure policies stay compliant with evolving regulations and run regular data audits to maintain Workday accuracy.


**Audit \& Statutory Filing**
* Own India benefits compliance filings and conduct regular Workday\-to\-vendor reconciliations.
* Monitor regulatory changes and maintain documentation for internal and external audits.


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

**Education \& Experience**
* Undergraduate degree in any field required; HR, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in benefits administration or total rewards with demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership of benefits programs.
* Proven experience operating with a high degree of independence; this role requires someone who can manage day\-to\-day work without close supervision
* Hands\-on experience with India statutory benefits and compliance
* Track record of managing vendor relationships and leading or contributing to renewal and RFP processes.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Proficient in Workday (benefits/HCM) and MS Office, particularly Excel.
* Comfortable with AI tools (Glean, n8n, Copilot) for automating workflows, drafting content, and surfacing insights — with a mindset to keep building fluency.
* Strong analytical and communication skills; able to translate data into clear recommendations and engage credibly at all levels.
* Detail\-oriented with the ability to manage competing priorities across complex, compliance\-heavy workstreams


 At Avalara, we expect this role to work
 *with* 
 AI, not just
 *alongside* 
 it. You are someone who reaches for Glean before writing a first draft, uses n8n or similar tools to automate repetitive data tasks, and treats AI\-generated outputs with the same critical eye you'd apply to any vendor deliverable. You don't need to be an engineer — but you are curious, self\-directed, and actively building your AI fluency
   

  

 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: HR Payroll System Analyst _ UK Shift
description:
JOB PURPOSE :
   

 This role is for a skilled HR Payroll System Analyst. This role will be responsible for maintenance, and optimisation of SAP ECP, ensuring seamless payroll processing and compliance with regulations.
 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
 



 Key Responsibilities
   

 •    Act as the SME for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP).
   

 •    Configure and maintain payroll schemas, rules and system settings where applicable.
   

 •    Support quarterly releases, upgrades and regression testing activities.
   

 •    Manage payroll related incidents, service requests and problem management activities.
   

 •    Support integrations between Employee Central, Payroll, Time, Finance and third\-party providers.
   

 •    Ensure system security, compliance, audit controls and GDPR requirements are maintained.
   

 •    Drive automation and process improvement initiatives across HR and Payroll operations.
   

 •    Produce and analyses system and payroll data to support business decision making.
   

 •    Maintain system documentation, knowledge articles and operating procedures.
 



 Key Skills \& Experience
   

 •    Strong SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll experience.
   

 •    HR Systems and Payroll systems expertise.
   

 •    Data analysis and reporting capability.
   

 •    Stakeholder management and vendor management experience.
   

 •    Testing, change management and release management knowledge.
 



 Qualifications
   

 •    Relevant HRIS, Payroll or SAP certification desirable.
   

 •    Educated to degree level or equivalent experience.
 



  

 PAYROLL CONFIGURATION \& TECHNICAL EXPERTISE
   

 •    Extensive experience configuring and maintaining SAP Employee Central Payroll (ECP) across multiple payroll areas and employee populations.
   

 •    Strong knowledge of payroll schemas, sub\-schemas, Personnel Calculation Rules (PCRs), functions and operations to support complex payroll 
   

 requirements.
   

 •    Experience creating, configuring and maintaining wage types, symbolic accounts, evaluation classes, processing classes and cumulation classes.
   

 •    Ability to analyse and resolve payroll calculation issues through payroll logs, payroll clusters and schema trace analysis.
   

 •    Experience configuring payroll periods, control records, payroll areas and payroll calendars.
   

 •    Knowledge of gross\-to\-net calculations, statutory deductions, pensions, benefits, absence processing and retroactive accounting.
   

 •    Experience configuring off\-cycle payroll processes including bonus payments, corrections, advances and termination payments.
   

 •    Strong understanding of retro payroll processing, payroll corrections and replication monitoring between Employee Central and ECP.
   

 •    Experience supporting Payroll Control Centre (PCC) configuration, validation rules, policy creation and payroll process monitoring.
   

 •    Ability to identify and implement payroll configuration changes arising from legislative, contractual or business requirements.
   

 •    Experience configuring posting to finance, symbolic accounts and payroll reconciliation processes.
   

 •    Knowledge of Time Management integration and the impact of absences, attendances, overtime and allowances on payroll calculations.
   

 •    Experience configuring and troubleshooting custom infotypes, wage type generation and payroll\-related master data.
   

 •    Strong understanding of payroll result clusters, RT tables, CRT tables and payroll data validation techniques.
   

 •    Experience performing root cause analysis on payroll defects and implementing sustainable configuration solutions.
   

 •    Knowledge of transport management processes and deployment of payroll configuration between Development, Test and Production environments.
   

 •    Experience supporting year\-end activities, tax updates and statutory payroll changes.
   

 •    Ability to produce functional specifications for payroll enhancements and work closely with ABAP developers on technical solutions.
   

 •    Experience conducting unit testing, integration testing, regression testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for payroll configuration changes.
   

 •    Knowledge of SAP Notes application, support packs and payroll legislative updates.
   

 •    Strong understanding of payroll audit controls, segregation of duties, GDPR and payroll compliance requirements.
 



 DESIRABLE ADVANCED ECP EXPERIENCE
   

 •    Payroll schema design and optimisation.
   

 •    Custom PCR development and troubleshooting.
   

 •    PCC implementation and configuration.
   

 •    BSI Tax Factory knowledge (if applicable).
   

 •    Payroll posting and finance integration.
   

 •    SuccessFactors Employee Central to ECP replication framework.
   

 •    SAP CPI integration monitoring and error resolution.
   

 •    Payroll cluster analysis and debugging.
   

 •    Data migration and payroll parallel run activities.
   

 •    End\-to\-end payroll process ownership from master data through to posting and reporting.

description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

Do you have exceptional customer service skills and an aptitude for technology?
  

Do you enjoy solving problems efficiently and effectively?
  

Are you action\-oriented and results\-driven?
  

  

We’re a high performance culture with laser focus on building world class products and a team that our clients love. Our flagship product, Olivia, is the AI assistant helping companies around the world reimagine the way they hire: conversations instead of job applications, automated interview scheduling, and so much more.
  

  

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to provide support excellence to customer to ensure their success with Paradox solutions. You’ll educate clients on best practices, provide support and resolve product questions, and provide guidance to help our clients maximize their hiring results.
  

  

Sound like your ideal job? We want to hear from you!
**About the Role**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Case Management:** Troubleshoot and resolve functional and technical issues submitted through the customer portal.
* **Technical Triage:** Identify system bugs and collaborate with Development and Product teams to fix them.
* **Consultative Support:** Educate customers on how to use specific features to meet their business needs.
* **Knowledge Creation:** Write and update "Help" articles and documentation for the Workday Community.
* **Tactical Configuration** : Performing routine administrative tasks that don't require a TAM’s architectural oversight, such as resetting passwords, updating permission sets, or minor CEM text edits.
* **Bug Documentation:** When a true system error is found, the Support role is responsible for documenting "Steps to Reproduce" for the Engineering team. Creation of RCA (root cause analysis) for critical or high impact tickets.
* **Knowledge Base Contribution:** Translating solved tickets into "Self\-Service" articles so customers can find answers faster next time.

**Location** : This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates must be local to Pune, India or be willing to self\-relocate. Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time. The Analyst will be working Shift 2 (11am \- 8pm IST).

Minimum 1 year of experience managing ticketing systems, support queues, or prioritized task workflows.  
*

* Prior experience in the recruiting, staffing, or HR industry preferred
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills
* Demonstrated experience delivering exceptional technical support in a SaaS or technology company
* Strong technology skills, able to quickly learn new software
* Proven ability to handle multiple priorities/projects/accounts at once
An innate desire to help, understand and find solutions  
*

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Why UKG:


At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.


We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  

  

The Product Support Representative II (S2\) is a customer\-facing role responsible for delivering outstanding voice\-based and digital support to our US customers. You’ll play a key role in resolving technical issues, guiding users on the UKG Ready application (Time, Labor, HR, and Payroll modules), and ensuring an exceptional customer experience through every interaction.
  

  

This role requires strong communication skills, technical curiosity, and a results\-driven mindset — balancing productivity goals with continuous learning and collaboration.
  

  

Primary Responsibilities
  

  

1\. Customer Support Excellence
  

Serve as the first point of contact for customer inquiries, primarily through voice\-based channels.
  

Demonstrate clear, confident, and empathetic communication while maintaining professionalism and customer trust.
  

Take ownership of customer issues by investigating, troubleshooting, and identifying root causes through a methodical process of elimination before considering escalation.
  

Manage interactions efficiently and provide timely, accurate resolutions to drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  

  

2\. Domain \& Technical Proficiency
  

Apply analytical and problem\-solving skills to investigate and reproduce customer\-reported issues.
  

Troubleshoot and resolve customer\-reported issues across applications and systems, using a structured and analytical approach; familiarity with HCM domains such as US Payroll, Time \& Labor, and HR is a strong plus.
  

Collaborate with the Tier 2 team to escalate and resolve complex product or technical concerns.
  

0–2 years of hands\-on experience with US Payroll or HR systems. (Preferred but not required)
  

  

3\. Performance \& Productivity Focus
  

Achieve and maintain high productive hours over the phone with customers.
  

Consistently meet or exceed team KPIs for quality, response time, and resolution rate.
  

Use remaining time effectively for research, learning, and skill enhancement.
  

Demonstrate ownership and accountability for individual and team goals.
  

  

4\. Process Adherence
  

Follow all UKG policies, support protocols, and documentation standards.
  

Complete assigned tasks, training, and certifications within required timelines.
  

Participate actively in meetings, huddles, and process\-improvement discussions.
  

  

5\. Team Collaboration
  

Contribute to a positive team culture by supporting peers and sharing knowledge.
  

Collaborate across functions and geographies to enhance overall customer experience.
  

Uphold the “Partners for Life” model through teamwork and customer advocacy.
  

  

6\. Adaptability \& Learning Mindset
  

Thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment with frequent product updates.
  

Take initiative in learning new modules, technologies, and troubleshooting techniques.
  

Embrace feedback and coaching to continuously improve.
  

  

7\. Work Flexibility
  

Willing to work Eastern Time Zone hours and follow a hybrid work model (6:30 PM IST to 3:30 AM IST)(minimum 3 days in office per week).
  

Open to working from the office 5 days a week as per business and operational needs.
  

During probation you are required to work from the office for all 5 days.
  

Adapt to changing priorities and operational demands.
  

  

Qualifications
  

  

3–8 years of experience in voice\-based technical support for US clients (mandatory).
  

Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  

Demonstrated ability to multitask and meet performance goals in a metrics\-driven environment.
  

Strong analytical and technical troubleshooting abilities.
  

Experience working in a tiered support environment, with hands\-on responsibility in a Level 2 (L2\) support role.
  

Bachelor’s degree (BCom, BA, BSc Computers).
  

Proficient in Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word).
  

Certification in Payroll or HR systems is a plus.
  

What Success Looks Like
  

You build trust quickly with customers through clarity and ownership.
  

You consistently meet or exceed KPIs while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  

You actively learn, adapt, and grow within the team.
  

You contribute positively to the culture and success of the broader support organization.

title: Head of Talent
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, and Kaaiser.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as AI reshapes the industries that keep economies running. Every institution that finds, develops, and places talent, whether for a company, a university system, or a country, is being rebuilt around that shift right now. Most of them are rebuilding slowly, with the same processes they used a decade ago and AI bolted on at the edges.
   

  

 Manifest doesn't have that luxury, and doesn't want it. The business is built on the premise that talent mobility, at civilisational scale, needs an AI\-native operating system, not a faster version of the old one. That premise applies as much to how Manifest builds its own team as it does to the students, schools, and universities it serves. A company that tells the world it is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity cannot run its own Talent function on spreadsheets and instinct, and cannot treat workforce planning as an afterthought to the business plan rather than the thing that makes the business plan achievable.
   

  

 This role owns Talent at Manifest globally, in full: the hiring engine, the employee experience, the leadership bench across every business unit, the workforce plan that keeps the org ahead of the business rather than reacting to it, and the AI\-powered infrastructure that ties all of it together. You are the person who translates talent into the language the executive team and the board already use for revenue and margin: capacity, capability, retention, and risk.
   

  

 You own building Talent into the kind of high\-performing, self\-sustaining organisation that Manifest expects every function to become, and proving that Talent can lead by example rather than trail behind.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most talent leadership roles inherit a function built for a single business, in a single market, with a stable headcount. This one spans five brands, multiple geographies, and a growth model built substantially through acquisition, which means the workforce plan, the leadership bench, and the AI infrastructure you build all have to absorb new companies and new people on short notice, repeatedly, without losing coherence. That is a materially harder systems and leadership problem than most "Head of Talent" titles are asked to solve, and it is why the Manifest ecosystem, the ability to move people, standards, and leadership talent across five connected businesses, is the advantage no standalone competitor for this hire can offer you.
   

  

 The timing is specific. Manifest is scaling its reach across more than 150 countries at a moment when the broader overseas education industry is contracting and Manifest is growing. Building the workforce plan, the leadership pipeline, and the AI\-native infrastructure now, while the function is still being shaped rather than fixed in place, is a materially different opportunity than doing it later, after the patterns have hardened.
   

  

**Why This Is Worth Your Next Decade**
 Most people who lead Talent at this level inherit an org chart and a reporting calendar and are asked to run both well. You are being asked to decide what the org chart should be, build the workforce plan that keeps pace with a business growing across borders, and prove that a talent function can operate with the same rigor, and the same voice at the table, as finance or product. Companies that get this right in the next five years will define how the next generation of global companies build their people functions, and how talent leadership earns a genuine seat in the room rather than an invitation to it. You would be one of the people who decided what that looks like, for Manifest and for the industry watching how Manifest does it.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Engine**
* Own the hiring strategy and standard across every brand, every geography, and every level, from individual contributor to executive search
* Build a sourcing, screening, and closing engine that runs on AI\-native tooling as the default, not the exception
* Set the bar for what a great hire looks like at Manifest, and hold every part of the function accountable to it


**Talent Operations And The Employee Experience**
* Own the full employee lifecycle globally: onboarding, offboarding, compliance, compensation coordination, people analytics, and workplace support
* Build a consistent standard of experience regardless of brand, geography, or manager
* Ensure Manifest's multi\-jurisdiction footprint runs with the same rigor a business its size requires


**High\-Performing Teams, Leadership Development, and Succession**
* Build and coach a Business Partnering team embedded in every business unit, operating as strategic peers to the leaders they support, not a support function
* Own leadership pipeline and succession coverage across the group, so every critical role has a named path to readiness rather than a gap discovered under pressure
* Set the standard for what a high\-performing team looks like at Manifest, and build the manager capability that makes that standard repeatable rather than dependent on any one leader


**Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Alignment**
* Own the workforce plan that translates business goals into people requirements, capacity, capability, and retention, the same way a financial plan translates strategy into numbers
* Build the forecasting discipline that keeps hiring, mobility, and org design ahead of the business plan rather than reacting to it
* Own Talent's presence in quarterly business reviews and board reporting, making the workforce as measurable and as credible as revenue


**Talent AI and Infrastructure**
* Build a dedicated capability that makes Talent AI\-native from the ground up: sourcing, screening, onboarding, workforce analytics, and decision support, all running on AI rather than layered with it afterward
* Own the systems architecture that connects every part of Talent into one coherent function instead of several
* Bring the same technical standard to Talent that Manifest brings to its own products


**Executive Partnership and Talent Thought Leadership**
* Be the strategic talent voice at the table when the CEO, COO, and business unit leaders are shaping direction, including on acquisitions from the earliest stage
* Represent Manifest's point of view on talent and AI\-native people practices externally, as part of how the company is known in its markets, not just how it hires into them
* Set the intellectual agenda inside Manifest for how leaders think about their people, so talent becomes a discipline every executive is fluent in, not a function they delegate to


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where Talent is today. We will calibrate the specifics once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first months, you have formed a clear, specific point of view on how the workforce plan should connect to the business plan, on where the leadership bench is strong and where it needs building, and on what the AI\-native infrastructure underneath all of it needs to look like. You have earned real credibility with business unit leaders and with the executive team as someone who understands their commercial reality, not just their headcount requests.
   

  

 By mid\-period, Talent runs measurably differently: the workforce plan is a standing input to business planning rather than a reaction to it, succession coverage exists for every critical role, and the function is visibly AI\-native in how it sources, hires, and supports people across every brand. Talent's reporting to the executive team and the board is as credible and as data\-driven as finance's.
   

  

 In the long term, you have built a Talent function, and a leadership bench beneath you, that other companies point to as a model, and that Manifest's own executive team points to as proof that talent strategy and business strategy are the same conversation.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You have built and led talent functions at real scale before, across more than one country and more than one business line, because the coordination problem here is not theoretical. You think about Talent the way a strong general manager thinks about a business: as a set of interconnected systems and bets, workforce planning, leadership development, hiring, infrastructure, not a collection of HR processes running in parallel.
   

  

 You have built high\-performing teams before, and you know the difference between a team that performs because of one strong leader and a team that performs because the systems, the bench, and the standards make it repeatable. You are fluent in workforce planning as a genuine discipline: translating a business plan into a people plan, forecasting capacity and capability gaps before they become urgent, and making the case for headcount and investment in terms the executive team finds credible.
   

  

 You are genuinely fluent in how AI changes talent work, not as a talking point but as a practitioner, and you know the difference between AI as a feature bolted onto an old process and AI as the foundation a process is rebuilt around.
   

  

 You have a real point of view on talent and you are comfortable being the voice that carries it, inside the executive team and in how the company is known externally. You have led leaders, not just individual contributors, and you hold them to a standard that is honest rather than diplomatic, while still being the kind of leader they would choose to work for again.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building, an AI\-native operating system for global talent mobility, and your first reaction was not "that's an ambitious mission statement," it was "I know exactly how to build the talent function, and the team, that proves it's true." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity across borders, an AI\-native operating system that identifies talent, develops it, and places it at civilisational scale. Through Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners), Manifest connects students, schools, universities, and employers across more than 150 countries. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as industries are reshaped by AI. Manifest is backed by $91M from Tiger Global, Square Peg Capital, Susquehanna Asia Venture Capital, and others. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically: Manifest sells the world an AI\-native way of moving talent across borders. Talent, the function, is where that standard either becomes real inside the company, in the teams it builds and the workforce plan it runs, or stays a claim on a careers page. This role decides which one it is.
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

 This is the transformation seat in that team. As UC scales, how the People function plans, measures and delivers has to be rebuilt around systems, automation and AI rather than manual effort. Owning that shift is the job. You will run it as a portfolio of projects: rebuilding how the company plans manpower and cost, automating work that today takes days, putting real analytics behind People decisions, redesigning core employee processes, and preparing the organisation for regulatory change. Each one is yours from diagnosis through design to adoption.
 



 The role reports to the Director, People Excellence, and works closely with the CHRO and business leadership.
 



  





**Why this role is different** 




 Real problems, owned end to end, with high impact and visibility. You pick what matters, build the case, and see it through to adoption.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 



* Own the transformation roadmap for People Excellence: diagnose where the function loses time, accuracy or credibility, build the business case, and sequence the work by impact
* Lead the automation and AI charter end to end, from problem definition and solution design through build with internal tech teams or vendors to adoption on the ground
* Redesign core People processes around the experience they should deliver rather than the way they currently happen, and drive the change management that makes a redesign stick
* Own People analytics: the dashboards, metric definitions and data that leadership actually makes decisions on
* Drive workforce and cost planning: the annual AOP, monthly budget versus actual analysis, and the manpower models behind both
* Run the mid\-year and annual performance management cycles for the organisation, working with People Success leadership
* Lead regulatory change readiness, starting with the new labour codes, translating legislation into process alongside consultants and internal legal
* Do the analysis yourself. This is a hands\-on role: you will pull the data, build the model and write the recommendation rather than briefing someone else to
* Own data accuracy across People systems, defining the controls that make HR data trustworthy for the People Success partners who rely on it day to day, and for Finance, leadership and auditors



  





**What we'll need:** 



* MBA with 4\-5 years of experience in HR transformation, HR operations, project management, analytics or automation
* Ownership of cross\-functional projects end to end, with outcomes you can point to
* Strong problem solving: able to break an open\-ended problem down, and comfortable working with data to get to the answer
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to choose what matters when everything looks urgent
* Ability to influence without authority, across Finance, Tech, Legal and business teams
* Hands on with Microsoft Excel and Google suite; experience with HRMS platforms (Darwinbox a plus) and a real appetite for applying AI tooling to operational problems
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the presence to hold a room with senior stakeholders
* Super organized yet agile to adapt to UC's way of working



  





**Folks you will work with:** 




 We understand that the people you work with and learn from is the single most important determinant of how much you enjoy working at a place. In fact, this defines the culture in many ways. Here is a list of UC folks you can expect to work with and collaborate with:
 


* Utkarsh Bindal, VP: Ex. Airtel, Bira91, MDI

**What can you expect:** 



* A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities \- we hire folks for a career opportunity, not just the role.

**Experience**
